rgyud 'bum/ 6) (83)0477 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can drag po gsum 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 3bal po'i paṇa ḍi ta de wa purgya ma ti dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(7) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(9)0478 gsang ba'i rgyud rnams kyi rnam par 'byed pa drag po gsum 'dul zhes bya ba/ 10le'u dang po/ 10le'u gnyis pa/ 12le'u gsum pa/ 17rgya gar gyi mkhan po de ba gu ma ti dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur/

bsdur mchan/(21) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(27)0479 lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga rdo rje be con gyi rgyud/ 28le'u dang po/ 28le'u gnyis pa/ 30le'u gsum pa/ 30le'u bzhi pa/ 31le'u lnga pa/ 31le'u drug pa/ 32le'u bdun pa/ 32le'u brgyad pa/ 33le'u dgu pa/ 33le'u bcu pa/ 34le'u bcu gcig pa/ 35le'u bcu gnyis pa/ 36le'u bcu gsum pa/ 36le'u bcu bzhi pa/ 37le'u bco lnga pa/ 37bsdur mchan/(39) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(42)0480 lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba/ 43paṇa ḍi ta a ḍa ya shrī ma ti zhes bya ba dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba bad de chos kyi dbang phyug 2

grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(50) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(52)0481 dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud/ 53dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 53gnyis pa/ dregs pa can phal pa btul ba'i le'u/ 55gsum pa/ khro bor bka' bsgo ba'i le'u/ 57bzhi pa/ gzhal yas khang lhun gyis grub pa'i le'u/ 58lnga pa/ 'bar ba'i khro bo khros pa'i tshul du bskyed pa'i le'u/ 59drug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'bar ba'i khro bo la dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 60bdun pa/ dbang du bsdus pa'i le'u/ 63brgyad pa/ dregs pa can zil gyis gnon pa'i le'u/ 65dgu pa/ gdug pa can bka' la btags pa'i le'u/ 66bcu pa/ klu gso ba'i le'u/ 67bcu gcig pa/ dregs pa can tshar gcod pa'i le'u/ 68bcu gnyis pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i le'u/ 71bcu gsum pa/ mtshan nyid brtag pa'i le'u/ 72bcu bzhi pa/ dug dbyung zhing mchod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 74bco lnga pa/ drag po 'khor lo'i le'u/ 76bcu drug pa/ dregs pas srog gi snying po phul ba dang / mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis bzlog pa'i le'u/ 77bcu bdun pa/ thug drag mchod sbyin gyi le'u/ 80bco brgyad pa/ dregs pa'i 'khor dag gis sri zhu dang gus pas mchod 3

pa'i le'u/ 81bcu dgu pa/ sa ma ya bkod pa'i le'u/ 82nyi shu pa/ gzhi byang chub snying po'i rgyu'i le'u/ 84nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ 'khor gyis mngon par bstod pa'i le'u/ 85nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ 'jig rten rdzog ser gyi le'u/ 86nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ mthar thug drag po'i las kyi le'u/ 88nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 89rgya gar gyi mkhan po a ba yug ta'i zhal snga nas zhus nas/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(90) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(102)0482 dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma/ 103dang po/ yum rnam par 'phrul pa dang / mkha' gsang rab tu ldan pa'i le'u/ 103gnyis pa/ 'khor lo bde rdzogs kyi le'u/ 104gsum pa/ klu thams cad rlag par byed pa'i le'u/ 105bzhi pa/ 'jig rten bcing zlog gi le'u/ 106lnga pa/ gsad pa sngags kyi le'u/ 106drug nga sto rab tu gsang ba'i le'u/ 107bdun pa/ bdud rtsi bum khrus kyi le'u/ 108brgyad pa/ bum pa khrol bu phye ma dang / 'de gu dang / khong du gtang ba'i le'u/ 109dgu pa/ rkun thabs kyi dug bzlog pa'i le'u/ 109bcu pa/ bsnyen sgrub kyi ltas dang / gnod rtags bstan pa'i le'u/ 1104

bcu gcig pa/ gdug pa'i dug rus pa la sleb pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u/ 112bcu gnyis pa/ gdug pa'i dug rdzas kyis gdul ba'i le'u/ 113bcu gsum pa/ dregs pa can shin tu tshar gcad pa bsreg pa drag po'i le'u/ 115bcu bzhi pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i gnon pa'i le'u/ 116rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ba yug ti dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba bla ban chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(118) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(125)0483 dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma/ 126dang po/ dug dang dug 'joms byed kyi le'u/ 126gnyis pa/ gdug pa srog gi 'khor lo'i le'u/ 127gsum pa/ dam tshig srog gi 'khor lo 'jam pa dang rtsub pa'i sngags kyi le'u/ 128bzhi pa/ phrin las mi 'gyur ba'i 'khor lo'i le'u/ 128lnga pa/ chu 'khyags lo tog 'joms byed kyi le'u/ 129drug pa/ bstan pa la gnod pa chom la dbab pa'i le'u/ 130bdun pa/ lus rnam par sba ba'i le'u/ 132brgyad pa/ yongs su gtad pa'i le'u/ 133rgya gar gyi slob dpon a ba yug ti la dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba bla ban chos kyi brtson 'grus kyis zhus te bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(134) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(137)5

0484 mi lam mthong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 138bsdur mchan/(139) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(139)0485 phyag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gnod sbyin drag po chen po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 140dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 140gnyis pa/ nges tshig gi le'u/ 143gsum pa/ dkyil 'khor dang lha'i le'u/ 144bzhi pa/ mchod pa'i le'u/ 151lnga pa/ nang dang sngags kyi le'u/ 156drug pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 160bdun pa/ las thams cad rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa'i le'u/ 164brgyad pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga'i le'u/ 166dgu pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u/ 168bcu pa/ klu gdug mdangs 'phrog gi gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 173bcu gcig pa/ tshangs pa srin po'i gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 177bcu gnyis pa/ gshin rje brang dmar gyi gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 182bcu gsum pa/ gnod sbyin gdong ser gyi gdon 'dul ba'i le'u/ 187bcu bzhi pa/ bris sku dang glegs bam gyi le'u/ 191bcwa lnga pa/ las sna tshogs kyi le'u/ 193rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po rat+na krirti dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis ri bka' drin mnos nas rgya dpe bod du spyan drangs te bsgyur/6

bsdur mchan/(201) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(217)0486 rdo rje snying po rdo rje lce dbab pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 218'di dang po ska cog gis bsgyur zhing / phyis gnyan lots+tsha ba dar ma grags kyis kyang bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(223) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(225)0487 dpal phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud/ 226dang po/ sgrub pa po gang zag bstan pa'i le'u/ 226gnyis pa/ bsgrub pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u/ 227gsum pa/ bskyed pa'i dmigs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 227bzhi pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dmigs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 227lnga pa/ 'khor bstan pa'i le'u/ 228drug pa/ rig pa phul ba'i le'u/ 228bdun pa/ sbyin sreg gi le'u/ 229rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta wa la tsan+d+ra dang / lots+tsha ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(230) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(231)0488 bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 232dang po/ rab tu dga' ba'i gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 232gnyis pa/ sgrub pa po'i gang zag bstan pa'i le'u/ 234gsum pa/ sgrub pa'i gnas bstan pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 2357

bzhi pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 236lnga pa/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i le'u/ 237drug pa/ gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u/ 241bdun pa/ 'khor nges par bstan pa'i le'u/ 244brgyad pa/ las sgrub pa'i lha rdo rje gtum po khyung gi bsgrub pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 245dgu pa/ gnod sbyin nag po sgrub pa'i le'u/ 248bcu pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 251bcu gcig pa/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 253bcu gnyis pa/ klu sgrub pa'i le'u/ 258bcu gsum pa/ klu'i nad zhugs pa brtag pa'i le'u/ 261bcu bzhi pa/ klu'i nad bsal ba'i le'u/ 264bcwa lnga pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga bstan pa'i le'u/ 265bcu drug pa/ yum bsgrub pa rnam par phye ba'i le'u/ 267bcu bdun pa/ las sna tshogs bstan pa'i le'u/ 269bcwa brgyad pa/ char dbab pa'i le'u/ 273bcu dgu pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga bstan pa'i le'u/ 275nyi shu pa/ mtshan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa'i le'u/ 278nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rgyud ji ltar bstan cing sba ba dang rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u/ 280rgya gar gyi mkhan po wa la tsan+d+ra gu ru chen po dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba glan chung dar ma tshul khrims kyis byang phyogs sha la'i dpe dang bstun te bsgyur/4 slad kyis yul dbus kyi dpe dang / kha che nas byung ba dang bstun nas legs par 8

gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(283) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(295)0489 rdo rje bde khros rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 296dum bu dang po bstan pa/ 296dang po/ gtam rgyud kyi rim pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 296gnyis pa/ sgrub rdzas kyi le'u/ 297gsum pa/ lha bsgom pa'i le'u/ 297bzhi pa/ gsang ba'i snying po dang mtshan ltas bstan pa'i le'u/ 298lnga pa/ me'i bsam gtan gyi le'u/ 298drug pa/ bsrung ba'i le'u/ 298bdun pa/ gzhan gyi gnod pa brtag pa'i le'u/ 299brgyad pa/ zhi byed mchod thabs kyi le'u/ 300dgu pa/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi le'u/ 300dum bu gnyis pa bstan pa/ 300bcu pa/ drag sngags khros pa'i le'u/ 300bcu gcig pa/ bum pa khros pa'i le'u/ 301bcu gnyis pa/ 'khor lo khros pa'i le'u/ 301bcu gsum pa/ phur pa khros pa'i le'u/ 302bcu bzhi pa/ me dpung khros pa'i le'u/ 302bcwa lnga pa/ ri rab khros pa'i le'u/ 303dum bu gsum pa bstan pa/ 303bcu drug pa/ las phra mo'i le'u/ 303bcu bdun pa/ rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u/ 304tsā na kā ras bsgyur/9

bsdur mchan/(305) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(307)0ga0 rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes bya ba/ 308dang po/ 'jug pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 308gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 312gsum pa/ gsang sngags rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 321bzhi pa/ ting nge 'dzin rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 323lnga pa/ gsang sngags kyi ye shes rnam par bsgyings pa'i rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 344drug pa/ phyag rgya'i mchod pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 364bdun pa/ byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i ye shes sgrub pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 373brgyad pa/ sbyor ba'i thabs kyis sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 379dgu pa/ sbyin sreg rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 388bcu pa/ cho ga thams cad bstan pa rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 395zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(403) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(428)0ga1 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 429dang po/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim par phye ba/ 429gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rim par phye ba/ 433gsum pa/ las kyi ririm par phye ba/ 434bzhi pa/ rnam par rtog pa gsod pa'i rdo rje'i 'khrul 'khor dang sngags 10

dang sman gyis gsad pa la sogs pa'i cho ga rim par phye ba/ 436lnga pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi go rims bri ba zhes bya ba rim par phye ba/ 442drug pa/ 'khor lo rnam par bri ba zhes bya ba rim par phye ba/ 444bdun pa/ dgug pa la sogs pa'i sbyor ba'i rim par phye ba/ 446brgyad pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 448dgu pa/ 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed ces bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 450bcu pa/ rjes su dran pa rim par phye ba/ 451bcu gcig pa/ spyod pa ston pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud rim par phye ba/ 453bcu gnyis pa/ nye bar mkho ba'i las kyi khyad par thams cad rim par phye ba/ 455bcu gsum pa/ dngos grub nges par bstan pa rim par phye ba/ 457bcu bzhi pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje sgrub pa'i thabs rim par phye ba/ 460bcwa lnga pa/ lus med rdo rje'i sgrub thabs rim par phye ba/ 465bcu drug pa/ he ru ka bsgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 466bcu bdun pa/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rim par phye ba/ 467bco brgyad pa/ 470rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mkhas pa dri paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/slad kyis lots+tsha ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis bcos la/ de las kyang dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bcos/bsdur mchan/(472) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(484)0gon dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i rgyud ces bya ba/ 48511

dang po/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i rtog pa/ 485gnyis pa/ las thams cad grub pa'i rtog pa/ 488gsum pa/ sngags btu ba bstan pa'i rtog pa/ 495bzhi pa/ bsgom pa'i rtog pa/ 498lnga pa/ bris sku'i cho ga'i rtog pa/ 501drug pa/ sbyin sreg gi las kyi cho ga rgya che ba'i rtog pa/ 504bdun pa/ bsam gtan gyi las bsgrub pa brtag pa'i rtog pa/ 508bla ma dam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i slob dpon dpal lā li ta badz+ras bton nas — mdzad/rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa bā ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas dang —/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(514) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(521)053 dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rtog pa gsum pa zhes bya ba/ 522dang po/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bri ba'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rtog pa/ 522gnyis pa/ 'jam dpal gyi rtog pa las dam rdzas sman du bsgyur te bstan pa'i cho ga'i rtog pa/ 528gsum pa/ dpal gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i cho ga las las kyi rgyud dang grogs bstan pa'i rtog pa/ 529bsdur mchan/(53)) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(536)12

0ga4 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 537dang po/ thabs dang shes rab kyi bsam gtan bstan pa'i le'u/ 537gnyis pa/ sbyor ba'i le'u/ 540gsum pa/ bris sku'i le'u/ 546bzhi pa/ sbyin sreg gi rim par phye ba'i le'u/ 547paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a mo lha'i zhabs nus pa can dang ske/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba mar pa ban+de chos kyi dbang phyug grags pas bsgyur cing zhus/slad kyis grub thob chen po kuṇ+ḍa shrī'i zhal snga nas mnyan te/ thar pa lots+tsha ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(553) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(559)055 gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa/ 560bsdur mchan/(562) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(563)0ga6 te'u lo pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba/ 564rgya gar gyi mkhan po dri pi ka ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(567) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(567)077 gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad grub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 568pa'i ta bā ro phyag rdum gyi zhal snga nas/ rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan 'diphab/13

bsdur mchan/(594) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(601)0gno dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 602dang po/ mngon rtogs kyi rim par phye ba/ 602gnyis pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi skabs rim par phye ba/ 610gsum pa/ sngags kyis 'gugs pa rab tu sbyor ba rim par phye ba/ 618bzhi pa/ 'jigs par byed pa zhes bya ba rim par phye ba/ 620lnga pa/ rgyal po sgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 622drug pa/ pha rol gyi dmag nyams par bya ba rim par phye ba/ 625bdun pa/ mi snang ba dang mig sman dang bcud len sgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 627brgyad pa/ grib gnon bsgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 632dgu pa/ ro langs gnod sbyin mo bsgrub pa rim par phye ba/ 634bcu pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rim par phye ba/ 640bcu gcig pa/ gtor ma'i rim par phye ba/ 643bcu gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i rim par phye ba/ 6gobacu gsum pa/ dbang bskur ba dang 'khrul 'khor gyi snang ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba/ 651bcu bzhi pa/ spyod pa'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 653bcwa lnga pa/ thabs thams cad sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba/ 655bcu drug pa/ dngos grub nges pa'i rim par phye ba/ 657bcu bdun pa/ lus med pa la sogs pa'i rim par phye ba/ 660bcwa brgyad pa/ byang chub sems kyi rim par phye ba/ 66514

bcu dgu pa/ pha rol gyi grong du 'jug pa rim par phye ba/ 669bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung gi 'od zer dang —/ bho ṭa paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung dang / mi'i dbang po kun dga' bzang po'i gsung dang —/ dpon kun gzhon gyis gser gnang ba la brten nas/shākya'i dge slong tsan+d+ra shrī'i zhal snga nas zhus shing / pa'i ta chen po tsan+d+ra grirnyi dang / yar lungs pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/bal yulayam bu'i grong khyer du bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(671) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(680)0ga9 dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 681dang po/ mngon par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 681gnyis pa/ 'khrul 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa'i le'u/ 689gsum pa/ sngags kyi dgug pa'i rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u/ 697bzhi pa/ 'jigs byed ces bya ba'i le'u/ 699lnga pa/ rgyal srid kyi le'u/ 701drug pa/ pha rol gyi sde rnam par 'joms pa'i le'u/ 704bdun pa/ mi snang ba la sogs kyi le'u/ 705brgyad pa/ grib ma 'phrog pa'i rab tu dbye ba'i le'u/ 711dgu pa/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le'u/ ci 713bcu pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u/ 720bcu gcig pa/ gtor ma'i le'u/ 722bcu gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i le'u/ 72815

sngag /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud/①༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa tsit+ta gu h+ya tan tra/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud/ dpal gtum po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ 'og min gyi gnas lcang (gyilo can gyi pho brang na sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yon tan dang phrin galas la gzigs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad chos kyi sku las ④longs spyod (5)rdzogs pa'i sku dang / sprul pa'i sku dang / rdo rje'i sku dang /mngon par byang chub pa'i skus 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /brjod med don gyi gsung dang / dgongs pa brda'i gsung dang / tshangs pa dbyangs kyi gsung dang / dbyer mi phyed pa'i gsung dang / rig pa 4)byin gyis brlabs ( kyi gsung gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi thugs dang / me long (8)lta bu'i thugs dang / mnyam pa nyid kyi thugs dang / so sor kun rtog 83—53

gi thugs dang / bya ba grub pa'i thugs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /gnas dang —/ gdan khri dang / 'khor dang / 'dul ba'i zhing dang / sku 'od zer ①bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang /dbang dang / drag po dang / lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin ②las kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na/ bcom ldan 'das rigs lnga dang / rigs gsum la sogs pa'i lasangs rgyas kyis sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab par gzigs nas ma chags pa'i thugs rjes rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'o/ /de'i tshe na lha ma srin ④shin tu dregs pa dang / dregs pa'i ru dra (5)zhen chags kyi 'dam na gnas pa/ nga rgyal gyi ri rab la gnas pa/phrag kyidog gi rlung sems la 'tshub pa/ gti mug mun pa'i g.yung drung na gnas pa / de lta bu dag 'dul ba'i dus la bab par gzigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs gcig tu gyur te/ mi gnas pa'i ye shes chen po las rdo rje'i rigs dang bud dha'i rigs dang / rin po che'i rigs dang / pad ma'i rigs dang / las kyi rigs su gyur te/ so so'i yum dang chas ⑦nas bzhugs te thugs 'dus pa'i byin gyis brlabs las thams cad kyi rigs kyi sangs rgyas sku bai ḍūr+ya'i (7rang bzhin ltar sngo ba/ sngon por snang ba sngo bar 6)gyur pa/ rin po che in+d+ra nī ⑩la ljang gu 11lta bu'i kha dog tu snang ba/ lcang lo can gyi cha byad phyag na rdo rje bsnams nas thugs kur 7brtan pa byung ngo / /byung bar gyur to/ /de'i mthu dang stobs kyis 'jig rten na gnas pa'i dregs pa can btul ( te/dam la btags nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las gleng gzhi'i yile'u ste skidang po'o// //83—54

yang de'i tshe na nyon mongs pa la gnas pa'i sems can zhi bas mi 'dul bar gyur pa dag gnas pa las rigs lnga'i bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 6)gsang ba'i bdag po la bka' bsgo ba ste/ kye gsang sngags dang rig ②sngags dang gzungs sngags kun gyi bdag po zhi bas mi 'dul ba'i sems can la thams cad khros pa'i tshul gyis gdul bar gyis shig ces chabaka' stsal to/ /oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ④gro dha gro ⑤dha hūṃ hūm̐ zhes ched du brjod pa lan gsum 6)ched du brjod pa las ⑦gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can mche ba gtsigs shing 'tsham pa/mig me mdag gi phung po ltar 'bar ba/ dbugs dur khrod kyi me lce niltar 'bar ba/ 'jigs pa'i nga ro bskal pa'i dus mtha' ltar sgrogs 6)pa lag pa dang rkang pa klu'i rgyal po nor bu dang nor rgyas kyi bus brgyan pa/ klu'i rgyal po nag po dang nye gnag nag 8pos se ral khar brgyan ⑩pa/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo 7'bar bas rna cha byas pa/ sbrul gdug pa 'bar ba za ba/bzhin rgyas pa/ smin ma ser nag dpral ba la bsdus pa/ gshin rje'i cha byad can / lce glog 7ltar 'gyu rdzib/ gsus po che sbrul za ba/ lag pa'i thal mo brdabs pa'i sgras 'jigs par byed pa/ klu'i rgyal po 'dab bzangs ska rags tso su bcings pa/ a la la zhes 'jigs par byed pa/ skrag ⑩par byed pa/ rgya mtsho'i zabs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa rkang pa'i pus 4 phomo tsam du phyin pa/dbang po dang nyi ma phrag pa la khur ba/ klu thams cad rlag 8par byed pa/ ha la'i gad rgyangs chen () pos dgod ru pas kun tu 'khrug par byed pa/ khams gsum 'jigs shing skrag par byed pa/ klu rnams 'chi bar byed pa zhig byung ste/83—55

rang gi gzungs sngags 'di ched du brjod do/ /tabya thā/ bho bho pā tunyen nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ i dan nī lām ba ra dha ra sha rī ②ram/ badz+ra pā ṇi skṛ nid yo/yaḥs mā ④ti kra ma tha/ mā ku la ud sā ⑤da rna bha bi ṣ+yo rtsiti/ tar+ya thā/ bud dha bud dha bi bud dha bi bud dha/ mā ti kra ma thal/ ha ra ha ra nā gā rnal/ pra ha ra pra ha ra nā gā 6)rna/ : da : ⑩da nā ga skṛ yid yā ni/ nyin da gin da nā ga marmā ṇi/ bi shrīrlus nā ga 8sha rī raṃ/ bi spo 8ṭa ya nā ga na ya nā ④ni/ tabya thā hūm̐ phaṭa/ nā ga bi ⑩tā ra ḍā ya phaṭa/ nā ⑩go ta sā da nā ya phaṭa/ nī lām ⑩ ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa ra hu)kra mā ya phaṭa/ kṛ tān tā ⑩ya phaṭa / kṛ tān ta 7 )r+sha pā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ tā sa nā ya phaṭa/ kurgyu kho'i 'omed nā ya phaṭa/ bre ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha (steka rā ya phaṭa/ yak+ṣa a pasmra sgoster bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dā ra dā ra( ste/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ nā sha ya nā sha yadu/ sarba bi bi nā sha cika rā ya phaṭa/ sarba sha 〉()/ si gha/bi nā sha ka rā ya phaṭa/ nī māṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi (nyerā dz+nyā pa 0ya ti swā hā/ de skad ces bka' stsal ma thag 69tu dregs pa can phal pa dag (1ri mo bzhin g.yo ba med par gyur te/ brgyal pu rab tu brgyal ba las phyir dran pa dusangs nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye gsang ba'i bdag po khyod ni thugs rje'i mnga' bdag kun gyi mgon dang skyabs su gyur pa lags na bdag cag gi sdug bsngal 'di las thar bar mdzad du gsol )zhes gsol to/ /de nas dregs pa can de dag dam la btags te dbang bskur (gyedam tshig phog nas byang chub tu sems bskyed do/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las dregs pa can (7phal pa btul ri ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //83—56

de nas 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can ①dag shin tu yang dregs par gyur pa dag 'di lta ste(mi/ klu rgyal rigs kyi rgyal po rgya mtsho zhes bya ba dang / rje'u rigs kyi rgyal po kun nas gdugs zhes ①bya ba dang / bram ze'i rigs kyi rgyal po chu lha zhes bya ba dang / gdol pa'i rgyal po shu la ④bu ka ra zhes bya ba dang /bdud kyi rgyal po skos rje drang dkar dang / gza' rgod chen po dang / dkar po dung na/ thor tshugs can dang / btsan 6)gyi rgyal po dmar po srog len dang /gshin rje'i rgyal po mig (5)pa dang / ma mo'i rgyal mo mkha' dbyings kyi yum dang (pe/ gshin rje'i sring mo phung byed re ba shu ti la sogs pa dang / shin tu dregs pa can gyis 'jig rten phung bar byed pa dag ma thul ba las yo)longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku lngas kye gsang ba'i bdag po yidregs pa pho mo dag thul bar ma gyur te / thams cad kyi thabs kyis dregs pa nyon mongs pa gdul (sprebar bya'o zhes bka' stsal to/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang gsang ba'i bdag po la 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /'jig rten gyi dregs pa 'di dag 'dod chags la gnas pas sems can la rnam par 'che1re.e/ kun gyi lus dang srog ma rungs par byed pas khyod kyis thams cad khros pa'i tshul gyis thul cig 4 ces bsgo'o/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa na yigebazhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' dang / rigs so sor kun nas 'dus pa rnams kyang gsung gcig gi snying ros 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /gsang ba'i bdag po khyod shin tu khros pa'i tshul 8ston la ma mchis yonapa'i stobs kyis dregs pa can thul cig ces bka' 5nyebasgo'o/ /gzhan yang rig yinasngags dang / gsang sngags ( )83—57

dang ske/ gzungs sngags kyi bdag po thams cad 'dus te/ rigs kyi bdag po dang —/ rigs kyi yum dang / rigs kyi khro bo dang / rigs kyi sprul pa dang /rigs kyi pho nya mo la sogs pa thams cad 'dus nas mgrin gcig tu bka' stsal pa / gsang ba'i bdag po gdul ①bya'i zhing 'di dag zhi ba'i cha byad kyis mi 'dul bas/ zhe sdang dang / gdug sems su bcas pa/ nyon mongs pa rang dga' mar 2spyod pa/ 'dod pa'i skom gyis gdungs pa 'di dag khyod kyi mthu'i stobs kyis shin tu khros pa'i cha byad ston la ma 'phyi ③bar myur bar rab tu thul cig ④ces bka' bsgo'o/ /de nas sku (5)mi snang ba yiye shes chen po'i ngang la bzhugs so/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud las khro bor bka' ⑦bsgo ba'i le'u ste (gugasum pa'o// //de nas rigs lnga yab 1)yum gnyis su med pa'i mkha' las thugs rjes 7khros pa'i sa bon hūm̐ mthing nag ha la nag po'i mdog lta bu (1'od zer sna tshogs 'bar ba / rab tu 'bar ba/ kun tu rab tu 'bar ba dag byung ste/ de'i byin gyis brlabs telas thugs rje byin gyis brlabs 7las e mthing rtsonag dang / yo sngo skya dang / ram̐ khaṃ tshadamar nag dang / sum̐ ⑩ser nag dang / ro dmar nag dang ske/ ka dkar 7skya dang / sna tshogs pa'i bh+rūṃ (nya'aphros par gyur to/ /de dag gi 'phro 'du 17las gru gsum mthing 9 rtenag nam mkha' dang / sngo skya rlung zla gam dang / dmar nag raka mnyata'i rgya mtsho dang / ser nag zhing chen sa gzhi dang / dkar skya keng rus ri rab dang / sna tshogs rin po che'i gzhal yas khang mthing nag rdo rje rgya gram las lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur to/ /83—58

chos nyid mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i lte ba ①mthing nag zlum po phrin ②las rnam pa bzhis lhun gyis grub pa'i rgya gram gyi rtse mo phyogs bcur 'phro bdu bar mtshams ④rin po che sna bzhi las lhun gyis grub pa/ gru chad rin po che ljang gur ⑤snang ba/ sgo bzhi rin po che sna bzhi tshad med pa bzhi'i phrin dulas su snang ba sna tshogs kyi rgyan rang bzhin du snang ba rang byung ⑦bar gyur to/ /de nas hūm̐ mthing ninag khro bo'i sa bon de las sna tshogs rdo rje phra mo'i 'od tsha tshar 'phro baX/ rdo rje phra mo'i 'od zer las tshurdo rje lcags kyu phra mo bsam gyis mi khyab pas ⑩'jig rten gyi 'dregs pa can kun dang / srog la rngam pa'i srin po pho mo sna tshogs pa bkug ste / gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du shing rtsa ba tsonas bsgyel ba bzhin du gyur te ri mo bzhin g.yo ba med par gyur to/ /mthu'i byin gyis brlabs ④kyis 'khor lo'i lte chadabus su rdo ba bskyur tsob bzhin du gyur 0to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang ste ra be+e zhes brjod pas srin po pho mo dran pa rnyed de mdun du gyur to / /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud las gzhal yas khang lhun gyis grub pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas thugs rje khros pa'i hūm̐ mthing tsonag 'od 'bar ba las de bzhin gshegs pa kun gsung gcig gis a bhi ro ṣa (peṇa hūm̐ zhes gsungs pa ()las khro gnyer bsdus shing zhal bgrad (nyepas dug gsum rtsad (nyenas gcod pa'i mche ba zur gsum gtsigs ⑥pa/ de ltar 'bar ba'i cha (pebyad du snang ba zhig byung ste/'jig rten gyi khams chen po gsum g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu g.yos/kun tu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs dugasang 83—59

ba'i rgyud las 'bar ba'i khro bo khros pa'i tshul du ①bskyed pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'ol// //de'i tshe de'i dus na/ dus gsum gyi theg pa'i bdag po thams cad 'dus te②ske/ ye shes kyi mkha' gsang ba'i bum pas 'bar ba'i khro bo de'i lus kun bkrus te ye shes kyi bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /dag par 'khru bar byed pa'i nye shing pa dang / sgrib pa sbyong zhing kun tu skyob par byed pa'i phur mo'i thal ba dang / chos nyid kyi rtsi dudang / ye shes kyi bcud mar la sogs pas 'gro ba rnams kyi tshul dang ldan pa'i phyir dbang bskur ro/ /ye shes kyi khro bo de lus la ④sim zhing rgyas te bde ba skyes par gyur to/ /de nas rigs ⑤thams cad kyi bdag po/ sangs rgyas lnga yum dang bcas pas bde ba la snyoms par zhugs te/ gnyis su med pa'i mkha' las ye shes kyi yig 'bru k+ṣi 6)mthing rgyag (nyadang ske/ k+ṣi (9)dkar mo 7dang / k+ṣi (1ser po dang / k+ṣiṃ yidamar po dang / k+ṣi ⑫ljang gu midang / k+ṣiṃ 7sna tshogs kyi mdog tu snang ba dag 'thon 7te/ gsung gcig gis bskyed bskul 7gyi sngags bka' stsal pa/ rtsu e yo raṃ khaṃ su rlo ka rbu/a bhi ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ/3ste i nyi ma sa sla la nān ga ru ṇa 6)tsa le tsa le hūṃ phaṭa ces gsungs pa las ye shes las 8nyasprul pa khyung mthing ga 6)dang / dkar po dang /ser po dang / dmar po dang / ljang gu (nyedang / so so nas sna tshogs pa 'dus pa'i khyung lus dkar ba/ gshog pa sngo ba/ rwa ye shes spu gri 'bar ba/gdug pa can 'dren cing za ba/ 'bar ba'i khro bo'i thugs rje la gnas par gyur to/ /lus kha dog lnga la ste/ mchu gnam 69lcags kyi rdo rje las grub pa/83—60

gshog ①pa nam mkha'i mtha' ma khebs pa/ mig gser zhun ma bzhin du snang ba/gdug pa'i sbrul rigs bzhi so sor za ba dag spyi gtsug dang / dpral ba dang /rna ltag (migayas g.yon dang / dbu'i ltag khung la sogs par gnas so/ /rigs so so ①phyag mtshan so sos ④dbang bskur te/ de bzhin gshegs (snyepa'i rigs kyi bdag pos (7'khor lo (spyispyi gtsug tu byin (nyete/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+pa ko3 6)rta zhes gsung kyizhing 'khor lo byin no/ /gsung ⑪rigs kyi bdag pos kyang āḥtsosarba ta thā ga ta bāg tsobadz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 yirta zhes gsung zhing chos kyi 'khor lo limagrin par gzhag yigo/ /thugs kyi rigs kyi bdag posatso/ hūm̐ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsista badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 8rta zhes thugs kur yo/rdo rje gzhag 6)go/ /yon tan gyi rigs kyi bdag pos kyang / swā sarba ta thā ga ta rata na gu h+ya (nyam bhi ṣiñtsan+tu rmāsasnye/ zhes rgya gram dang lte bar rin po che 'bar ba gzhag 4)go/ /las kyi rigs kyi bdag pos kyang hā sarba ta thā ga ta kurma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu sbos ni/ zhes gsung zhing gsang gnas su rgya gram gzhag /(steye shes kyi khro chung sku chung la spyan che ba rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub li'adzin pa/ dkar po dang / dmar po dang / ser po dang / ljang gu 4)dang / mthing ga (nyal sogs te sna tshogs pa'i khro chung 'thon no/ /'thon ⑥par gyur to//de dag gi byin gyi rlabs nu)kyis sa chen po 'di rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos / kun tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /sreg (spepa'i bskal pa'i sgra tsam yang grag sa par gyur to/ /de dag tshur du 'dus shing nam mkha' la bab susnyenas/ 'khor lo 'bar ba'i lte dbus su gnas pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gcig gis ro ṣa ṇa yak+ṣa groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi sa phaṭa ces 83—61

gsungs pa las ye shes kyi khro bo sku dug ha la nag po'i mdog ltar 'tsher ①ba/ye shes rngam pa'i spyan gsum bskal pa'i glog ②ltar 'khyug ①cing gdug pa nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin gang la bltas pa ④brlag nus shing tsha ba/ smin ⑤ma rngam pa'i glog yidrag po bzhin ser nag tu 'bar bas gti mug dang / nyon mongs pa'i mun pa sel bar byed pasti/ sma ra ser 9kyinag la ye shes kyi me 'bar ba/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags sreg 6)pa/ nyon mongs pa gti timug 'joms par byed pa'i glang po che'i ko rlon gsol pa/ nyon mongs pa'i zhe sdang 'dul ba'i rtags sum/ gcan gzan (7gyi rgyal po stag gi sham thabs bgos gtso/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog 'dul bar byed pa'i gzig tegi mgo bos tsobargyan 8pa/ nyon mongs pa'i 'khor ba ma spangs pas zhing chen gyi tsogayang gzhi gsol ba/ sbrul dkar khras dbu brgyan 6 7pa/ ser khras mgur chu byas pa/ dmar khrus phyag gdub byas pa/ ljang khras rked 12bcings byas pa/ nag khras zhabs gdub byas pa/dug (7gsum ngang gis mi spong bar nyon mongs pa'i sha khrag gsol ba/ sku dang /gsung dang / thugs dang ldan pa'i thod pa skam po dang / rlon pa dang / ne phreng gis sku la brgyan 2 pa/ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don dang ldan zhing 'khor ba khrag zhag dang 'dra ba la thugs rjes gzigs pa'i phyir zhag gi zo sonyeris kyis (nyasku la brgyan da pa/ theg pa chen po'i dbang gis thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir thal chen gyi tshom 2 bus sku la brgyan 2 pa/ chos nyid skye ba med pa'i don dang ldan zhing nor bu 'bar bas 0cha byad du snang ( meste/ dbu skra sngo nag la ral pa'i cod pan gyis bcings 2 pa/ zhabs g.yas pa brjid pa'i tshul gyis kyibaskum nas gnas pa/ zhabs g.yon pa drag po'i tshul gyis bsgrad nyanas gnas pas (1srog 83—62

la rngam 6)pa'i srin po pho mo brdzis pa/ phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdeg ②pa'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa na sdigs ①pa'i mdzub ④mo phyar (9ba dag tu snang ba zhes rgya gram dang / ral gri du'abar bas yan lag bzhi la las kyi byed pa por dbang bskur ro/ /dam rdzas ⑦bdud rtsi rnam pa 6)lngas dbang bskur nas phrin 6)las thams cad kyi byed pa por dbang bskur te/ de yang gnyis su med pa'i 0rol pas so/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs (7gsang ba'i rgyud las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'bar ba'i khro bo la dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas dpal rdo rje gtum po lag na rdo rjes sdigs mdzub 7ni bsgreng / rdo rje ni spar nas 'bar ba'i khro bo'i lta bas kun tu bltas 8te/ spyan ni bzlog /zhal ni bgrad tsonas zhal nas snyirngam pa'i sgra skad ni ha ha/ hūm̐ hūṃ/ a la la/i i/ dhi dhi/ ho ho/ zhes pa'i byin rlabs tsolas phrag pa gnyis rab tu 'bar te/ rdo rje khro bo tshudakar ba/ rnam par dkar ba dag mtha' yas pa 'thon (nyeto/ /dpral ba rnam par 'bar ba las khro bo mthing ga 5)sna tshogs pa 'thon nu to/ /mgrin pa rab tu 'bar ba las khro bo dmar po rnam par dmar ba dag 'thon 41to/ /thugs ka rab tu 'bar ba las rdo rje khro bo nag po rab tu 'bar ba sna tshogs pa 'thon ru to/ /sku lte ba rab tu 'bar ba las rdo rje du khro bo ljang gu ( sterab tu 'bar ba dag 'thon sogeto/ /'bar ba'i khro bo de dag kyang 'bar ba/ rab tu 'bar ba/ kun tu rab tu 'bar ba/ me lce lta bu ste/shin tu rngam pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa/ dgod pa'i mdog tu snang ba/ log 83—63

sred can dag la gshe ba'i mdog tu snang ba/ thams cad thugs rje chen pos kun la khyab pa/ thugs zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / drag po dang —/ phrin las bzhi yis 6)sku'i dngos po shin tu bsgyur te 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /zhal nas rngam pa'i sgra sgrogs ②pa de dag kun kyang khro bo'i stang stabs dang / mchongs ri)pa dang / 'gying ba dang / rtse ba dang / spyan bgrad ④pa dang / mche ba gtsigs (5)pa dang / khro gnyer mi bzad pa gtsigs pa shin tu mi bzad pa'i khro bor sprul te/ rtsi mchog gi rgyal po ma gi ta'i (0)drir ldan pas gdug 75pa can kun gyi snying rab tu rul bar byed pa de lta bu'i 'bar ba'i khro bo 98)de dag sprul rab tu sprul par gyur to/ /de nas rngam pa'i gsung gis drag po'i sngags bka' stsal pa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa13/ oṃ bi pu le7/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa (nyapra ba ra nā ga /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa 7ma hā nā ga skṛ tsod ya/ ā 8bar te/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/sarba nā ga ṣ+ṭṛ da yā ni/ ā bar te dz+wa la7/ sarba nā ga hre da yā ni⑩/ ki mi ki mi / nā ga ku lā ni tshabi snyi sa nī/na/ ha na ha na/ sarba nā ga dus/ skṛ da yā ⑪ni / da ha da ha/ sarba duṣ+ṭan 2 snanā ga brnya ( nyani/ pa tsa pa tsa/ pā tsa ya pā ⑤tsa ya/ sarba dusnyi nā gā 8 rna/ a kra ma a kra ma/ su kra ( stem sa ka ra bi ma li/bi kra ma/ ma hā nā ga te dza ba re swā hā/ zhes pas de dag thams cad yur yur por gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen ( mipo'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ rab tu g.yos/ kun tu rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud las dbang du bsdus pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //83—64

de nas dregs pa can de dag zil gyis gnon lho)pa'i phyir rdo rje nam mkha' la gsor bas dregs pa can de dag shing lo rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin no/ /de nas rngam pa'i gsung dang / brjid pa'i sku las 'di skad gsungs so/ /khro bo'i rgyal po nga nyid kyis/ /srid pa gsum na gnas pa ②yang / /thams cad ma lus zil gyis gnon②/ /rigs bzhi klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas/ /gzi byin drag pos gnon ④par bya/ /nga ni mthu stobs bdag po ste/ /rngam pa'i gsung dang brjid pa'i sku/ /phyag rgya drag pos zil gyis gnon ⑤zhes ched du brjod pas yibarjod nas brjid gnon ⑦gyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba bcas te phyag sor mo bsnol te mthe (gyibong gnyis dang mthe 6)chung gnyis so sor rtse sprad nas brkyang (rtengo ske/ /phyag gi mthil 'khor lo can yang thur du bstan te shin tu mi bzad pa'i sngags bka' stsal pa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇa ḍa badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ rgyu(spe/ ga ru ḍa pak+ṣikyi/ hūṃ rtsu/ jo mā (nyal ba ri tsi/ tsi tshesri tsa rtsu phaṭa ces ched du 8brjod pas yidregs pa can dang klu thams cad myos rab tu myos nas bka' bzhin bgyi'o zhes gsol to / /de dag thams cad kyang myos pa'i chu drag po 'thungs 0)pa lta bu'am/skyes bu gnyid tu kyis gdungs pa lta bu ste/ de dag thams cad kyis zhanamagrin gcig tu gsol pa/ kye ma gsang ba'i bdag po bcom ldan 'das/ /rig sum̐ )sngags 5nyebadag po khro bo'i rgyal/ /khyod kyi rig sngags smod ru pa yis/ /shin tu mi zad 'gyerab tu myos/ /'bangs su mchi zhing bka' bzhin 'tshal/ /thugs rje can gyis ( stebadag cag la/ /rab tu dgongs shig ru 'bangs su mchi/ /slad ma rnams la 'tshe mi bgyid ces dam bcas so/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud las ( nadregs pa can zil gyis gnon khri pa'i le'u ste brgyad 83—65

la ba der 'ongs te mchod pa'i yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs pas mchod nas rdo rje khro bo de la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye khro bo'i bdag po chen po dregs pa gdug pa can 'di dag ni shin tu ma rungs par gyur na/ 'di dag brid nas bstan pa gnas pa'i thabs kyi spro ba mdzad du gsol zhes gsol pa las lha'i dbang po nyon cig /klu rnams kyi rdzas rnams rdzas sna tshogs pa bsags la/ bdag nyid kyi lus dag cing gtsang bar byas la longs ma spyad (kyepa'i ras dkar po bgos te/mngar ba dang gsur ④ba'i dri zhim po dang ldan pa'i thig les phyilus byugs 6)la bu ⑦ram dang / sha kha (8)ra dang / sbrang rtsi mur bar byas la zhag bdun nam dgu'i gong nas kha zas ngan pa spang bar bya'o/ /lus kyi rnam pa la rma bya'i sgro lnga 6)btsugs 7te/ shes rab can gyis bya ba'o(/nya/ /klu'i sman sna tshogs pa dang 'jam pa'i 'bru bsres pa'i phye ma mngar ba'i chus sbrus 7te ri lu sha rtug yi gi 'bru tsam brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /klu sman rnam pa tha dad pa yang blugs te dkar ba tshul sogs pa dang ldan par bya'o/ /de nas thugs rje yichen pos yigazigs te/ klu yi 7rgyal po 'khor dang bcas/ /dga' dang gus pas spyan 'dren gyis/ /rtse zhing gdung bas 1nyatshur shog cig /dga' zhing 67gus pas mngan ( rtemi sems/ /kun kyang brtse 5stobs tshur shog cig( ge /ces bka' stsal pas de dag kun gyi dbang po kun kyang shin tu dngas rmo gepar gyur nas sha 6 )rid la sbrang ma 'dus pa lta bu ste/ kun kyang dga' ba'i mdangs dang chas nas gang na ba der 'khod do/ /83—66

sngags bka' stsal pa/ nā ga rā dza sa ma ya swā hā zhes bka' stsal pas6)/ ⑧kun kyang tshim par gyur to/ /de dag kun gyis kyang mgrin gcig gis dam tshig gi rim pa phul ba/ dpa' bo chen po khro bo'i bdag /khyod kyi bka' las 'das gyur phyin/ /bdag cag rnams kyi mgo lus snying / /dum bur gas nas rul bar shog /tabya thā/ oṃ tsa ṭā tsa ṭā/ bi tsi khul/ sha tha sha tha/ swa tsa ⑤te swā hā zhes gsol to/ /dpal rdo rje gtum po thugs gsang ba'i rgyud las gdug pa can bka' la btags ⑥pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas yang dbang po chen pos gsol pa/ kye ⑦rdo rje khro bo dag dregs pa can 'di dag shin tu ma rungs par gyur na/ la la ni rus pa chag cing grugs/la la dag (kyeni tshe'i 'du byed mtha' la gtugs su nye/ la la dag ni nam 6)mkha' lding dbu'i gtsug tor (lhan gnas pas len pa'i sdug bsngal gyis (spregazir/la la dag ni 'khrag bskams/ la la dag ni sen mo dang yan lag chag /la la dag ni gti mug gi gnyid log pas byang chub kyi snying po mi shes/ la la dag ni rtsa dang rgyus pa chad de/ nad rnam 7pa sna tshogs kyis gdungs/ la la dag ni lus kun tsha ba'i nad kyis nyam yithag /la la dag ni rtse 7zhing tsoming yang mi grag() /la la dag ni nyon mongs pa rgyas te sngon spre sems bskyed pa rjes su mi dran / la la dag ni sems bskyed pa (/narjes su dran yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mi mthong / la la dag ni yi dgas (gekyi khams lta bu ste kha zas kyi skal ba dang mi ldan na 'di dag gso ba'i thabs bka' stsal du gsol zhes gsol pa las lha'i dbang po dag dbang po'i lag pas ni lag pa chad pa sos par 'gyur ro/ /83—67

par rgyal/ / bsdigs par 6)bya ba 'di dag go/ /shin tu khros bcas mgo stod ⑧la / /mkha' lding ga durur sprul par bya/ /rdo rje khro bo 'chol ④ba gdon/ /phyogs bcur rdo rje spro bar bya hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ/ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ⑤yi ༷āḥ nā ga pra tha pra tha/hūm̐ nā ga nā sha ya phaṭa/ ces bka' stsal pas dregs pa can de dag lus la gcad ⑦gtubs kyi sdug bsngal byung gis ⑧dogs te/ 'phral nyid du gdug pa can de dag shin tu bred ⑨par gyur te bka' bzhin du nyan no0/ /shin tu 'jigs dngangs yinas bcom ldan 'das thugs rjes gzigs su gsol zhes bka' nyan no / /de nas gags gcad 7par 'dod na sbyin sreg tsobazhin las bya'o/ /gang na ba der cha bsnyams skyil/ /nag po dri dang 8ldan par byug /zur gsum sum brtsegs thur ⑩du brko—/ /kha khyer thams cad rdo rje gnagatso /dbus su gzhal yas rgya gram 4)bri/ /se skyer gdug pa'i shing dag la/ /zur gsum khru do'i tshad du brtsigadu /logs la rak+ta'i 0tshar tshar btang ⑥/ /tsher can nag po ri zur gsum bshag(ste /brag nag skyes pa'i tshe yinag shug /sor ni bdun bdun tshad du bya/ /ma tsodu zur gsum sor gsum tshad/ /'bru chan dunanag po rak+tar ()sbyar/ /ming bya sbyin sreg gyurab tu sbar/ /brgya rtsa brgyad rdu )de nyi shu gcig /dmigs pa che ge'i ling ga ni/ /dri ma khu chu khrag dag dang / /skra dang rkang rjes gos la sogs/ /tshogs par bsogs la a mu ()rka /de la dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥsgonyes dgug /yi dgas ru gang gnas mtshon pa bla/ /sbrul gdug dmigs pa'i gzugs su bya/ /gnon par byed pa mtshon byas dzaḥ(ste/ /snying gar so)bris la gan rkyal (nyamadun/ /thun brab gdab sngags ()bskor bcas dbul/ /mā phyir ya dang bcas pa'o/ /nag po'i chas bgo re 6)stan sa/ /stod g.yog zhu sngon po 83—69

de nyid 6)la bcom ldan 'das kyi spyi bo'i gtsug nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gnang ba/ sngags rnam pa ②gsum gyi bdag por gyur pa phyag brnyan dulag na rdo rje zhes bya ba kha dog sngon po cher grags pa/ phyag g.yas pa na rdo rje rtse dgu pa thogs pa/ g.yon pa na nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po drag po thogs pa zhig rgya mtsho chen por zhugs so/ /de nas nam mkha' lding gi gshog ④pa bskyod pas rgya mtshor zhugs te/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo (snyedang / 'jog pos rang gi bdag po'i spyi bor 'dud (9)do/ /nye dga' bo dang dung skyong gis rna cha byas so/ /rigs ldan gyis mgul rgyan du byas so/ /pad+ma dang pad+ma chen pos lag gdub tu byas so/ /sprin gyi shugs can gyis se ral khar bcings so/ /hu lu hu lus ska rags su byas so/ /'brug sgra dang bdud 'joms kyis rkang gdub tu byas te/slar bdag (7po'i lag pa g.yon par song ngo / /de nas gnod sbyin bye ba tshug bcu dang / drag po'i rigs rnams brgyal ba las sangs te/ phyogs kun tu bltas pa las phyag brnyan (shelag na rdo rje rgya mtsho'i nang na yina'adug pa mthong nas/rings par kye ma a la la bdag cag gi gtso bo nyid bzhugs so/ /zhes brjod nas song 7ba las phyin te/ bltas pas cher drag pa skra kham pa gyen du 'phags pa / mig me mdag gi phung po ltar 'bar ba/ mche ba gcigs pa/ lce glog ltar 'gyu ba/ gsus pa rdzing bu /nyeltar 'khyil ba/ rgya mtsho'i zabs tu su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa rkang pa'i pus tsho mor phyin pa/ klu'i rgyan cha bdun dang ldan pa/ lag pa g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu pa thogs pa/ g.yon na nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po drag po thogs pa/ sku byin po la dpag tshad nyis kha'abum drug khri yod pa bzhugs so/ /de nas gnod sbyin rnams kyis gsol pa/ gtso bo khyod 83—141

kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i don drag po rgyas par gson ①cig dang ②/bdag cag rnams kyis zhu bar ma spobs kyis ③zhes gsol nas/ lag na rdo rje la gos sngon po dar la bai ḍūr+ya ri )zhun ma'i nang du btsos pa zhig bla gos su gsol to(ge / /stag gi pags 95)pa drug stong gis sham thabs su bcings so/ /de nas lag na rdo rje rings par bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te/ mdun du snying po dang ldan pa'i skyil mo krung ⑦bcas te 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 98)nam mkha' dang sa gzhi (9)la gzigs nas/bar snang du yang spyan gyis 'khor bar gzigs so/ /de nas khaṃ phroṃ saṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod do/ /de nas lag bon rdo rje stan las langs nas/ rdo rje thal mo rang gi snying gar 31sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /kye ma bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba drag 8po'i don bdag dang sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir zhu na/ ci bcom ldan 'das kyis skabs dbye bar gnang ngam zhes gsol pa dang / ci yang mi gsung bar bcom ldan 'das gdug pa'i tshogs nges par 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ zhugs ma thag 7tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'khod pa'i gdug pa can 7thams cad snying 'dar bar gyur to/ /de nas ting nge tsha'adzin de las bzhengs nas/ lag na rdo rje la gzigs te byed pa g.yon pa'i chu shing snying po nas drangs te bkug pa'o/ /byed pa skyes pa'i chu shing sgra dang bcas pas brkyang ba byas te gnas so/ /de nas lag na rdo rje phyag rgya de nyid yang dag par rig ste/ tshig 'di skad ces brjod de/ khyed la sogs pa'i 'khor dag sa phyogs 'dir ma gnas par phyogs gzhan du dengs 83—142

shig /gal te mi 'gro na khyed ①la sogs pa'i snying 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brjod pas sgra gnas kyi khung bur sgrib byed kyi tshogs song ste/ snga ma bzhin du 'khod do/ /lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje me lce'i rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas phyag na rdo (brje yis/ /thub pa'i sku la 'di skad gsol/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje drag po'i don/ /rgyas par bdag la bshad du gsol/ /gsang ba'i bdag po legs par yang / /nyon la yid la zung ①shig khyod/ /nga yi gsang ba gang yin dang sti/ /rdo rje drag po gang yin pa/ /nga (snyel mtshan nyid gzhan med de / /khyod nyid kyi ni rgyud zhudang yang / /khyod kyi bya ba'i las bshad bya/ /skye ba bzhi ⑦bsdus sems can rnams/ /gdug pa can gyis gtses (shegyur pa/ /thabs su ldan pa'i bzlog pa yipo)/ /mtshan ma nges par bshad par bya/ /ba ni rnam par snang mdzad de/ /dza ni mi bskyod kyithub pa'i sku/ /ra ni rin chen 'byung ldan sku/ /me lce'i (7yig 'bru gsum po la/ /dang por gtso bo bshad bya ba/ /pā 7ni rdo rje 'joms byed ma/ / ṇa ni pad+ma 'joms byed ma/ /4 yi yini kun 'gro 'joms 7byed ma/ /'og btags 8gsum po ming mthar sbyar/ /e ni kun tu go 7byed de/ /ra ni smin par byed pa ste/ /pa ni kun nas sdud pa yin//sa ni yongs su rten yi pa'i las/ /ya ni yang dag bskyod par bshad/ /go 'byed gnyis pa'i steng gnas pa'i/ /sna ldan //dag tu shes par bya/ /de las nges par byung ( )bas na/ /kun snang gang yin dngos dang sbyar/ /bsam pa'i dngos la 'jug rnams kyi/ /yan lag thabs rnams thams cad du/ /gong du 83—143

smos nas brjod pa yin/ /don du gsal bar zlos pa yi4)/ /tshig ni rgyas par brjod mi dgos/ /las las grub pa'i gzugs rnams la/ /drag po yongs su ston pa dang / /gnod sbyin be con thogs rnams la/ /gtso bo'i don du bshad pas na/ /tshig tu nges par yang dag brjod/ /khyod kyi lung 'chang rab dga' bas / /de nyid rigs su byung ba ste/ /kun kyang drag po'i las la dga'/ /snang ba dag par mi mthong bzhin/ /de nyid la ni nges par brjod/ /gong du bstan pa gang yin pa/ /so so dag la gdon mi za/ /sbyor ba sna tshogs des bsgrubs na/ /snang bar 'byor pa sna tshogs pa/ /mngon du rgyas shing nges par gsal / /snang ba chen po bdag med par/ /rgyud pas yongs su grub (mipa yin/ /kun rdzob gong ma'i tshig lta bu(2)/ /dngos po bsten ④pa lta bur mthong / /don dam 'og ma'i sgra lta bur/ /nyon mongs kun bsregs (5nyerang bzhin gyis/ /'od gsal ba ru gnas pa yin(6/ /snying po don dam la 'jug pa/ /phyi rim 63)kun rdzob la brten bya/ /dang por sangs rgyas mi gnas shing / /snga ma'i bya ba sbyor bar brtson tsho/ /dbang thob pa la rlom sems med/ /bla ma'i 6)man ngag nges pa las / /bla ma nyid la ci nus kyis/ /yang dag par ni mchod par bya/ /rdo rje ngo bo kun 'byung dang / /gdug pa thams cad sreg kyiphyir gang / /dngos po la 'jug gong ma'i sgra/ /gong ma'i tshig tu brjod pa yin/ /lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje me lce'i rgyud las/ nges tshig gi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //gos sngon lag na rdo rje yis/ /sangs rgyas mgon la 'di skad gsol/ /gang zhig bsgrub par bya ba yi1lha/ /thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gsung du gsol/ /83—144

yin / /'phang du ①tsho gang tshad byas te/ /dang po ②byang shar mtshams nyid nas//kun rten kha dog rigs mthun niblang / /yongs su bsdus byas nges par bya/ /gnyis pa gnyis pa nyid du nges/ /gsum pa gcig gi tshad dang ldan/ /de ltar tshad du ldan pa las/ /shin tu mnyam par 'thas par bya/ /de nyid rjes su 'jug pa yis/ /dang po'i srad ④bu gang yin pas/ /kha dog ser po'i thig gdab bya/ /dkyil 'khor dgu ru nges pa las⑤/ /'bru dang sa dang rin chen dang / /phye ma nyid du btags pa yis/ /dkyil du pad+ma bcu drug pa/ /'dab ⑥mar ldan par bri bar bya/ /shar dang lho dang nub byang dang / /mtshams rnams su yang de bzhin bri/ /le 9metshe'i pad+ma gang yin pa/ /sna tshogs par ni yang dag bshad / /mtshams rnams su ni mchod pa yi/ /lha mo yongs su dgod par bya/ /sgo bzhi dag tu khro mo bzhi/ /sbyor bas yang dag dgod par bya/ /rin chen pha gu 'dod yon dang / /dra ba dra phyed yang dag ldan/ / twa ra ṇa ni bzhis (kyibargyan cing / /sna tshogs rdo rje gzhir 6)gnas yin/ /gdugs dang ri dgas tīgang yin pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par sgegatunye /sngags pa byang chub blo ldan pas/ /keng rus phreng ba nyid dang yang / /sbrul mgo'i phreng bas yirnam par brgyan12/ /rdo rje sna tshogs rab 'bar ba'i/ /phreng bas sa/phyi rol legs par bskor/ /zur bzhi dag tu bum pa bzhi/ /rgyan gyis rdzogs par yang dag bri / /de dkyil phyag na rdo rje nyid/ /snga ma'i tshul gyis yongs su gnas/ /shar du khams gsum rnam rgyal nyid/ /yang dag par ni bri bya ste/ /kha dog dmar po nyid la yang / /dbu gsum phyag ni drug pa'i dbyibasadhi/ /zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /pho ni tshardo rje nges pa las/ / mo ni sna tshodagra sta yang dag 83—146

ldan / /bar stim gnyis kyis 'ching byed pa/ /gung (mimo mthe bo nges mdud ④nas / /gzhan rnams yongs su brkyang pa yin/ /de nyid snying po gang yin pa/ /snying gar 4)yang dag bzung ⑥byas nas/ /de 'og pho yis zhags pa 'dzin/ /mo yis ral gri ⑦bzung byas pa/ /dang po nyid la dgod par bya/ /lho ru nag po chen po nyid/ /kha dog dud sprin lta bu la/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa'i dbyibasal/ /pho nyid tsan dan beng chen bsnams/ /mo ni zhags pa yongs su 'dzin / /khro zhal gzigs pa mi bzad ⑧pas/ /phyogs bcu rnams su rab tu gzigs / /de nyid mgon po gang yin pa/ /phyogs gnyis par ni rab tu dgod / /nub phyogs gsum par dgod bya ba/ /lus ngan sras po stobs po che/ /kha dog ljang gu yo)nyid la yang / /chung 7zad spyan ni rgyas pa nyid/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa la/ /spyi bor rdo rje rmog hu gis brgyanatso/ /g.yas pa nyid la rdo rje can/ /g.yon pa ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis drang por rab gnas te/ /shar phyogs bltas pas yongs su gnas/ /byang phyogs bzhi par dgod bya ba/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yongs su gnas/ /kha dog sngon po de nyid la / / tsham rngam yi khro gnyer brjid pa'i zhal/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang stang liṃstabs tshul/ /phyag gnyis brang du rab bsnol te/ /g.yon du nges par cung zad gzigs/ /lhor bltas yang dag dgod par bya/ /byang shar rdo rje gnod sbyin teli/ /kha dog dmar nag 'jigs pa la/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rab bzhugs nas/ /phyag g.yas gri gug rnon po 'phyar/ /g.yon pa cang te'u drag po rdung ⑩/ /gtso bo la bltas dgod par bya/ /shar lho rdo rje ro langs ོnyid / /kha dog sngo /sheskya rab 'bar la/ /mi bzad 'bar ba 'jigs pa'i //83—147

gzugs / /cung zad g.yas su nges par gzigs/ /g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum tshul gnas te/ /rdo rje lcags sgrog rab bzung nas/ /gung 0)srin la sogs gsum po rnams/ /dam ( por bkug pas yongs su bsdams/ / mtheb mdzub ①bzhi rnams rab brkyang ste/ /spyi bor nges par bsnol bar bsnams/ /lho nub rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste/ /kha dog dmar skya nyid la yang / /shin tu mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhabs gnyis mthil sbyar btsugs pa la/ /nam mkha' gru bzhi pa ru 'dod/ /lag gnyis spyi bo 6)thal sbyar nas/ /me lce 'bar ba yongs su 'dzin/ /thod pa lnga yis mgo brgyan pa(snye/ /gtso bo la bltas dgod par bya/ /nub byang bzhi pa'i mtshams su yang / /rdo rje 'jigs byed zhes ⑥bya ba / /kha dog sngo nag na'ajigs pa'i gzugs/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa la/ /zhabs gnyis dag tu rnam par bshad/ /g.yas g.yon dang po glang chen gyi/ /pags napa yongs su brkyang ba 'dzin/ /de 'og g.yas pa dgra (9)sta la/ /g.yon pa rdo rje yang dag 'dzin/ /gsum pa'i g.yas na lcags kyu ste/ /g.yon na mi mgo rlon 7pa bsnams/ /brkyang bskum tshul du gnas nas kyang / /gtso bo nyid la kha bltas bzhugs/ /mtshams kyi gru chad (nyagang yin par/ /'od skyed ma dang yid 'phrog ma/ /kun bzang ma dang glu sgra can/ /rang gi phyogs kyi kha dog la/ /shin tu zhi bas ldem bag can/ /phyag g.yas su ni me tog dang / /dri dang zhal zas sgra brnyan lornams/ /gar gyis rol par yang dag ldan/ /nu ma cung zad 'bur ba la/ /dar dag dkar pos smad g.yogs pas/ /gtso bo la bltas mdzes pa'i gzugs/ /phyi yi grwa 1 ru dgod par bya/ /sgo rnams su ni sgo skyong ni//srog gcod ma dang dbugs rngub ma/ /khrag 'thung 7)ma dang sha za ma/ /zhal 8(3—148

blta ①zhing / /shar phyogs khro bo'i snying po bzlas/ /de nas de nyid mthong ba dang ske/ /ha la ha la'i sgra yang ②brjod/ /ba yi ①rnam lnga nyid dang ni/ /rams dang mthing shun dri chu la/ /sbyar bas ④tsho gang mtho gang gi/ /dkyil 'khor zur lngar ldan par bya/ /dkyil gyi lte ba nyid la ni/ /lha yi tshogs rnams nges par dgod/ /zur lnga pa dang 'dabs 'byor ⑤du/ /zur gsum pa dang sor brgyad pas/ /yongs su zabs su bru bar bya/ /'og tu sman gyi phye ma yis/ /legs par bdal (6)bar bya ba yin/ /de dang de nyid gzugs byas la/ /spra tshil las sbyar sor bcu'i tshad/ /drag po rid par gyur pa la/ /lag gnyis sar kho ba gdengs (8)par bya/ /skyer pa'i phur pa sor bzhi pas/ /mtha' ma yongs su bskor bar bya/ /steng yang phur pa yungs kur 6)la/ /sngags bzlas pa yis yongs su bsnun⑩/ /gtor ma stobs rnams skyed byed dang / /mchod pa lnga yis dus ḍo/nyeganyis su/ /yang dag par ni mchod par bya/ /rang nyid snga ma'i tshul gnas la/ /yid ches phreng ba rab bzung nas/ /drag po'i rigs la rtsa ba'i sngags/ /tshad du phyin par yongs su bzlas/ /de mtha'i snying po ma lus pa//brgya rtsa brgyad dag bzlas par bya/ /de yi mtha' ru bzlas bya ba/ /de yi srog snying nges par bzlas/ /skyer pa'i tsher ma rab spangs la/ /dkyil 'khor mtha' ru gnas par bya/ /de nas 'gugs pa'i sngags bzlas yonyebya/ /tshad du nges par thim byas la/ /de nyid 'ongs par ma gyur na/ /gu gul nag po'i dud pa yis / /de bkug sngags lho kyis mngon par bzlas/ /lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas pa las/ /yongs su dgug par bya ba yin/ /de nas sngags pas nad pa nyid/ /mdun du mngon par bkug byas la/ /sngags chus nges par gtor 7bar bya/ /83—178

la zhugs byas la/ /skar ma dag la nges par bsgomasti/ /chang 'du ba la gnas bcas la/ /shes rab zung du ldan pa yis/ /skar ma nyid la mnyam sbyar la/ /brgyud pa yis ni sngags bzlas bya/ /zhag grangs brgya rtsa brgyad pa yis/ /yang dag pa ru bsgrub par bya/ /de nas zhag grangs thim par bya/ /mtha' ru mtshan mo thog thag par/ /sngags dag nges par bzlas par byaphyi/ /de nas ske tshe yungs kur chadang / /khrag dang sbrang rtsi sbyar ba yis/ /sbyin sreg ④stong du thim byas la/ / ka ra bī ⑤ra'i lhug ma la/ /tsan dan dkar po'i chus bskus te/ /me tog phreng ba btags pa yis/ /lag pa g.yas su thogs byas te/ /yid ches spu la thag pa yis/ /yang dag pa ru bkal khunyenas ni/ /bdag gi spyi bor bcing ⑦ byas te/ /de nas grong khyer rgyus pa na⑧/ /kun gyis phyag byed mchod par byed/ /'jig rten kun gyis phyag byed cing / /snying du sdug par nges pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs phra 1)men mas/ /bdag la lung ⑩yang nges par ston/ /sdug bsngal rtag tu mi 'byung zhing / /lha min la sogs gdug pa yis/ /de yi phung por (nyamathong ba yin/ /bdag la sdig 8pa mang po 'jug /de la 'jigs pa bskyed mi bya/ /bdag la gdug pa sna tshogs pa/ /gnod pa sna tshogs byed pa na / /de la 'jigs pa mi bskyed yi cing / /sems dga' ba yis yongs su mchod / /oṃ ka pā la dha ra sid+dha yeñtsa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa tsosarba na maḥs māṃ tso hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ḍā ki n+ya ba shī ka rā ya maswā hā/ oṃ sarba lo kā ba shrī ka rā ye tu rtsu/oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭa tsi t+ta sa //na ya phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa ba ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can rdo rje me lce'i rgyud las tshangs pa srin po'i gdon 'dul ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //83—181

badz+ra pra be sha ya/ sa 'di srungs shig byer ya/ bh+yor ma ma chahā a hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa swā hākhu/ de nas gzungs 'di gsungs ma thag tu nam mkha' la gnam lcags drag po'i rdo rje'i thog phab nas/ dgra dang / gdon dang / lo tog ma rungs par byed pa thams cad kyi lus dum bu ②dum bur gtubs nas rdul phra rab bzhin du brlag par byas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis cho ga bka' stsal pa/drang srong chen po sa'i dkyil 'khor byagru bzhi pa byi dor byas nas ba'i rnam lngas byug par bya'o/ /tsan dan dang rgya spos dri zhim pos byug par bya'o/ /me tog sil ma dgram mo/ /bum pa gang ba gzhag ②go/ /mar me bud ༅do/ /gtor ma bzang po gzhag (7go/ /lcags sam seng ldeng gi phur pa gzugs so/ /dbus su rdo rje snying po gzhag (kyepar bya'o/ /de'i mdun du klu mtha' yas gzhag 6)go/ /de nas mchod par 'dod na me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lnga bya'o/ /klu mchod par 'dod na 'khar ⑩ba'i snod du 'o ma dang / klu sman sna tshogs dang / rtsi sman sna tshogs kyis bya'o/ /nad dang dug bsrung (stebar 'dod na tshil chen dang /gla rtsi dang / skud pa sngon po dang / rma bya'i sgros bya'o/ /klu nag po chen po ⑫la ni tshil chen dang / gla rtsi dang / tshon yinaskud sna lnga dang / seng ldeng gi phur pas bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad la ni phur pa dang / yungs kur yigyis bya'o/ /skya rengs 8'char ma'i gdon la ni phur pa dang / yungs kur dang / yungs rdzinag dang / ske tshe dang / thal chen gyis bya'o/ /'byung po kun du rgyu ba la ni phur bu lnga dang / thod pas bya'o/ /gzhan dag gsad par 'dod na phur pa dang / gzugs dang / thod pas bya'o/ /gnon 9par 'dod na thod pa dang /dug dang / yungs kur /nyegyis bya'o/ /lo tog gzhom par 'dod na thod pa 83—221

dang —/ dug dang / yungs kur ①dang / tshil chen dang / khrag sna tshogs la bya'o / /lo thog bsrung ②bar 'dod na thal chen dang / ske tshe dang / phur bus bya'o/ /kun tu bsrung ②ba zhes bya ba gzhan gyi sbod ④gtong bzlog par 'dod na mchod rten (snyedang gzugs dang / thod pa dang / yungs kur ⑥dang /phur pas bya'o/ /thams cad zhi bar 'dod na thab khung rnying ⑦par tsan dan nam rgya shug nil me btang la/ dkar gsum dang / mngar gsum dang /'bras dang / til dang / mar dkar la sbyin sreg bya zhing / che ge mo mā ra ya shān ting 6)ku ru swā hā zhes bzlas na 0thams cad bsrung yonyebar 'gyur ro/ /gang dag gsad par 'dod na sla tsonga'i nang du seng ldeng ngam gdug pa'i shing la me btang la/ gdug pa'i rdzas sna tshogs dang / ske tshe dang / til dang /mar nag dang / tshil chen dang / ming byang spel te/ sbyin sreg ()bya zhing /che ge mo ra sha mā ra ya rbad ces bzlas na dgra dang / gdon thams cad brlag dhi par 'gyur ro/ /bdag dang gzhan bsrung 8bar 'dod na rma bya'i mkhris pa dang ka ra dang / sa'i bdud rtsi lo lnga brgya lon pas bya'o/ /klu sa bdag bsrung ⑩bar 'dod na spos dang / gu gul nag po dang / gla rtsi dang / mu zi dang /ldong ros dang / dri chen dang / sbrang rtsis bya'o/ /mchog tu bsrung ()bar 'dod na 'bras bu gsum dang / bu chung gi rang byung dang / dri chus bya'o/ /khyad par dam pa bsrung (stob chen po ni a ru ra rnam par rgyal ba bcang zhing gzungs 'di brjod par bya'o/ /shig byer nān/ 'go (rtenān 9 nyaha na ha na mā ( nyar ya rbad nān/ drang srong chen po nyes 'dor gzungs 'di yid la rab tu zung 6)shig /sems can ni thams cad la bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar 83—222

gyis ①shig /nga'i bstan pa rjes su srungs shig /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ drang srong chen po nyes 'dor dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang /dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te②/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //rdo rje snying po rdo rje lce dbab pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs sol// //'di dang po ska cog gis bsgyur zhing / phyis gnyan lots+tsha ba dar ma ⑦grags kyis kyang bsgyur ro// //bsdur mchan/218 0)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gri/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉hā na ha/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gyi ma la/ 〈〈snar 〉〉rwa na ha/ ④〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dha/ (ge〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gzung / (5)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gcig (7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kha/ ni〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol〉〉 nas/219 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉nye/ (kye〈〈zhol 〉〉rbod/ (0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉lta/ ④〈〈zhol 〉〉zungs/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 pa/ ( ni〈〈zhol 〉〉thon/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/ (kye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sa zla nan/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉nān/ zla ba nān/ 5༄7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉nan/ (nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉yag sha zlog byer/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉yag sha zlog byed/ 〈〈pe 〉〉yag sha zlog byed/ 〈〈snar 〉〉yak+ṣa bzlog byer/〈〈zhol 〉〉yak+ṣa zlog byer/ 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 shing / /9nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rlag ④〈〈zhol 〉〉bgyi'i/220 0)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bu / (kye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉tsa/ (5nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dru yag sha zlog〈〈zhol 〉〉dra yak+ṣa zlog 6)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gyis/ (༄〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gan/ 4)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉 tu/(7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kyis/ (kye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgrog 〈〈zhol 〉〉sdog po)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsrung / 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉nga / 〈〈pe 〉〉bar gyur da/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bar/ (nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉klags/ 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉pa'i/〈〈pe 〉〉pa'i nga / 7〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 badz+ra badz+ra rgyu/ na mo bu ya tsi tra mu dra yak+ṣa zlog byer/ 7〈〈snar 〉〉83wa 223

bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (1༷2)83wa 225

༄tshogi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya (mibardzo pā ṇi a bhi de sha tan+t+ra nā cham/bod skad du/ dpal phyag na rdo rje gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa 6)dus gcig na/'og min gyi gnas lcang lo can gyi pho brang na/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po la / rig 57sngags kyi lha tshogs kyis bskor te bzhugs so/ /de nas dpa' mo'i dbang phyug mas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po 'di sgrub tsho pa'i rnal 'byor pa ji lta bu cig lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ snying rjer ldan zhing shes rab che/ /bzod dang ldan zhing brtson 'grus che/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang thob cing / /bslab pa gsum la rab tu gnas / /des ni dpa' bo yang dag 'grub/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las sgrub pa po 7gang zag bstan pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //83—226

yang dpa' mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo 'di bsgrub pa'i gnas ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dben pa tunyenyams dga' yid 'ong ba/ /bkra shis dpal 'phel dbang yang 'dzin/ /dur khrod chen po 'jigs gnas pa/ /ri gsum rtse 'am brag ri sngol/ /khro bo'i cha byad 'dra ba'i gnas/ /de ni dpa' bo bsgrub la shis/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las bsgrub ①pa'i gnas bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //yang dpa' mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo 'di bskyed pa'i dmigs pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dang po stong zhing bdag med dego/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag /de lta bu yi ⑤chos nyid la/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med pas/ /mi 0sgom mi rtog snang la gsal/ / mtha' bral (nyamakha' mnyam dbu ma'i don/ /sems kyi rang bzhin de lta bu/ /de ltar ma rtogs sems can la/ /sdug bsngal kun dang bral ba yi/ /thugs rje phyogs med bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /rang gi (8༄sems ni yi ge hūm̐/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las/ /gzhal yas khang dang lha yi gdan/ /lha yi sa bon yi ge las/ /go rims dzi)bzhin du bskyed par bya/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las bskyed pa'i dmigs pa bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //yang dpa' mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rig ⑩sngags kyi bdag po 83—227

'di'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dmigs pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ bskyed ①pa'i dmigs pa thob srinas ni/ snying gar ①ye shes sems dpa' ④bsgom/ /ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kur ⑤ni/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi rgya sran tsam/ /dbus su nyi zla'i gzhal yas khang / /gzhal yas khang gi nang du ni/ /a shad mar me'i rtse ltar sgomanya/ /de la dmigs pa thob nas ni/ /ci yang bsam par mi bya ste/ /bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams pas༅//de la ye shes thob par 'gyur/ /gsal la rtog med rig pa'i sku/ /ye shes zhes ni de la bya'o/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dmigs pa bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //yang dpa' mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po 'di'i 'khor ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpa' bo chen po 'di'i 'khor ni/ /thugs kyi 'khor ni bzhi'o/ /gsung gi 'khor ni brgyad do / /sku'i 'khor lnga brgyar nges so/ /gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las 'khor bstan pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o // //yang dpa' mos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po 'di'i rig pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī nyachu ba ra dha ra (9)badz+ra pā ṇi li hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā / oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi kro dha ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa 6nyaro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor bzhi'i rig pa phul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro snyidha ma hā kā lā /steya hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa yitsit+ta 83—228

ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /ting 'dzin rgyal po mi g.yo las/ /cig car bzhengs te gsang ba'i mchog /ye shes lnga yi spyod yul gyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mchog /ji ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa dang / /las kyi bya ba mdor bsdus te/ /gang zag ji lta bus sgrub 6)cing / /rig pa'i rgyal po mchog gyur pa/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs/ /zhes zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das mnyam par bzhag pa las langs te / thugs kur (miye shes lnga mi phyed pa'i rdo rje lan gsum du gsor bas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'gul ba dang / ldeg pa la sogs pa kun tu 'khrugs te/ gdug pa can 'dul ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer bkye nas slar thugs kur stithim pa (5)las rdo rje'i lte ba nas yum dpa' stimo rdo rje bde ma zhes bya ba byung ste/ rang gi ston pa la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba lan gsum byas nas/ phyag byas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ni/ /gsang ba ⑦dam pa gang yin pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas legs par gsungs/ /'di ni rnyed dka' rgyud chen te/ /rin chen lta bur 'dod 'byung ba/ /grangs med tshogs las byung (sheb 'di/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin stong pa las/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis bshad du gsol/ /zhes zhus pa dang / zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas byams pa rnam par 'phrul pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten gyi khams thosakhyab par byas te/ tshur 'dus nas rang gi zhal du thim pa dang / dpa' mo rdo rje bde ma khyod/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin bdag med mas/ /ji ltar zhus bzhin bshad par bya/ /gus par nyon la legs par zung / /rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs/ /mi (khephyed stong pa'i rang bzhin las/ /thugs rje sna tshogs thabs tshul te/ /'di ni rab tu rtogs 83—233

dka' bas/ /'das dang ①da ltar bzhugs pa dang / /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas spyod yul yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rnam par dag /brjod med mi g.yo 'dus ma byas/ /nam mkha' dri med chos kyi sku/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i mchog /'di la ji ltar bstan du yod/ /'on kyang snying rje'i rang bzhin pas/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin ni/ /gnyis med gnyis kyi thabs tshul rig /'di ni gsang ba dam pa ste/ /de nyid gzhan la mngon bstan pas/ /gdul bya tshim 'gyur rgyal po bzhin/ /rang 'dod 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur bas/ /gsang ba mngon par bstan pa yi(snye/ / rgyud chen rgyal po bshad par bya/ /tshim ma ho mi phyed rdo rje gsang ba'i mchog / e ma ho ④thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i//sna tshogs nor bu rgyud chen 'di/ /rang gi gsang ba dam pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las rab tu dga' ba'i gleng gzhi'i ①le'u ste dang po'o// // snyedapa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po khyod bsgrub 967pa'i gang zag ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /ngaganyid sgrub pa'i gang zag ni/ /snying rje ldan zhing shes rab che/ /bzod ldan brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs/ /bslab pa gsum ldan dad pas brgyan/ /dpa' zhing rdo gsang ba'i spyod pa shes/ /gus (kyeshing g.yo med skyabs ciganas gsum / /rtag tu mchod cing yengs pa med/ /lhag pa'i lha la (9)yid ches shing //83—234

phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang thob la/ /dam tshig brda don nges par 'dzin/ /de ltas sgrub pa byas gyur na/ /yun mi ring bar nga nyid kyi/ /gsang gsum la ni mkhas 'gyur te/ /'bad pas thob pa'i ①'bras bu ni/ /skal ldan de yi snying la gnas/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan ②pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las sgrub pa po'i gang zag bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang khyed sgrub ①pa'i gnas ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /nga nyid sgrub pa'i gnas mchog ni/ /dur khrod brgyad dam nye ba'i gnas/ /dur khrod nags kyi nang du ni/ /ri rtse brag ri sngon po'i mdog /khros pa'i gzugs 'dra byang lta ba/ /me tog sngon po limadzes pa dang / /ne'u gsing (snyedang ut+pal nags6)ske/ /dben zhing yid 'ong gnyams dga' ba/ /bkra shis dpal 'phel dbang yang 'dzin/ /lcang lo can dang ming mthun (kyepa/ /sna tshogs sgrub pa'i gnas su shis/ /tshwa sgo chu med u 5)ma'i gnas/ /rgyal rtepo'i pho brang tshong dus /gedang —/ /nyan thos la sogs 'dug gnas su/ /nga nyid sgrub yi par mi bya'o/ /smin (/snyepa'i gang zag rnams la ni/ /gnas sogs brtags pas ci zhig bya/ /thams cad bde chen sangs rgyas kyi/ /zhing khams rol pas gnas pa yin/ /de tibs rigs kyis tsobartag par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba 83—235

rab ldan/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa gdan dang bcas/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i ①rang bzhin te/ /snying rjes sbyangs nas gsum pa rdzogs/ /sku mdog nag po zhal gcig ②pa/ /phyag gnyis g.yas pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /snun pa'i stobs can rdo rje 'bar/ /g.yon pas dril bu dkur brten ①te/ /sgeg pa'i tshul can nam mkhar ④gdengs/ /rin chen chu 'dzin rgyan dang ldan/ /stag lpags dar gyis sku la brgyan⑤/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bdud la brdzisayi/ /spyan gsum gdug ⑦pa'i mche ba gtsigasani/ /bskal pa'i me 'od nang du bzhugs/ /yi ge gsum gyi gnas rgesum po/ /lhar byas skye mched byin gyis brlab/ /gnas su khro bo'i yig 'bru bskyed/ /sprul pa dpag med phyogs bcur 'gyed/ /yi ge bzhi yis ye shes dbab/ /rigs bdag la sogs sangs rgyas kyis/ /dbang bskur byin brlabs cod pan bsam/ /de yi ting 'dzin 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /cho ga gsum pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /gzhan don rgyun mi 'chad par bsgom/ /yang na gsung 6)gi yig 'brus mtshan/ /phrin kyilas thogs med rnal 'byor bzlas / /'di ni rnam dag rig pa ste/ /rtag tu ma nyams 'bras bur ldan/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las dpa' bo gcig pa bsgrub pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i thabs ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma(ste / /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon//83—237

badz+ra tī la ya ā ko ṭa ya r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ spyi bor btab pas nges par brlag① /slar 'dus phyogs mtshams ma lus par/ /sa gzhi ra ba dra ba dang / /gur bcing ba dang bla re dang / /mda' dang me yi 'od 'bar bsgom/ /oṃ badz+ra me di nī ②badzi bhā tshub badz+ra brnya brnya du / oṃ badz+ra pā kā phyir hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañdza yir hūm̐ lo rgyu / oṃ badz+ra bi tā ⑦na rtsu khaṃ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dusha ra 0dz+ra tshul traṃ si tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dzā ⑩la a na lārka rtsu ro (8/ rim pas brjod la snying rje yi/ /bdag nyid gzhan la phan 'dod pa/ /smon lam las 'byung 0rdzu 'phrul mchog /yaṃ las byung ④ba gzhu 'dra ba/ /sngon po ba dan ldan pa bsam/ /de steng ro byung rgod ma'i kha/ /gru gsum dmar po 'od 'bar ba/ /bo las skyes pa skum po ste/ /dkar po 'khyil pa'i tshul du bsam/ /de las skyes pa dbang chen te/ /lo 8skyes ser po rdo rje'i rgyu/ /gru bzhi 'od zer 'bar ba ⑩bsam/ /de steng rtsa las chos kyi 'khor —/ /lte bar sum̐ tsolas gzhal yas khang / /gru bzhi sgo dang rta babs ⑪bcas / /dra ba phyed dang dra bas brgyan/ /phreng ba rin chen rdo rje dang / /mdzes pa'i ba dan bcas pa bsam/ /de nang paṃ las chu skyes ni/ /ge sar 'dab mar bcas pa'i steng (gye/ /nyi ma kā li 'od 'bar tsha( nye/ /steng du zla ba ā li bsil(gye/ /kha sbyar bar du hūm̐ dang ā/ /gnag (nyecing dmar ba'i rnam pa la/ /de las pad+ma rdo rje bsam/ /slar yang yi ges ( ge'agro ba sbyangs/ /rtsu gis mi bskyod ru thugs rnams bsdu/ /a yis 'od dpag gsung bsdus la/ /gnyis med zhu bas ⑩sprul pa bsdu/ /rdo rje las ni khro bo ste/ /pad+mas khro mo'i rnam par bskyed(nye / /khro bo mthing ga su zhal gcig pa/ /rang 'od las byung phyag gnyis 'khyud / /rdo rje dril bu thabs shes rab/ /g.yas dang g.yon du bsam par bya/ /83—239
