ma hā de bi mā ra ya ha na ha na/ ma hā ma nu mā ra ya gtubs gtubasanyu/ ma hā grub pa mā ra ya tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭhazhu/ ma hā yak+ṣa mā dur ya bhin+da durnyin+da ma hā gan dharba mā ra ya khos khosabya/ ma hā ma ri ni mā ra ya rna/ ma hā nī lī ba radha ra badz+ra pā 0ṇi yak+ṣa hūm̐/ mu ru ta mu ru ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ mā ra ṇa ⑦sod sod/ mā ra ṇa nibying bying /mā ra ṇa 6)rmugs rmugs/ mā ra ṇa ⑩hal hal/ mā ra ṇa yimyos myos/ mā ra ṇa ⑫myos bying / mā ra ṇa 8thum ril dza dzaḥci/ ka ka rak+ṣe rtsu rgyu s+t+waṃ bh+yo dz+wa 8kha khā/te she tsorak+ṣa hūm̐ hūṃ/ s+t+waṃ ⑩skyo dzaḥyikha khā/ tsa pa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūṃ s+t+waṃ bh+yo dz+wa ⑩kha khā/ tsa ka rak+ṣa hūṃ hūm̐ s+t+waṃ bh+yo dz+wa 6)kha khā/ mun du rak+ṣa rgyu rdzu sdi bh+yo dz+wa 6)kha khā/ ka ka rak+ṣa sa ma ya bud+dhā ya spu ⑥ta ra/ te sha rak+ṣa dus ma ya bud+dhā ya spu sonyeta ra tsa pa rak+ṣa sa ma ya bud+dhā ya spu 6)ta ra tsa ka rak+ṣa sa ma ya bud+dhā 6)ya spu ta ra/ mun (nyedu rak+ṣa sa ma ya bud+dhā yiya spu ta ra/ hūṃ rgyu hril hril/ dim dim/ phob phob/ shar shar/ di ri di ri rbad rbad/ kha the kha tho/ zhus/ zhus/ dza re dza (nyere bh+yo/ ha sa ha sa / te pa te pa/ kri ta ha kri ta 6)ha/ kri khug kri khug /tshal pa tshal pa/rbad ling rbad ling / srog tshig nan rbad/ lus dul mā ra ya rbad/ raṃ ro dzā la dzā (nyal shi shi/ rdul bun rbad sod/ nā ga mā nunyer ya hūṃ phaṭa/ dzaḥs baṃ hoḥdharmā ka ka ki ( ti ra/ dharma (gete sha sa muñdza/ dharma te sha ta ka ra/ dharma dunate sha tsa ka ra/ dharma 69te sha sa ma ya/ bud+dhā su ya pu ta ra/ te pa te pa kha khā raṃ/ te pa te pa ka (nyetsa ri/ te pa te pa mun+d+ra ri/ te pa te pa pu s+t+waṃ ha dunar/ te pa te pa sa dza sa muñdza/ tsa 6)ka ra mus ra khe/ badz+ra tsa yaṃ ran dzā dzā/ te sha raṃ/ mun+d+ra nan / badz+ra dzu ru dzu ru raṃ/ dzu ru dzu ru sa sum̐ dza dzā tsā me/ badz+ra ghi ne khe dza/badz+ra puṇ+ḍi ( khe dza/ badz+ra muṇ+ḍa zhe re khe dza/ kha dza rā dza mun+d+ra ra khe/ kha dza rā dz+dza (ste83—243

mun+d+ra ra sa rmu khe/ pad+ma ra ṇi 6)kha dza rā dza ⑤mun+d+ra rā dzā ③kho/ kha dza rā dza mun+d+ra ra sa muñdza ④ra khe dzu dzu dza dza khā hi dza/ oṃ kā ya wā ka tsotsit+ta i rda ⑥ba ling / buñdza dzi gha phul+la dhū pa māṃ ⑦sa se/ sa kharnyi khun ṇi phaṭa gā tani/ oṃ a mṛ ta pra ti dza ka las ka ru pū dzā khā hi/ rak+ta 0pi ba ta ka se ru pū ()dza khā hi/ dhū 7pe/phusne / a (nyalo ke/ gan dhe/ rna bi bye8/ ka sa ka ru pū dza snyi' hi/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā 〉yi/ ār+ya nud pan na tāta ⑩ma āḥ6)rdu/ 'di ni rin chen sngags kyi mchog /ma lus dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i dpal/ /gzungs ma khyod la nyer bshad pas/ /'di ni mi 'da'i 6)dam tshig yin/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rdo )rgyal po las gsang sngags bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi 'khor ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /nga yi 'khor ni bsam mi khyab / /'di tsam grangs ni sangs rgyas kyis/ /bskal par bgrangs 61kyang shes mi 'gyur/ /de bas nam mkha'i tshad dang mtshungs/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad par bya/ /sku yi 'khor ni khro bo bcu/ /rigs lnga'i ngo bo sku gsung thugs / /mi 'gyur gdug pa 'dul ba yin/ /thugs kyi 'khor ni rigs brgya ste / /mdor bsdus sprul pa'i khro bo bzhi/ /gsung gi 'khor ni dpag med kyang //rigs drug 'dul nyaba'i khyung chen yin/ /sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ /83—244

gdul bya'i 'khor ni klu chen brgyad/ /gsung gis de rigs 'dul ba yin/ /gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje'i tshogs/ /lnga brgya rigs bsdus sku yis 'dul/ /thugs kyis lha srin gdug pa 'dul/ /byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'dul/ /'di la 'dis 'dul sprul pa'i tshogs/ /smon lam dbang gis byung ba ste/ /bsam gyis mi khyab des ①'dul ba/ /rigs la brjod par ga la nus/ /mdor bsdus mdzes ma khyod la bstan/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las 'khor nges par bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi las ②sgrub pa'i rim pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /gdug pa'i klu rnams 'dul 'dod pa'i( )/ /rdo rje khyung chen stobs chen 'dul/ /nga yi gsung gi sprul pa ste/ /mche ba rno dbal drag po ④gtsigs/ /baṃ las rgya mtsho'i ri rab steng / /yi ge hūṃ las byung ba yi/ /dpa' bo klu 'dul bsgom (5)par bya/ /sku mchog nag po zhal dgur 4)ldan/ /rtsa zhal mthing nag g.yas pa dkar/ /g.yon pa dmar po de steng du/ /dbus dmar g.yas pa ljang ba ste/ /g.yon pa btso (pem gser dang 'dra/ /de steng dbus dkar g.yas pa gnag /g.yon pa be+e ḍūr+ya (8)ltar sngo/ /thams cad spyan gsum rdo rje'i mchu/ /spyi gtsug rin chen rdo rje'i (9)rwabo/ /phyag ni bcwa yi/brgyad g.yas pa na/ /rdo rje ral gri dgra sta 83—245

zhags / /mdung dang lcags kyu mda' dang ni/ /rtse gsum las kyi bya khyung bsnams / /rim bzhin chu bdag mtha' yas dang / /nor rgyas stobs rgyu dung skyong dang / /pad+ma pad chen rigs ldan dang / /'jog po klu dgu ②ro stod lha/ /thal sbyor gtso la rin chen stobs(mi/ /mjug ma phyag la dkris mdzad de/ /kun kyang rang rang kha dog 'dzin/ /sbrul mgo bdun pa sprin bzhin gtibs③/ /g.yon pa dril bu be con dang / /'khor lo rgya gram thod dbyug che/ /sbrul gyi rgyal mtshan gzhu dang ni/ /gtum chung phur dang khyung ①phur ro/ /rim bzhin rlung 'byin dga' ma dang / /mdzes ldan dpa' mo 'od byed ma/ /grub ma brtan ma dge ma dang / /gsal byed rim bzhin yab dang 'dra/ /thal sbyar gtso la pad+ma 'bul/ /gdengs ka gsum gyis 'dud byed ma/ /g.yon du rim bzhin bsam par bya/ /zhabs bzhi chu srin ru (nyasbal dang / /phag dang lto 'phye'i steng na bzhugs/ /gshog pa rigs ⑥bzhi'i rdo rje ste/ /mjug ⑦ma ral gri rigs bzhir ldan/ /sder chen pags (gyel me 'bar bas/ /rab tu gtum zhing sa bdag dang / /klu rigs ma lus brlag mdzad pa/ /'og min gnas su slebs 99)par bsam/ /de rjes gnas gsum yi ges brgyan/ /oṃ āḥrdu dkar dmar zhing gnag /sprul pa go cha'i sngags bsam pa/ /oṃ hūm̐ ṭ+wāṃ trī yi.ā/ spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga nyamedang / /lte ba gsang gnas bsam par bya/ /e baṃ ma yā ⑫dpung ba dang / / dpyi yi steng du 7bsam par bya/ / rtsu swa tī yis brang dang ni / /sog tshadaprag stong 7mo lte lkog bsam/ /dzaḥ/ baṃ hoḥsgo bzhir bsam/ /sto dza ya a sprul pa dang / /yang sprul bsam gyis 7mi khyab bsam/ /de nas gsang ba'i sngags bstan pa/ /las kyi khyung chen drag 9/shepo'i sngags/ /sangs 83—246

rgyas kun gyi mthu bsdus pa/ /oṃ badz+ra khyung kur khyung kur badz+ra ga ru ḍa ①tsa le tsa le phyis phaṭa/ sku yi gsang ba'i sngags su bstan/ /oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa dus srog tshig nan rbad/ lus dul nā ga mā ra ya phaṭa/ raṃ raṃ dz+wa la ④tsa la zhi zhi ⑧rdul bun rbad phaṭa/ gsung gi rig pa dam pa'o༅/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ga ru ḍa hūm̐ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sbo ṭa ya slo ṭa ༅ya/ badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa be ge hūṃ dza dza ri dza pri dza rtsu phaṭa/ thugs gsang durdo rje gtum po'i sngags/ /drag byed thams cad rlag ⑨par byed/ /klu rnams snying khrag 'thig pa yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dam tshig 'di / /rin chen bzhin du rnyed dka' bas/ /'di la rtag tu 'bad par bya/ /mthun ⑩pa'i rdzas kyi gtor ma sbyin/ /de yi nang du gnod pa dgug⑩ /oṃ badz+ra shrī ma mā nā 8ga sa bi 8ta cho ga khug mo dzi dhi 8swā hā/ 'dis ni bkug la lha la 'bulaX / /gal te gsad par ⑩'dod pas na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rig pa la//phur bu gnyis pa'i drag sngags chadang / /gsad pa spyi yi sham bur gdags/ /gzugs brnyan phur bus btab 8par bya/ /tshangs pa yin yang (7nges par brlag /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa (nyebadz+ra tī lā ( nyeya sarba bi na muṅga ra tī lā ()ya ā ko so ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ga ru ḍa tī li tī la ④ya sarba bi na muṅga ra tī lā 6)ya ā ko chaṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtum chung phur bus btab ()pa'i sngags/ /de rjes gzugs brnyan ma lus pa/ /drag po'i thab tu bsreg (nyepar bya/ /tsher ma can gyi me sbar la/ /khyung chen gtum po'i nga rgyal gyisayi/ /nā ga bhū (3 mi pa ti sarba kā ya wāka (stetsit+ta badz+ra dzā la a na lārka snyen / ci rigs sngags kyis ru)bsreg pa dang / /thal ba dkar gsum sbyar bya ste/ /rgya mtshor 4ge'abab pa'i chu la dor//de ltar las kyi sbyor ba de/ /lan bdun byas par gyur na ni/ /klu chen dug 83—247

gis snying la zin/ /nges par sos par 'gyur ba yin/ /gal te mi gtong klu chen gyi/ /lus dang khang par bcas pa la/ /me dang rdo rje'i char pa yis①/ /skad cig nyid la 'tshig par 'gyur/ /de bas dam tshig mi 'da' bas②/ /las 'di myur bar mi bya'o/ /las kyi gtum po khyung sgrub pa/ /mdzes ma khyod la bstan pa yin/ /brtsem ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par chabastan pa'i rgyud kyi 4)rgyal po las/ las sgrub ⑤pa'i lha rdo rje gtum po khyung gi bsgrub pa bstan ( dpa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi sku'i sprul pa/ pho nya gnod sbyin nag po'i sgrub pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /nga yi gnod sbyin nag po 'di/ /bya ba'i las kun thogs ⑦pa med/ /khyad par drag po'i phrin (kyilas 'grub/ /dur khrod brag rdzong nags yi)phug tu/ /nag po'i sa godakyil 'khor bya/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sgo dang bcas/ /mthing nag gru gsum me 'od ldan/ /sum̐ 7las ri rab steng du hūṃ/ /'od zer 'phro 11'dus rdo rjer bsam/ /de las gnod sbyin nag po ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gsum ldan/ /g.yas pa 'jigs 7pa stag gi zhal/ /g.yon pa stobs chen seng ge ste/ /phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnyis pa rtse gsum gsum pa phur/ /g.yon pa dril chen lcags kyu dang / /thod pa khrag gis bkang ba yin/ /g.yas pa gtum pas bdud mo brdzis/ /g.yon pas bdud pho nyi 83—248

gdong mnan①/ /phur zhabs dmar po me 'bar bas/ /gnod byed bgegs kyi mgo la btab/ /thod phreng mi yi pags ②pa gyon/ /dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /dbu skra dmar po thur du 'phyang / /spyan gsum mche ba rab tu gtsigs / /ha ①har dgod cing gdug pa 'dul/ /sprul pa'i gnod sbyin stong dang bcas/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin sgrub/ /de yis rig pa phul ba ni/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kā la tsaṇ+ḍa ④gri lī ba ra dha ra sha rī phyir rgyu phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags 'bum du bzlas/ /grub par gyur nas gang dmigs la/ / rjes su 0tsha ba'i 'bru dang ni/ /tshwa las ling gar 'khor lo gzhug /dmigs pa bstims ⑦la 'grub gnas gzhug /de steng yungs kur (9zi ra dang / /dug gi rigs kyis yo)brab par bya/ /gsang ba drag po'i ⑩sngags 'di bzlas(7/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kā la tsaṇ+ḍa nī lī ba ra dha ra tisarba sha rgyu bi dhā rā yo ya phaṭa/ ha ra ha ra phaṭa/ pra ha ra pra ha ra phaṭa/ sbyisdo tshin+da 8phaṭa/ bhin+da bhin+da phaṭa/ bi sbo ṭa ya 'bi sbo ṭa ya phaṭa/ sarba sha rtsu 8kā ya wāka tsotsit+ta bi nā sha ka ra (nyeya phaṭa/ ji srid ma shi'i bar du brab/ /grub nas rigs med thod par gzhug /tse ti chen po'i 'og tu sba / /steng du ri rab rdo rje yis/ / mnan pa yi byas pas nges par brlags na /yang na gnod sbyin chen po deri 7/ /dur khrod ras la bris byas la( ci / / de yi sa snying gar (9sngags 'di bri/ /e yi nang du chud par ni/ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kā la tsaṇ+ḍa sa ma ya ma nu sma ra sirnyi hūṃ/ phyag la yak+ṣa pa ta lisage/ /zhabs la kai mi bha khrimar bri//de nyid gtor ma chen po la/ /bcug ste sngon po'i dar gyis dgab/ /de steng ru tshoras sam shing lo la/ /gnod sbyin srog gi 'khor lo ni/ /lte ba rtsibs sa bcu mu khyud bcas/ /yang rtsibs thobacu dang mu khyud ldan/ /me 'od ldan pa bri byas 83—249

te① / /sngags kyi 'khrul 'khor bkod phyinas kyang / /las kyi ming dang spel ba bri / /'di ni gnod sbyin srog yin te/ /mi 'da' bka' yi dam tshig ①yin/ /las rnams gang bcol sku yis byed/ /yang na rgyal rigs thod pa la/ /gnod sbyin bris la tsha ba'i mar/ /chang dang bsres la byug bya ste/ /nyin re gang 'dod las dang sbyar/ /me tog kha dog mthun pas brab/ /bsgo ba'i phrin las 'grub par 'gyur/ /chu dar sngon po'i gzhi ma la/ /gser gyis ④'khor lo bri bar bya/ /lte ba rtsibs brgyad mu khyud ldan/ /phyi ma re'u dumig bcu drug par/ /sa bon sngags dang spel byas te'u/ /kun gyi mtha' ru phrin las sngags/ /bris pa mgul du btags pa yis/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams bsrung ⑦'gyur te/ /bung ba me la bya ba bzhin/ /khyi sha btags pa'i ril bu'i (nyanang / /dgra yi yonyegazugs bris sngags dang spel/ /nyi nub bya rog la byin te/ /sngags bzlas phyir zhing lan grangs ni/ /brgya 'am stong du byas gyur na/ /gang yin gnas nas bskrad par 'gyur/ /khyi 'brel spu la srad bu byas/ /mdud pa brgya rtsa brgyad byas te/ /sngags re zhing yang gnod sbyin re/ /'bras kyi nang du bskyur ⑩ba na/ /phub ma 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin khyim du bcangs (1pa na/ /mi phyugs la sogs 'khrig 7pa na/ /khyi yidang 'dra bar 'brel par 'gyur/ /khyi nag snying du gnod sbyin gyi / /snying dang sku dang sngags bcug nas/ /bcangs snyipa tsam gyis gnod sbyin nyid/ /lus dang grib mar li'adra 7bar 'gyur/ /skad cig tsam yang sgrub pa po ste/ /de yis gtong bar 6)mi byed do/ /de la (lhasogs pa'i las kyi rim/ /mdzes ma khyod la bshad pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las gnod sbyin nag po 83—250

sgrub pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// // dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 6)bka' stsal nga// /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rdzogs pa che/ /lha yi bya ba sngon song ste / /bskyed la dmigs pa thob nas ni/ /snying gar ②ye shes sems dpa' ②bsam / / de yi ④rang bzhin snying nang du/ /pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i thig 0les brgyanal/ /nyi zla'i bar du rgya sran tshad/ /de yi nang du gnas pa'i srog /a shad mar me'i rtse ltar sgom/ /de la dmigs pa brtan 6)pa dang / /ci yang bsam par mi bya ste/ /bsam gyis mi khyab de bsams na/ /de las ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /gsal zhing mi rtog rig pa'i sku/ /ye shes zhes ni de la bya/ /rten med rnam dag gsal ba yin/ /rtog pa rten can bsgom 'dod pas/ /sku yi gnas su 'khor lo ni/ /dkar po rtsa 'dab sum cu ⑦gnyis/ /mtshan gyi thabs kyis (kyechas brgyan pa/ /gsung gi gnas su rtsa 'dab ni/ /bcu drug dmar po shes rab ste/ /de la thabs kyis nges par brgyan/ /thugs kyi dzi)gnas su dus sbyor brgyad/ /gtso bo'i yi ge brgyad gnas pa/ /phrin las bya ba'i gnas dag tu/ /dbyug gu'i grangs kyi rtsa gnas pa/ /shes rab gnyis 'gyur kha dog dmar/ /de dbus gnyis med g.yas dang g.yon/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam par dbye/ /rtog 7pa sad pa'i 'khor lo ni/ /thabs la drug dang 83—251

shes rab drug /tha ma bde ba 'dzin pa'i sa①/ /mi rtog ②dpa' bo gnas pa yin / /yi ge bzhi yis rgyan ③mdzad de/ /bde 'dzin 'khor lor 0yi ge med/ /brjod pa thams cad spangs ⑤pa stedu/ /'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin mchog /khu ba khrag dang chu ser gnas/ /'di ni lam gsum 'joms byed pa'o/ /skad cig rlung gi rta yis ni/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis bskul nas/ /gnyis med ye shes skye bar 'gyur/ /ye shes kyis ni rtog pa bsreg⑦ /thal ba'ang dmigs par mi 'gyur ba'i(9/ /rtags ⑨lnga rim par kyi'abyung bar 'gyur/ /de nas dpal gyi yon tan te/ /yang nas yang du goms par bya/ /sde pa bzhi yi longs spyod ni/ /gnas su yang dag skye bar 'gyur/ /gnyis med bde ba'i gnas thob nas/ /skye 'chi 9/sprel sogs rgyun chad de/ /'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i gnas/ /thob par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /'di ltar rnam par dag pa nibo / /nyin mtshan cha yi (nyadabye ba yis/ /dbyug gu chu tshod dus sbyor sogs/ / brtsi bas 〉rnal 'byor ngal ba'i rgyu/ /thams cad gcig tu bsdoms 7gyur na/ /mi rtog mnyam nyid nam mkhar dag /'bad med ye shes lhun gyis grub/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas ye shes che/ /khams gsum thams cad sgrol mdzad ma/ /shes rab yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi gnas spros bral 'dus ma byas/ /legs rtogs bla ma mchog la 'dud/ /brjod par dka' ba'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /mdzes ma khyod la bshad pa yin/ /dpa' bo brtan par ma gyur na/ /yi ge hūm̐ gi sbyor ba yis/ /'jig rten khams kun 'jig par 'gyur/ /me yis bud shing sreg tshamadzad de/ /shing med me yang ji ltar gnas/ /brtan ⑩g.yo nyams par gyur pa 1snyen/ /mi shigs yi ge rnam par dag /'di ni gsang ba dam pa ste//83—252

gsang ba bla na med pa 'di/ /bdag med rtogs ①pa khyod la bshad/ /gzhan du gang gā'i ②bye ma dang / /mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ②kyis kyang / /brjod par ④nus pa ga la yod/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las bsam gyis mi khyab pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das phyirdo rje 'chang gi rigs dag pa 96)la dbang bskur ba ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon / /dang por slob dpon mtshan nyid kyang / /mdzes shing dul la byams sems ldan/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi de nyid mkhas/ /snyan par smra zhing gtong la dga' / /brtan (7zhing bden smra byams sems ldan/ /bsam pa shes shing gsong por smra/ /dam tshig ldan zhing sngags tshul mkhas/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor brda rnams mkhas/ /de (lde)nyid bcu shes 1)snying rjer ldan/ /'jig rten pa yi ṇirnam spangs pa/ /mkhas pas de nyid shes nas kyang / /de ni sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /byang chub sems dang dgra bcom dang / /nyan thos rang rgyal gong na med/ /de lta'i bla ma srog ltar bsten/ /gal te slob dpon smod pa la/ /dngos grub rmi lam du yang med/ /de bas bla ma mnyes byas la/ /bla gos phrag pa la (/nyagayogs te/ /pus btsugs tsothal sbyar me tog thogs/ / /dkyil 'khor bri bar gsol bar bya/ /grong dang tshong dus 'dur khrod dang / /tshal dang lha 83—253

khang grong khyer te/ /byang shar dngos grub gzhan gnyis spangs/ /ro hi ta sogs zla ba yi/ /lto 'phye'i lto bar shes par ①yin/ /gzhan du nyes pa ②'byung bar 'gyur/ /mkhas pas nyes pa med par bya/ /sa bslang ①ba dang brtag pa ni/ /rim bzhin gtsug lag khang pa dang / /tshal dang rdo leb khang bzangs te/ /kun la brtag pa spang rtsibar bya/ /slob dpon smin pas slob ma rnams / /phung po lnga po dag par bya⑤/ /sa yi nyes pa kun bsal nas/ /lo las byung ba'i lha mo ni/ /rgyan ldan bum pa phyag na bsnams/ /de la mchod cing gsol bar bya/ / oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum / /rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod par/ /mchod yon 'di ni bzhes nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor las ni legs sgrub mdzad/ /oṃ hi nyi hi ti hūṃ 4)swā hā/ / gnang bas tsos la slar thim bsam/ /slar sbyangs bsang (87zhing gtso bo la/ /dri yi gdan chen gru 6)bzhi ste/ /'khor lo sum cha dor bas zlumakho/ /me tog sngon po'i gdan la bsam/ /rin po che 'am sa yang rung —/ /bum pa nag po'i skyon sbangs te/ / byu gyi seng gyi dbyug 61pa yi/ /ut+pal gzhan gyis mi thub 7pa/ /ha sa de bas nad rnams sbyong / /dngul dang mu tig mu men dang / /bye 7ru gser gyis skiye shes 'phel/ /nas gro til dang sran ma dang / /mud ga 7yis ni lam lnga dag7 /ga pur gur gum dzā 7ti dang //tsan dan a ga ru yis ni/ /gzhan don phrin las lnga 'grub bo/ /chu dang snying po lnga yis ni/ /rnal 'byor phun sum tshogs gyur pas/ /mgrin pa gos kyis dkris pa dang / /'bras ldan shing gis kha yang brgyan/ /ku sha la 'dug (ste83—254

mtshan ma can/ /rang rang phyogs su gzhag par bya/ /bdug spos ①thogs la gsol ba gdab②/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal①/ /bdag la dgongs nas gzigs su gsol/ /slob ma rnams kyi don phyir dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor 'dri ④bar 'tshal/ /rin po che yi phyimathu bzhin du/ /bka' drin rjes su gnang ba yisayi/ /sang ni byon par mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum bar du gsol bar bya/ /slob ⑦ma rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /sdom gzung gsol zhing srung ⑧ba dang / /slob dpon rdo rje can dmigs la/ /gang yang gsang sngags lha kun dang / /'jig rten skyong ba ma lus pa/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub la zhugs dang / /sangs rgyas bstan dga'i dzi)'byung po dang / /gang dag rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang gi dkyil 'khor mchog /deng bdag 'dri bar 'gyur ba la/ /bdag dang skal ldan slob ma la/ /byin gyis rlabs 7phyir bsrung bar mdzod/ /srad bu ye shes lnga yi dngos / /re re'ang rigs lnga rnam dag ste/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid med pas/ /phan tshun sngags bzlas bsgril bar bya/ /dkyus su 'khor lo'i nyis 'gyur la/ /sboms 41su sgo yi 7bcu gnyis tshad/ /hūm̐ brjod bdud rtsi lnga (nyebyugs la/ /dz+dza dz+dza yisgra brjod lte bar gzung / /slar yang de bzhin ye shes kyi/ /thig chen nam mkhar chagadab par bya/ /de bzhin cha ldan gnyis pa yis/ /gtsang zhing rdo rje 'dzin bsams te / /tshangs pa'i thig chen gdab par bya/ /gnyis pa zur thig la sogs para'i/ /nub dang lhor ni slob dpon la/ /byang shar slob ma'i gnas sa ste(nye/ /g.yas kyis bskor ba ma gtogs par/ /g.yon du nam yang ma yin no/ /de ltar cha yis rnam par dbye/na/ /thig skud chad na ru bla ma 'chi/ /83—255

dman dang lhag pas nad du 'gyur/ /phyogs 'khrul na ni slob ma rmongs de bas mkhas pas skyon med bya/ /rin chen 7lnga 'am 'bru yi phye/ /yang na 'byung khungs ②las byung (gub/ /yi ge bcu yis byin brlabs (4)te/ /rigs lnga rnam par dag pa las/ /dkar ser dmar ljang nag po dang (zhe/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas bri bar bya/ /gal te tshon rtsi mi mnyam zhing / /yo dang dma' bar gyur na ni / /dngos grub med cing rtsod la gdung (5)/ /sbom pas nad 'byung phra bas ni/ /nor nyams gal te chad pas ni/ /'chi 'gyur g.yas skor (hom bris na/ /phur bus btab pa yin zhes bya/ /shar phyogs dkar la lho nub byang / /ser dmar ljang khur bri bar bya/ /dbus ni be+e ḍūr+ya (kyelta bu/ /pad+ma phyogs kyi rnam pa ste5)/ /mtshams ni mdzes tshon 7bum pas brgyan/ /sgo la sogs pa'i rgyan rnams dang / /dur khrod ra ba'i nang du bri/ /gtum drag la sogs phyogs mtshams dgod/ /dbus mtho 17shar dang byang gzhol zhing / /mtho zhing ma 'dres drang bar sna bri/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin dmigs la/ /gus tu pas me tog dang bcas nas/ /gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsola'7/ /byang chub sems mchog bdag la stsola'i/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsolas/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug par mdzod/ /ces pa lan gsum bar du bya/ /bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ /tshul chen snod ni khyod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga mchog /khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdo rje mi phyed mthu yis ni/ /mnyam med pa yi 7ye shes 'thob/ /de bas kun mkhyen 83—256

thob 'dod pas/ /bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /bla ma sangs rgyas kun mchod cing / /rtsa ba yan lag nyes pa spong 0)/ /ma grol 'khor ②ba'i sems can la/ /snying rje chen po rab bskyed nas/ /bsgral zhing grol ba'i lam la dgodag / /bde bar dbugs ni dbyung bar bya/ /de dag rim dang rim min pa / /slob ma'i rim pa rnam par brtag /khrus bya so shing sbyin par bya/ /phrin las phyogs dang dngos grub kyi/ /rim par rnam par brtag par bya/ / srung skud gdags ④dang ku sha sbyin/ /rmi lam brtags la ngan pa na⑤/ /zhi ba'i me yis (5)bzlog par bya/ /gdong g.yogs bcings la ye shes dbab/ /dkyil 'khor dam par gzhug pa'i phyir/ /sngon bsags sdig pa ma lus las/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis 'byang / /bu khyod su yin ci dga' ba/ /bdag ni skal bzang rigs yin pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod la dga'/ /mig dbye dkyil 'khor lha yang bstan/ /dam tshig chu sbyin mna' yang bsgrag /me tog dor la lha ngo bstan/ /gang dang gang du bab gyur pa'i/ /rigs kyis (7de la spro bar bya/ /chu dang cod pan (8)rdo rje de/ /dril bu ming gis yinyedabang bskur te/ /rigs lnga'i bdag nyid ye shes lnga/ /brtul zhugs lung bstan rjes gnang sbyin/ /dbugs yidabyung rdo rje slob dpon bsgrub/ /gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang / /bzhi pa brjod med dbang bskur ba/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /mchog tu rab zhugs mthong bas na/ /deng khyod sdig pa ma lus las/ /rnam grol rigs su skyes pas dzispen/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam gsungs pa'i/ /rjes su gnang bas dbugs phyin 'gyur/ /dngos grub rgyu yi tshadam tshig ni/ /bu yis rtag tu bsrung bar gyis/ /slob mas bla ma la btud nas/ /gtso bos ji 83—257

ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bsgrub par bgyi0)/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa ltar/ /rgyan dang na bza' rin chen dang / /rgyal srid bu dang chung ma dang / /rang gi lus kyang bla ma la②/ /bsnyen bkur tshim pa med par bya/ /deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /bdag ni gson pa 'bras bu che/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur pas/ /sems can don ni mnyam med bya/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dudangos grub grogs/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dge 'dun mchod④/ /nad pa'am mgon med phongs pa kun//kha zas kyis ni tshim par bya/ /zhing skyong gtor mas mnyes byas la rang 'dod 'bras bu gsol ba gdab/ /rjes su dam tshig spyod pa dang / /skyed ⑤pa la sogs rgyun mi chad(6)/ /rnal 'byor pas ni bsam par bya/ /'di ni rigs ⑦mchog dbang bskur bla na med/ /mdzes ma khyod la skal ldan bsgrub phyir bstan//gzhan du rigs med dug la de yis slar zhing gnod/ /de phyir 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i 8)bkod pa yin/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las slob ma dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o // //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi 'khor klu sgrub pa'i thabs ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /gdul bya'i rigs su skyes pa yi(9)/ /gdug pa'i klu chen rnam pa brgyad/ /rigs 83—258

bsdus bochu bdag ba ru 9①/ /dam tshig la gnas sog ma med/ /'di dag bsgrub ②par 'dod pas ②ni/ /mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam lngas byug④ /pad+ma lha snam sgo ⑤dang bcas/ /sgo rgyan ltos 'gros rab tu mdzes/ /74)lte bar rdo rje 'dzin pa bsam/ /mdun du las kyi bka' nyan bskyed/ /pad+ma brgyad la klu chen brgyad/ /gdengs stika bdun ldan thal sbyar (9bsam/ rme /lha rnams ⑨rigs bzhi'i sa bdag ste/ /sgo dang gru chad 7rigs kyi rim/ /mchod rdzas klu yi rtsi sman bsam/ /de rjes rdo rje 'dzin bsams la/ /klu chen gnas nas (nyespyan drangs te(nye/ /e h+ye hi (nyenā ga rā dza sa pa ri bā (ster sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ(nye/rang rang stan la bzhugs par bya/ /pad+ma'i lte bar chu bdag dang / /dam tshig sog med dkar dang ser/ /thal sbyar sbrul gyi yizhabs su 'khyil/ /gtso bo rdo rje 'chang la 'dud/ /shar phyogs mtha' yas sngon po ste/ /lho phyogs nor rgyas ser po che/ /nub phyogs 'jog po kha dog dmar/ /byang phyogs stobs rgyu nag po ste/ /shar lhor pad+ma dung dang 'dra/ /lho nub pad 7chen ser ba tunyeste/ /nub byang dung skyong btsod dang 'dra/ /byang shar rigs ldan drur 4)ba'i mdog /mjug ma 'khyil bas gtso la 'dud/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni rigs bzhi dang / /sa bdag sna tshogs gzugs kyis bskor/ /de dag sngags kyi rim pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa badz+ra pā ṇi skṛ ( )da yaṃ/ nā ga ya ( spes mā ti krā ma tha ud sā da rna bha bi ṣ+pe ru ti swā hā/ rdo rje 'chang gis klu dam tshig la gzhag sapa'o/ / oṃ ba ru ṇa ya r+ghaṃ phuḥ(geswā hā/ oṃ sbu ṭa lisgru ṭa ma hā nā ga rā dza kro dha hūṃ/ sidhi sirnyi sbo ṭa ya hūṃ phuḥlig hā/ oṃ a nan ta r+ghaṃ phuḥ6)swā hā/ oṃ bā ne su ki hūṃ phuḥphyog hā/oṃ tak+ṣa ka hūm̐ phuḥ(gyes hā/ oṃ kur ko ṭa r+ghaṃ phuḥ(nyag hā/ oṃ pad+ma hūṃ phuḥru swā hā/83wa 259

oṃ ma hā pad+ma hūṃ phuḥ(1)swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā la rtsu phuḥ.aswā hā/ oṃ ku li ka hūm̐ phuḥ0swā hā / 'di dag klu'i rgyal po rnams kyi sngags so/ /rim pas mchod cing gso ba bya / /mdzes pa'i ④rgya mtsho (snyegator ma yis/ /klu rnams tshim pas gdug sems zhi / /de rjes bstod pa brjod par bya/ /hūm̐ chu bdag chen po (nyasprul pa'i dam tshig can/ /mtha' yas nor rgyas la sogs klu dbang rnams/ /rgya mtsho chu gter zab pa'i mjing 0chen gnas/ /rin chen sna tshogs yid 'ong spras pa yi/ / gzhal yas rina'abyor pa phun sum gnas na bzhugs/ /sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka rab 'bar rin chen gsal/ /yid 'ong nor bu 'dod pa kun sgrub pa/ /rang gzhan phun 9)tshogs don rnams ster ba'i dpal/ /'od 'bar sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel/ /du ma'i bskal 7par yon tan sbyangs pa yis/ /klu rgyal 'byor pa mchog la mnga' brnyes pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rdzu 'phrul mchog brnyes (nyapa'i / /yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab khyod yonyal bstod/ /sangs rgyas bka' ⑫thob dad pa'i stobs 'phel ba/ /sangs rgyas sar gnas sgrub la nan tan byed/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bas gzhan don mdzad/ /bdag gzhan don sgrub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas te/ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'gro rnams bskyang ba'i 7phyir/ /khas blangs mna' phul gedam tshig dran gyis la/ /phrin las don gyis bdag gzhan don grub khomadzod/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten pa rnams la/ /oṃ mtha' yas dang ni 'jog po dang / /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang / /nor rgyas bu dang dung skyong dang / /pad+ma dang ni chu lha dang / /rgya mtsho rgya mtsho chen po dang / /dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che / /gzugs che lto 'phye sbrul chen po/ /klu chen 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /83—260

mthun pa'i dam rdzas yid 'ong ba/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum gso ba'i sman/ /rin chen dar dang za 'og dang / /dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /sna tshogs khyed la phul ba yis/ / klu yi ①nad rnams ②med par mdzod/ /phyis kyang mi phyed chadam chos la/ /so so'i gnas su 'gro bar gyis/ /'di ni rdo rje 'chang gi bka'/ /'di las 'das na klu rgyal rnams/ /snying 'tshig mgo bo 'gas 'gyur te/ /lus la bskal pa'i me 'bar nas/ /sdug bsngal gyur na ma legs pas/ /dam las 'da' bar ma byed cig /nā ga rā dza sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ④badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ klu rnams dam tshig sgrub pa'o/ /de bzhin byas na klu nad rnams/ /skad cig nyid la byang 'gyur te/ /sgrub po bde bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de bas 'di la brtson par gyis/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa bzhin/ /gtan la phab pas rab tu bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las klu sgrub ⑤pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rjo 'chang gi (6swā'akhor klu gdug pa can rnams kyi ri nyend 'byung ba'i rtags ji lta bu lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi (5)mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /klu la rigs drug la sogs pa/ /sna tshogs rigs su yod gyur kyang / /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin te/ /nor rgyas (9nyedung skyong rgyal rigs yin te mthong ba'i dug /ser po sa la dbang ste lci 'thibs 83—261

lus po sbol/ /sha babs ra ba ②bzhi la khyad par ②na ba yin/ /bcwa ⑤lnga nyin gung rgyu ba'i dus la na6)/ /nad kyi gnas ni yispyi bor nges par 'bab/ /rlung rtsa babs la sha rus bar du na/ /skra 'byi glang thabs byas nas ⑦na ste rna ba dang —/ /glo bar (mi'abrel pas sha ro glo lu 'byung ba ⑨yin/ /dga' bo rigs ldan bram ze yin te bsams ⑩pa'i dug /dmar po me la dbang ba yin te 0tsha zhing gdung / /lus dmar skyi 7chung thang la mig rtsa lus po skam/ /'bring po babs sa nyi nub dgongs mo'i dus su na8/ /gnam stong bcwa lnga rgyu ba'i dus te de la na/ /snying gar babs pa ④snying mi dga' zhing dran pa nyams/ /mjug tu mgo dang lus la babs te 8na tsha che/ /sha ro snying la 'ong bas lce yis ro mi tshor//pad+ma 'jog po rje rigs yin te kha rlangs yidug /dkar po chu la dbang bas grang zhing bsil bar na / /lus mdog dkar la pags pa'i spris ma (she'achags//tha chungs babs pa yin te tshes brgyad bcwa brgyad na/ /snga dro tho rangs mi bde ske dang dpung pa g.yas/ /brang na tha ma mchin par babs pa'i sa yin no/ /pho bas zas mi 'ju zhing mig gis gzugs mi 'dzin/ /sha brul tshor ba med de cung zad sha lpags dmar1rte/ /pad chen stobs rgyu dmangs rigs yin te ( )reg pa'i dug /nag po rlung la dbang bas yang zhing g.yo/ /lus 'dar sems rgod sha 'phar phu shus 'debs/ /yan lag tshigs bzhi na zhing phol dang bad kun skye/ /sgrogs dang ro stod na zhing sna khrag dag kyang (nya'abyung / /'byang zhing lus (nyengal dgongs dang srod 8 la na/ /tha chungs 8stezhag la 'bas te so tshes gsum bcu gsum na/ /'di ni 'gong rigs rtsub cipas smyo 'bog btsan thabs gsod/ /tha ma mkhal mar 'bab 9 meste rna bas sgra mi thos/ /khu chu nyams pas chu sri sor 8)mo 83—262

phra / /chu lha dam tshig nam mkha' yin pas kun la khyab/ /gong ma ci ①rigs 'byung zhing dus med shes pa zhum/ /lus kyi shed nyams bral te sna tshogs ston pa ste0 / /'di ni bcos par dka' ②ste gtan la phebs ④par bya/ /khyad par mcher ⑤ba na zhing gdong dul sme ba 'byung / /lus la shig mang ko dri rwa phyagazhob mnam pa dang (nya/ /thur sel rlung la rul ba'i dri ma bro gyur lakhya/ /'di ni mcher ⑩bar 'bab ste chu la khrag kyang 'byung / /so so'i rtags su mkhas pas shes par gyis/ /spyir ni lnga po (nyegang zhugs kyang / /rim pas 'di ltar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /me dang grog po phugs rdugs dang / /ri phug dog pa'i sgo dang dong ske/ /lha khang 'dam rdzab mi sdug gzugs/ /dud 'gro'i tshogs dang mtsho ri gzar / /snying mi dga' zhing 'tshig 8pa ni/ /dang po 'byung bar shes par bya/ /glu len nub mo na dang shes pa lci/ /yan lag mi bde shu ba g.yan pa dang / /bas ldags 8'brum chung dmar sib 'ong / /'khrug cing za 'phrug sha mdog nyams / /me ris chu grang mablugs ltar grang 8/ /grang sib tsha thig sha bkra che chung byed/ /sha 'phrig tsobem dang sbrid cing 'khol/ /mig zlum tsha zhing smin ma byi(na / /lag sor sen mo nyams pas phra/ /lus la dri nga chu bur dang / /nya sgangs gnag chu rul dri mnam/ /stod gzer smad du 'khru bar byed/ / phyi yi /shesha skams mdog nyams dri ma bral/ /bug pa'i sgo yo bdud rtsi dus med pa/ /yang cig mdor bsdus bshad pa ni/ /dbang po gsal ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /mchin pa'i sgo yin mig la brtag /rgyal mo 'khor lo g.yang ra yin/ /gnas pa rus pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /mdzes pa so yi mkhar yin pas/ /kha dog rkang bu nus pa blta/ /nus pa chu ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /zangs mdog sen mo'i tshogs 83—263

yin pas/ /skye lugs kha dog rtsa ba brtag /mdongs dang sha yi 'bras bu ni/ /khyab pa dreg pa yin pas na/ /chags lugs kha dog 'gyur ba ①blta/ /drod brten 0khrag gi 'bras bu ni/ /bud med gsang sgo'i chu yin pas/ /kha dog ku ya gzugs la brtag /rkang mar ⑧bcud kyi 'bras bu ni/ /rtsa ba gnas lugs skye sa brtag /de rnams thams cad rtags ldan na/ /ngas kyang gso bar ga la nus / /gsum bzhi lnga la sogs pa yi/ /rim pa rnams dang ldan pa na/ /sngags dang sman gyis gso bar bya/ /phyi nang 'brel ba'i babs sa yis/ /legs par brtags te gso bar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las klu'i nad zhugs pa brtag pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //dpa 'a mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang gi (geklu'i nad gso ba'i cho ga ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /byol song klu yis zin pa la/ /'tsho dang mi 'tsho gnyis yin te/ /nges pa'i rtags chen drug 57tshang na/ /de la mkhas pas ci byar (6)yod/ /rnam smin las las byung ba yin / /gzhan rnams gso bar 'dod pa la(7)/ /dka' dang sla ba gnyis yin te / /dang po sngags kyi rim pa yin/ /gnyis pa rdzas dang 'brel pa yin/ /dang po sngags kyi sbyor ba ni/ /dbang bskur tshogs bsags rgyud sbyangs la/ /rim tsho pa gsum gyis bsnyen par 9bya/ /kha cig de tsam gyis kyang zhi'i/ /gal te 83—264

nus pa che ba na/ /gsad pa drag po'i sham 1)bu gdags/ /kha cig de yis 'tsho ba yin/ /gal te gnod tshabs che ba na/ /klu yi rang ②gshed bzlas pa tsam/ /nam mkha'i klu yis snying nas gzir/ /rig pa gnyis pa gsham du sbrel/ /rdo rje lte bar 'khor lo bri/ /de la dmigs te bsgrub par bya/ /dug rigs gsal bar gyur na ni/ /sa dug ngos zin rdo rje'i nang / /dga' bo rigs ldan me yi ③sngags / /bram ze'i 'khrul 'khor shis ④pa yin/ /me la chu yi 'khrul 'khor te/ /de yi sngags kyis gsad par (snyebya/ /pang chen stobs rgyu rlung ⑥yin pas/ /sa yi 'khrul 'khor lte bar bcas(pe/ /pad+ma 'jog po chu yin pas/ /rlung gi 'khor los gsad (nyapar bya/ /rang rang kha dog gshed du sbyar/ /gzhi snying sngags rnams dril la bzlas/ /gnyen po mi mthun rdzas dang sbyar/ /gnyen po gang yin lha yi gshed/ /man ngag bzhin du shes par bya/ /'khrul 'khor tshang 5)nas ma 7bde na/ /rgyal po'i sdong zla dbye bar bya/ /dus tshod zhag grangs 41)rim pa ni / /rtags tsodang sbyar la shes par bya/ /rtags rjes rjes su log pa na/ /sbyin sreg /geci rigs mkhas pas byayi/ /phyi rjes drag pos bcad 7pa dang / /lha dang rdzas kyi sngags kyis bcad9/ /mnan pas las mtha' brtul bar bya zhi ba drag po'i rim pa ni/ /mkhas pas brtags la brten ⑩par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las klu'i nad bsal 4sheba'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis 83—265

zhus pa legs②/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /dkyil 'khor 'dri ②dang sbyin sreg (gyidang / /bzlas pa thun mtshams durab gnas dang / /dbang bskur bskrad cing gsad pa dang / /'byung po khyung dang gnod sbyin dang / /klu dang ⑤gnas skyong mchod pa niyi/ /gtor ma med par gang spyad pa/ /las de 'bras bu med pa 'am/ /bar chad nye bar skye 'gyur bas/ /gtor ma'i cho ga bstan par bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor ldan pa yis/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pa bsag /gtor ma'i 'og tu rlung lha yil/ /sa bon las skyes (kyekha dog sdokyi/ /g.yo ba'i rlung yab dang bcas pa/ /de stengs 0rgod ma'i kha bsams te/ /dmar po rlung las skyes pa bsam/ /gru gsum rtsu las rdo rje gsum/ /sku gsung thugs kyis brtan por bya/ /de steng a 9/spelas pad+ma che/ /yangs la dkar zhing cung zad dmar/ /chos dbyings snod kyi gzhal yas yin/ /de nas sbyang ba'i ⑫ sa bon las/ /rbu i 'dzi khaṃ rtsu bsams te④/ /slar yang sha lnga sbyangs pa las/ / māṃ lī ṭ+wāṃ t+t+waṃ ṭ+wāṃ 8bsams te/ /yum lnga'i ye shes rnam par dag /bdud rtsi ye shes rnam dag 'di/ /sbyang dang spar rtogs sbyor ba yis/ /yi ge gsum gyi sgra ldan pa/ /bde ba'i ro cher nyi mar gsal/ /'char ba'i kha dog 'dra bar 'gyur / /rdo rje las byung dngul chu'i mdog /gnyis med thabs dang shes rab yin / /sa bon las byung pad+ma'i gdan/ /yangs par rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /phyogs skyong la sogs bkug la bstim/ / mdzub mdud 7gung mo rtse mo sbyor/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan 7par gnas/ /rang 'dod dngos grub sar bzhag zol/ /hūm̐ sgra ldan pas sngags 'dis sbyin/ /oṃ in+da dza (nyam dza la/ dzak+ṣa bhu ta 6)ba n+ni/83—266

ba u rak+ṣa/ tsan+da su dzasti/ ma da pa pa②/ ta la ③pa tā le/ aṣ+ṭha saspa ④ga hā/i rda ba ⑤ lo hūṃ dzi gha duphul+la/ dhū ⑦pa/ rmā sa/ paṃ ⑧ga /am+bha/ mdza/saspa 0sā ha/ khaṇa ⑩ti khu ṇi phe ḍa yig da swā hā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇ+ḍaṃ/āṅgā 7nut+pan+da tad 0i āḥs phaṭa swā hā/ 'khor rnams rtogs par bya ba'o④/ /lhag par khyung chen mchod pa ni/ /nya 8sha sgreng gi la du dang / /'o ma sbrul gyi sha yis mchod/ /gnod sbyin dag la sha rlon dang / /chang ni med du mi rung ngo / /ra khrag shing thog rnams kyis so/ /klu la dkar gsum mngar gsum dang / /rtsi sman dar zab sna tshogs mchod/ /rang gi rig pa phul byas la/ /bstod cing gsol ba gang yin bya/ /rgyu khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /rang gi gnas su gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang spyan drangs tshe na spyon/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya muḥzhes brjod/ /mchod sbyin 'di dang ma bral na/ /zhi sogs grub pa brgyad gang yin8/ /mchog gi 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi tu)rgyal po zhes bya ba las gtor ma'i cho ga bstan pa'i le'u ste bcwa lnga pa'o // //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ rdo rje 'chang la zhi zhu ba gsol ba bdag gi sgrub pa'i cho ga ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed yo pa'i ma/ /rdo rje bde chen stong pa nyid/ /khyod kyi sgrub pa 83—267

bzang po ni/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bshad/ /da ltar byung ba'ang de 'chad de/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang 'chad 'gyur la/ /nga yis kyang ni 'dir bshad de/ /byang chub sems ldan gang zag gis/ /rab dben pa yi sa yi char/ /mchod cing bstan dga' bsnyen byas la/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje can mchod bya/ /rim pas tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi bsgom/ /oṃ swa bhā ba shud r+sāḥ.asarba dharmāḥ0su bhā ba shud rnyo3 burta/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa bsgom/ /oṃ shu lan+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3 ⑧lha/ brjod med ye shes dag par bsgom / /bsrung zhing gzhal yas khang pa der/ /mdzes pa'i (7pad+ma la gnas pa//chos 'byung rnam dag pho brang du/ /nyi ma zla ba rnam dag dpal/ /baṃ las byung ba'i lha mo ni/ /sku mdog dmar ljang zhal gcig ⑦ma/ /phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /gar stabs rgyan ( tsho gyis mdzes ma ste/ /thod pa skam po'i phreng bas brgyan/ /shar du mā ma tī bsams te6)/ /sngon mo zhal gcig ⑩phyag gnyis ma / /g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon thod pa/ /g.yas su sangs rgyas spyan ser te/ /zhal gcig 37phyag gnyis g.yas pa na/ /rin chen g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin/ /g.yon du dam tshig sgrol ma ljang / /g.yas pa ut+pal thod pa 'dzin/ /rgyab tu gos dkar dmar ser te/ /pad+ma thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag /kun kyang khro zhing gar stabs 7bzhugs/ /rus pa rin chen rgyan dang ldan/ /mchog sgrub nad rnams sbyang ba dang / /bsrung zhing 'dod pa zhi rgyas dang / /rang gi srog 'dzin phrin las dbang / /rtag tu ye shes pa yang mchod/ /rig yi pa nges par bstan pa ni/ /oṃ badz+ra su khā 'a)bud+dha sarba pa shaṃ 7ku ru su ra ka hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ shang ka re shārnyi ka re/ lhusta cas 76sbyi ni ghā ta pho ya/ bhā ta nyi ya/ kurtsi 67ni swā hā/83—268

o ru ru sgu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dha stilo tsa ni sarba arba sā dha ni swā chahā/ oṃ a ka ṭi ③bi ka ṭi ni ka byashe ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi ka ro ṭaṃ bīḥ (9swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re ma ma ā yu ṣe 6)swā hā/ rang rang las dang 'brel pa ni/ /'bum 'gyur sngags kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /las gzhan dngos grub ma bsgrubs 9)par/ /lha mo khyod kyis byed pa yin/ /'di ni gsang ba dam pa ste(kye/ /ches gsang bas kyang mchog yin no/ /de bas mdzes ma khyod la bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje gsang ba mngon par bstan pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las yum bsgrub pa 6)rnam par phye ba'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //dpa' mo rdo rje bde mas gsol pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi las sna tshogs pa sgrub pa ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdzes ma khyod kyis zhus pa legs/ /zag med bde ba'i rgyu 'byung ma/ /bdag med shes rab ma yi mchog /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /sgrub po phun sum tshogs 'dod pas / /nga nyid thog mar mnyes bya ste/ /'dod pa'i rdzas la 'khor lo bri/ /de yi nang du chud pa yi/ /longs spyod ming dang spel bris nas/ /dgug la bcug la sngags 'di bzlas/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa 97/ tar+ya bā(te/ oṃ tsa le pra tsa le la lā lu te yā/ de ba kā tsom hā kā la an tsa ra ya bi sī 5geswā hā/ khri bzlas pas rang ci 'dod pa 'ong bar 'gyur te/ gong bu dgug pa'o/ /rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin du bsams la ta la'i lo ma la ri rab kyi 'khor lo byas te/ zur du hūm̐ dang hrī'i rdzibar du bsgrub bya'i ming bri'o/ /lte bar sngags bri/ rtsibs la yang sngags bris te/ rkang pa g.yon pas mnan 7cing / oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa tsa 83—269

murnyi ①du ma ke shi rnyi(9/ ha na ha na hri / pa tsa pa tsa hriskyi/ de ba dad ta che ge mo me pa shi ri swā hā/ zhes khri bzlas pas rkang pa dgug pa'o/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ⑤ga (6)ga a ri garka tha ⑦ta ri swā hā/ sngags 'di bzlas la kha bkrus la/khyu mchog gi lci ba dang / ldong ros bsres la rdo rje'i gzugs byas te/ lte bar 'khrul 'khor bcug la dgra'i sgor sbas na 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /bklags pas 'grub 'gyur nus pa 'di(nya/ /rdo rje 'dzin par rab zhugs nas/ /rdza mkhan lag pa'i 'dag pa la/ /rdo rje'i rnam par 'khrul 'khor bca'/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa che ge mo mu kha te tsa)/ ti sa 7lha tsā (nyan ting ghan da na titing lo māṃ timu tra mu rī ṣe tsharna che ge mo bharnya mi tshig hā/ sngags 'di khri bzlas khang par yimanan/ /nges par shags 7las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā tunyero ṣa ṇa na ma ni kha be rā ya tsi ri tsi ri kun+ta tu be na 1)mu shi tun te brta si ri kha li swā hā/ rdo rje la ni 9 )khrag gis 87bri/ /gang gis 5)phyogs mtshams sbas pa na/ /byi ba kha ni 'ching ba yin/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa rna ( )tu na te (stesi ri si ri khi li khi li swā hā/stag gi pags 5pa la bris te/ /gang la btags pa'i spyang ki bsrung / /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa mi ra burak+ṣa 7 rteto/ nā ky-i nyasha ka rā ⑥ya swā hā/ shing thog la bzlas ra 6nyabar sbas/ /spre'u'i 8gleganod pa bzlog par 'gyur/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa (stesarba sti bha ya dro sgye ri swā hā/ sbrang rtsi bu ram khu ba la/ /'di bzlas byug chogepas dom 'bros so/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa pā rā ha dhi rna ri rdu rdu dhe swā hā/ dug dang lan tshwa ske tshe dang / /yungs kur 8nyal phug sa bon dang / /dha zhu 7du ra dang gal bi dang / /ma te phag dang ce 87spyang khrag /sbrus 6)la rdo rje brgyad byas la/ /phyogs mtshams sbas na gnod pa zhi/ /mtshams bcad pa yi dam pa yin/ oṃ 83—270

lha dang rab sbyar nas/ /de nyid bstan pa'i yan lag gis/ /rang lus tshags ①su gzhug par gyis/ /rdo rje bde khros pa'i ②rgyud las lha bsgom pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas mngon par bshad bya ba/ /sgo chagasum sbyor ba shes pa yis/ /gsang ba'i snying po 'bum du bzlas/ /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sasba dus 0ta ka ha na/ da ⑧ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ bco yibargyad sngags kyi rgyal po 'di/ /ma byung mi 'byung 'byung mi 'gyur/ /'di bzlas sngon du grub ⑦par 'gyur/ /rtag tu mtshan ma bzang po 'byung / /gzhan gyi sbyor ba 'ong mi 'ong / /rang la nges par ston par 'gyur/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pas thub mi thub/ / 'bad pas ①legs par brtag par bya/ /de nas gtor ma'i ①sbyin pa ni/ /oṃ āḥrgyu zhes rgyun du gtang ⑩ngo —/ /rdo rje bde khros kyi yirgyud las gsang ba'i snying po dang mtshan ltas bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas mngon par bshad bya ba/ /rten ⑩ni rdo rje'i 'od du 'bar/ /brten 7pa 'phro tshad hūṃ du 'bar/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro/ /'jig rten ma lus sbyangs nas kyang / /slar la thig le nyid la 'dus/ /sgra tsodang bcas te rang gsal 'bar/ /brtan snyipar gyur na spro bsdu bya/ /rdo rje bde khros kyi 7rgyud las me'i bsam gtan gyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas mngon par bshad bya ba/ /mthing yigi shog gu tu sngon po la/ /gser 83—298

gyi 'khor lo bris pa'i steng / /bsrung ba'i snying po legs bkod de①/ /gang ming rak+ṣa sbyar bar gyis/ /de yang tri yis yongs bgos ②te/ /sangs rgyas sems can nyid la bstim / /de nyid bum par legs bzhugs la/ /mchod cing bzlas brjod gsol ba gdab/ /de nas tshes pa'i dus bzang la rang ngam gzhan la btags gyur na/ /bar chad thams cad nyer zhi nas/ /tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas par 'gyur/ /rdo rje bde khros kyi ④rgyud las bsrung ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas mngon par bshad rgya ba/ /'gro ba dug gis gdungs pa la/ /gdug pa'i dbang chen la sogs pa/ /'tshe ba 'di ltar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /mi dga' sems 'phyo 'gro snying 'dod/ /nyam (7chung 'thibs dang ltas kyang ngan / /yang yang na zhing gtam bsnol yi'ong / /de ni klu yi (7gnod pa ste/ /tshor nas legs par bcos na bzlog(kye /sa srin mi la 'di ltar gnod/ /lus sbrid sha 'phrig yonyesha ro 'byung / /sha bkra thor bu ngo yang 'gyur/ /de yang tshor nas bcos na bzlogatso /sa bdag gnod na 'di ltar 'gyur/ /gdon tunyeyang shin tu ldog 'gyur chedhi/ /na tsha'i zug rngu drag por 'gyur/ /res 'ga' bde ba ltar yang byed/ /skabs su thig le kho nar natunye/ /de yang bcos dka' shes pas bzlogatso /gnyen 8gyi gnod pa 'di yin te/ /shin tu na tsha'i tsotshabs kyang che/ /rkang lag na ⑩'khums dri ma ldog /sha khrag lud nas mig kyang sle/she/ /kha yo sna yo chu ser za/ /kha yang mi thub gnod pa za/ /chu bur byur 67na 'tshang sum̐ noyang che/ /tshor bar 0mi chog bsgrim pa gces(she/ /gdon tshogs gzhan yang 83—299

yun mi rtag① /phra mo tsam la sogs pa bzlog② /kun la bsgrims te bcos na 'tsho / /rdo rje bde khros kyi ②rgyud las gzhan gyi gnod pa brtag pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas mngon par bshad bya brgya/ /dbang chen la sogs thams cad la/ /mchod dang gtor mas mgu bar bya/ /ci 'dod pa yi rdzas rnams sbyin/ /rten yod gnas su legs par sba/ /snyan pa'i tshig gis ⑤bsgo byas la/ /bum par nor bu rin chen gzhugazhi) /mdzes pa'i dar sna 'bru yi stimadzod/ /gang gi rten la sbas gyur na/ /gnod pa rags ⑧pa zhi bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje bde khros kyi po)rgyud las zhi byed mchod thabs kyi le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas mngon par bshad bya ba/ /btsan ⑩dug gu gul gla rtsi dang / /shu dag shing kun mu zi drug /gsang sngags btab ste (melus la byug /gu gul nya mkhris 7gla rtsi dang / /sgog pa shu dag dri chen rnams/ /bdug pa byas te yang na bkru / /gser g.yu byi ru mig 'am phug /btsan dug rma bya'i mkhris par bcas//bcangs na bsrung ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje bde khros kyi 8rgyud las rten 'brel rdzas kyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //rdo rje bde khros kyi 7rgyud las dum bu dang po bstan pa'o// //de nas mngon par bshad bya ba/ /gdug pa thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir/ /drag sngags 'di dag brjod par bya'o/ /oṃ mā tsor ṇa yinasod sod/ mā ra ṇa /nya83—300
