sngag /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes bya ba/1)༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ mā yā dzā la ma 9na hā tan+t+ra rā dza nyananā ma/ bod skad du/ rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig (4)na/bcom ldan 'das gnas gtsang ma'i steng na khang pa brtsegs pa 5rin po che'i gzhal med khang chen po bkod pa/ rdo rje'i ka bas brgyan 6pa shin 7)tu mdzes pa'i rin po che bkod pas rnam par bkra ba/ rdo rje tsho dril bu 'khrol ba/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'i khyad par chen pos brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i 'khor los spras pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i cha byad sna tshogs 'chang ba rnams kyis 9don gyi bya ba byas pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po las yang dag par 'byung khoba'i spyod pa bskyod nas zhal bzhi'i sgo'i go skabs nas byung ba sna tshogs dang / rdo rje dang / rin po che chen po dang / 'od dpag med dang / byang 843—308

chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i tshogs dang / rig 0)sngags kyi lha mo rnams kyis brgyan pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po dang / bran pho ②dang / bran mo dang /pho nya dang / pho nya mo dang / phyag brnyan dang / phyag brnyan mo du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor zhucing mdun gyis ④bltas ⑤pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes kyi bde ba de'i (5)bdag nyid dang / dmigs pa dang ma ༅bral ba thugs rje chen pos mnyes gshin pa/ sems can thams cad bsgral ba la brtson par mdzad pa/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ⑤/ lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / mi ma yin pa la sogs pa mang pos brgyan pa na5)/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs so/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis nga'akhor gyi khyams kyi dbus na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rje 'dug pa la gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'dzum pa mdzad ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes /kyebla gos phrag pa gcig tsho tu gzar nas 'gying bag can du bltas nas rdo rje gsor te/pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar nas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas gsol pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dgongs pa ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhu dgongs pa gang gi slad du gzigs pa dang 'dzum pa mdzad/ 8des na bdag dang 'khor rnams ngo mtshar du gyur pa lags na/ de'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis seng ge chen po'i sgra dbyangs kyis bka' stsal du gsol/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes de skad du gsol ba btab ma thag tu/83—309

bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ①sna 'phrul dra ba ye shes rnam par bsgyings pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi phyi ma'i ②yang phyi ma'i thabs bde ba rdo rje'i ye shes bsgrub ①pa rol pas mnyes par bya ba'i thabs de kho na nyid thams cad kyi bu'abyung gnas stang stabs kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i thabs dang shes rab bde ba chen po'i rdo rjes sgrol ba/ rol pas bzhad cing bsgyings pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud kyi dam tshig dang te/ dkyil 'khor dang ri mo'i gzugs dang / bsgom ⑤pa dang / bzlas brjod dang / stang stabs dang / sbyor ba dgod ⑥pa dang / ting change 'dzin dang —/ dbab pa dang / bskrad pa dang / dbrog pa dang / dgug pa dang /bcing ba dang / brdeg pa dang / bsdigs pa dang / nyam thag par bya ba dang te/ bcad (shepa dang / bsreg 6)pa dang / bkang tib dang / bskrun pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / sbyin pa dang / slob dpon dang / slob ma gzung 41ba dang / gsang sngags mang po'i 'jo 8tshul rnams ngas bshad par bya'o / /de'i phyir khyod kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin mchog la snyoms par zhugs la nyon cig /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / gzhan yang gang dag 'khor du 'dus pa de dag thams cad kyis chos kyi 'bel yi ba'i gtam mnyan par cibartsams so/ /de la re zhig /sridang po dngos grub ni slob dpon chos kyi yinarjes su 'brang ba yin pas/slob dpon med par gyur na ni/ /dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /ye shes snying po khyod nyon cig /brtan skizhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo sgyu /nyamed/ /gsang sngags 83—310

rgyud kyi sbyor shes pas/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las bya'o/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs shes shing / /sems can kun la mi 'jigs sbyin/ /theg pa che zhu)la rtag dga' ba/ /de ni slob dpon yin par gsungs/ /phyi rol bstan bcos yongs shes shing / /nyan thos rnams kyis ②lam 'gro dang / /gsang ba de nyid bsdu ba gedang ske/ /theg pa chen po mi shes pa/ /snying rje yod pa ma yin dang / /dad med brtson 'grus ④mi ldan la/ /rtag tu ngan pa'i tshul spyod dang / /bstan bcos rnams la smod pa min/ /gong du bstan pa'i mtshan nyid dang / /ldan na slob dpon yin par gzung phyi/ /de yis yidakyil 'khor bri ba dang ⑦/ /de nyid kyis ni rgyud rnams bstan⑧/ /de yis bstan pa'i gsang sngags dag⑨ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /dge dang sdom la dga' ba dang / /rtag tu bla ma la gus dang / /rgyun du lha rnams mchod byed pa'i/ /yon tan ldan na slob ma yin / /slob dpon ci 'dra blta zhe yin/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen togatunye /de ni ye shes rgya mtsho che/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon tan gzung / /skyon rnams nam yang dzinam yin no/ /yon tan bzung 8bas dngos grub cing / /skyon rnams kyis 8ni dngos grub nyams/ /de yi grib ma'ang ⑫mi 'gom ste/ /mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu gsang ba yi/ /dam pa gang yin spangs par 'gyur/ /slob dpon smod par byed pa dgatso /rmi lam du yang mthong mi bya/ /slob dpon smod pa gang yin te/ /bgegs dang log 'dren rnams kyis gzung yin/ /ngan pa gtum 5nyepo las byed pa//mkhas pas rtag tu spang bar (7bya/ /mnar med shin tu skyi g.ya' ba'i/ /83—311

dmyal ba bstan pa gang yin pa/ /der ni slob dpon smod byed pa/ /gnas par 'gyur zhes rab tu gsungs/ /de phyir kun gyis rab bsgrims te/ /bsam yas 'bras bu smin byed pa'i/ /gyenasangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod byed pa'i/ /sems can dad pa ldan pas mchod/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/'di ni 'jug pa rim par phye ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po ye shes bsgyings pa gsang ba'i byin brlabs rdo kyi mchog rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas kyang rdo rje 'chang la bka' stsal pa/ phyag na rdo rje rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po chen po dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi phyi ma'i yang phyi ma ye shes chen po'i snying po 'bar ba rdo rje bsnyen bkur dzod byed pa zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir dbang bskur na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur bar 'gyur bas phyag na rdo rje sems can gang la las tshon rtsi mthong ba de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag byas pa dang / mchod pa (grwabyas par 'gyur ba la yang dag par zhugs pa de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du sangs rgyas nyid kyi (57grangs su 'gro bar 'gyur ba de nyon cig /dang po kho nas yongs su gzung 0ba byas te / slob dpon gyis lha nyid kyi stang nastabs su 'dug la/ lag pa g.yas pa (9)bsgrims te rdo rje gsor zhing /lag pa g.yon pas dril bu gsil 7nas rdo rje 'gros kyis yongs su bskor bar 8 3—312

bya'o / /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi brjid pa gang 1)gis bskor nas kyang khro bo'i skur bsgoms (minas sdang ba'i lha dang / lha ma yin dang gsang ba pa rnams la tshig 'di rab tu brjod par bya'o/ /slob dpon ming 'di zhes bya bas slob ma che ge mo zhig rdzogs pa'i byang chub rdzogs par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyis ( /ribla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po ming 'di zhes bya ba bri yis/ lha dang lha ma yin dang / gnod sbyin dang srin po dang yi dgas 54)dang / sha za dang / brjed (5)byed dang / 'byung po dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / gnon po dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi 'am ci dang / rig sngags grub pa ( nodang / rgan po'am/ rgan mo g.yog dang 'khor du bcas pa gang dag 'khod pa rnams dengs shig /'di ltar rdo rje 'chang gi bka' thos nas myur ba nyid du dengs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag ni phyag na rdo rje hūm̐ zhes bya ba rab tu khros pa'i bzhin 'bar ba can gyis ji ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar ba kun tu 'bar bas mgo tshal pa brgyar du 'gas par 'gyur ro zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ stang stabs nyukyil gnas bzhin du sa gzhi ngordo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /g.yas brkyang ba dang / g.yon brkyang ba dang / sa ga'i 'dug stangs dang / zlum po'i 'dug /1nistangs dang / mthun lopa'i rkang stabs dang / rus sbal gyi rkang stabs dang / rdo rje gdegs rim pa dang / rdo rje 'jo tshul dang / rkang pa ya gcig r+sha gi stangs dang / seng ge'i kestabs dang / seng ge glal chosab dang / bung / ba'i 'phur ba'i stang /shestabs dang / rdo rje sgrog dang / rdo rje gsor ba dang / rdo rje'i nyushe stang stabs sku dang /83—313

rdo rje dgug pa dang / rdo rje gar ①dang / rdo rje 'jigs su rung ba dang / rdo rje ro langs ma dang / rdo rje tho ba dang / rdo rje'i byin rlabs ②dang / rdo rje'i gdu bu dang / bud med kyi sgyu 'phrul stang stabs dang / rdo rje'i dra ba dang /stobs po che'i 'dregs pa dang / rdo rje mche ba dang / rdo rje gad mo dang / rdo rje sgra dang / ral gri'i ( thabs dang / rdo rje'i thabs dang / 'khor lilo'i tshul ⑤dang / gtun 6)shing gi tshul (medang / ba dan gyi tshul (shedang / zhags pa'i tshul (1)dang / pad ma'i tshul dang / be con gyi tshul kyidang / mi 'jigs pa'i tshul dang / lcags kyu'i tshul (nyudang / 'bras bu'i tshul dang / mdung thung gi tshul 'odang / gzhu'i tshul spyodang / mda' bzung ciba'i tshul 7dang /mda' 'phang ba'i tshul tsodang / thag mdung bskor ba'i tshul ⑩dang / mchog sbyin pa'i tshul dang / mdung gi tshul 9/nyadang / mtshon rtse gcig 7pa'i tshul ( )dang glu/ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang / rdo rje'i (1'dug stangs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi 'dug stangs dang / rdo rje skyil mo krung (snyedang / pad+ma'i 'dug stangs dang —/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 4)dang / dpa' bo'i luste'adug stangs dang /bzang po'i 'dug stangs dang / tsog pu'i 'dug stangs dang / rtse ( geba'i 'dug stangs dang / mdun du dgu ba dang / phyir dgye ba dang / mtha' yas dang —/ rnam par rgyal 69ba dang / sprin sgra dang / gsus po che dang / rgyal ba'i phur bus gnas pa'i bcing ba dang / phur bu brdung ( rteb dang / dra ba dang ske/ ra tsho snyebs mtshams gcad 6)pa dang / phyogs bcing ba de lta bus/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od 'bar bas du )'khrigs par bsgoms nyate gtan la dbab par bya'o/ /rang gi ming nas smos te/ hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyi 83wa 314

sgra brjod na 'khor lo thams cad kyi bla na med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas par bya ba ni/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang 6)du gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis ②dkyil 'khor 'dri ①bar bya/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sta gon du gnas par bya ste/ thugs brtser gnas pa'i dgongs pa can/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /sras dang lhan cig gshegs nas kyang / /sa gzhi yongs su gzung bar mdzod/ /de nas 'khor lo'i dbus su chos kyi dkyil 'khor byas la/ mtha' kun tu yang mtshan nas smos te thig ler bya'o/ /de ltar spyan drangs te mchod pas mnyes par byas nas phyir byung ste phyogs kyi gtor ma sbyin no/ /de nas sems can sta gon du gnas par bya ste/ spos chus spyi bor bsang rtsigator byas nas⑤/ lag pa snying gar rtsibakram nas su/ /rtse mo lnga pa rgya gram bya/ /g.yas pas ⑦ srung skud (kyebacings 6nyenas su/ / lag mthil so yishing ku sha sbyin/ /de nas 'dug ste gsum la skyabs su btang ba dang / sdig pa kun tu bshags (nyepa dang / bsod nams kyi kyirjes su yi rang ba dang / bdag nyid dbul ba dang / byang chub tu sems tsobaskyed par bya'o/ /de la 'di ni skyabs su 'gro ba yin te/ dkon tso mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'gro ba'i dge la yi rang ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung ⑫/ /zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas ci nus kyis ci 'dod pa'i chos bshad par bya'o/ /de nas sngar bshad pa bzhin du mnyes par 'gyur bas 7mchod pa'i cho ga bzang 83—315

po bya stodhi/ slar yang gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /de nas nang du zhugs la dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir glo g.yas pas nyal te/ rmi lam bzang ngan bltas nas phyi de nyin ②dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /tshon dang thig las sangs rgyas lnga'i/ /ngo bo dag kyang sprul par bya/ /'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can rnams ni rnam grol mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal bdag 45)ste/ /nyes pa thams cad rnam spangs pa'i/ /tshon rtsi dgye ba brtsam (4)par bya/ /dang po 'a)slob dpon nyid kyis bgyi(0)/ /de nas kun tu slob mas bya/ /dang po sa gzhi yongs gzung (7)ba/ /gnyis pa sta gon gnas pa ste/ /nub gsum pa ni 'jug pa ⑧yin/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i srad bu yis/ /khru stong pa'am lnga brgya bar(9)/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa thig gdab bo/ /yang na khru lnga khru do pa'am/ /khru gang ba yi 7bar du bya'o/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhis ni brgyan pa yi/ /dbus su 'khor lo legs par bri/ /dkyil du rnam par snang yonyamadzad gzhaganyi /shar phyogs su ni mi 'khrugs (snyepa/ /lho phyogs su ni rin chen 'byung / /nub phyogs su ni 'od dpag med/ /byang phyogs su ni don grub mirnams/ /'khor lo grwar yini lha mo bzhi/ /dngos grub sbyin par mdzad par bri/ /dbang bdag gi phyogs su ni spyan (7no/ /me'i phyogs su ni mā ma tī'o1 / /bden bral phyogs su ni gos (lha dkar can no/ /rlung gi phyogs su ni lha mo sgrol ma'o/ /rdo rje shugs kyis phyir phyung nas rim pa gnyis pa la shar phyogs su ni rdo rje sems ma/ lhor rdo rje rin chen ma/ nub tu rdo rje chos ma/ byang du rdo rje las ma rnams bri'o/ /grwa lho rnams su skul khri 7byed ma dang / rin chen sgrol ma dang / khro gnyer can dang / rdo rje lu gu rgyud rnams so/ /de nas yang 83—316

'gying bag tu langs te/ rdo rje shugs kyis phyir phyung hunyenas rim pa gsum pa la/shar phyogs su byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / 'jam dpal dang /spos kyi glang po dang / ye shes tog rnams bri'o/ /lho phyogs su bzang skyong dang /blo gros rgya mtsho dang / blo gros mi zad pa dang / spobs pa brtsegs pa rnams bri'o / /nub phyogs su ni phyimathu chen thob dang / ngan song thams cad spong ba dang —/ mya ngan gyi mun pa thams cad nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros dang / dra ba can gyi 'od rnams bri'o/ /byang phyogs su zla 'od dang / 'od dpag med dang —/ nam mkha' mdzod dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba rnams bri'o / /shar sgor ①ni gshin rje mthar byed do/ /lho ④sgor ni shes rab mthar byed do/ /nub sgor ni pad+ma mthar byed do/ /byang sgor ni bgegs (gemathar byed do / /grwa (5)rnams su ni mi g.yo ba dang / 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang / be con sngon po dang / stobs po che'o/ /zur rnams su ni rdo rje bri'o/ /sgo'i nang logs su yang rdo rje bri'o/ /'khor lo ni tshon rtsi dkar pos bri'o/ /gnyis pa ni tshon rtsi dkar po dang / ser po dang / sngon po gsum gyis bri'o/ /gsum pa ni sna lngas bri bar bya ste/ de lta bu ni dkyil 'khor chen po yin no/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i don du dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa (/sgo bzhi dang ldan pa rim pa gnyis par bya'o/ /dbus su ni pad+ma 'dab ma (8)brgyad pa snying po dang bcas pa bri'o / /snam bu gnyis pa la shar phyogs su ni rdo rje'o/ /lho phyogs su ni rin po che / nub phyogs su ni pad+ma/ byang phyogs su ni ral gri stetshon/ de lta bur dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /de nas slob 4 nodapon gyis yi lus legs par bkrus te/spos kyis bskus nas legs par brgyus pa'i me tog gi phreng 7ba mgo la bcings 83—317

nas / mgul pa dar gyis bcings pa la/ /ldum bu yis ni kha bkab pa/ /rin chen sman 'byung sna lnga dang / /spos chu yis ni bkang ba dang / /bum pa mngon par bsngags par bya/ /rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil 'khor gyi/ /bdag po lha mo rnams kyi bzhi/ /lha rnams kun gyi bum 6)pa bzhi/ / sgo yi phyogs kyi bum pa ni/ /(khulas kun byed (8)pas bzlas brjod do④/ /sems can kun gyis bsang zhi)gtor bya/ /yang na ku ⑥sha'i chun rtsipos bya/ /de nas bum pa mngon par 69bsngags te lha bshos dang gtor ma phul nas me tog dang bdug pa dang /dri dang / phreng ba dang / mchod yon dang / zhabs bkru ba la sogs pa dbul (9)lo/ /de rnams phul nas bum pa rnams grwar yigazhag 7par bya'o/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa ni dbus su spyan drang bar 7bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams spyan drangs nas gsal bar bya ste / gzhug 39pa dang / bsdam yidang / dbang du bya ste/ phur bu dang / ra ba dang / dra bas phyogs bcing ba tsodang / mtshams gcad ⑩pa byas la/mchod yon dang / zhal yo bsil dang / gdan dang / me tog dang / bdug pa la sogs pa yang bsngos te phul nas phyag rgya'i tshogs rang rang la bstan par bya'o / /bstod pa dang / rdo rje'i glu (snyedang / dril bu gsil (7ba'i sgra dang /sil snyan dang / gling bu dang / rgyud kyi sgra'i khyad par yang dbul lo/ /rol mo'i khyad par gzhan rnams kyis kyang bstod par bya'o/ /bstod nas bzod par gsol te dngos grub thams cad kyi phyir gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas slob dpon bdag nyid zhugs te/ de'i 'og tu slob ma gzhug / )go/ /de nas sems can thams cad snying po 'di dang phyag rgyas gnas lngar bsrung ( stezhing gnas lngar cho 83—318

ga bya'o/ /rgyu ①ma dzi na dzika /āḥ.ā ro blaka8 /hūm̐ badz+ra lhaka /swā rat+na lhaka /hā pradz+nyā sgrikadu /de nas tshigs su bcad pa 'dis gzhug par bya ste/ rdo rje ye shes thob byed pa'iskyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /pho brang dkyil 'khor snying po 'dir⑤/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya/ /rdo rje sems mas me tog gtor bar bgyi ste/ pra tīts+tsha ⑥badz+ra hoḥg/ tshigs su bcad pa 'dis gdong g.yogs dgrol lo/ /de ②ring dad pa'i shugs kyis ni/ /dkyil 'khor deng 'dir blta bar gyis/ /sangs rgyas gdung gi rigs su 'khrungs/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /dam tshig mchog tu grub par byed/ /rdo rje pad+ma rol pa'i mchog /sngags kyi bdag nyid shes par bya/ /de yi snying po 'di yin te/ /pa sh+ya badz+ra/ gang la me tog bab pa de de'i lha yin no/ /de nas dbang bskur sbyin bya ste/ /dri dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /gos dang rgyan gyis legs par brgyan/ /steng du bla re bre 6)bar bya/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan tsob dan dang / /lha dang tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / /gdu bu dag dang ska rags dang / /bkra shis yo byad rnams kyis bklubasaskyo/ /slob ma sdig dang bral ba la/ /slob dpon gyis ni dbang bskur ro/ /dang por rnam rgyal bum pa yis/ /de nas lha mo bzhi rnams dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bzhi po yis/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad glu sgra dang / /rdo rje dril bu gsil tsob yis/ /skyob pa kun gyis mngon sum du/ /til gyi gang bu bzhin gang ba'i/ /rgyal bas tsho bum pa bzung linas ni/ /de nyid la ni dbang bskur bya/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid rig tshepar bsam/ /de lta bur ni bsams nas kyang / /chos kyi mtshan nyid bstan par bya/ /thur ma me long 'khor lo 83—319

dang —/ /dung dang rdo rje glegs bam dang / /gser dag dang ni dngul rnams kyis / /mi shes rab rib 6)la sogs pa/ /ci nus par ni bsal (9bar bya/ /thur ma la sogs med na yang / /phyag rgyas thugazugs rnams bstan par bya/ /de nas dam tshig bstan (4)par bya/ /de ⑤ring phyin (7)chad bu khyod kyis/ /srog dang lus la bab gyur kyang / /dam pa'i chos dang byang chub sems/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /rdo rje spun rnams bkur sti zhing / /sdang la byams shing chags bral ba/ / nam yang ④bya ba ma yin no/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas kyis/ /khyod ni dmyal ba'i nang du 'dor/ /de nas bla mas yon blangs te//sa dang yid 'ong chung ma dang / /rin chen gser dang nor bu 'bar/ /mu tig byi ru la sogs dang / /lus kyang dbul du gzhug par bya/ /bla ma la ni gus pa yi / /slob mas de bzhin kho nar bya/ /bla ma de ni mgu bar bya/ /bla ma mgu ba dngos grub sterten / /gzhan du min zhes thub pa (9)gsung / /de nas slob ma bslang ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar mchod pa bya ste/ sbyin sreg 7gi las bya'o/ /de nas cho ga mthong bas las byas nas/ /sbyin sreg (1bzlas brjod mchod pa dang / /de bzhin bsgom 7pa'i rim pa'i tshul/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i rim pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad tshim par bya/ /de nas dus gsum gshegs pa yi/ /rgyal ba thams cad gshegs su gsol/ /bsgrims te tshon rtsi rnams bsdus nas/ /chu klung chen por bskur nas kyang / /ba yi phyi bas byug par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni yo byad kun/ /slob dpon nyid kyis bsdu yi bar bya / /slob mas cung zad mi spyad dokha/ /de ni dam tshig nyams par 'gyur/ /slob dpon gyis kyang ci rigs par/ /bdag nyid 'dod pa spyad par bya/ /8(2—320

rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las 'di ni dkyil 'khor rim par phye ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas yang gsang sngags kyi 'khor lo la 'jug pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs nas phyag na rdo rje la bka' stsal pa/phyag na rdo rje gsang sngags kyi snying po'i yi ge rnams nyon cig /phyag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ sems can thams cad la sman zhi)pa'i slad du bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas ②bshad du gsol/ oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad do/ /oṃ hūṃ mi 'khrugs pa'o/ /oṃ ṭ+wāṃ ③rin chen 'byung gnas so/ /oṃ hrīḥ(ge'od dpag med do/ /oṃ khaṃ don yod grub pa'o(snye/ /oṃ ga ga na lo tsa ni yi hūṃ spyan gyi'o/ /oṃ ki ri ki ri mā ma tī hūṃ mā ma khri'i'o4)/ /oṃ ka ṭi bi ka (sheshe ka ṭaṃ ka ṭi 5)ka ro ṭi bīr+ya 7su hā/ gos dkar mo'i'o(nye/ /oṃ tā re tut+ta 8re tu re swā hā/ sgrol ma'i'o8/ /oṃ satwa brdzu tso:/ rdo rje sems ma'i'o⑩ /oṃ rat+na badzī tso / rdo rje rin chen ma'i'o⑩/ /oṃ dharma brdzu 6)rgyu/ rdo rje chos ma'i'o4)/ /oṃ kurma brdzu so)rtsu/ rdo rje las ma'i'o tu/ /oṃ tsa ru le tsu le tsun+de swā hā/ skul tsobyed ma'i'oluste/ /oṃ rat+na tsolo ki gyurat+na 4 natsā li ni swā hā/ rin chen sgron ma'i'o(she/ /oṃ skṛ kurtsi :khrin/ khro gnyer ma'i'os )/ /oṃ badz+ra shri kha (1le hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i'o/ /oṃ mizhu / byams pa'i'os / /oṃ mudun/ 'jam dpal gyi'o(nyam/ /oṃ sa man+ta bha dra hūṃ/ kun tu bzang po'i'o(sgo/ /oṃ garnya ha ti ce ni rtsu/spos kyi glang po'i'os / /oṃ dz+nyā na ke tu ba ti hūm̐/ ye shes tog go/ /oṃ bha dra ru 83—321

bha ①te bha dra (kye'i le ①rgyu/ bzang skyong ngo / /oṃ sā ④ga re ma hā sā ⑤ga re hūṃ/blo gros rgya mtsho'o/ /oṃ ak+ṣa ye ⑥ཿ hūm̐ ak+ṣa yak+ṣa a kurma ā pa ⑦ra ṇa pa ri sho dha ni (sheg hā/ blo gros mi zad pa'o/ /oṃ pra ti bhā ni pra ti bhā ne kū 5)she hūṃ/spobs pa brtsegs pa'o⑩/ /oṃ sbru (7me ma hā s+thā ma ba ati swā hā/ mthu chen thob pa'o / /oṃ sarba ⑫ a pā ya dza te sab yihā paṃ sho dha hūṃ/ ngan song thams cad spong tshuba'o/ /oṃ sarba 8sho ka ta mo ni rdu yim ti hūṃ/ mya ngan thams cad kyi mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i blo gros so/ /oṃ dzā (nyeli ni ma hā dzā li ni 7rgyu/ dra ba can gyi 'od do/ /oṃ su dha na shri ( )ye hūm̐/ nor bzangs so0/ /oṃ tsan+de tsan+de tsan+d+ra byā ba sa lo ki te (nyes hā/ zla 'od do/ /oṃ a mi (gete pra sgye a mi zhunate hūṃ/'od dpag med do/ /oṃ ga ga ne ga ga na ba ra lo tsa na hūm̐/ nam mkha' mdzod do / /oṃ sarba ni bā ( nyar ṇa bisko ( )rnyi ne ju/ sgrib pa thams cad ()rnam par sel ba'o / /oṃ ya mān+ta krita rte/ gshin rje gshed do/ /oṃ pra dz+nyān ta krita(nye/gzhan gyis (1mi thub pa'o/ /oṃ pad+mān ta krita(snye/ rta mgrin no/ /oṃ a mṛ (steta kuṇ+ḍa li bi na ta krita(ste/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor ro/ /oṃ a tsa la hūm̐ haṃ/ mi g.yo ba'o / /oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'o/ /oṃ nī la ru daṇ+ḍa ma hā daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ be con sngon po'o/ /oṃ kro dha hūm̐ dzaḥ(nya/ stobs po che'os / /dkyil 'khor du dgod pa'i gsang sngags kyi yi ge de dag go(nya/ /'di dag la bsten so)nas ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par las nges par 'byung ba'i gsang sngags bye ba phrag du ma gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa thams cad ni lcags kyus spyan drang ngo me/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rdo rje'i phyag rgyas so/ /rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi ni rigs kyi yum rnams kyis so/ /khro bo rnams kyi ni zhal gyi phyag 83—322

rgyas so/ /bran rnams ni zhags pa'i phyag rgyas so/ /pho nya rnams ni lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas so/ /de dag la sogs pa ni spyan drang ba'i sbyor ba'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las 'di ni gsang sngags rim par phye ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i ①rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes chen po'i stobs kyis rnam par 'phrul pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /phyag na rdo rje ras sam rtsig (9pa la sogs pa la gzugs brnyan bsgrub rinasapa la dmigs pa gang gis gsang sngags 'chang rnams kyis ye shes rdzogs par 'gyur zhing ye shes rdzogs pas sangs rgyas nyid bde blag tu thob par 'gyur na/dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang (gci dgos pa'i gsang sngags kyi tshogs thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin gsang chen bla na med pa bshad par bya yis (genyon cig /oṃ gyi ye shes kyis bsgrubs pa/ /rgyal chen rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /shes rab ye shes rab rgyas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis (ponamachog gis mchod/ /zhi ba thor tshugs cod pan 'chang / /zhal gsum gyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /gser gyi mdog can phyag drug pa/ /dang po bsam gtan phyag rgya can/ /bgrang phreng ldan zhing mda' yis brgyan/ /g.yon gyis (/lha mo'i nu ma 'dzin/ /'khor lo dang ni gzhu thogs shing / /lha rnams bred cing khams rnams 'dzag /'bar ba'i 'od dkyil brgyan pa la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprin 'phro ba/ /rab tu 'byung (na zhing legs 'khyud 5)pa/ /de nyid spyod yul can bsgoms te/ /gsang 83—323

sngags nang gi (/—)bzlas brjod bya/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi stobs rdzogs par byed pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /oṃ zhes bya ba'i tshig gi lam / /'jig rten dbang phyug 'od chen bsam/ /thor tshugs cod pan 'chang ba'i lha/ /dbu rgyan (5)thams cad mkhyen pas brgyan/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /gtso bo zla ba'i gzugs dang 'dra/ /zhal gsum spyan gsum 'bar ba la/ /phyag drug 'dug stangs bzhi pa can/ /phyag gnyis pad+ma'i 'jo ( natshul can/ /g.yas na bgrang phreng rdo rje 'chang / /g.yon pas nu ma 'dzin pa la / /ril ba (4)spyi blugs gsum pa na/ /gzugs rnams thams cad 'phro (5)mdzad cing / /kun nas 'od zer phreng ba can/ /lag nas mtshon shor 'jigs 'khrugs pa'i/ /bgegs 'gyel ba la lta byed pa'i/ /de 'dra'i tshig gis lam bsgoms na/ /ring por (6)mi thogs sangs rgyas 'thob(7/ /rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog yangs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /zla ba'i (shegazugs la rtsu zhes pa6)/ /sems kyi rdo rje bsgom 7par bya/ /mthing shing bzang po lta bu'i mdog /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab bklubs 11pa/ /cod pan la ni mi 'khrugs bzhugs/ /rin chen rnams kyis yongs su brgyan/ /zhal ras gsum ldan spyan gsum pa/ /cung zad bzhad cing 'jo sgeg can/ /phyag brgyad kyis tu ni brgyan pa la/ /rdo rje dang por gsor ba dang / /gnyis pa na ni ral gri gdengs/ /lcags kyu bzang po gsum pa na/ /bzhi pa yis ni mda' yang gsor/ /de bzhin g.yon na dril bu bsnams / /de bzhin gnyis pas nu ma 'khyudakyi / /gsum pa na ni zhags pa ste/ /bzhi pa lha rdzas gzhu yang 'dzin/ /rol pa'i stabs su legs par bzhugs/ /83—324

de bzhin sangs rgyas sprin gyis 'bar/ /'di 'dra gang zhig 6)rtag sgom ②pa/ /de yi rdo rje sems brtan ②zhing / /ring por mi thogs byang chub 'thob④/ /rga shi rnams kyi pha rol 'gro/ /sems can gyi stobs mtha' yas pa rdzogs par byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po rdo rje shugs zhes ⑤bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / ṭ+wāṃ gi 4)ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /rin chen ⑦'byung ba'i bdag nyid de/ /zhal ras gsum ldan spyan gsum pa/ /thor tshugs cod pan rnams kyis brgyan/ /bde ba chen po kha dog dmar/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya rnam ⑧par bzhugs/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung yo)bcas pa ste/ /phyag g.yas na ni rdo rje dang / /g.yon pa rin chen yongs su 'dzin/ /'od zer ser po 'phro ba las/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i sprin chen nam/ /byang chub sems dpa' gzhan rnams kyis/ /rin chen char gyis ⑩rgyas par byas/ /rin chen mngon par thob pa'i skeye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /khaṃ gi 7ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /don yod rdo rje bsam par bya/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgya legs bzhugs pa/ / margad ta yi ⑫'od ltar 'bar/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na ral gri dang / /g.yon pa yis ④ni lcags kyu nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sprin 'phro zhing / /legs par bsgrub tsophyir slar yang sdud/ /'od zer chen pos rab gsal ⑩zhing / /ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /'di 'dra rtag tu sems byed pa/ /nam mkha'i tsosnying po thub pa che/ /'du byed thams cad spangs pa yi/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa der /she'agyur ro/ /nam mkha' tsho/snang bar byed pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /la yi ye shes las bsgrubs ( /pa/ /rgyal ba thams cad kyis kyang brgyan / /lha mo spyan gsum phyag brgyad pa/ /zhal gsum gser gyi mdog dang 83—325

mtshungs / /sgeg pa'i cha lugs legs 'chang ba/ /cung zad bzhad pas 'dod chags ma6)/ /dang po'i phyag ni mchog sbyin mdzad/ /de bzhin gnyis pa mi 'jigs sbyin/ /phyag gsum pa na rdo rje ste/ /bzhi pa na ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa sdigs (nyamadzub zhags pa can/ /rin chen snye ma gnyis pa na/ /gsum pa na ni bgrang phreng ste/ /bzhi pa gzhu yis legs par brgyan/ /'od dmar 'od zer phreng ba can/ /lha rnams 'jigs pas sems myos te/ /lag pa thal mo sbyor bar ri byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprin (ge'aphro bar/ /ye shes rdo rje spyan ma bsam/ /byang chub yan lag 'bras brgyan pa'i/ /lha mo 'di 'dra bsgom par bya/ /ye shes spyan gyis snang bar byed pa'i rdo rje 'jo tshul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ma yi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /rdo rje rigs can mā ma (5)khri / /lha mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ /dgod cing zhal ras khro dang bcas/ /ut+pal sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /'od dmar shin tu 'bar ba can/ /dang po mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag /gnyis pa legs par rdo rje bsdams/ /gsum pa yis ni mda' (beyang gsor/ /g.yon pa bsdigs pa'i mdzub (7mo ste/ /gnyis pa zhags pa legs par bsnams/ /gsum pa yis ni gzhu yang 'dzin/ /rdo rje can ma sku gsum 'chang / /dngos med ngo bo mtshan nyid can/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni sprin 'phro ba/ /'di 'dra sgom pas (7bsgom par bya'o/ /sgyu 'phrul 'byung ba'i stobs kyis (9)ye shes zab mo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /pa yi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /zla ba'i mdog dang ldan pa'i yum/ /ming ni gos dkar can zhes bya/ /spyan gsum dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /zhal ras gsum pa dga' mdzad ma/ /phyag drug mi 'jigs sbyin mdzad ma/ /gnyis pa na ni rdo rje ste/ /83—326

gsum pa mda' yis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yon pa pad+ma bsnams par bya/ /gnyis pa na ni bgrang nor phreng / /gsum pa na ni gzhu bsnams shing / /rol pa'i stabs su legs par bzhugs①/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni 'phro bar mdzad/ /pad+ma'i sprin gyis rgyas par bsgom(mi/ /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /rin chen skur ②ni bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma'i gzugs kyi ④'jo tshul sangs rgyas kyi rgyal ba 'dren pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /tā (9yi ye shes las bsgrubs (5)pa/ /lha mo sgrol ma rdzu 'phrul can( )/ /'jo sgeg cha lugs dul gnas pa / /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /phyag drug sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 6)/ /bzhad pa margad 'od dang ldan/ /dang po mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag /gnyis pa na ni rdo rje bsnams/ /gsum pa na ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa bsdigs 7pa'i mdzub mo ste/ /gnyis pa na ni ut+pal nyid/ /gsum pa na nyunyeni gzhu yang 'dzin/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar ba can/ /sangs rgyas 'phro bas rgyas mdzad pa/ /dga' mdzad sems can kun gyi ma/ /rtag par rgyun du bsgom par bya/ /sems can thams cad dbang du 'gro zhing dga' bar byed pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /skyes 7mchog rgyal bas gsungs pa yi()glu/ /sems ma bzhi ni brjod pa'i ming / /sems ma dang ni rin yichen ma/ /chos ma rdo rje las ma ste/ /rol pas 8rjes su mnyes mdzad ma/ /de dag ji ltar rigs par bsgomatso/ /de dag kyang ni bsgoms pa yis/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub 'thob/ / /sems can rab tu dga' tsho byed pa'i/ /'phags tsho/ma bzhi yi ting nge ṭaṃ )'dzin to/ /rgyu gi ri 1yi ge las bsgrubs pa/ /ming ni skul sa byed ces ma'i gzugs/ /sku gsum rgyal ba bye ba phrag /bdun ( gegyis gsang sngags 83—327

glu yis bstod/ /yi ge dgu pa thabs dgu can/ /lha dgu rnams kyi gnas kyang yin / /zhal gsum ston ku'i 0)'dam bu'i ②mdog /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /na chung skal ②ldan dar la bab/ /rig ④sngags thams cad sgrol mdzad ma/ /dang po'i zhal ni cung zad tsam/ /bzhad cing spyan gsum ldan pa ste(5)/ /g.yas kyi zhal ni rnam gdangs pa/ /ut+pal sngon po 'dab ⑥ma'i 'od / /mche ba zla ba tshes pa bzhin/ /lce ni glog bzhin ljib par mdzad/ /g.yon pa kha dog dmar po ste/ /tshems kyis sgros ni rnam par gnonag/ /rol pa'i stabs su legs par bzhugs/ /gdu bu rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /brgyan pa'i phyag ni 98)nyi shu rtsa drug de 6)la phyag gnyis rtsa ba'i phyag rgyas snying ga'i yiganas rnam par brgyan pa'o/ /g.yas pa gnyis 6nyani mi 'jigs pa 7sbyin pa'o/ /gsum pa na ral gri'o/ /bzhi pa na yonyerin po che sbyin pa'o/ /lnga pa na 0shing tog bī dza pū mira'o/ /drug pa na ⑩mda' gsor ba'o/ /bdun pa/na dgra sta'o/ /brgyad pa na dbyug to'o/ /dgu pa na tho ba'o/ /bcu pa na lcags kyu'o/ /bcu gcig pa na rdo rje'o/ /bcu gnyis pa na se gol gtogs yo 7pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa na bgrang phreng ngo / /g.yon pa gnyis pa na yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal mtshan no / /gsum pa na pad+ma'o/ /bzhi pa na ril ba spyi blugs soyi / /lnga pa na zhags pa'o / /drug pa na gzhu'o/ /bdun pa na mdung thung ngo / /brgyad pa na 'khor lo'o / /dgu pa na dung ngo / /bcu pa na bsdigs 17pa'i mdzub mo'o/ /bcu gcig pa na bum pa bzang po'o/ /bcu gnyis pa na thag mdung ngo / /bcu gsum pa na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /'od zer dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ /pad+ma la bzhugs bsgom tsho 7par bya/ /la yi zhing cung bgos pa yi/ /83—328

steng du bla gos gyon pa ste/ /sna tshogs tshig gu na bzar gsol6)/ /cho 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ②sku gzugs 'phro/ /sum cu'i ⑧lha rnams ltung ⑤ba dang / /bgegs rnams shin tu 'jig skrag nas ni/ /thal mo sbyor bar byed pa ste/ /'di 'dra gang zhig rtag bsgoms shing (5)/ /bsgrims nas gsang sngags brjod pa des/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob gyur ( nyen/ /dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /ting (kye'adzin ngo bo thob 'gyur zhing / /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol5)/ /rgyal ba mtha' yas pa'i ye shes skul 7bar byed pa'i stobs kyi rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ra yi ye shes las yinabasgrubs pa'i/ /rin chen sgron ma zhes bya ba'i tunyegazugasayi/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /phyag drug gser gyi mdog dang ldan/ /na chung dar la bab pa'i tshad/ /zhal ni cung zad bzhad pa ste/ /phyag ni rin chen gdu bus gtams/ /phyag gnyis rin chen thal mo ste/ /'od kyis mdakyil 'khor phreng ba 'khrugasatso/ /g.yas pa'i phyag ni mi 'jigs sbyin/ /gsum pa mda' ni rnam par gsor/ /g.yon mdzub ma rung nyu rnams la bsdigasatsho / /gsum pa yis ni gzhu yang 'dzin/ /'od zer dmar po legs par 'baranyuge rol stabs thabs kyi zhabs kyis na riganon/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni 'phro zhing sdud/ /chos 'dzin yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha mo 'di 'dra bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas rin chen sprin gyi ye shes kyis snang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /sgri 47yi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /'jigs las sgrol ba khro gnyer can/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /ston ku'i zla ba'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /phyag drug pad+ma la bzhugs ri ci pa/ /rol pa'i stangs la brtson ( gepa ste/ /zhal ni khro dang 83—329

bcas par bzhad/ /legs par 'bar ba'i rtser lta 6)can/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa be con 'dzin par bshad/ /gsum pa yis ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa bsdigs ②pa'i mdzub mo can/ /gnyis pa ril ba spyi blugs bsnams/ /gsum pa na ni mtshon cha gzhu/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dusprin 'phro zhing / /de bzhin gzhan dag legs sdud pa'i/ /nyal dang 'greng dang 'dug pa na/ /lha mo 'di 'dra rtag tu bsgom/ /'jigs ④pa thams cad dmigs pa med par byed pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /hūm̐ gi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /ming ni rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /thams cad 'ching ba ⑤bskyed pa ste/ /sems can ma rungs phung bar byed/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /phyag drug sngo bsangs yigazugs bzang ma/ /zhal ni cung (7zad bzhad pa khyamadzad/ /lag pa g.yas na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa 6)rdo rje lu gu rgyud/ /gsum pa na ni mda' yang bsnams/ /g.yon pa bsdigs pa'i mdzub kyimo ste/ /gnyis pa na ni zhags par gsungs/ /gsum pa gzhu yang thogs par brtson/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni sprin 'phro ba/ /rdo rje lu gu rgyud bsgoms na/ /byang chub skad cig gis 'thob na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ /rdo rje sgrog gi ye shes kyi rdo rje lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / mi yi (1ye shes las bsgrubs pa / /thub pa'i skyes 7mchog byams pa ni/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /de yi 'og na pad+ma ste/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung khri du bzhugs/ /phyag bzhi dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgyas brgyan/ /g.yas pa yi ni phyag gnyis pa/ /sems can skyob ñtsa)pa mchog 'dzin amadzad/ /g.yon pa lha rdzas klu shing gi/ /me tog ze'u 7'bru'i mgo lcogs yi 7bsnams/ /sangs 83—330

rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sprin chen de bzhin 'phro bar mdzad/ /byams pa'i stobs kyi ①ye shes kyi rdo rje rnam par ②brgyan pa'i ting nge ②'dzin to/ / rmu gyi ④ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /gzhon nu 'jam pa tshig gi ⑤lam/ /shes rab ye shes mchog thob pa/ /zab mo tshul ni ston pa po/ /zhal gsum spyan gsum zur phud gsum/ /gzhon nu rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /cod pan bzang po mi 'khrugs (7can/ /me tog sna tshogs rnams kyis bklubs / /'og ma (shepad+ma chen po la/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung yo)du bzhugs/ /'jo sgeg thabs kyis rol pa ste/ /zhal ni cung zad bzhad pa la/ /dpa' bo chen po phyag drug pa/ /dang po mi 'jigs sbyin par bya/ /gnyis pa na ni ral gri nyid/ /gsum pa na ni mda' yang gsor/ /de bzhin g.yon pa shes rab 'chang / /gnyis pa na ni ut+pal thogs/ /gsum pa na ni gzhu nyid do/ /shes rab ye shes mchog gis bklubs la/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sprin gyi bsnams/ /'phro bar sangs rgyas 'dod pas 5nyabasgomatso/ /'jam dpal tu mchog gi shes rab dang ye shes kyi rdo rje snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /spos kyi glang po ye shes tog /de bzhin du ni bzang skyong dang / /blo gros 8rgya mtsho blo gros ni/ / mi zad mapa dang spobs tshubartsegs 9nyid/ /ngan song kun spong mthu chen thob/ /mya ngan kun mun 'joms pa'i blo/ /nor bzangs /shedang ni dra 519ba'i 'od/ /de bzhin zla 'od 'od dpag med/ /nam mkha'i sa rimadzod dang sgrib kun sel/ /de ltar de sogs grangs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' 47skyob pa kun/ /sa bon yig 'bru rnams las 'khrungs/ /yi ge phyag rgya'i sbyor ba can/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis rol bar mdzad/ /byang chub sems 83—331

dpa' 'di yi rgyu/ /gsang sngags bzlos 6)par bsgom par bya/ /mdog ldan 'du zhing 'phro mdzad pa/ /rnal 'byor can gyis rtag tu bsam/ /hūm̐ gi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /gzi brjid ldan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi/ /gshin rje'i dgra zhes rnam grags pa/ /bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba ste/ /char sprin gyi ni 'od dang 'dra/ /zhal drug pa la phyag drug pa/ /de bzhin zhabs drug mi'u thung 'dra / /gsus khyim shin tu che ba ste/ /de ni drag po chen po yin/ /ljags (snye'adril rdo rje mche ba can/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan ①pa ste/ /stag lpags kyis ④ni sham thabs bgos(ge/ /rol pa'i stabs 6)can ma he bcibs/ /de yi 'og tu pad+ma byas/ /mi thod phreng can skra 'khyil ba/ /ag tsom (7ser la sgra chen 'byin/ /mgo yi steng nas (7mi 'khrugs pa/ /sku gsum la ni rnam par bzhugs/ /'jam pa'i dpal gyis rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni rnam par bzhad/ /g.yas pa ljags ni 'dril ba ste/ /g.yon pa'i tshems kyis po)sgros mnan khro'i/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na ral gri ste/ /gnyis pa na ni rdo rje nyid/ /gsum pa yis ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa sdigs yinyamadzub zhags pa can/ /gnyis pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin / /gsum pa gzhu ni bdungs 7pa yis/ /shin tu legs par rnam par brgyan / /lha mo yis ni g.yas nas (nya'akhyud/ /gnyis pa na ni ut+pal thogs/ /g.yon pa zla ba ltar snang ba/ /pad+ma dkar po thogs par bya/ /'og tu lha dang bgegs kyi rnams/ / snar ma mi)bred nas phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar dang bcas/ /sangs rgyas sprin rnams 'phro zhing sdud/ /rnal 'byor dag gis bsgoms 'onas su/ /bsgrims nas gsang sngags bzlas pa de/ /'dug dang nyal dang 'chag pa na/ /legs par bsams te kun zos shing ⑩/ /83—332

'dod pa lnga la longs spyad ①kyang / /nam mkha' lta bur gos mi 'gyur/ /gshed byed thams cad rmongs par byed pa'i ye shes rdo rje ②gshin rje gsod pa'i 'dul ba 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /pra yi ye shes las bsgrubs pa / /khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /phyag drug gis ni rnam par brgyan/ /mdog ser ①mi thung ④gzugs can la/ /'od zer dmar po'i dkyil 'khor can/ /pad+ma la bzhugs rol pa'i stabs/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis ⑤brgyan pa la/ /dang po'i zhal ni rnam par bzhad/ /de bzhin g.yas pa rnam par bsgyur/ /g.yon pa'i tshems kyis 4)sgros kyang mnan/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis 'bar ba ste/ /lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje thogs/ /gnyis pa na ni dbyug pa ste(pe/ /gsum pa na ni mda' yang thogs/ /g.yon pa sdigs (gyimadzub zhags pa can/ /gnyis pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa gzhu can yin par gsungs/ /spyi bo'i steng na mi 'khrugs 5)pa/ /rim bzhin 'phro zhing sdud 7pa ste/ /'di 'dra goms par 5stebasgom par bya/ / bzlos pas skusangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ha yi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /khro bo pad+ma mthar byed pa/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /kha dog dmar po phyag brgyad can4ge/ /sku ni sbrul gyis dkris pa ste/ /pad+ma la bzhugs rol pa'i stabs/ /khro bo lta babs gzigs mdzad pa/ /dang po zhal ni rnam par bzhad/ /g.yas pa ljags ni 'dril ba ste/ /g.yon pa tshems kyis lasgros mnan pa/ /stag lpags gsol zhing khro ba la / /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa na ni dbyug tho sngagasungs//gsum pa na ni lcags kyu ste/ /bzhi pa na ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa 83—333

bsdigs pa'i mdzub (3)mo ste/ /gnyis pa yis (nyani nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa na ni pad+ma ste/ /bzhi pa na ni gzhu nyid do/ /de yi ⑧cod pan mi 'khrugs pa/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni mang po dag /'phro zhing 'du bar bsgoms ④byas na/ /'grub par 'gyur te gzhan du min/ /rta mchog gi ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i (3)ting nge 'dzin to/ /rgyu gi 6)ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /ming ni khro bo bgegs kyi gshed / /me yi dkyil bzhugs sgrub pa sbyin/ /lag na rdo rje'i ༷rjes 'brangs pa / /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad phyag drug can/ /dang po'i zhal ni bzhad pa ste/ /de bzhin g.yas pa'i zhal gdangs pa/ /g.yon pa tshems kyis sgros (8)mnan khro/ /ut+pal 6)sngon po'i 'dab ⑩'dra'i mdog /zhabs kyis bgegs ni mnan pa ste/ /gnyis pa pad+ma'i steng na bzhugs/ /g.yas kyi phyag na ral gri ste/ /gnyis pa na ni dgra star 5megasungasal/ /gsum pa yis ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub ⑫zhags pa can/ /de bzhin gnyis pa nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa na ni gzhu yang gsungs / /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sprin 'phro bar/ /ye shes mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /bgegs rnams thams cad 'dral ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /hūm̐ gi 12ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ / mi g.yo byis sa pa'i gzugs dang ldan/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /gzhon nu'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa la/ /dang po'i zhal ni bzhad pa ste/ /de yi g.yas pa'i zhal gdangs pas/ /khrag gis brlan pa'i ljags kyang 'dril/ /g.yon pa tshems kyis sgros mnan khro/ /hūm̐ gis snying ga'i 7phyogs kyang bkang / /mthing shun gyi ni mdog can te/ /rin chen ri stengs 7pad+ma la/ /rol pa'i 83—334

zhabs kyis stabs su bzhugs①/ /thub pa bgegs kyi chu 'dzin (ge'ajoms/ /phyag drug 'bar ba 'phro ba yi/ /'od bzang chadamar po'i dkyil 'khor na/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na ral gri ste/ /gnyis pa na ni rdo rjer gsungs/ /gsum pa mda' ni rnam par gsor/ /g.yon pas sdigs mdzub gzhags pa can/ /gnyis pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa gzhu ni bdungs 4)pa la tshangs pas gzung ⑥ste lta ba dang / /sna tshogs me tog gis ⑦bcings pa'i/ /cod pan dang ni dbu rgyan thogs/ /zur phud (nyagayon pa bung ba'i mdog /mi 'khrugs pa yis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sprin dag gis/ /cho 'phrul chen po du ma 'phro/ /de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor gang / / sgom pas sgom (9)par byed pa de/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi/ /them skas la ni 'dzeg 0par 'gyur//de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin byed pa mi g.yo ba'i ye shes rdo rje bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /hūm̐ gi ye shes las bsgrubs (1pa/ /ming ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po ste/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa / /phyag drug pa zhes bya bar bsgrags/ /dbu rgyan sangs rgyas kyis brgyan pa'i / /thor tshugs cod pan bzang po can/ /dang po'i zhal ni bzhad pa la/ /g.yas pa yi tsos ni rnam par bsgyur/ /g.yon pa tshems kyis tshonasgros mnan khro/ /dpral ba khro gnyer rim pa can/ /'bar ba char sprin lta bu'i mdog /dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar ba can/ /phyag gnyis 'dod pa'i phyag rgyar ldan/ /g.yas pa na ni rdo rje mugasungs/ /gsum pa mda' yis rnam par rol/ /g.yon pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa'i phyag na gzhu yang bsnams/ /pad+ma la bzhugs rol pa'i stabasabla/ /'og tu bgegs kyang rnam par mnan/ /sangs 83—335

rgyas lang long 'phro mdzad pa/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis bsgoms 6)byas na/ /bla na med pa'i ye shes 'thob②/ /snying thams cad 'gugs ①pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /hūṃ gi ye shes las bsgrubs ④pa/ /khro bo be con sngon po can/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /phyag drug gis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dang po'i zhal ni 'jo sgeg bzhad/ /de bzhin g.yas pa rnam par gdangs(5)/ /g.yon pa tshems kyis kyisgros kyang mnan/ /sku ni kha chu 'dra ba ste/ /lus ni sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan/ /skra tshogs lcang lor ga'akhyil pa ste/ /dbu rgyan la ni sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /pad+ma la bzhugs ⑧rol stabs can / /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje 5)ste/ /gnyis pa na ni be con nyid/ /gsum pa mtshon 7cha mda' dang ldan/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub (1zhags pa ste/ /gnyis pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa na ni gzhu nyid bsnams/ /dkyil 'khor dmar po 'bar ba can/ /sbyor ba'i ye shes kyis bskrun 7pa'i/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni rtag tu 'phro/ / bgegs kyis rtog (/stepa'i ye shes rdo rje 8rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /hūm̐ zhes gsungs pa'i 7khro bo ni/ /ye shes dam pa stobs po che/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /phyag brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /sprin gyi kha dog kha'adra ba ste/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /mig dmar skra 'bar gyen du brjes/ /mgo bo la ni mi 'khrugs bzhugs / /dang po'i zhal ni rnam par bzhad/ /de bzhin g.yas pa rnam par gdangs / /g.yon pa tshems kyis 1 sgros mnan pa/ /pad+ma la bzhugs 'gying 6nyebag can/ /drag po'i tsham rngam (/(stang stabs can/ /phyogs bcu'i lha rnams phung bar mdzad/ /'bar ba rnams kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /nyi ma'i zhi )dkyil 83—336

'khor nang na bzhugs/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa be con thogs par mtshon/ /gsum pa yis ni ral gri gdengs/ /bzhi pa mda' yis rnam par brgyan/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub ①zhags pa can/ /gnyis pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa na ni tho ba nyid/ /phyag bzhi pa ni gzhu (bcan la/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sprin 'phro ba/ /sgom pa mchog gis bsgom par bya/ /bsnol ②ba med pa'i ye shes rdo rje'i stobs kyis rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / r+ghaṃ gyi liye shes las bsgrubs (9pa/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ⑥ba ste/ /sku gsum ldan pa zhal ras gsum/ /gser gyi mdog can 'od bzang ba/ /'dom gang 'od kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ting 'dzin phyag rgyar rnam par gnas/ /rin chen ri stengs ⑦pad+ma la/ /rdo rje skyil mo krung (kyedu bzhugs/ /rigs kyi kyi)yum ni bzhi po rnams/ /gzugs dang yan lag kun mdangs can/ /zhal ras 'jo sgeg tshul gyis brgyan/ /gos dang rgyan gyis bklubs zhipa ste/ /chags phyir spro ba'i rtsol ba can/ /phyag rgya rin chen snye (spem dang / /rdo rje pad+ma ut+pal ldan/ /lha mo so so'i phyogs na bzhugs/ /gtsug (1nator 'od zer lnga pa can / /kun tu 'khor lo'i phreng ba dang / /'khor lo'i bar na rdo rje gnas/ /'od zer phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin sprin 'phro bas/ /nam mkha' thams cad 'gengs par mdzad/ /byang chub snying po don gnyer bas//'di 'dra'i su 'khor lo yican sgom tshezhing / /bsgrims nas rnal 'byor bsgoms skopa yis/ /ring por yimi thogs 'dod pa 'thob/ /byang chub snying po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dzo gyi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /gnod sbyin gnod gnas sku gsum can/ /zhal ras gsum pa 83—337

phyag gnyis na/ /bī dza pu 1)ri ne'u le can/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa 'am//yang na bzang po'i (mi'adug stangs gnas/ /ngos na rgyan rnams thams cad kyis//brgyan pa'i gnod sbyin mo bzhi dag /rin chen char pa 'bebs par byed/ /mgo bo'i steng na sangs rgyas lnga/ /de ①yi cod pan bzang po yi/ /g.yon phyogs rtse phran ④rgyan yang chags/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ⑤spyin 'phro zhing / /rin chen char pa 'bebs par mdzad/ /gang zhig nor rdzas 'dod pa yis/ /gnod gnas 'di 'dra bsgoms (7byas na/ /de yis gas chen nor rdzas kyis/ /ring por mi thogs gang bar 'gyur/ /lag na rdo rjes bdud rtsi yi/ /chu yang rtag tu dbul bar bya/ /rin po che sprin sbyin pa'i char pa (nya'abebs pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /ma yi ye shes las bsgrubs 6)pa'i/ /nyi ma'i 'od ltar 7'od zer can/ /rta bdun ldan pa'i shing rtar (1bzhugs/ /'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor 7snang mdzad pa/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum ldan//phyag drug kha dog ser por snang / /phyogs bcu bsrung (stebar brtson pa ste/ /'jo sgeg tshul du zhal yang bzhad/ /na chung rgyan ni g.yo ba can/ /cod pan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga/ /thor tshugs me tog rnams kyis brgyan/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa la 7ni khab skud bsnams7/ /gsum pa na ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub yizhags pa can/ /gnyis pa a shwa'i yal ga ste/ /gsum pa na ni gzhu nyid do/ /gzugs brnyan mang po yona'aphro ba yis/ /sdang ba'i sems can bcing ba dang / /mig dang kha ni 'drub par (nyabyed / /gsang sngags bzlas brjod 'bad pa 17dag /gal te byang chub mchog 'dod na/ /lha mo hūṃ mdzad bsgom par bya/ /'di ni sgom ripar byed pa yis ste/ /83—338

dbang du sems can rab tu 'gro/ /sdang ba rnams kyis mi tshugs par byed pa'i rdo rje mchog rab ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /pa yi ye shes las bsgrubs pa'i / /rig pa'i ri khrod shing lo can/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /zhal ras bzhad cing khro dang bcas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /na chung sa/zhon nu phyag drug ma/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa na ni dgra sta nyid/ /gsum pa mda' yang rnam par gsor/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub hurizhags pa can/ /gnyis pa shing lo'i bam po ste/ /phyag gsum pa na gzhu nyid do / /thor tshugs me tog phreng bas brgyan(mi/ /de steng ①kha dog lnga po dag /rab tu 'dres ④pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /mdog ser pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs / /dkyil 'khor dmar po cher 'bar bas(ge/ /khro bo'i 6)sprin 'phro sdud mdzad cing / /gdon gang skye dgu'i dzo)nang gnas pa/ /de dag khro bo'i sems (shekyang bsreg5) /phyir yang bsregs yinas sangs rgyas kyi/nya/ /kha dog bdud rtsi char 'bebs mdzad/ /de 'dra rnal 'byor gyis bsgoms na/ /mi ngas nyu)thams cad zhi bar tsomadzad/ /nad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /dza yi ye shes las bsgrubs 8pa/ /rig blasngags mtshan ni dug sel ma/ /sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdengs ka can/ /nor bu 'bar tsobs brgyan pa ste/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /gzhon nu mtshan ni 'bar ba can/ /bzhad cing khro dang bcas pa ste/ /sbrul gyi ska rags dag gis brgyan/ /phyag drug rol pa'i stang tsho stabs can/ /mgo yi steng na mi 'khrugs bzhugs/ /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa ral gri thogs par brtson/ /phyag gsum pa ni /shegar thabs kyis/ /stang tsho/stabs tshul gyis 83—339

mda' yang zhi)gsor/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 0zhags pa can/ /gnyis pa dug gi me tog can/ /phyag gsum pa na dugazhu nyid do/ /dbu rgyan ④me tog rnams kyis brgyan/ /gser mdog pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /'od ni dmar po'i rgyadakyil 'khor can/ /dza rnams 'phro bas bskor ba ste/ /kun nas 'bar ba rnams kyis khebs/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan 'phro ba can/ /phyag bzang bum pa zla 'dra ba'i/ /kha ni 4)dza yis ⑦rnam brgyan pas/ /dug gis phog pa rnams (8)la ldugs/ /rtag tu sku gsum dug sel ma/ /dug gis phog pa rnams la bsgom(9)/ /de ltar bsgom ⑩par byas pa yis/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub 'thobaspyo/ /nyon mongs rnams kyi dug sel ba/ /gdengs ku'i dbang po rde rje ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /tri (1yi ye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /sku chen ha la ha la ste/ /zhal ras gsum pa spyan gsum pa/ /thor tshugs cod pan rnams kyis rgyan8/ /zla ba tshes pa bsnams pa'i lha/ /dbu rgyan thod pa dag gis brgyan/ /thor tshugs rgyal po'i sku gzugs bzhugs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa ste/ /pad+ma dkar po lta bur snang / /sems stobs ldan pa'i 'jo tshul can/ /phyag brgyad zhal yang bzhad pa ste/ /smad g.yogs stag gi pags pa mnabasayi / /g.yas pa'i phyag na rdo rje ste/ /gnyis pa bgrang nor phreng ba can/ /gsum pa yis ni mda' yang gsor/ /g.yon pa pad+mas rnam par brgyan/ /gnyis pa yis ni nu ma 'dzin/ /gsum pa na ni gzhu nyid do/ /g.yas pa mdung rtse gsum pa la/ /sbrul gyis yongs su dkris pa ste/ /g.yon na thod pa dri zhim pa'i/ /me tog sna tshogs kyis bkang ba/ /pad+ma dmar po la bzhugs pa/ /rol pa'i stang stabs ( tshul du gnas/ /rin chen ri phug nang 83—340

bzhugs par/ /rnal 'byor sems dpas 6)bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas rang bzhin gzugs dang ni/ /cho 'phrul chen po sna tshogs 'byung / /rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin gyis/ /kha zas thams cad za byed cing / /nang gi sngags pas sngags brjod cing / /rim bzhin rnal 'byor gyis bsgoms na/ /byang chub myur du thob 'gyur zhing / /bla na med pa'i ②bde ba 'dren/ /'dod pa thams cad rab bsgrub nipa/ /ha la ha la yongs su mnyes par byed pa'i ye shes kyi ④rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ / sa yi rgyaye shes las bsgrubs pa/ /stong chen rab tu 'joms mdzad pa'iyi/ /lha mo nad kun 'phrog ma ste/ /sdang ba'i sems can 'joms mdzad ma/ /phyag stong ldan zhing dbu stong la/ /spyan gsum dag gis rnam par brgyan/ /brtson chen phyag brgyad khro ba dang / /steg pa'i stabs bu kyis dgongs pa can/ /phyag g.yas mchod sbyin lha rdzas kyi/ /ral gri lcags kyu mda' dang ldan/ /phyag g.yon pad+mo rdo rje nor/ /zhags pa gzhu dang sta re can//mdog dmar zhal ras bzhi pa ste/ /bgegs stong 'joms par mdzad pa yin/ /rang gi rnal 'byor la brtson pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs 'jug cing spro/ /glang po rta dang skyes pa dag /za bar mdzad ma phreng ba can/ /de yi las kyis bskul ba yi5she/ /gsang sngags dpa' bos gdon 5dpar bya/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug las 'dod pas/ /'di byas pas ni srung bar 'gyur/ /dpung chen po la rnam par lta ba thams cad srung ba stobs kyi mchog stong chen po rnam par 'joms pa'i ye shes kyis rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /t+t+waṃ yizhes bya bas bskyed tshospe pa yi'/ / bsdigs pa'i mdzub (gemo'i phyag rgya can/ /drag mo chen mo zhal bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum 'phyag brgyad kyis rnam skobargyanayi/ /83—341

mdzad dran/ /gsang sngags rgyal po bzlas pa yis/ /las kun rab tu grub par byed6)/ /char pa che na ②gcod 'gyur la/ /char pa chung na rab tu 'bebs / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kun tu 'bar ba'i snying po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas khro bo chen po 'dod pa'i khro bo 'di rdo rje sku gsum rnams las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā ṭ+wāṃ/ ṭak+ki tsū dzaḥge/de nas khro bo gsungs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rab tu 'dar/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang skrag /bdud kyi dpung rnams ltung bar 'gyur(ge/ /rkang g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje yi(7/ /sbyor bas (nyamatshan ni mnan nas su/ /sku gsum ye shes stobs ldan pas/ /khro gnyer rim par gnyer byas teng )/ /gsang sngags kun gyis bkug nas su/ /sems can thams cad dbang du byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas rdo rje rab tu 'bar zhing khro (7ba'i ye shes rab tu 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje khro bo mi g.yo ba gtum 5)po 'di rdo rje sku tsogasum rnams las phyung ngo / /na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā 44te/ a tsa la kā ṇa tsaṇ+ḍa/na ṭa na ṭa/ mas mas/ mos mosal/ sas sas/ tab ta(4 / ta na ta ken / da ha da ha/ mo ha mo ha/ mo ha ka ra/ ha sa ha sa/ badz+ra mahā sa ku ru/ hā sa hā tsos/ ma ra ma ra ṭa/ ma ra tsho ma ra ṭa/ gadz+dza gadz+dza/ ha na ha na/brnya brnya/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ā /shebi sha ā tsho bi sha /ma hā mas pā la kā/ dhu na dhu sa rin / ti ṇi ti ṇi/ khā da khā da/ baspyo na/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ duṣ+ṭa nari gle/bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ sar+pā (glen ku ru ku ru/ ki ri ki ri/ ma hā ( nabi ṣa ma badz+ra/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ/ tri bi lā 5 rata raṅga nan+ta ka /i i i/ tsā ṭ+wāṃ māṃ cige/83—351

a tsa la tsa tshiṭa/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa ya/ hūm̐ hūṃ a sa man+ta kā zhutā ṭa ma hā ba la sha tā ①ya / pa ra mas ④na/ i oṃ/ tsā hṝ mi shu : tu phyilo ka /tu ṣ+yo tu brgyu⑥/na mo tu kru ⑦a pra ti ha ta ba le bh+yaḥ dz+wa lā ya/ tā (miṭa a sa ha na maḥswā hā/ de nas khro bo mi g.yo ba/ /khro bo stobs chen 'di gsungs pa/ /lha dang klu kun mngag gzhug byed/ /gnod sbyin srin po lha ma yin/ /'jigs pa thob nas brgyal bar 'gyur/ /bdud kyi sde ⑨rnams lhung nas su/ /tshig cing rab tu zhum bzhin du/ /gtso bo rdo rje snang mdzad dran/ /khro bo'i rgyal po du ma yis/ / bcug pas bo'ajigs pas nyen (nyebazhin du/ /gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /sna tshogs las rnams myur du mdzad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas sku gsum gyi ye shes rdo rje 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis 'jigs pa chen po'i yirdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rig pa'i rgyal po chen po 4)gnod mdzes 'di gsungs so/ / na maḥyi.o sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha li:/ grit+na grit+na hūm̐/ grisna pā ya grit+na pā ya rtsu/ oṃ yi.ā na ya ho bha ga bān bibyā 3narā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas khro bo (nya'adi gsungs pas4) /lha yi bu mo thams cad ni/ /skra tshugs zhig cing gcer bur gyur/ /mig rtsa ( skarig rig byed pa dag /sku gsum rdo rje mchog mnga' ba'i/ / zhabs kyis ( nyanu ma gnyis mnan pas/ /gtso bo rdo rje rnam snang (2nyamadzad/ /ye shes kyis ( ge'ajoms dran par tsho 〉'gyur/ /lcags kyu yis ni rnam dral te/ /rdo rje zhags pas bcings nas su/ /bu mo thams cad dgug bya ba/ /bu mo dgug pa'i mchog yin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ye shes chen po rnam par bsgyings pas tsho snyedaga' ba ston pa zhes 2 bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sku 83—352

gsum gyi mchog rdo rje 'chang bskyed 6)par mdzad pa sangs rgyas kyi byang chub 'di rjes su dran par mdzad do/ /'khor lo che la rnam gnas nas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi khyasprin dag dang / /de bzhin rdo rje 'chang ba'i sprin/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags thogs 'byin/ /kun mkhyen ye shes las byung gtso/ /gsang sngags skyes bur bdag bsgoms na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'gugs byed na/ /rdo rje 'chang sogs ci zhig smos/ /bud med lha chen bu mo dag /rlung la rkang pa bzhag nas su/ /lcags kyus snying la drangs nas ni/ /sems can kun yang 'gugs 'gyur te/ /'di la dpyad pa cung zad med/ /rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /sku chen zla ba'i kha dog yin①/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi 'bebs bsams te④/ /lan grangs bcu ni brjod pa yis/ /de nas phyigadon mi za bar khugs/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor las byung ba/ /rdo rje lcags kyu chen po yi4)/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba yis/ /gzhon nu ma dag nges par 'gugs( nye/ /rdo rje gsum 'khrugs khro bo ni/ /rdo rje sa 'og gnas pa ste / /lha ma yin kun des sreg (kyecing / /lha min bu mo rjes chags pas/ /gsal shing gis ni bskyel nas su/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ /drangs nas lha min bu mo 'gugs/ /btsag dzinadang thod lo kor dang ni/ / ba bla ོ'byor par gyur na ni/ /gzas zin tshe na khar bcug ste/ /rdzas rgyal rdo rje lcags kyus 'grub/ /drag po rlung dang khyab 'jug dang / /lha mo gnod sbyin gnod sbyin ma/ /mngag gzhug bcas par 47'jigs skrag 7ste/ /ming bris 4 kun nas rtag tu 'gugs/ /sangs rgyas 'khor lor kha)legs bzhugs te/ /'jam dpal kerdo rjer rnam par bsgomadzo/ /khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ /83—353

lag na rdo rje lcags kyu thogs/ /khros shing 'bar ba 'phro ba yis/ /gnod sbyin bu mo bkug nas spyod/ /phyag rgya gsang sngags sbyor ba dang / /bsam gtan 'khor lo sbyor ba yis/ /dgug par bya ba'i tshig gsungs pa/ /gzhan du byas na 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i zhabs drung kun gnas pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che0)/ /kun gyis sems rab rdzogs byed pas/ /yang dang yang du skul (7bar byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen pos rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas ye shes kyi rnam par rgyal ba'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i (7ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje rgyal mo chen mo (gernam par bsgyur ba'i rdo rje 'di rdo rje sku gsum rnams las phyung ngo / /oṃ shu li (snyeni swā hā / de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /klu mo dbang chen grags pa dag /gos dang bral zhing tshig (6)bzhin du/ /gtso bo rdo rje rnam snang dran/ /gsang sngags rig (7sngags 'di yis ni/ /klu rnams thams cad 'gugs par byed/ /bsam gtan rdo rje mthu dang ni/ /gsang sngags bzlas brjod byas pa yis/ /sor (8)gdub rgyan ni gsol ba yis(9)/ /klu mo 7mig yangs bkug nas ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lngas chags pa'i/ /klu mo nye bar spyod par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nam mkha' chen po'i shugs rgya mtsho 'phro ba'i dam tshig ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas skul (1byed ma chen mo'i gzungs kyi rig sngags chen mo tu 'di gsungs so/ /na maḥs man+ta bus nī/samyakle bud+dhā ko ṭī rnaX / tabya thā/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun+de swā hā/ de nas rig sngags che gsungs pas/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams rab tu g.yos/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus/ /ting nge 'dzin las g.yos par gyurayi/ /bdud 83—354

rnams brgyal zhing tshig ①nas su/ /thams cad cho nges ②'debs par byed/ /sa yi 'og gi bu mo dang / /lha min bu mo klu mo dang / /gsang dbang bu mo rnams 'khrugs nas/ /gtso bo rdo rje snang mdzad dran/ /rig sngags 'di ni bzlas pa dang / / sgom pa yi ①ni sbyor ba yis/ /bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub 'gyur zhing / /bkug nas rab tu longs spyod byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nam mkha' mdzod kyis ④rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas chos bdud rtsi'i dam tshig gi rdo rje'i khro gnyer 'di phyirdo rje sku gsum rnams las phyung ngo / /oṃ bha ya nā sha ni tā sa ni tā se/tā sa ya yitā sa ya/ bai nyar ṭi ṣ+ṭṛ (nyeku ṭi ti she5)/ bai ṭa ṭi be+e ṭa ṭi/ shwe te shwe te / dza ṭi ni swā hā/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rig sngags 'chang dang lha rnams ni/ /g.yos shing 'jigs pa thob par 'gyurayi/ /bdud rnams 'jigs pas rnams 4)'khrugs te/ /gtso bo rdo rje rnam snang mdzad/ /yid gcig tu ni dran par byed/ /nor bu'i gdub rnams g.yo ba yis/ /rig sngags 'chang ma klu mor bcas/ /lha min bu mo gsang ba yi7/ /bu mo bkug la tu spyod par byed/ /'dis ni las kun byed pa dang / /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'jigs pa yin/ /yang na gsang sngasas thams cad ni/ /skye bo med pa'i nags tshal du/ /sngags pas bye ba bzlas nas su/ /las rnams thams cad bya ba 8gsungs/ /gang gzhan slob dpon smod pa dang / /theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang / /mi gang gsang sngags rgyud dag gisake/ /sbyor ba la ni 'phya byed pa / /de yis dngos grub thob mi 'gyur/ /de ni rtag tu gdon gyis zin/ / bsgrims nas gsang bar dzabya ba 'am/ /yang na lus ni gzhig par bya/ /sngags 83—355

pas 'di ltar byas na ①ni/ /byang chub dngos grub legs par 'thob/ /phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad ni/ /sku gsum ye shes las byung ba'i/ /khyad par du ②ni bsgom par bya/ /dgra la 'di ni the tshom nimed/ /khrag 'thung duchu yis brlan pa 'am/ dur khrod thal ba'am bshang gci yis/ /brlan pa'i gos ni bgos nas kyang phyi/ /rkang pas mtshan ma mnan nas su/ /khro bo'i rgyal por sbyor ⑥byas te/ /gsang sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas na/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni nges par 'jig /chus brlan pa yi gos bgos te/ /khro bo'i mdun du bcings nas su/ /rkang pa g.yon pas mnan na ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang nges par 'jig /bshang gci yis ni sbags ⑦pa'i gos/ /rul ba'i dri can smad pa dag(kye /bgos nas gsang sngags bzlas brjod na/ /mod la 'chi ba'am skams 6)par 'gyur/ /dur khrod thal bas bsdus pa'i gos/ /bgos nas khro bo 'khrugs ⑩nas ni/ /lan grangs stong du brjod na ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang (7rnam par 'jig /skra ni lhug par bshig nas ⑩ni/ /kha bzhin rnam par bsgyur byas te/ /rkang pas mtshan ma mnan na tunyeni/ /nam mkha'i khams kyang 'jig ④par 'gyur/ /ma mo'i gnas sam dur khrod dam/ /khang stong 'am 8ni bzhi mdo 'am/ /mtshan ma gcig pa'am 7shing gcig tu/ /drag shul spyod pa brtsam yonapar bya/ /de yi rkang rjes sa la ni/ /mi rus 1nyalas byas phur bu dag /sor brgyad tsam gyi tshad tsam la/ /lan grangs brgya rtsa brgyad brjod pa'i/ /phur bu yis ni btab nas su / / dgra yi 1)khyim sgor brkos te gzhug /sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog sbyin pate/ /shes dang mi shes spangs pa yang / /zla phyed nya yi nang rol du/ /'ching ba'am yang na 'jig par 'gyur/ /mkhas pas thod pa yongs tshang bso )/ /khyad 83—356

par can ni rnyed pa dang / /de la gsang sngags tshig bris te/ /rdo rje tshig gis bzlas brjod nas/ /dgra yi sgo 'am yang na ni/ /grong du sbas na nges par skyod / /ta la'i 'dab 6)ma'am gzhan la'ang ①rung / /khro bo'i zhugasang sngags legs bris te/ /dgra yi khyim mam ④sgo kur 6)ni/ /sbas na du'achi 'am skams ⑦par 'gyur/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad chen pos bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsum rdo rje'i phur bu'i ye shes kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ khams gsum thams cad (kyiye shes kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i phur bu zhes bya ba 'di nyid kyi 6)sku dang gsung ⑩dang thugs rdo rje rnams las phyung ngo / /oṃ 0gha gha/ bhā ta ya bhā ta tsoya/ sarba du/ tshuphaṭa phaṭa/ tī la ya tī la ya/ sarba ༷pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ rtsu rtsu hūm̐ badz+ra tī la badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā 8pa ya ti / kā ya bārtsit+ta yibadz+ra/ tī la ya tsū rtsu rtsu phaṭa phaṭa/ de nas 'di ni gsungs tsam gyis/ /rdo rje dbang chen grags pa kun/ /brgyal nas 'jigs pa skyes gyur te/ /rdo rje rnam snang mdzad pa dran/ /mi yi rus pa'i phur bu'am/ /yang na seng ldeng las byung ba'am/ /lcags las byas pa'i phur bus ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rnam par 'jig /rdo rje sems dpar mnyam gzhag ⑩ste/ /'od bzang ( me stag 'khrug pa can/ /sku gsum rdo rje mtha' gtugs pas/zhe/ /gzugs brnyan la (lhani bsams nas sbyor(spe/ /rnam snang phyag rgya chen po 'am/ /yang na 'dod chags rdo rje can/ /phyag rgya chen po gshin rje gshed/ /'dod pa'i khro bo nyid du ni/ /rdo rje phur bu bsam khri par bya/ /bdag nyid chen po stobs po che/ /bdud rtsi thab ru sbyor rdo rje dang / /rdo rje yi ni rnal 'byor gyis/ /83—357

sdang dang gtum po gcad 6)par bya/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid chen po yang / /thugs nas zhabs la thug bar du/ /rdo rje phur bus rnam par bsgomasage/ /rdo rje ting 'dzin sbyor ba yis/ /sangs rgyas dag kyang nges par gnonani/ /'di ni phur bu'i mthu rlabs ④te/ /steng 'og lha yi dam tshig yin/ /rgyal chen rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad gnon pa yi/ /ting 'dzin sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /myur du 'chi 'am skams ⑤par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i ye shes rnam par bsgyings pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje'i sku gnyis su med pa'i (9)dam tshig gi phur bu'i gsang sngags 'di nyid kyi rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje rnams las phyung ngo ske/ /oṃ tshin+da tshin+da da ha da ha/ dīp+ta (7)badz+ra tsakra hūṃ phaṭa/ phan tshun bzlas pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /mthe bo'i ngos (7kyi drung du bsdu/9)/ /snang mdzad zhabs kyis mnan nas su/ /rdo rje phur bus btab ⑩par bya/ /btab pa tsam gyis sems dpa' che/ /sku gsum ye shes las byung ba/ /dam tshig mchog gis (stebazhengs par mdzod7/ /gzhan du byas na brlag par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje'i thugs kyi ye shes chen po rnam par bsgyings pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dam tshig chen po'i stang stabs kyis yistephur bu zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags 'di nyid kyi rdo rje 'a)sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams las phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra rā dza khurtsu/ rtse mo lnga pa bcings nas su/ /me stag 'phro ba bsgoms sabyas te/ /rdo rje thugs kyis zhabs kyis mnan/ /rdo rje phur bus lho tshogadab par bya/ /btab pa tsam gyis rgyal po che/ /sku gsum ye shes 83—358

las byung ba/ /dam tshig mchog gis bzhengs par mdzod4)/ /gzhan du byas na brlag par 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dam tshig mchog rnam par bsgyings pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas gsung gi dam tshig gi stang stabs kyi phur bu'i gsang sngags 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs (snyerdo rje rnams las phyung ngo / /oṃ tri oṃ bhu sgu baḥsem/ rdo rje sor mo bcum pa yis④/ /pad+ma kha bye 'bar ba yis/ /'dod chags rdo rje zhabs kyis mnan/ /rdo rje phur bus nges par gdab/ /btab pa tsam gyis rgyal po che/ /sku gsum ye shes las byung ba/ /dam tshig mchog gis bzhengs par mdzod/ /gzhan du byas na brlag par 'gyur/ /sku gsung ⑤thugs kyis chags pa yin/ /cho ga bzang po tsam gyis ni/ /rdo rje mkha' dbyings mtha' gtugs (6)pa/ /mnan 'gyur 'di la the tshom ( )med/ /ces bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis rdo rje phur bu'i tshig rnams bka' stsal to/ /de nas sangs rgyas sku gsum mchog /sems can khams la phan bzhed rnams/ /dgyes shing mgu ba brnyes (8)nas su/ /rdo rje dbyings kyis 'di skad gsungs/ /kye ma'o gsang ba'i tshig gi mchog /kye ma'o gsang ba kun 'dus pa/ /kye ma'o zhi ba chos kyi tshig /ye shes rdo rje phur bu rmad/ /gsang sngags kun gyi phur bus 'di/ /bde gshegs bka' yi rjes su byed/ /'di dag sangs rgyas kun gyi ste/ /phur bu de nyid rnams las byung / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis chom rkun thams cad mdongs 5)par byed pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo tso'od zer can 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ mā rī rtsu de ba tā yi 41swā hā/ rig sngags gsungs ke83—359

pa'i mod la ni/ /dbang chen grags pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /thugs ni dgyes shing mgu bar 'gyur6)/ /sras rnams kyi ②ni spyan yang phye/ /'di ni las rnams thams cad ma/ /chom rkun ①snang ba 'ching mdzad margya/ /'di yi sbyor ba la gnas na/ /'gro ba'i tshe na mthong mi 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas ( sdang ba thams cad rnam par 'joms pa sems can thams cad sgrol bar byed pa'i ye shes chen po'i ⑥stobs kyis rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas stong chen po rab tu 'joms pa'i rig sngags kyi ⑦rgyal mo 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma hā sa ha ((sra pra ma rda nā dzi)ba ra sid+dhi da rmā ( )ge ma ṇi badz+ra ṇi (nyertsu phaṭa swā hā/de nas rig sngags che gsungs pas/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams rab tu g.yos/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /bdud kyi ris 7rnams g.yos par 'gyur1ste / /gtso bo rdo rje snang mdzad pa/ /thams cad tshig 8ba zhin btud nas su / /bcom ldan rig 8sngags mthu stobs kyis/ /gnod bgyid thams cad gzer ⑩lags so/ /gang na 7rig sngags stobs mo che/ /pha rol gnon 4)pa 'di zlos 67pa/ /der ni bdag cag mi mchi zhing / /der ni srung ( gyeb dag kyang bgyi / /de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas/ brgya byin mngon par mtho ba'i stobs lha ma yin rnam par 'joms pas rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi gzungs ( mechen mo ( nya'adi gsungs so / /oṃ bha ga ba tī dh+wa zhi dzā gra ke yu zhi )re pa ra si n+ya/ bi spyon ( min kā swā ( nyasi n+ya pa ri la ni/ u lu ( snakā mu khi kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ pa ra si n+ya ma a ( snyenan+ta bhu dze/83—360
