bya ba yi/ /rig sngags gsungs pa'i mod la ni/ /bgegs dang log 0)'dren thams cad dag /yid ni 'jigs shing skrag gyur nas/ /rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ /drung du nye bar 'ongs nas su/ /dam bcas pa yi tshig smras pa/ /bcom ldan nor rgyun zhes phyibya ba'i/ /mtshan ni mi (mimachog sgrogs ④bgyid phyin/ /de la nor gyi char 'bab cing / /nor chen dang ni ldan par bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gnod (7par byed pa thams cad 'dul ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas srin mo glog ⑦'bar ma bsgyur ⑧ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ / a re du tre ṇi 6)pra kup+ta kyitsaṇ+ḍi ma hā be ga 0dha ri bid sā 8tho dzi tro⑩/ ma ho da ni 8ro tri ka pā la mā la dha ri ṇi dzā ṭa mu ku ṭa/ maṇ+ḍi te / nā nā 8pra ha ra ṇali/ dha ri rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba ⑩ta thā ga ta tsos ma ya ma nu sma ra/ /ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ pra ma dha ma sarba sha hūm̐ tsā/ sho ṇi nyunyeta bi ba pra tsaṇ+ḍi4 nyam/ be ga dha ri ( 1pa tsa ta pa tsa ta/ be ki ( ster ta sa ta gos/ da ha da ( geha / sarba spegesha t+t+waṃ/ sarba dus na( snye/ ni kṛn+ta( nya/ pra sā dha ( )ya tsū/ ma hā bha ga ba 6)te/ dzā la dzā la/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ che ge ( 7mo zhig me ba sha mā nā ya ce )swā hā/de nas srin mo 'bar ba'i glog /rig sngags chen mo gsungs pa yis/ /bdud kyi zhuganas rnams tshig par 'gyur(ste/ /dgra rnam sa kyi ni snying yang skams(ste/ /dur khrod kyi ras la srin mo btsag gis zhi)bris nas legs par sbaso te gu gul gyi bdug pas bsreg 8micing brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod byas la/ /me tog dmar po dang / dri dmar po dang / gtor ma dang / lha bshos dmar por byas pa byin nas dur khrod du brko bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du ming nas smos shing brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod 87byas pa'i yungs shar zhunagyis gtor to/ /brkos sonyepa'i mod 83wa 362

la phyir rgol ba dang dgra thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro/ /mnan pa dang rmongs par byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phrog ma'i dga' ston gnod sbyin mo'i tshogs dga' bar byed pa'i dngos grub kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs yonyenas rdo rje 'chang (0chen po 'phrog ma'i gsang sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ hā ri h+ye gom hā yak+ṣi tsā ④ye ha ra ha ra/ sarba yak+ṣi tī pra rgyabe sha ni swā hā/ de nas 'phrog dga' 'phrog ma ni/ /gnod sbyin chen mo gsungs pa dang / /gnod sbyin ma kun g.yos nas su/ /dngos grub phyir ni mngon phyogs gyurazhin/ /khro mo'i 'khor lo gnod sbyin ma/ /brgyad dbus 'phrog stims brgyan (8)byas te/ /lcags kyu 'bras bu ne'u lale can/ /gnod sbyin brgyad kyis bklubs 7nas su/ /gnod sbyin ma kun bsgrub par bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nad chen po thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas mi ngas chen po zhi bar mdzad pa'i rig nyunyesngags ri khrod kyi shing lo can ma 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ pi shā ⑫tsi par+ṇa sha ba ri/ sarba mā ri dzi pra sha ma ni rtsu phaṭa/ de nas rig tsosngags che gsungs pas/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams rab tu g.yos/ /gnod byed nad 'gro srin po dang / /sdang ba rnams kyi tsosnying yang zags/ /yam shing 'o ma can dang til / /'o mas du ba zhi bar 'gyur/ /nam mkhar kun nas rig sngags kyi/ /rgyal mos legs par bkang nas su/ /bdud rtsi char 'bebs bsams na yini/ /mod la gnod pa 4 tshozhi bar 'gyur/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul gyi ( dra ba las 'di ni gsang sngags kyi ye shes rnam par bsgyings pa'i (7rim par phye ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //83—363

de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pas phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sku gsum ye shes kyi rdo rje las yang dag par byung ba lag pa'i phyag rgya tha dad pa rnams mnyam par gzhag 6)pa'i sems kyis (minyon cig /gang zhig bcings pa tsam gyis ni/ /sdig pa kun las rnam grol zhing / /'di na (7lus ni byin rlabs ④te/ /rang gi gzugs su (snyernam bsgoms yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa las mthe bo gnyis bteg ⑦pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ste/ sku byin gyis brlab (nyapa'i phyag rgya'o / /de nyid las g.yon pa'i mthe 6)bo nang du bcug ste/ g.yas pa'i mthe bo bteg pa ni 'jig rten dbang phyug gi ste gsung byin gyis brlab yipa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las g.yas pa'i mthe bo nang du bcug ste/ g.yon pa'i mithe bo bteg pa ni rdo rje 'chang gi ste/ thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs (nyapa las g.yon pa'i mdzub (nyemo bsgreng ba'i tunyethor to g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis bzung ba ni rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 7du 'dug nas lag pa g.yon pa pang par bzhag ste/ g.yas pa sa la gnon pa ni mi 'khrugs 7pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las g.yas pa mchog sbyin par byas pa ni rin chen 'byung gnas kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las lag pa gnyis bsam gtan gyi tshul du byas pa ni 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin par byas pa ni gdon mi za bar grub pa'i phyag rgya'o / /lag pa gnyis rdo rje bcing bar 7byas pa las gung mo gshibs te bsgreng 83—364

ba ①ni rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las gung mo'i tshigs dang po bkug ste / rin po che'i tshul du byas pa ni rdo rje rin chen ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las gung mo pad+mo'i cha'adab ma ltar gdu ④bu'i tshul du byas pa ni/ rdo rje chos ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las gung mo nang du bskum pa ni rdo rje las ma'i phyag rgya'o / /lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba la byamadzub mo gnyis gdu (5)bu ltar byas te mthe bo'i rtse mor mig gi 9tshul du byas pa ni/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa ⑦las gung mo bsgreng ba'i dutshigs gsum par mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i tshul du bzung ba ni mā ma khri'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar te pad+ma kha bye ba'i tshul du byas pa ni gos dkar 5༄can gyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pas gung mo'i sen mo mnan te mthe bo gnyis dbus su bzhag nas yosang zad bkug pa ni sgrol ma'i ut+pa la'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar te/mdzub mo dang gung mo'i tshigs dbus mar gdu 0stebu'i tshul yo byas nas mthe bo gnyis glor bzhag pa 'di ni skul tsho byed ma'i gzungs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rdo rje bcings pa /nyebyas pa las mdzub mo gnyis mthe bo'i rtse mor bkug pa 'di ni rin chen sgrol ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis brkyang ste mthe bos so so'i mthe'u chung gi sen mo mnan nas lhag ma rdo rje'i mtshan nyid du byas pa 'di ni khro gnyer can ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis so sor khu tshetshur bcangs pa las mdzub mo dang mthe'u shi4chung gnyis lu tsho gu rgyud ltar bcings pa 'di ni rdo rje lu /sheg rgyud kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs pa las gung mo dang srin lag gnyis bsgrengs te rtse mo'i tshul du byas la gung mo'i rgyab tu srin lag bsnol la/ mdzub 83—365

mo gnyis gdu ①bu'i tshul du byas pas dkris pas mthe bo gnyis mdun du bzhag pa las cung zad bkug ste ②kha'i tshul du byas pa 'di ni gshin rje gshed kyi phyag rgya'ol/ /lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur bcangs pa las khro bo'i mdzub mo snying gar dze+ebazhag ste/ lag pa g.yas pa thal lcag gi tshul du byas pa ni khro bo gzhan gyis ④mi thub pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis la mthe'u (5)chung lu yigu rgyud ltar mdud la mdzub mo gzhibs te bsgreng ba ⑦las bzlog (kyeste/ dpral bar bzhag yonyepa ni rta mgrin gyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bos srin lag dang mthe'u chung gnyis kyi sen mo mnan la ral gri shubs yinas dbyung ba'i tshul du byas pa ni 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcangs ⑩pa las rgyab sprad de mthe'u chung gnyis lu 8gu rgyud ltar bcings nas mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs pa las zhags pa'i tshul du byas pa ni 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi mdzub mo snying gar yo bzhag la/ g.yas pa khro bo'i sor mo be con gyi tshul du phyar 7ba ni be con sngon po can gyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje snying gar snyibazhag la g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur rdeg stangs dang bcas par phyar 7ba ni stobs po che'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis so sor ()khu tshur bcangs la/ mdzub mo dang gung mo bsgrengs yonyete sprad nas me tog gi tshul du byas pa ni byams pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar nas mdzub mo gnyis kyis srin lag 6)gnyis kyi sen mo mnan nas ut+pa la kha bye 6 )ba'i tshul du gzhug ( 1pa ni 'jam pa'i 3 dbyangs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa pang (2 par bzhag la( )/ lag pa g.yas pa glang po che'i sna ltar byas pa ni spos kyi glang po'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i zhi rdo rje khu tshur nam mkha' la sgreng ba 69lag pa 843—366

g.yas pa'i sor mo ba dan ①gyi tshul du byas pa ni ye shes tog ②gi phyag rgya'o/ /bzang po'i 'dug stangs su 'dug ste/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar te snying gar (kyibazhag pa ni bzang skyong gi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis chu rlabs kyi tshul du brkyang ba las sor mo rnams chu rlabs drang ba ni blo gros rgya mtsho'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur snying gar ④bzhag la g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa ni blo gros mi zad pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur pang ⑤du bzhag la g.yas ⑥se gol gtogs ⑦pa'i tshul du byas pa ni spobs pa brtsegs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis pad+ma cung zad kha bye ba ltar byas pa ni mthu chen thob kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis me tog 'dor ba'i tshul du byas pa ni ngan song thams cad spong ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las bsnun pa'i tshul du byas pa ni mya ngan thams cad kyi mun pa nges par 'joms pa'i ji blo gros kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis brkyang nas 'phro ba'i tshul du byas pa ni dra ba can gyi 'od kyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin par byas pa 5)la g.yon pa zla ba'i tshul du byas pa ni zla 'od kyi phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis bum pa'i tshul du byas nas dbang bskur ba ni 'od dpag med kyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur byas la g.yas pa'i khu tshur nam mkha' la kun tu bskor ba'i tshul du byas pa ni nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa sa la brkyang nas lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo dang mthe bong tshesprad nas zhi ba'i 5)tshul du byas pa ni sgrib tsho pa thams cad nges par sel ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur las khro bo'i mdzub mo snying gar yi bzhag la hūm̐ zhes bya zhing /lag pa g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur rdeg stabs yidang bcas par phyar 'ab ni ri khrod lo ma can gyi ⑩phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa sor mo brkyang ba las mdzub mo dang 83—367

mthe bo rkang 6)pas 'dzin pa'i tshul du byas la/ lag pa g.yas pa khab kyi tshul gyis 'tshe ②bar byed ①pa rnams kyi kha mig 'drub ④pa ni 'od zer can ma'i phyag rgya'ol/ /lag pa gnyis spyi bor sbrul mgo gdengs (5)ka'i gdugs ltar byas nas phud ces brjod pa ni dug sel ma'i (6)phyag rgya'o/ /'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag gnyis las mdzub mo gnyis tso)bsgreng (nyab ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las g.yas pa'i khro bo'i lcags kyu yis dzaḥzhes bya ba'i 6)dgug pa ni rdo rje khro bo lcags kyu 7dgug pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan 'dren pa ste rdo rje khro bo'i nyunyelcags kyu'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung mche ba'i tshul du byas pa las bsnol te 'gram pa gnyis su bzhag kyil/ lce ljib cing khro bo'i lta bas /nyabalta bar bya ba ni rdo rje mche ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mthe'u 7chung gnyis bskum/ mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du byas nas kha'i grwar tu bzhag ste hūṃ zhes bya zhing khro bo'i lta bas lus gcu (7ba ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyis rdo rje khu tshur bcangs 4)pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste bsnol nas gyen du bteg pa ltar byas pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya'o / /de nyid las mkhrig 1stem gnyis bsnol te bstod 4)cing bteg ( )pa ni sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bsnol nas mchan khung du bsdams te ( 1khro bo'i lta bas 'gyur ba dang bcas pa ni gdon thams cad skrag par byed pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon brkyang ste kha sbub ( nyapa la de'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag nas lag pa gnyis kyis sor mo 2bskyod pa ni lha ma yin gyi sgyu dang 'khrul 'khor 'byed na nyapa dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo smrar gzhug pa'i phyag rgya'o / /lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bo dang mthe'u 25chung gnyis lu gu rgyud ltar 83—368

bcings te bzhag la/ lhag ma ba dan rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas nas stang stabs dang bcas par hūm̐ zhes bya ba ni khro bo rdo rje 0)sa 'og gi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi khro bo'i mdzub mos bsdigs ②pa ni rdo rje'i (cibadag mo'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ste phur bu'i tshul du byas pa ni rdo rje phur bu'i phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur brdung ba'i tshul du byas pa ni rdo rje tho ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcangs pa las mdzub mo gnyis brkyang (geste rdo rje mdud pa dor ba'i tshul du byas pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje bcings pa'i zhi)phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyis 6)rdo rje khu tshur bcangs te (7)sog le drang ba'i tshul du (kyebyas pa ni rdo rje sog le'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo zla ba'i tshul du byas te gdong g.yog cing brkyang 5༄la khro bo'i mig tu byas nas a la la zhes bya ba ni rdo rje srin mo'i phyag rgya'o / /lag pa gnyis lu 7gu rgyud du bcings pa la mdzub mo dang mthe bo gnyis pad+ma'i tshul du byas pa ni sprin thams cad gtub pa'i char pa'i 5stephyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs 7pa las mdzub mo gnyis gdu 6gebu ltar byas te skam skipa'i tshul du dpung pa brkyang skub ni 'khrul 'khor gyi phur pa dbyung ba'i skam yipa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bo lag mthil du bzhag ste/ lhag ma rnams 'dab ma ltar g.yab cing rkang pa ya gcig sa la btsugs la/ gcig rgyab tu bskums nas khro bo'i kyi lta bas lce ljib cing hūm̐ phaṭa ces bya bas yi rim gyis bskyod pa ni rdo rje nam mkha' lding gi phyag rgya'o/ /'di bcings pa tsam gyis khams gsum khyab pa'i dug kyang skad cig gis tsho sel bar byed do/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis mda' gzhu dgang ba'i ( nitshul gyis phyogs bzhir mda' bkang ste 83—369

'phangs pas pha rol dpung gzhig pa ni mnyes par byed pa'i rdo rje mda'i phyag rgya'ol/ /khu tshur gnyis las ①gung mo gshibs (mite bsgreng (8)ba las rin ④po che'i tshul du bkug 'a)la mthe bo brkyang ba'i steng du mdzub mo gnyis gdu (7bu'i tshul du byas pa ni sangs rgyas 'khor lo can gyi phyag rgya g.yul las sgrol ⑦bar byed pa'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bos sor mo mnan te gung mo bsgreng la (9g.yas pas pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i tshul du byas pa ni ha la ha la'i phyag rgya'o/ /khu tshur gnyis kyis mthe'u chung gnyis dkris la mdzub mo gnyis gshibs kyi)te bsgreng nas bzlog 0la dpral bar bzhag pa ni rdo rje khrag 'thung gi phyag rgya ste/ dur khrod du 'jug pa na mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'jigs par byed pa'o/ /g.yon pas thod pa gzung (nyal g.yas pas mdung rtse gsum thogs nas ral pa bcings te zla bas brgyan cing mtshan bsgreng 7la/ mig gsum pa gar byed pa ni gar stabs ()kyi phyag rgya ste 'di ski ni bde byed kyi phyag rgya'o/ /g.yon pa mi 'jigs par byas pa las sor mo rnams cung zad phye ste mthe bo lag mthil du bzhag /de bzhin du g.yas pa'i khu 8tshur dbyug tho 7'dzin pa ltar byas pa ni khyab 'jug gi ⑩phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis brkyang nas pad+ma'i 14tshul du byas (6pa ni tshangs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa gnyis thal mo khong stong 2 7du sbyar te me tog ltar byas pa ni ma mo rnams kyi phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis nesteni/ /rgyab tu mdud pa ltar 'dor so zhing / /rdo rje sems ma la sogs pa'i/ /rin chen cod pan phreng dbang bskur( ste/ /ting 'dzin gnas pas 'khor lo can/ /'khor lo mnga' ba'i lha rnams la/ /sangs rgyas sa ni rab 'gengs ( /pa'i/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa 'byung bar bsam/ /'gyur zhing cung zad 'jo tshul can/ /sgeg ma mo yi ni phyag rgya yis/ /gar gyi 8(3—370

tshul du bskyod stinas kyang / /hūṃ zhes bya ba glur blangs ②shing / /de nas sangs rgyas kun dgyes ②pa/ /rdo rje rgyud ni bsgreng ④bar bya/ /de nas phreng tshul phreng ba yis⑤/ /lha rnams kun la bcing bar bya/ /'jo sgeg thabs la spro ba yis/ /lag ⑥gnyis bskor zhing dgrol ba dang / /g.yas nas g.yon du bskor ba yis /gar stabs byas nas stimago la gzhag⑧ /me tog dbul ba'i tshul du ni/ /gang gis 6)me tog thal mo sbyar/ /bdug 0spos rtse mo sbyar ba yis/ /gung mo gnyis ni bzlog ⑩ste bsgreng ⑫/ /bskor cing ()bsgyur ba byas pa yis/ /mtheb gnyis mar me'i tshul du gzhag8 /dung gi tshul du lag bsgyur nas/ /dung phor lta bu'i mamachod yon dbul/ /de nas lha rnams kun la yang / /lag pa'i gar gyis byug tshul bya/ /de nas sil snyan tshul gyis su/ /lag gnyis sil snyan legs par brdung ske/ /dung dang gling bu bud ⑩pa dang / /lag pa gnyis ni rnga yab g.yob/ /bsil yab tshul gyis bsil yab dang / /sor mo gnyis kyis rgyal mtshan bya/ /tshon dgye 'tshe na lcug phran ltar/ /bskyod cing tshon gyi phreng ba dgye4ste/ /lag g.yon snod kyi tshul byas la/ /g.yas pa yis ni lha bshos dbul/ /khang pa brtsegs pa bzhag nas su/ /gos kyi tshul gyis 4)gos rnams dang / /gdu pya bu ske rurjerags rkang rgyan dang / /rna cha do shal gnas zhu)lngar gzhagakhrin /de nas gdugs kyi tshul gyis su/ /lha rdzas gdugs ni legs par gzung ( ste/ /bsam (gegatan tshul gyis tsolag pa dag /nam mkha' la ni mdzes bskor na/ /sangs rgyas zhing rab 'gengs byed pa'i/ /bla re rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyur/ /grwar ( ni pad+ma'i phreng ba dang / /dril bu g.yer ku'i dra bas brgyan/ /gsang sngags 'di ni cho ga bzhin / /rdo rje dril bu gsil sa ba yis/ /sgo 'phar dag kyang dbye bar bya/ /83—371

oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta si pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba ①bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te / pradz+nyā pā ②ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā be ①badz+ra dharma skṛ da ya/ sarnyo ṣa ṇi ④rgyu hūṃ hūm̐/ lag g.yas rdo rje gsor bya zhing / /sna tshogs khugs su 'gyur ba yiphyi /rdo rje glu yis bstod par ⑥bya/ /rdo rje theg pas mnyes byed pa/ /'di ni don dam mchod pa yin/ /gang gis ⑦rnam rtog rnam spangs te/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgoms pas/ /lus ngag sems ni rnam dag pa(kyi/ /de yi mchod pa bla na med / /sems can gang gis 6)dbu ma yi/ /theg pa gong ma ma bsgoms shing / /theg pa dman pa lhag mos pa/ /de yi mchod pa kun rdzogs ⑩pa/ /sangs rgyas dbang chen grags kun gyis/ /mchod pa de dag gsan pa dang / /ngo mtshar byung ba'i spyan phye yonyanas/ /legs so zhes ni rab tu gsungs/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas thams cad kyis(nya/ /byang chub sangs rgyas thabs su ste/ /rdo rje bsgom tu)pa byas pa yinacha/ /nyon mongs med par byang chub 'thob/ /rdo rje theg chen legs pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan pa legs/ /zab cing rgya che legs pa ste//rdo rje rin chen kun 'dus legs/ /de nas ye shes kyi sku gsum las byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis lisangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje theg pa bsngags 7pa thos nas/ dga' bas spu zing zhes byed par gyur nas/ gtso bo rdo rje snang mdzad la/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis stod 6 tshopar byed/ /thog ma med cing skye ba med/ /'gyur ba med cing gnas pa med/ /mkha' bzhin rnam rtog las grol ba/ /rtog pa rnams kyis rnam par brtagayo /thabs su brtags pa gang yin des/ /ye shes kyi ni sras po kun/ /rdo rje theg pa bsgoms yo)pa yis/ /sangs rgyas sa ne yang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes smras so/ /bde ba las 'khrungs rdo 83—372

rje 'chang ba yis/ /dngos po dngos med 'byung gnas chen por mkhyen/ /dang po gang du rnam par snang mdzad ni/ /dag cing dri med blos ni oṃ du sprul/ /gzugs mang ①tsal gyis phreng bas bskor ba yiphyi/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung snyan yi ge kun la khyab pa yi / /spros med gsung du 'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs/ /mig gsum lha mo dang bcas 'dul mdzad pa/ /sgyu 'phrul tshul mang ldan pa 'ga' ma mchis/ /gang du bde chen rang bzhin rjes chags pa/ /na chung dag dang lhan cig bzhad mdzad ④cing / /g.yas pa'i phyag gis rdo rje gsor nas su/ /g.yon pa'i phyag gis dril bu sgra snyan 'khrol/ /lha mo mtha' dag btsun mor gyur pa yi(pe/ /dam tshig rnams kyis bya ba byas par 'gyur / /gcig gi lag pas kun nas 'khyud pa (6)ste/ /gnyis pa rjes su chags phyir bde ba'i mthu/ /gsum pa mi bzod me tog phreng ba 'thor bzhi pa bde ba yis ni mda' yang 'phen/ /gang zhig glu 'di len par byed pa dag /bde ba'i rdo rje can dang mnyam par 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byed pa'i rdo rje'i 7raglu yin no/ /oṃ a nut+ta ra sasba pū dzā (9me gha uṅga te5) / s+pha ra ṇa i mi tsog ga na khaṃ /〉rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ sngags 8'di lan gsum brjod pas mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byam 52thams cad kyi 8byin gyis brlab 8par 'gyur rol/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las 'di ni phyag rgya'i mchod pa rim par phye ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pa la tsho de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang /83—373

byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis tshig mthun 6)par sgra dbyangs gcig ②gis gsol ba ①btab pa/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs kun gyi/ /ye shes gces pa dri med pa/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /bla na med pa bshad du gsol / /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pa (gethugs su chud nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems ni lus kyi rnam pa yin(5)/ /lus kyang sems kyi rnam pa (7yin/ /sems kyang tshig gis (7brjod pa yin/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis (8)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rnam par sbyor ba thos nas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /e ma kun tu bzang po ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /chos rnams skye ba med pa ste/ /g.yo ba med cing gnas pa med/ /rtog pa'i dri ma spangs pa 6)'di/ /bskyed par bya zhes rab tu gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de dzazhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pas gsung spros pa med pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po 'di dag ma skyes te/ /chos can med cing chos nyid med/ /nam mkha' bzhin du dmigs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems 'di brtan pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i tshade bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pas gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen 'byung gnas kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dmigs su med pa rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po 'di dag dngos med de / /chos kyi mtshan nyid spangs pa yin/ /bdag med chos las legs byung yin8(3—374

ba'i / /byang chub sems 'di brtan pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog gis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyis rdo rje me lce 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /dngos po skye ba med pa ste/ /dngos po ngo bo yod min pas/ /nam mkha'i go 'phang thob po zhes / /dngos rnams rab tu brjod pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyis gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bla ma'i yang bla ma ①ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas byang chub kyi sems 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /gzod phyinas dag cing rtog ④pa med/ /sems can med cing srog kyang med/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang byang chub med/ /rmi lam sgyu ma ltar snang ba'i/ /byang chub sems 'di brtan ④pa yin/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa don yod grub kyis gsungs so/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la sogs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rje'i 'a)de bzhin gshegs pa'i 56)byang chub kyi sems rnam par dag par ⑦mthong nas ngo mtshar skyes par gyur (kyete ched du brjod pa 'di yodabarjod do/ /kye ma'o sangs rgyas kye ma'o dag /kye ma'o chos ni bstan pa rnams/ /bdag med chos las legs tsobyung ba/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom 57pa yinas/ /mi g.yo yi ge las byung ba/ /rmi lam sogs ltar ma skyes pa//byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnas dang stan /tsho ni rnam bsams te/ /83—375

sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ①bcas nas/ /dang por rang bzhin dag pa'o ②zhes//dag pa'i chos kyi tshul la gnas/ /yid ②kyis hūm̐ byas rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems mas byin gyis brlabs/ /rin chen lus su nga rgyal bya/ /lag pa bstod de bskor ba yirgya/ /lcags kyu yis ni spyan yang drang ⑤/ /byon nas dang por phyogs bcings te0/ /dam tshig dag kyang dbul bar bya/ /gdan rnams so sor phul nas su/ /mchod yon dbul ba'i sbyor ba bya7/ /dbang bskur mtshon cha go cha sogasal/ /sil snyan mchod sogs ngo bo bya/ /rnam pa kun gyis (nyamanyes par bya/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid can gyis brtag /rnal 'byor rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /byin gyis brlabs lhonyedang yongs brtags dang / /gzugs gnyis rdzogs par gyur pa ni/ /rnal 'byor yin zhes sangs rgyas gsung / /sngags kyis yibyin brlabs 9gleng rgyal bskyed/ /rnal 'byor byin brlabs tu yin par gsungs/ /byang chub sems ni dag pa dang / /gsang sngags sa bon (nyebaskyed pe cheyi/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs su brtags pa yin/ / rim gyis skigazugs ni rdzogs byas pa/ /de ni brtag 7par brjod pa ste/ /rnal 'byor cho ga yin par gsungs(na/ /bsdu dang spro bar byas pa las/ /rnam pa'i mchog kun ldan pa dag /skad cig ye shes kyis rdzogs pa/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes brjod do/ /dang por dam tshig 1 byin brlabs par(ge/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa bdag gis brtags/ /rab tu rdzogs par bya ba 3 )dag /'di ni rnal 'byor cho gar bshad/ /nyon mongs dri mar byas pa'i sems/ /byang chub sems kyis dag byas te/ /de ni rang bzhin dag pa'o zhes/ /brjod cing thal mo gsum gyis sbyang / /dag 'gyur ( stede nas blo yis ni/ /sems la so sor brtag par bya/ /sems la so sor brtags nas 843—376

kyang ske/ /phyi rol rang bzhin stong par bya/ /sems tsam la ni gnas nas su/ /byang chub tshogs kyi bag chags te0)/ /bsgom ②par bya ba'i ngo bo dag /zla ba'i gzugs su rnam par brtag /lag pa'i pad+ma la gnas pa'i/ /oṃ gyi myu gus bskrun pa yi / /yan lag kun gyi mtshan nyid gzugs/ /rdo rje skur ni bsgom ④par bya/ /āḥzhes bya ba spros med gsung / /sems ni hūm̐ zhes bya bar sprul/ /yi ge gsum gyis (7byin brlabs (5)lus/ /snying la gnas pa'i zla ba'i gzugs/ /de la rang gi yi ge ni/ /mdog gzugs 'od ni phyed bsams dzo)te/ /nga rgyal bskyed nas de la ni/ /rdo rje'i (shebadag nyid bdag yin brjod/ /rgyan kun yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa/ /cha shas kyi 6steni dra ba can/ /ye shes sems dpa' rdzogs par brtag /de 'og lag pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /go cha mtshon cha la sogs bya/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas lngar dbang bskur te/ /cod pan phreng ba rnams kyis bklubs7/ /de nas de 'og sangs rgyas kyi/ /sprul pa mdzad pa'i sgyu ma spro/ /yan lag bzhi pa'i dbus ldan pa'i/ /phyogs bcur 57khro bo bcu dag dang / /bsnyems yo ma dang ni rtogs 4 ldan ma/ /mtshon cha mda' mudang rtse mo can/ /sgyu ma'i cha byad rnam mang po/ /rnam par 'phrul par 'byin gyis brlabs/ /kun la khyab par byed pa yi/ /sna tshogs dbus su bzhag nas ni/ /de nyid chen po bdag nyid lngas/ /phyogs bzhi'i nyu —'khor lo khyab byas te/ /dga' bas dga' byed bzhi yang spro4snye/ /ting 'dzin kun gyis yi dga' ba la/ /longs par spyod pa'i sngags pa yis/ /'khor lo la ni rdo rje'i gzugs/ /pad+ma'i gzugs la de dag ni/ /'khor lo kun las pad+ma yi / /ngo bo yis ni rol pa dang / /e zhes bya ba 'phros ri pa las/ /mdog ldan 83—377

bdag nyid gzugs su bya/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan nyid kun ldan pa/ /nyid kyi stan yo)la bzhugs par blta/ /sgeg mo glu ②dang gar rnams dang / /rgyal mtshan la sogs tshon dgye dang / /sil snyan mchod pa'i rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs rnams kyis mchod par bya/ /rnam pa kun dang ldan par ni/ /bdag nyid kyi ni lus bsgoms nas/ /myur ches pa dang bul ba dang / /mi gsal gug skyed gnyams pa dang / /rtog pa ngan pa rnam spangs nas/ /de nas gsang sngags bzlas brjod bya/ / bzlas pas liskyo na lag g.yas kyis/ /bsgrims te rdo rje gsor nas kyang / /g.yon pas rdo rje dril gsil ( zhing / /rdo rje glu tshul sna tshogs dang ske/ /ba dan tshul du bya bas mchod/ /bzlas pa'i mjug ni brtul nas kyang ske/ /gshegs su gsol te bdag nyid bsrung (6)/ /lus dang ngag dang sems bsgoms te/ /brtan por ci bder 'gro bar bya/ /bar chad du ni gyur na yang ske/ /yi ge brgya pas byin gyis brlab/ /de ltar sgom (7pas sgom byed pa/ /rdo rje theg pas (nyarab rdzogs pa'i/ /byang chub des ni myur thob nas/ /zla nya'i 5)dkyil 'khor lta bur snang / /sna tshogs las kyis 7thog 'dren cing / /rin chen rgyal mtshan rab dga' byed/ /chags chen pad+ma'i gdung rgyud can/ /gnas chen 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gyur/ /dpal ldan rig (1sngags kun gyi gtso / /dga' chen rdo rje lcags kyur 'gyur/ /sgyu ma bshig pa kune shes shing / /dregs pa 'joms byed khro bor 'gyur/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las 'di ni byang chub kyi sems sgom tsho pa'i ye shes sgrub tsho pa rim par phye ba'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //83—378

de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka'i 'khor lo rab tu sgrub ①pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas phyi nang gi 'khor lo thams cad rab tu sgrub (snyepa'i ye shes kyi las kyi sbyor ba rab 'byam ④'di bka' stsal to/ /lha ni gang yang rung dub zhig /'khor lo'i dbus su bzhag na ni/ /de yi ming smos rdo rje yi/ /dkyil 'khor yin zhes sangs rgyas gsung ⑤/ /zhi dang rgyas dang drag shul dang / /rang gi las la sbyor ba na/ /'khor lo'i rgyal po rnam (5)bsgoms nas/ /bdag po nyid kyis rab tu bya/ /zhi ba spyan dang skul ⑦byed mas/ /rgyas la rin chen gos dkar mo(8)/ /dbang la sgrol ma lu gu rgyud6)/ /yams dang gnod pa gzhig pa'i phyir/ /'od zer can dang ri khrod mas/ /drag shul spyad la mā ma tī/ /khro gnyer can ma dag gis bya/ /'di dag shes rab rol pa ste/ /chags pa'i rdo rjes rjes yichags pa/ /gsang sngags de nyid kyis bskul na/ /gdon mi za bar phrin /spelas mdzad8/ /spyan dang lha mo skul 7byed ma/ /dbang po zhi ba zla 'dra ba/ /phyag gnyis na teni bgrang phreng dang / /ril ba spyi blugs kyis brgyan pa/ /dang por ting 'dzin gyis sprul nas/ /bum pa zla ba'i mdangs ldan pa/ /bdud rtsi'i 'o mas rab bkang ste/ /lag gnyis pad+ma'i gdub mchog gis/ /rnam par snang mdzad zhabs drung du/ /nad pa la ni bdugs 7par bsamasatso/ /rin chen ma dang gos dkar can/ /sku che mkha dog ser po ste/ /lha mo ser mo snang ba la/ /phyag na rin chen pad+ma can/ /dang por ting 'dzin gyis sprul nas/ /yid 'ong rgyal ba'i 'dod pa yis/she/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i zhabs drung du/ /bdud rtsi'i tshoge83—379

rab tu dgang ba dang / /bla med rin chen khar bab na/ /rgyas pa mtshungs med mdzes 0)par 'gyur/ /lha mo sku chen mdog dmar ba/ /sgrol ma de bzhin lu gu rgyud(mi / /kun nas 'od dmar 'bar ba can/ /lha rdzas lcags kyu zhags (snyethogs pa/ /rab tu bzhad cing spyan phye bas/ /'od dpag med pa'i zhabs drung du/ /bsgrub ④bya rgyags pas myos pa dag /bkug steng ⑤mda' yis bsnun na ni/ /skad cig nyid la dbang du mdzad/ /mi ngas gnod pa gzhig pa'i phyir//sku chen nam mkha'i kha dog can/ /'od zer can dang ri khrod mas/ /rdo rje don yod zhabs drung du/ /mkhas pas sngar bshad tshul du ni/ /bdud rtsi yis kyang rnam par bzlog /lha mo khro gnyer mā ma khri(6)/ /margad lta bu'i mdog can ma/ /rdzu zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrogs 97pa/ /rdo rjes bsdigs par (8)brtson pa yis/ /rdo rje mi 'khrugs (9)zhabs drung du/ /khros yinas rdo rje'i me 41yi char 'bebs par rnam par bsam 7par bya/ /rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba des/ /bsgrub bya tshig nas mog ces byed/ /sbyor ba 'di yi (stemod la ni/ /de ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na lus ni 'jig par mdzad/ /byin rlabs yidam tshig dbang bskur la/ /rdo rje sems ma rin chen dang / /chos dang rdo rje las ma bzhi/ /sbyor ba rnams ni rab tu sbyar7/ /sems dpa' chen po bcu drug kyang / /bla med 'khor lo byed pa ste/ /rang gi phyogs nas las byas na/ /'bras bu don yod sbyin par byed / /khro bo'i lus la legs gnas te/ /khro bo'i rgyal po sbyar bar bya/ /dam tshig la sogs cho ga bzhin/ /der ni rdo rje bsgoms nas bskul/ /rkang pa'i rjes kyi sa blangs la/ /dur khrod thal ba dag dang bsre/ /de yi ras blangs mi rus dang / /chu 'gram gnyis kyi sa dag ni/ /btags /tshanas lung bong gcin 8(3—380

gyis sbrul/ /de las dgra bo'i gzugs byas la/ /de tshe gzugs brnyan bcing bar bya/ /dug dang ske ①tshe lan tshwa dang / /'bru mar tsha ba rab bsres te/ /dgra bo tsha ba bskyed ③pa'i phyir/ /de yis ༷lus nang rab tu dgang / /de nas rnam shes rlung 'dra ba/ /lcags kyu yis ni bkug nas kyang / /srin bu me khyer 'dra bcug ste/ /zhags pa yis ni dam du gzung ⑤/ /de ni rdo rje sgrog tu gzhug /bsgrims nas de yi ming smos te/ /dgra bo'i lus ni ma lus par/ /po son cha yi tsher mas dbug⑥ /mi rus las byas phur bu 'am/ /yang na seng ldeng las byung bas/ /dpral ba snying mgrin dpung mgo gnyis/ /gnas lnga dag tu bsgrims te gdab⑦/ /nim pa'i shing la sbar ba yis me 'bar ba la bskam par ⑧bya/ /mkhas pas rkang pa nas brtsams te6)/ /mtshon cha rnon pos gtubs nas ni/ /'bar ba'i lus can khros pa yis/ /de yi dum bu ⑩sbyin sreg (nyebya/ /las 'di la ⑩ni lhag par yang / /rus sbal gyi ni rkang stabs ⑫sbyar / /nyi ma'i gung ngam nam phyed na/ /las 'di nyid ni bsgrub par bya/ /las 'di byas nas nges par ni/ /gang zhig rgyal bas bsrungs na'ang des/ /nges par 'chi na tsokhyab 'jug dang / /lha chen tshangs pas ci zhig smos/ /phyi rol gyi drag shul spyod pa'i go cha'o/ /gsod pa'i ye shes las sprul pa/ /nang gi yang ni bshad par bya/ /bsgrub bya yid kyis bsrungs nas su/ /cho ga bzhin du dgug par bya/ /lag na ral gri mtshon cha dang / /be con rdo rje gtun lishing zhags / /lag na tso'akhor lo mda' gzhu can/ /khro bo sna tshogs bsnams pa des / /bsgrub bya zhags pas bcings nas su/ /rdo rje yi yini khro bo yis/ /lho yi phyogs su khrid pa dang / /rdo rje gzhan gyis brdeg pa dang / /de ni ral gris 83—381

gtub pa dang / /rgyu 0)ma lang long nar bar bsam/ /oṃ hūṃ badz+ra rāk+ṣa sril/bhak+ṣa ya tha phaṭa/ rdo rje srin mo bsgoms nas kyang / /bya rog wa dang bya rgod kyis ske/ /kun nas yongs su bskor nas su/ /de dag zang thob byed par ni/ /bsgom (pezhing ming nas bskul bar bya⑤/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i/ /rdo rje rnga mo rnams bsams te/ /bsgrub par bya bar yongs brtags pa/ /de yi rgyab tu zhon nas su/ /rdo rje khro bos gzir bzhin du/ /lho phyogs su ni dkri ⑥bar bya/ /de yi rtsirkang rjes sa la ni/ /rlung gis gtsubs ⑧pa'i shing lo la/ /de yi ming nas brjod byas te/ /rdo rje sna yon drung du sbang)/ /de lta bur ni sbyor ba'i bolas/ / bsgom zhing (nyacho ga bzhin byas na/ /brgya byin nyid kyang bskrad 'gyur na/ /sa steng skye bo smos ci dgos/ /de ming yigasang sngags dang 6)spel te / /'ug pa'i sgro la bris nas ni/ /dge sbyong bram ze'i spas dkris te/ / sa yi 7'og tu brkos snyinas gzhug /rdo rje khro bo gnyis kyis ni/ /'thab mo 'gyed du gzhug ⑩par bya/ /de ltar bsams (1pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /'dod pa bzhin du dbye kyi bar 'gyur/ /hūṃ zhes bya bas gang ba yi/ /rdo rje phra mo bsgoms ()byas nas / /sna yi rtse mo nas bton te/ /bsgrub bya'i lus ni dgang bar bya lus kyi tshigs ni thams cad du/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bcings nas su/ /rdo rje 'bar ba 'phros gyur pa/ / des ni 9 )lus kyang bskam par bya/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgoms te/ /kun nas kyang ni gzhig par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ a mu ka su rak+ta 1ā kur+sha tsa sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sbyor ba'i rim pa 'di yis ni/ /skam ( gye'agyur 'di la the tshom ( stemed/ /mkhas pas rlung gi phyogs song ste/ /dkyil 'khor gru ( )bzhir byas nas ni/ /spos kyi thig le bdun byas te/ /de dag kham pa'i por pa 83—382

dgab / /de ni ri rab thams cad nas/ /rtse mo brgyad par sprul byas hu)te/ /rdo rje 'phro bas brgyan pa yis/ /de dag rnams ni mnan ②par bya/ /yo zhes bya bas ③bskyed pa'i rlung bdun rnams/ /lo zhes bya ba'i ④mtshan ma dbang chen gyi②ske/ /nang du rlung rnams nges par chud par bya/ /de lta'i sbyor bas 'jig pa'i rlung yang bcings/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsgoms nas de'i du'adab la/ /klu brgyad bkod dbus me tshogs 'bar ba can/ /rdo rje khro bo'i sku yi zhabs ⑦ mthil gyis/ /klu rnams mnan na char sprin char pa 'bebs/ /rtsu zhes bya bas gnyis dbus ②klu rnams kyi/ /snying po yongs bcug spel mas gzir nas su/ /hūṃ zhes bya ba bzlas brjod byas nas su/ /'jig 6)dus char pa lta bu'i kyichar pa 'bab / /nyi ma'i mdog ltar dmar po'i 'od bzang 4)zhal/ /nam mkha' khyab par rnam par gdangs nas ni/ /kun nas char chus yongs su gang ba'i sprin/ /r+ghaṃ zhes bya ba'i 'bar ba'i lce yis ldagatso /dbugs rngub pa yis bkug nas dbyung skab yis/ /shing bal bzhin du rab tu gtor bar bya/ /yang na rang gi phyag rgya'i tshogs cha'abar ba/ /btang bas skad cig la ni bcad gtubs te/ /hūm̐ zhes bya bas bsdigs 8pa byas na ni/ /nam mkha' dag kyang ston ku'i dus ltar snang / /me yi dkyil 'khor la gnas snang mdzad kyi/ /zhabs drung dpral dbyes yinas byung mi g.yo bran/ /bdud las rnam rgyal phyag drug mda' gzhu zhags / /ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje char 'bebs pa/ /khro bo grangs med pa yis yongs bskor nas/ /bgegs rnams sreg mdzad hūm̐ gi ⑩sgras bkang nas/ /'jig rten gsum po gang 'di /shernam par 'jig /rkang rjes sa dang mi yi khrag dag las/ /mi yi gzugs byas mi rus phur bu la/ /'od zer can gyi nyugegasang 83—383

rnams dang / /bzang po rnam pa bcu drug po/ /kun dang drag po'i ting 'dzin la / /gnas pa yi ①ni khro bo dang / /gsang sngags rdzogs mdzad rig rgyal ma⑤/ /rnam pa kun dang ldan pa dag /rims bral rang gi ting 'dzin gnas/ /thams cad ldan pa'i 'khor rnams la/ /gzigs pa chen pos rnam gzigs nas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can/ /smin ma mdzes ③par bskyod nas su/ /yan lag 'phrog pa'i 'dzum bstan nas/ /thugs kyi dusems ni dga' bar mdzad/ /dga' bar mdzad pa'i mod la ni/ /sangs rgyas mchog kun gyis mchod pa/ /shes rab chen po'i thog 'dren pas/ /bsgrims te so sor gsor nas des/ /bde chen ting 'dzin la gnas te(ge/ /ldem bag 'jo tshul gyis bltas nas/ /lag gnyis pad+ma'i tshul gyur te6)/ /spyi bor thal mo sbyar byas nas/ — /ye shes lam ni rab ston pa/ /rgyal chen rnam par snang mdzad la/ /lag na rdo rje stobs po che/ /yid rgyas pa yis tshig gsol ba/ /ci slad rnam pa thams cad du/ /zur gyis rnam par gzigs pa dang / /smin ma bskyod byas 'dzum mdzad pa/ /ye shes rnam par bsgyings pas gsungs( ta/ /byang chub chen po'i rdo rje can/ /lag na rdo rjes (8)gsol mod la/ /brtan zhing zab pa'i gsung gis ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rol pa bshad/ /bsgom 5)pa'i lam la legs byung ba/ /rdo rje ye shes rnams kyi 7thabs/ /bde ba'i 41byang chub thob 'gyur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun dang sangs rgyas kyi'o/ /rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor nyon cig /gang la dngos rnams dngos med cing / /mtha' gnyis kyi ni mtshan ma med/ /dbus la'ang spyod pa med pa dag /dus gsum 'das pa'i /shenam mkha' 'dra/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam spangs pa/ /de la byang chub ji ltar rtogs/ /rtogs 83—385

par 'dod pa de dag ni/ /thabs rnams nga yis bshad par bya/ /phung po dngos po yod med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni grogs gyur pa/ /spro ba dang ni btung ba yis/ /sku gsum mchoge ni mchod par bya/ /sems kyis sku ni thob yo)'gyur zhing / /sems kyis chos rnams bstan pa yin/ /sems kyis byang chub 'thob 'gyur bas②/ /de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par bsgomatshu/ /sems ni sgyu ma'i rnam pa ste/ /byang chub kyang ni sgyu ma 'dra/ /dper na sgyu ma'i mkhan po 'gas/ /gyo mo la ni sngags bzlas te/ /legs par byas pa'i gzugs dag la/ /sbyor ba goms pas bsnun na ni/ /rkang bzhi pa la sogs pa'i gzugs/ /zhen pa'i sems la snang bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin bsod nams ye shes las/ /byung ba'i tshogs kyis bsgom gopa'i sems/ /sems can rnams kyi bsam (nyapa la/ /bla med byang chub snang bar byed/ /dngos po don dam mi shes pa/ /phyi rol dngos la mngon zhen pa'iyi/ /ngan par rtog ⑦pa'i rnam rtog (0gis/ /rin chen sems 'di dri mar byas/ /'byung ba chen po bzhi rnams dang / /dngos po thams cad ldan zhes gsungs/ /de la gtsang dang mi gtsang sogs/ /mi shes pa yis 99)yongs su brtagasakyi/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa'i (nyamangon zhen pas/ /don dam phyi rol byas pa yi/ /theg pa dman pa pa 7rnams kyisatso/ /bla med byang chub ci miltar 'thob/ /byang chub rnam pa gnyis gsungs te/ /lhag ma dang bcas lhag ma med/ /lhag bcas phung po'i ngo bo ste/ /nyon mongs pa rnams yongs su bsregs/ /lhag med bag chags med pa ste/ /mkha' ltar dri ma med pa yin/ /bla med byang chub 'di lta bur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rnam par bshad / /de yi byang chub spel ba'i phyir/ /las kyi tshul ni sna tshogs yin/ /83—386

rnal 'byor can gyi gsang sngags gang / /ye shes sems dpa'i zhabs drung du/ /rtag tu mnyes byas ma grub pa'i/ /lhag ①ma nga yis bshad bya ste/ /de ni bde blag thabs kyis su/ /tshar bcad nas ni bsgrub ②pa bshad/ /rdo rje lcags kyu rgyal po che/ /rdo rje zhags pa rab gdung byed/ /rdo rje khu tshur gzi brjid che/ /rdo rje phur bu rnams ③'dril byed/ /rdo rje tho ba rdung ba ste/ /rdo rje nag mo cher 'bar ba④/ /lha rnams kun la 'jigs pa skyed⑤/ /phyag rgya rnam pa sna tshogs 'di / /bsgoms nas las la sbyar na ni/ /dam tshig burgyal bas bstan pa'i phyir / /mtshungs pa med pa'i las byed do/ /gsang sngags rig ⑦pas hūṃ zhes pa'i / /lcags kyu btang nas zhabs drung dgugadu /'di ni gal te sangs rgyas sam / /rdo rje 'chang ba'i snying las dgug6) /dam tshig gis ni zhugs pa dang / /rdo rje bcing bas bcing bar bya/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyis bzung yinas/ /rdo rje nag mos kun tu bsdigs7/ /rdo rje yi ni phur bu yis/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni gnas lnga poti/ /dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga (nyadang / /de bzhin dpung 8pa gnyis su gdab/ /rdo rje tho bas brdung bar bya/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 8'di yis ni//sangs rgyas nyid kyang nges par gnon/ /bsdigs tshul sogs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /gzugs brnyan ⑩mig yor gyur pa dang / /sangs rgyas byang chub rab rdzogs pa'i / /dngos grub de tshe sbyin par mdzad/ /'di ni mthu yis grub pa yi/ /sbyor ba gcig pu gsang chen yin/ /de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag gis gsang ba'i ༷ sgrub pa thos nas mgrin gcig 47tu thams cad kyis legs so zhes bya bar gsol to( ska/ /gtso bo rdo rje rnam snang mdzad/ /dpa' bo chen po legs so zhes/ /zab mo chos kyi mchog gyur pa/ /dam pa bshad par salhamadzad 83—387

pa legs/ /sems can phan phyir thugs rje yi/ /lcags kyus kun nas 'bar ba legs/ /bdag med chos rnams sgrub pa yi/ /ye shes snying khu ①'bar ba legs / /gsang chen thams cad bstan pa yi/ /rdo rje theg pa nges par gsungs / /theg pa'i tshul 'di la gnas na/ /bla med byang chub bde bar thob/ /oṃ badz+ra e ku sha ā kun+ta ②ya r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha brnya ①rgyu/ oṃ badz+ra ṭāk+ki rā dzā ④ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi grosna (5)rtsu/ oṃ badz+ra tī la ya tī la ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mud ga ra ā tsiko ṭa ya hūṃ/ ye shes kyi snying khus ④snying po can du gyur pa'i gsang sngags dag pa mchog tu gyur pa don yod pa'i las 'di dag su la yang bstan par mi bya'o / /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul dra ba las 'di ni sbyor ba'i thabs kyis sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad chen pos sbyor ba'i las thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dbab pa la sogs pa'i las bya ba 'di bshad do / /oṃ zhes bya ba mgor bzhag ste/ /āḥni bzhin gyi pad+ma la/ /hūm̐ ni bskul nas snying gar gzhag(kyi /yo ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor la/ /bzhag nas bsgrims te gdeg 997byas na7/ /'gro ba dang ni gnas pa yi/ /'gro ba thams cad 'bab par 'gyur/ /dbab snod (7skul byed gzugs de yi/ /gzugs kyi ngo bor bsams nas su/ /rdo rje 'chang ba'i nga rgyal gyis/ /gsang sngags bsnyems 7dang bcas par bklaga'i /brjod par bya ba thogs pa med pa'i phreng ba ni/ /na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nī/ samyakle bud+dha ko ṭī dzāñtsa)/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun+de kyis 83—388

hūṃ hūm̐/ rtsu rtsu rtsu/ tri tri tri/ oṃ tsa le tsu le ① tsun+de sasba ②snga dha ya swā hā/ de ni ①rdo rjes bskul nas su/ /rdo rje dril bu gsil dubya zhing / /rdo rje bcing ba dubaskyod par byayi/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor la gnas oṃ/ /dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang / /'brel ba'i pad+ma bzhag nas su/ /āḥgazhes bya bar ⑧brgyad kyis brgyan/ /dbus su bsgrub 6)bya bzhag nas su/ /hūṃ bzhi yis ni mdzes par bya/ /kham phor kha sbyar nang bcug ste/ /steng du rdo rje 'chang bas mnan / /sgom ⑩zhing gsang sngags bskul ⑩tshig gis/ /bzlas brjod dag ni bya ba dang / /ba zhes bya ba'i theg pa yis/ /kun nas kyang ni bkri 8bar bya/ /'di ni sku gsum las byung ba'i/ /lha dang mi kun mnan par 'gyur/ /sngags la mkhas pa'i bdag nyid ni/ /kha dog dmar po rdo rje can/ /'dod chags che ⑫dang ldan pa'i gzugs/ /'dod pa'i lha dang lhan cig bsamatso/ /sku gsum ldan pa mda' thogs shing / /g.yon pa yis ni gzhu yang gzung snyi/ /oṃ r+ghaṃ bud med spyi bor bsams tsonas ni/ /'dod pas snying zags yidregs bdo btso/ /mdog dmar thal mo sbyar nas ni/ /'dud (7bzhin du ni mdun bzhag ste/ /rdo rje mda' yis bsnun na ni/ /pad+ma dag las (nyazil pa 'dzag /rdo rje mda' yi sbyor ba yis/ /'dod chags can ma 'dzag par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor can gyis ḍo medabang bya'i phyir/ /'dod chags rdo rje can yang bsgom(nya/ /mi thod las byas cang te'u la/ / spre'u'i pags pas 9 stegayogs nas ( )ni/ /ngos gnyis (nyal ni pad+ma bri/ /bud med khrag gis 'dzag sripar bya/ /de yi dkyil du phre so bris te/ /mi yi skra ( sheyis btags nas ni/ /mthing ril gyi ni rkang rus kyis/ /phre myos ming nas brjod cing brdung / /lam gyi bzhi mdor dkyil 'khor ni/ /rkang pa 83—390

g.yon pa'i mthe bos bris/ /gyur ①ni bu mo zas sbyin ma/ /'gugs par brtson ②pa'i lcags kyu bya/ /gtso bo khrag 'thung cha lugs kyil/ /gzugs can gyis ①ni rting bas brdung / /'dis ⑤ni khams gsum rnam duganas pa'i/ /bu mo zas sbyin 'gugs ⑦par 'gyur/ /gang yang rung ba'i gzugs brnyan la/ /gnas pa yi nini nga rgyal gyis/ /rnal 'byor 'khor lo rdzogs gyur na/ /tshig gi rnam pa tsam gyis kyang / /lha dang lhan min mi ⑨la sogs/ /rnal 'byor can gyis thams cad byed/ /gang tshe dbang nyid la gnas pa/ /de tshe thams cad mngag gzhug 'gyur/ /bltas pa tsam gyis 'chi ba 'am/ /me 0tsam gyis kyang gcod pa'i mchog /sgyu ma'i ye shes kyis bskul nas/ /rnal 'byor can gyis glu dang gar/ / ci ltar ci ltar bsgoms (nyebyas pa/ /de ltar 'gro ba rab tu byed/ /sbyin sreg 8de nyid la gnas pa'i/ /me yi lha ni zhal yin pas/ /sna tshogs las rnams grub byed pa'i/ /sbyin sreg ()las ni rab tu bshad/ /sbyin sreg gis ④ni lha rnams tshim/ /tshim par gyur nas dngos grub steratso/ /gsang sngags lhag chad gang yin pa/ /thams cad sbyin sreg dag gis skong / /de phyir sku gsum mkhas mchog gis/ /sbyin sreg ⑩rab tu bsngags par mdzad/ /gtsub ⑩shing las ni byung ba'i me/ /dge ba yi 4)ni las rnams byed/ /gdol pa'am dur khrod las byung ba'i/ / me yis 4)las rnams rab tu sgrubaso )/ /thab khung skum po gru ⑥bzhi pa/ /zla gam dang ni zur gsum pa/ /dkyil 'khor zur gyi kha khyer la(nye / /rdo rje mtshan ma dag gis du brgyan/ /sbyin sreg rustede nyid tshul rig dupas/ /thab khung rnams kyi dbus su ni/ /pad+mo steng gnas gtsug tor dang / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma gzhagadu /ci khri ltar rigs par 'dug gnas ()su/ /lag gnyis 83—391

pus mo'i bar bzhag ste/ /dgang gzar tshimar gyis bkang nas ni/ /blugs ②gzar bkang ste de bzhin bsreg /sbyin sreg dul dgos g.yas su gzhag④ /g.yon du chu yi snod dag go/ /las kun byed pa bzlas nas su/ /bsang gtor dudang ni 'thor yi'athung bya/ /ku sha'i rtse mos gnon ⑦pa yis/ /thab khung khor yug bskor bar bya/ /me ni 'bar bar shes pa dang / /g.yas pas mi 'jigs mtheb (kyebaskyod cing / /gsang sngags 'dis yo)ni cho ga bzhin/ /me yi lha ni spyan drang ngo / /tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /bsreg 0blugs zhal zas 7bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/oṃ asna nyurten/ dī pya dī pya/ ā be ()sha ma hā shri yiye/ ha bya ka 8bya/ ba ha ⑩nā ya swā hā/ lag g.yon rdo rje bsang ⑩gtor te/ /mchod yon mchod pa rnam lnga dbul/ /me yi phyogs nas bod (nyapa ni/ /gsus po che la mig gsum pa/ /gdong bzhi lag pa bzhi dang ldan/ /'od dmar ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ /me yi dkyil 'khor la gnas shing / /las kyi 'od zer rnams kyis brgyan/ /lag pa dang po mchog sbyin la/ /gnyis pa na ni sngags nor phreng / /g.yon na ril ba spyi blugs te/ /gnyis pa na ni be con nyid/ /mdog dmar rgyan ni med pa la/ /drang srong rnams kyis yongs bskor ba/ /'di lta'i gzugs ni bsams nas kyang / /thab 17kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ /de la sbyin sreg ( )la dgos pa / /kun nas lan gsum bsreg ( )blugs dbul/ /de nas 'thor ( ge'athung byas nas su/ /'bar ba'i rnam par bsgyur bar bya/ /rim pa 'di yi tshul gyis ni/ /mkhas pas lha rnams tshim par bya/ /legs par tshim byas bzod gsol te/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub gsol ba gdab/ /bum pa rgyal mtshan rdo rje gdugs/ 83—392

pad+ma lcags kyu'i rnam pa 6)dag /me lce mdog dkar snang ba dang / /'khyil pa'i mtshan ma mkhas pas brtag /de nas myur du 'grub 'gyur bas/ /bsgom ②dang bzlas la 'bad par bya/ /zhi chadang rgyas dang dbang la ni/ /oṃ zhes pa dang swā hā mthar/ /dbyangs kyi rgyun ni bsring ④ba dang / /bar chad med pa'i dbyangs kyis (shesbyar/ /zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba mo/ /'byor pa rgyas pa mngon par spel/ /dregs gdong stabs tshul bcas pa dang / /dbang du gyur pas ⑥dbang bya'o/ /drag shul spyod tshul la gnas pas/ /hūm̐ zhes pa dang phaṭa dang bcas / /lus ni me lce 'bar ba dang / /'jig rten gsum po bzar bsams nas / /bskul ( )ba'i tshig dang spel ba yi/ /gsang sngags yi ge nges par sbyar/ /sngags grub cho ga shes pa yis/ /sbyin sreg (8)cho ga thams cad la/ /sna tshogs las dang ldan pa'i lha/ /gang dag yin par 5)mchod par bya/ /sbyin sreg ⑩de nyid kyis bskul cing / /dang po dgang blugs sreg tuskrecing dbul/ /phyis ni rim bzhin rnam par spel/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang rnams la/ /dge ba rdzas rnams sbyin sreg 'bya/ /bshang gci khrag rkang rus pa dang / /sha chen dag kyang sbyin sreg tsobya/ /ci ste ye shes sems dpa'i 8zhal/ /mi gtsang ba yis bkang na gosnyi/ /ji yiltar sdig pa mi skye 'gyur/ /gal te sdig 'gyur 'bras bu gang / /sems can mi shes pas rmongs te/ /thams cad shes rab rnams 5 mospangs shing / /phyi rol dngos la mngon zhen pa/she/ /rnam rtog dra bas blun byas gang / /de dag gis ni dge sdig gi/ /phung po gnyis su rnam par brtags/ /chos 'di rang bzhin gyis dag ste/ /skye ba med cing gnas pa med/ /sems can shes pa spel ba'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thabs kyis bstan/ /dam pa'i don du dge 83—393

spangs ①na/ /bsod nams med pa ci zhig smos/ /dper na chus gang chu klung gi / /pha rol 'gro ba'i sems can dag /rtswa ②dang shing la sogs bsdus te/ /chu las (1rgal ba'i gzings byas na④/ /de la 'jus ⑤te legs brgal yin/ /bor te bde bar 'gro ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'khor ba'i pha rol gyi/ /chos kyi lam ni bskyed byas kyang / /chos dang chos min rnam (7spangs nas/ /byang chub bde ba ⑧thob pa bzhin/ /de phyir rnam rtog drang spongs la/ /zab mo yi ni chos spel te / /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs (9)lam la/ /sngags rig rnam rtog ma byed cig /rnam rtog rmongs pa chen po ste7/ /'khor ba'i rgya 7mtshor ltung byed pas/ /nam mkha' lta bur dri med pa'i/ /rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin mnos8/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyar te/ /lus dang ngag dang sems bsdams nas/ /nga'o snyam pa'i gzi bskyed gzugs/ /rnam pa kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor ldan pa tshe 'di la/ /ye shes rdzogs pa nyid du 'gyur/ sne/las las byung bar tirnam bstan pa'i/ /skyes pa bud med gzugs mang tshul/ /brnyas ⑩pa nyid du mi bya 'dis/ /rdo rje lus yican dam tshig yin/ /ngan rtog bzang rtog dra ba yi/ /sems kyi ⑩sems can rnams la ni/ /sna tshogs gdung bas sun mi dbyung ske/ /rdo rje sems ldan dam tshig yin/ /sred pas bskyed rtsub phra ba yis/ /tshig dag 6sternam par mi smra zhing / /mnyan na bde bar byed pa 'di/ /rdo rje ngag (tshecan dam tshig yin/ /rnam par snang mdzad cher 'khrugs mchog /sha yi khams la gnas pa yin/ /rkang la mi 'khrugs ( nyargyal po ste/ /khrag la rin chen 'byung ba gtso/ /sems can rnams kyi rus phung gi/ / rus gong 8)la ni 'od dpag med / /rtsa yi tshogs rnams rnam 'dren pa/ /thub pa skyes zho nyamachog don yod la/ /83—394

dam tshig shes pa rnams la ni/ /gsang chen nga yis bstan ①pa 'di/ /blo ldan rdo rje sems kyis ni/ /rtag tu bsten zhing bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags zhe snang de bzhin rmongs/ /sred dang de bzhin rnam spel ba'i/ /chos ni rnam pa lnga po 'di/ /thub pa skyes mchog rnams kyis ②gsungs/ /bshang gci khu ba mchil ma khrag /'dzag pa 'byung ba bzhis dubasdus pa/ /bsgom ④pa'i blo gros rdzogs pa yis/ /dam tshig bsten par bya ba ste/ /rtag tu bza' zhing btung bar bya/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po sgyu 'phrul gyi ②dra ba las 'di ni sbyin sreg ⑥rim par phye ba'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad chen po rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas ting nge ⑦'dzin thams cad kyi dngos grub dam pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dam tshig thams cad kyi rdo rje chen po'i mchog dngos grub 'di bka' stsal to/ /lag na rdo rje gsang sngags bsgom ④pa'i rnal 'byor gyi cho gas yang dag par bskul nas rdzas thams cad kyi dngos grub bsgrub 5)pa'i thabs gsang chen 'di nyon cig /rnam par snang mdzad ting 'dzin la/ /gnas shing sku gsung thugs bsgoms te/ /mdun du 'khor lo legs par gzhagatso /sku gsum rdo rje can gyi gzugs/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs spyi pa'i 'od/ /'khor lo'i nang du zhugs gyur par/ /bsgom 8zhing 'khor lo bsgrub par bya/ /me yi 'od ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /'khor lo chen po 'phags par 'gyur/ /spyan ni bzlas brjod byed bzhin du/ /bla med 'khor lo blang bar bya/ /rgyal chen 'khor lo drug pa dag /'od ni rnam par snang mdzad 83—395

bzhin / /lan gsum 'jug pa'i sems can la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyural / /mi 'khrugs ②par ni rnam bsgom zhing ①/ /rdo rje mdun du bzhag ④nas ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bskul na 'dis/ /sku gsum rnam par 'phel 'gyur zhing / /'bar ba'i phreng chen mnyam pa'i 'od/ /rdo rje chen po 'phags par 'gyur/ /mā ma tī ni zlos bzhin du/ /rdo rje bla med blang bar bya/ /rdo rje rgyal po blangs pa yis/ /gtso bo rdo rje 'chang gnyis 'gyur/ /gtso bo chen po sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpas (5)yongs bskor nas/ /sems can kun sems la gnas pa'i/ /lag na rdo rje rdo rje 'chang / /'jig rten khams su rnam rgyu zhing / /kun gyi bsam pa yongs rdzogs byed/ /rin chen 'byung ba bsgoms yin ni/ /rin po che ni mdun bzhag ste/ /sbyor ba'i rim pas rnam spel na/ /rin chen chen po 'phags par 'gyur/ /rin chen sgrol ma zlos bzhin du/ /'od bzang lagazi brjid 'bar ba can/ /phyogase kun snang bar byed pa yi/ /nor bu'i rgyal po blang bar bya/ /lha rdzas nor bu blangs pa yis/ /rin chen 'byung ba gnyis par 'gyur/ /de ni (9sems can thams cad kyi/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen bzhin/ /rin chen char pa rab 'bebs shing / /sems can kun gyi dbul ba 'joms/ /gtso bo yid bzhin nor bu can/ /sangs rgyas zhing du rnam par rgyu/ /'od dpag med par rnam bsgoms nas/ /pad+ma chen po mdun 99)bzhag ste/ /rim bzhin gzi brjid gzengs bstod yin/ /'dab ma bye bas rnam brgyan pa/ /'od bzang 1nyagaser ltar 'bar ba can/ /pad+ma chen po 'phags par yina'agyur/ /gos dkar can ma'i gsang sngags kyis/ /yid las byung ba'i pad+ma blang / /pad+ma'i rgyal po blangs pa yis/ /'od dpag 83—396

med pa gnyis par 'gyur/ /chos mdzad rnams kyis ①thog 'dren cing / /sems can rnams la bdud rtsi stsol②/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams ①snang byed gtso/ /bde ba can gyi rgyan du 'gyur④/ /don yod grub pa rnam bsgoms dunas/ /ral gri mdun rjodu rnam bzhag ste/ /rnal 'byor rim pa 'di yis ni/ /bsgom ⑦pa de nyid kyis bskul na/ /rdo rje 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od/ /ral gri chen po 'phags par 'gyur/ /sgrol ma'i gsang sngags zlos bzhin du/ /ral gri bla med blang bar ⑧bya/ /de ⑨nas ⑩ral gri mchog blangs nas/ /don yod grub pa gnyis par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas zhing du rnam rgyu zhing / /sems can rnams kyi ⑩mi shes gcodakyi/ /rtag tu dri med snang gyur 8te/ /chu yi nang gi ston zla bzhin/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub bstan ④nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgrub par bya/ /rnal 'byor che la rnam gnas pa/ /de bzhin gshegs kyi 8btsun mo che/ /zhe sdang rigs ni 'dren mdzad ma/ /rdo rje gdan can mā ma tī/ /rin chen 'byung ba'i lha mo dang / /lha mo 'gro ba dbang mdzad ma/ /mkha' la longs spyod spyod mdzad ma / /rim pa bzhin du nga yis bshad/ /de nas bu mo mig yangs ma/ /lo ni bcu drug lon pa la/ /gzugs dang mdangs dang lang tshor ldan/ /gser gyi rna cha g.yo ba can/ /gcig cig yibasgrims te btsal nas su/ /lha mo byi dor legs byas te/ /rigs lnga yi ni tshogs can ma/ /las kyi rjes su bsgoms byas nas / /bzhag ste 4)sprad pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /pad+ma la ni rdo rje gzhag(3 /sprad pa dang ni 'khyud (7pa yis/ /rdo rje dang ni pad+ma bskul/ /gar gyi tshul du gyur pa dang —/ /de bzhin spro dang bsdu ba yi( bye/ /mod la sgyu ma'i dregs zhu)myos nas/ /rdo rje las ni bdud rtsi 'byung / /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i shes rab las/ /pad+ma la 83—397

gnas bdud rtsi btung / /rnal 'byor ldan pa'i kha yis ni/ / 'thungs pas ①de bzhin gshegs lnga yikhya/ /sku ni yongs su 'gyur ba ①'thob/ /nam mkha' 'dra ba'i chos kun la/ /thabs dang shes rab rnam par 'phel/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku yi snying po sgrub ④pa ste/ /'dod lnga'i ⑤yon tan rjes 'jug pa'i/ /byang chub bde bas bsgrubs na ni/ /rdo rje pad+ma byin brlabs yinas/ /rjes su chags pas 'thob par 'gyur/ /grub chen gsang ba'i dngos grub ni/ /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba'i thabs/ /rjes su chags pas bde ba yig/ /rdo rje theg pas mnyes ⑧par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba'i khyad par 'di yis ni/ /lan gsum 'jug pa'i gsang sngags dang / /lam yo)gyi phyag rgya ngas bshad doyi/ /de dag lag pa'i phyag rgya dag /ye shes phyag rgya rab bskul bas / /dam tshig mchog gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /thub chen sna tshogs gzugs mnga' ba/ /sna tshogs phrin tu〉las mdzad par 'gyur/ /de nas phyag na rdo rje tsokhams gsum gyi dam tshig gi 'khor lo 'di nyid kyi rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang ()/thugs las phyung ngo / /sa ni spyan du brjod pa ste/ /chu khams mā ma tī ⑨zhes bshad / /sgrol ma rlung zhes kun tu brjod/ /gos dkar can ma me ru bsgragasa'i / /rdo rje dam tshig nam mkha'i dbyings/ /ston pa rdo rje 'chang bas yibashad / /ces de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sa'i dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' chen pos gsungs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i de bzhin gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 83—398

thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas nas cang mi gsung bar ①gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs gsang ba 'dus par dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis ci ltar blta (mibar bgyi ①lags/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyis 'di ni rdo rje'i byang chub kyi sems su blta bar bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems dang ④rdo rje slob dpon 'di gnyis gnyis su byar med pa'i phyir zhes bya ba'i bar nas rigs kyi bu mdor (ge bsdus nas yang bshad par bya'o/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs shing gzhes ⑥pa'i bar de dag thams cad dus gsum du byon nas/ slob dpon la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis stimachod pas mngon par mchod nas 'di skad ces bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha yin no/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ma yin no/ /bdag cag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ston pa yin no / /zhes rdo rje'i yi ge gsum phyung (nyenas 3)slar yang rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu dper na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bar de dag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bsod nams kyi phung po bas ni rdo rje slob dpon de'i spu'i khung bu gcig gi bsod nams kyi phung po ches tsokhyad par 83—399

du 'phags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas thams cad hu)kyi ye shes kyi ②snying por gyur pa'i bar nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi 'byung gnas yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa 'jigs shing skrag pa'i ①yid kyis cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa dang / rin chen 'byung gnas skyidang / don yod grub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad rnams rdo rje 'chang thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi dam tshig la dmigs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la bos nas shes ldan byang chub sems dpa' thams cad nyon cig /phyogs bcu dus gsum du byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams (5)rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du byon nas mchod par mdzad cing phyag 'tshal bar brjod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ston pa yin pa dang / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang de nyid ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi dngos grub gang la gnas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje'i sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba gsum ni rdo rje 907slob dpon gyi lus dang ngag dang yid la gnas so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gsol pa/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus dang ngag dang 83—400

sems kyi ①gsang ba gang la gnas/ nam ②mkha' la gnas so / /nam mkha' gang la gnas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sems la gnas sodu/ /sems gang la gnas / gang du yang ma yin no/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ngo mtshar du gyur nas cang mi zer bar 'khod do/ /dkyil 'khor dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin dang / phyag rgya dang / stang stabs dang / 'dug stangs phyidang / bzlas brjod dang / sbyin sreg ⑥dang / mchod pa dang las la sbyar ba dang slar bsdu ba rnams ni gsang sngags kyi tshul de kho na nyid bcu yin par gsungs so/ /dus gsum du 'byung ba'i rgyal ba thugs rje'i ro gcig pa rnams kyi gsang ba dang / gsang chen dang / ye shes rnam pa gsum gyi snying po bstan pa dag ni slob dpon gyi kha (penas bla ma la gus pa'i slob mas shes par bya'o / /bla mas dam tshig ci ltar (kyelta ba bzhin gyi dbang du byas nas bshad par bya'o / /bsgrims stinas sems can rnams la rnal 'byor dang / rnal 'byor chen po dang / lhag pa'i rnal 'byor rnams go rims ⑩bzhin bshad par bya'o/ /'di mtha' dag ni rgyud thams cad kyi (nyespyir shes par bya'o/ /de kho na nyid kyi dngos po mtha' dag yongs su mi shes par gsang sngags smra ba nga yin no zhes mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis gsang sngags kyi cho ga 'chad par byed na dam tshig thams cad nyams ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig las nyams na bdud kyis gzung (nyebar 'gyur ro/ /skyes bu shi nas dmyal ba'i gnas mi bzod yipa chen por 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /sems can rnams la snyibarten yite byang chub thob par 'gyur bas sems can la bslu bar mi bya'o/ /zhes shes par byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i lam de nyid la sems can de dag ri nasbyar bar bya'o/ /gang zhig 'di la 83—401

'dod pa yin/ /sna tshogs rdo rje 6)'jigs rung ba/ /nam mkha' rdo rje'i dkyil du bsam/ /de dkyil bzhugs pa ②gshin rje'i gshed/ /gnag (micing 'bar ba bsgom par bya/ /shar du gti mug rdo rje ste/ /lho ru de bzhin phra ma yin / /nub tu 'dod chags rdo rje ste/ /de bzhin byang du phrag dog go/ /mtshams kyi rdo rje rtse bzhi la/ /tsartsi kā ④sogs rnam par bsgom⑤/ /sgo yi rdo rje rtse ⑥bzhi la( )/ /tho ba la sogs rnam par bsgom(kye/ /sna tshogs rdo rje'i mtshams bzhi ru/ /mi yi mgo bo bzhi dag go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gshin rje'i gshed po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas zhe sdang chen po'i rigs kyi sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ dzi)tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos gti mug rdo rje chen po'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ dzi na jokayi /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos phra ma rdo rje'i sngags gsungs pa/ /oṃ rat+na :ka(nya /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos 'dod chags rdo rje'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ ā 4 ro smikaXsnye /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos phrag dog rdo rje'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ pradz+nyā :ka'o /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje tho ba'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ munar :ka8 /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje dbyug pa'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa :ka8 /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje pad+ma'i 83—431

sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ pad+ma :ka0) /de nas bcom ldan 'das ②de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje ral gri'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ khan :ka(gyi /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje tsartsi kā'i ④sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ mo ha ra ti/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje phag mo'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ de ṣa ra ti/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ rā ga ra ti/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos rdo rje gi rī ma'i sngags gsungs pa(5)/ oṃ badz+ra ra ti/ de nas (7de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos 9)sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab ( pa'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko35)ho/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa yiṅgā ba ād+ma ko3rta(me/ oṃ sarba ta bī ga ta tsit+ta ⑫badz+ra swa bhā 1 ba ād+ma ko3rta0)/ de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag pos 7zhe sdang chen po'i asku nges par bstan pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug khros pa la/ /in+d+ra nī la 'dra ba'i mdog /phyag na rdo rje bsnams pa nyid/ /gshin rje'i gshed ni bsgom par bya/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhi ba la/ /gsal ba'i gzugs nyi dang 'dra ba'i 'od/ /phyage na 'khor lo bsnams pa nyid/ /gti mug rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /zhal gsum phyag drug rgyas gyur pa/ /gser gyi rnam pa'i 'od dang ldan/ /phyag na rin chen yi bsnams pa nyid / /phra ma rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dbang byed pa/ /pad+ma rā ga mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa nyid/ /'dod 83—432

chags rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /zhal gsum phyag drug thams cad la/ /rin chen margad 1'od dang ldan/ /phyag na shubs can bsnams pa nyid/ / phrag dog ②rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las mngon par rtogs pa'i rim par phye ba ste le'u dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' chen po la bstod pa/ gshin ③rje'i gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /gti mug rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin / /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po rab 'jigs pa'i ge / /phra ma rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /rdo rje thugs dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje rin chen phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i ngo bo khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po rab 'jigs pa/ /rdo rje gsung dang rab mtshungs pa/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog ngo bo'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje'i gshed po las kun pa/ /rdo rje chags dang rab tu mtshungs/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos po khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pas/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gtso bo'i (5)gtso/ /dkyil 'khor gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje mig dang / rdo rje rna ba dang /(phyin rdo rje sna 5gedang —/ rdo rje lce dang / rdo rje lus dang / rdo rje thugs zhes bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa ni mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /'dod pa'i don grub sgrub narabyed pa'i/ /gshin rje'i gshed 83—433

yi / /'jigs pa'i gshin rje 'joms dkyil 'khor/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ /mgon po dkyil 'khor bri bar mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin chen pos nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rnams las bdud rtsi myang ba'i cho ga nges par phyung ba/ oṃ āḥrgyu/ rdo rje me lce sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje can kun mnyes pa dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs/ /ye shes 'byung gnas ngo bo nyid/ /dgug pa dang ni gzhug pa dang / /bcing dang de bzhin dbang bya nyid/ /tho ba la sogs 0)sngags bzhi yis/ /mnyam par bzhag (rinasapas rnam par bsgom / /ma he rdo rje rnam bsgoms la/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnam bsgom bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /gti mug rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /rta bdun ldan pa'i dbus gnas pa/ /phra ma zhes bya rnam bsam ④bya/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa'i dbus gnas pa/ /'dod chags rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas pa/ /rdo rje las ni bsgom (ripar bya/ /zhi ba'i gti mug rdo rje ste/ /rgyas pa de bzhin phra ma yin/ /'dod chags rdo rje dbang du byas/ /rdo rje las kyis thams cad du'o/ /rdo rje las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /mi tshil mi yi thod par bzhag(6) /de bzhin mi spas sdong bu bya/ /dur khrod dag tu du ba bsgrub/ /mig sman dag ni de bzhin du/ /mig sman las kyi bsgom ( pa dang / /las kyi (8)bzlas pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /mig sman 'di ni 'grub 59)par 'gyur/ /khrag dang gur gum gzung 7byas nas/ /sgrub pa byug pa bsgrub par bya/ /las kyi rdo rje sbyor ba yis/ /rkang mgyogs dag ni thena'agrub par 'gyur/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni mnyam pa la/ /sha lnga dang ni ldan pa yis/ /lcags gsum du ni bcug byas na/ /las kyi sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur/ /83—435

dkar pos dus gsum gtor/ /gshin rje mthar byed chu shel 'drar/ /bdag nyid bsgoms nas mdun bkod la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas nas/ /bsgrub bya bltas nas dbang bskur bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis gang ba yime/ /bum pa dkar po (bzla ba 'dras/ /rdzogs sangs du mas khrus byas te/ /bltas nas sngags kyi bzlas pa brtsam/ /oṃ na maḥtrīḥni:ཿ wi kṛ ④tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa (gede ba dat+ta ya shān+ti ku ru na maḥ(6)swā hā/ zhi ba'i cho ga gsungs pa'o/ /skyes pa zhi la ⑦kur kum (nyegyis/ /bri bya de bzhin rgyas pa yang / /'khor lo gnyis ni kha che yi / /swā hās ming ni brgyan 6)pa yi/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni bris byas la mar dang sbrang rtsis bkang nas ni/ /kham phor kha sbyar nang du gzhugatso /skud pa ser pos (stebacings nas ni/ /me tog ser po dus gsum gtor/ /byang du kha bltas mdog ser ba'i/ /gshin rje'i gshed du bdag nyid bsam/ /bsgrub bya zla ba ser nag la/ /bum pa ser pos bkru yigebya zhing / /dbang bskur ba ni bsgom ( byas la/ /spros la rgyas pa'i bzlas pa bya/ /o hrīḥdhīḥ wi kṛ yitā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de ba dat+ta puṣ+ṭi 7ku ru swā hā/ o hrīḥyiji wi kṛ rme 7tā na na rtsu r+ghaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bo ṣa ṭa de ba dat+ta su puṣ+ṭi 5)ku ru bo ṣa ṭa swā hā/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyas pa'i cho ga gsungs / pa'o/ /gro ga'am ras la rgya skyegs kyis / /khu ba'am tsan+dan dmar po 'am/ /srin lag gi ni khrag kyang rung / /yi ge hoḥ( nyayis brten ru pa yi/ /'khor lo gnyis ni mnyam par bri/ /'khor lo nag po sogs bral ba'i/ /kham phor gnyis ni kha sbyar du/ /mar dang sbrang rtsis ( nyebakang ba gzhag ri /skud pa dmar pos bcings byas la/ /nub phyogs su ni kha bltas nas/ /me tog dmar pos mchod par bya ge/ /bdag nyid gshin rje 83—437
