par zhugs te/ rdo rje phag mo'i chang ①'gugs pa'i sngags gsungs pa/ /oṃ badz+ra sto ṇi su gho ṇi ②badz+ra mā ma tī bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra/ tre+e dhā tu kārul/ā ④kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdu/ rdza mkhan lag pa phyis pa'i sas/ /bum pa kha mdzes nyer byas la/ /rkun ma'i skra ⑥ni rten bzhag ste/ /sngags ni rjes su dran par bya/ /sngags 'di che ba'i bdag nyid 'di/ /ba ta mchod rten dag tu bstan/ /dal gyis dmigs nas 'bad par bya/ /chang ni 'gugs par rab tu grags/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig chen po'i gshin rje'i gshed rdo rje shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā bad+dha ni dzā la dzā la me dhā ⑦bad+dha ni / dhi ri rnyi ri/ budhi bad+dha ni swā hā/ tshes kyi dang po nas bzung ste/ /kun tu zla ba nya yi bar/ /sbyar ba'i skad ni smra bar bya/ /ji srid zla ba'i rjes 'jug (snyepas / /rtag tu tshigs bcad brgya zin 'ab/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub par 'gyur / /khams gsum ma lus pa dag ni/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'grub/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed rdo rjes khu ba 'gugs pa zhes bya ba'i porating nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ khu ba 'gugs par byed pa'i gi rī'i ོsngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ā mar+sha ṇi ā /1kar+ṣa ṇi gi rī hrīḥduṣ+ṭa ya/ duṣ+ṭa tsho ya/shu kra ma/ ā 8kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥtso( hūṃ hūṃ tsheswā hā/ pad+ma kha dang rdo rje dang / /dril bu lcags kyu'i rlung sbyor gyis/ /bzlas dang bsgom 8pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /khu ba'i tshogs ni 'gugs par byed/ /nags kyi nang ngam dben pa ru/ /las 'di dag ni bskul byas nas/ /nub bdun tsam du sbyor ba yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed 83—447

chen po/ rdo rje nag po 'jigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas dbang bskur ba mchog gi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams las phyung bar mdzad do/ /u dum bā ①ra man dā ra/ /pa ri dza ta ka phreng dang / / kur ṇi ②ka yi phreng ba ni/ /bu khyod zung ③la byin gyis rlob④/ /ral gri chen po ⑤khams gsum pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /'byung po thams cad 'gugs par byed/ /las kyi ral gri dam pa 'di/ /bzung 6)na bdud las rgyal bar 'gyur/ /shes rab thabs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rdo rje dril bu bsgrubs ⑦pa 'di/ /long ⑧la slob ma yang dag zung / /btung ⑨ba rin po che 'dis ni/ /rdo rje lus ni rab tu sgrubayi/ /kun tu ye shes bu khyod kyis / / 'thung shig 7ye shes las byung ba/ /slob ma'i khar yang blug 8bya ba/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyis bsgrags tu pa yin/ /rdo rje slob ma bdag nyid ches/ /shin tu dga' ba'i sems su bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cadakyikyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las dgug 8pa la sogs pa'i sbyor ba'i ⑫rim par phye ba ste bdun pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /srung 7ba'i 'khor lo sbyor bar byed/ /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa dang / /gdug pa can dag bsal dzinaphyir gsungs / /dpal ldan ral gri 'chang ba'i bdag /sung (nyaba'i 'khor lo sbyor bar byed/ /ral gri 'bar ba'i bdag nyid kyis/ /rig pa gsum las mchod par byed/ /sems can thams cad skyob pa yi/ / spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /47lha mo khyod ni dpang 6)du gyur(1/ /83—448

gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /slob dpon bdag tshigis dkyil 'khor bri / /gos kyis ②gdong ni bcings byas la/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni mdun skor bzhagazhu /khyod su zhes kyang 'di skad dri/ /skal bzang bdag ces tshig tu brjod / /gsol btab pa yi ①blo bzang ⑤la/ /yol ba'i nang du sbyin par bya/ /dbang bskur don du gus chen pos/ /de nas lan gsum ched du brjod/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos chen pos/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag kyang mgon pos dbang bskur zhing / /mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol / /de bzhin glu dang rol mos mchod/ /de bzhin khrus dang byug pas kyang —/ /slob ma dang bas 0blug par bya/ / de la bstod pa ⑦kun kyang bya/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal pos stong ⑧pa'i sngags gsungs pa/ oṃ shu n+ya tā ②dz+nyā na badz+ra kyiswa bhā wa 0ād+ma ko37rta/ oṃ pū dza tsobadz+ra swa bhā ba āt+pa ko37lha/ oṃ dharma dhā 8tu badz+ra swa bhā ba yi.ād+ma ko3 ⑩lha/ zhi ba la sogs dbye ba yi(nye/ /sbyin sreg ⑩de nas bshad par bya/ /sbyin sreg 6 )gang gis grub pa yi/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub 0pa/ /zhi ba zhi ba'i sems kyis te/ /rgyas pa rgyas pa'i sems kyis so/ /dbang yang der gtang sems kyis te/ /bsad ( nyedang bskrad pa la yang (nyengo / /zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor zlum po nunyeste/ /rgyas pa yi ni rdzing bu 'dra / /dbang du bya ba zla gam ltar(na/ /nam mkha'i khams 'dra bas ni bsadas//zhi ba khru gang tshad du ste/ /de bzhin rgyas pa'i khru ( nyedo pa/ /ji ltar rgyas pa de ltar dbang / /bsad ni pa la ni sor nyi shu/ /zhi ba steng du khru phyed tshad/ /rgyas pa la ni khru tsam ste/ /sor lnga gnyis ni bsad (7pa la/ /dbang la ji ltar de bzhin dgug /tshes gcig ru la ni zhi ba bya/ /zla ba nya la rgyas pa ste/ /bcu 83—449

bzhi la ni mngon spyod do/ /dbang gi las 0)ni tshes brgyad la'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las sbyin sreg ②gi cho ga rim par phye ba ste brgyad pa'o// //rgya mtsho'i sa ni blangs nibyas la/ /klu yi gzugs gcig stibartsams byas te/ /yi ge hūm̐ phuḥ(5)snying gar (nyuni/ /hrīḥcistiḥl sogs bzlas pa bya/ /char ni mi 'bab dus dag tu/ /bzlas pa khri byas 'bab par 'gyur/ /sbrul nag po yi ⑧sha dang ni/ /nim pa'i lo ma dang bsres la/ /de la ril bu 6)byas nas ni/ /brtul zhugs can gyis 7rgya mtshor gzhug /sngags 61kyi bzlas pa khri byas na/ /mtsho rlabs rengs byed mchog yin no/ /tsan+dan 1nya'abras bu brgya blangs la/ /'bras dang mar shas bsres byas te/ /'bum phrag brgya ni rab bzlas la/ /sbyin sreg tunyebyas na lha mthong 'gyur/ /dur khrod ro bsregs yog pa'i shing / /brtul zhugs can gyi yigazugs su bri/ /smyon yipa'i khu bas bsku tsobyas la/ /sngags khri bzlas pas mdzes thebs 7'gyur/ /grub pa'i yungs kur ()blangs byas la677/ /'bum phrag bzhi ni bzlas byas na/ /sbrul gyis bzung nas 'gyel ba la/ /gtor na 'tsho bar the tshom med/ / ri gshong ( nyachu yi sa blangs la/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa 'bum byas nas/ /mgo la bskus pa tsam gyis ni/ /mgo yi 6stend ni nyams par byed/ /sngags ni lan bdun mngon bzlas pa'i/ /lag pas mgo bo mnyes na gi ni/ /mgo ni zug (nyagazer 'byung mi 'gyur/ /de ni 'di ltar the tshom ( med / /bram ze yi ni sha dag la/ /dur khrod sa dang thal ba las/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs byas te/ /phyag gnyis zhal ni gcig pa la/ /rdo rje chen po 83—450

g.yas pa na/ /de bzhin mi mgo g.yon pa na'o/ /mdog ni dkar po cher 'jigs pa/ /de yis gdug pa 'joms par byed/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang 517sha lnga yis / /nyin re bzhin du gtor ma sbyin/ /bdag gi dgra bo choms (9shig ces/ /rnal 'byor pas bdag gsol ba gdab/ /nub mo de skad brjod pas nyal/ /dgra ni tho rangs ①'chi bar 'gyur/ /chu 'gags ④la sogs pas gzir zhing / /yang na nad kyis thebs par 'gyur/ /dgra (9yi be+e ro tsa na blang / /mi yi rkang sbubs yongs bkang ⑥ste/ /rab tu bkang nas 'bum bzlas na/ /shing rtser rgyu ba'i yi dgas ( )mtshungs/ /lha rdzas dngos grub kun byed cing / /dgos pa sna tshogs rab sgrub (kyebo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung 5)thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las 'jigs byed gshin rje'i gshed ces bya ba'i rim par phye ba ste dgu pa'o// //ro langs chen po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /sgrub pa bzang po kun byed cing / /dgos ⑩pa sna tshogs rab sgrub pa'o/spre /bzang po ma god rma med pa/ge/ /shing la sbyangs pas bsdus byas la /phab la legs par bkru bya ste/ /der 'dug sngags bzlas brtul zhugs yi can/ /e ma'o ngo mtshar sngags kyi mthu/ /bsam pa med pa'i tso'o dod 'bod/ /gshin rje'i rnal 'byor ldan pa yi/ /yid kyis cung zad 'jigs mi bya/ /rnal 'byor lam ni gang 'dod pa/ /de kun thams cad ster bar byed/ /ma he dang ni ku be ra/ /stag dang de las gzhan pa dang / /dom dang spre'u dag la tsheni/ /khyi dag gi ni khyad par dang / /dug dang ske tshe tshwa dang tsheni/ /de bzhin tshwa nyu gsum 83—451

so bañdza/ /'di dag legs par sbyar gzugs bya/ /gshin rje'i gshed po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /de la rnal 'byor pas gsol gdab/ /hrīḥ༅jiḥl sogs sngags kyis ni/ /che ge mo de bdag la 465/ / de yi ②pha yis ster bar byedam/ /gal te rnal 'byor pa ma phyin / /rmi lam gshin rje'i gshed brdeg ④cing ske/ /lho ⑤yi phyogs su khyer mthong nas⑥/ /sad na de yi ⑦pa yis steraphyi/ /zhal gsum phyag drug 'jigs pa la/ /in+d+ra nī la 6)'dra ba'i mdog /tho ba ⑩'dzin pa'i brtul zhugs can/ /phyag tu tho ba dgod par bya/ /zhal gsum phyag drug khros pa la/ /mdog dmar po ste khros par (nya'ajigs/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /mkhas pas phyag tu dbyig pa dgod/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dmar ba tsol/ /'jigs pa chen po bsdigs pa yi(nye/ /phyag na pad+ma dmar po bsnams/ /pad+ma zhes bya mamakhas pas bsgoms/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ljang gu ⑩ste/ /phyag na ral gri bsnams pa yi/ /las kun byed par gyur pa'ol/ /ral gri zhes bya rnam bsgom yo 7bya/ /bha gar ling (nyag rnam bsgom (nyenyid / /dkyil 'khor bdag po rnam par bsgom(lha/ /zhe snang rjes dran rnal 'byor gyis/ /gti mug rjes dran rnam bsgom (nyabya/ /gti mug rjes dran la dmigs nas/ /phra ma rjes dran bsgom par bya/ /phra ma rjes dran rnal 'byor gyis / /'dod chags rjes dran bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags rjes dran rnal 'byor gyis/ /phrag (stedog dran bya brtul zhugs so can/ /so so'i sogerigs kyi sprin rnams ni/ /ba spu'i khung nas spro bar so bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /gtum po'i khro bo ( nyabasgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /lha mo bzhi po rab bsgom bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dun sku 83—452

gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las rjes su dran pa 6)rim par phye ba ste bcu pa'o// //zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro mthong nas/ /zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed gzugs sum/ /bcom ldan gshin rje'i dbang du mdzad/ /zhe snang thams cad zad par byed / /gti mug gis mnan 'gro mthong nas/ /gti mug gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su/ /bcom ldan gshin rje'i dbang mdzad nas(mi/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad/ /'gro ba phra ①mas mnan mthong nas/ / phra ma ④gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su/ /bcom ldan snying rje ⑤can gyis mdzad/ /phra dum thams cad zad par mdzad/ /'dod chags kyis mnan 'gro mthong nas/ /'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su/ /bcom ldan snying rje can mdzad nas / /'dod chags thams cad zad par mdzad/ /phrag dog gis mnan 'gro mthong nas/ /phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed gzugs su/ /bcom ldan snying rje can mdzad nas/ /phrag dog thams cad zad par mdzad/ /byams pa tsartsi kār (legasungs te/ /snying rje de bzhin phag mo'o/ /dbyangs can ma ni dga' ba ste/ /btang snyoms gi dri'i (8)gzugs so/ /bdag nyid dngos po thams cad kyis(9)/ /rdzogs par byas nas dkyil 'khor gyi/ /rnal 'byor snying ga'i kyis bon spro/ /'grub par 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas da yinyeni bshad bya ba/ /spyod pa yi ni mtshan nyid mchog /gshin rje'i gshed po 'jigs gzugs kyis/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs su 'grub/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs su/ /ma he mchog ni bkug la zhon/ /sbrul dag gis ni brgyan par bya/ /lcags 7kyi rdo rje 83—453

gzugs par bya/ /spa yang ser po dag tu bya/ /gyen brdzes yo)pa yi khyad par gyis / /mgo la thod pas yang dag bskor/ /sma ra lkog spu ser por ②bya/ /hrīḥsnriḥl sogs sngags brjod cing / /lcags kyi rdo rje mkha' la gsor/ /rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed sbyor bas/ /seng ge'i sgra yang de la bya/ /nus pa cung zad skyes pa na①/ /rol cing grong du 'jug par bya/ /gar dang bde ba'i cha kun gyisal/ /drug las skyed ④sogs glu blang bya/ /de nas rgyal mtshan khyams (snyemathong na / /der ni 'o ma rab bsgrub bya/ /'o ma la sems gcig skyogoms pas/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub bya/ /phag mo yi ni gzugs bzung stiba'i/ /btsun mo kun la 'khyud pa yis/ /dpa' mo (8)seng ge bzhin du spyad/ /'dod pa'i don kun rab tu 'grub/ /de nas da 6)ni bshad bya bayi/ /phyag rgya ma ni rab sgrub (1thabs/ /gsang sngags chen po yi ge gcig /de yi bzlas pa mngon bshad bya/ /yi ge hrīḥtsolas byung ba yiyige/ /ma he yang dag bsgom 8bya ste/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /ma he steng du bsgom par bya/ /gang yang cung zad gcod cing 'bigs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs gzugs de ni/ /ma he sna tshogs bsgrub 7pa yi/ /blo dang ldan pa'i phyag na bsnams/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dbyig pa gshin rje'i gshed sgrub 4thabs/ /yi ge hrīḥ6)ni gsang sngags che/ /ma he chen po la bcibs yo pa/ /phyag yi7ni 'bum phrag rdzogs pa'i phyag /sku ni mi ro'i thal bas bskus/ /ri rab dang ni mnyam pa'i lus/ /gser gyi sa gzhi ( rmethug par mnan/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bye ba'i phyag can sgrub 37pa'i thabs/ /yi ge hūṃ las byung ba'i gtso/ /wi kṛ tā (gyen gsang sngags che/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa 2 /ha hā hi tī hu hū 83wa 454

he hai ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa ①su hā/ dgos pa thams cad bsgrub (snyepa yi/ /dam tshig sgrub ②thabs bshad par bya/ /sngags kyis dub pas kha zas bza'/ /ngan pa dang bral rnyed ④dka' min/ /sha chen dang ni rta dang ni/ /glang po che yi khyad par dang / /ba lang (gegi dang khyi dang ni/ /bong bu rnga mo ce yispyang ngo / /sngon po dang ni bsres pa yi/ /snum chen gyis ni lus byugs na/ /lus la byugs pa tsam gyis ni/ /'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'gyur/ /snang mdzad si du ba ra dang ske/ /de bzhin bil ba'i lo ma dang / /so phag phye ma bsres pa dang / /gser shing lo ma'i khu ba rnams/ /'di yis dril phyis byas gyur na/ /khams gsum po ni dbang du 'gyur/ /dug dang chu bur de bzhin mdze/ /dril phyis byas pas nyams par byed/ /gci ba chen po btung bar bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi de bzhin du/ /'di ni rnal 'byor mchog gtso bo/ /rang 'byung ( me tog btung ba bzhin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las spyod pa ston pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud rim par phye ba ste ⑧bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i dam tshig rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo tsartsi kā'i 5)rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang tsosnyoms par zhugs shing / phag mo'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang yistesnyoms par zhugs so'i/ /dbyangs can gyi rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la yang snyoms par zhugs so(ge/ /gi rī ma'i 8rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 7snyoms par zhugs te/ mchod pa'i glu 'di dag rjod rdzipar mdzad do/ /a 9kye kye gshin rje'i gshed nag bla nye/ /srin po'i gzugs can 83—455

rang bzhin khyod/ /bdag gis khyod mthong shin tu 'jigs/ / khro ba'i ①rang bzhin 'di thong mdzod/ /mtho ris sa stengs sa 'og bcas/ /khyod kyi gar gyis g.yos par mdzad/ /añdza phyinag po bcag 'dra ba'i/ /khro khyod ro langs zhi gar ①mdzod/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul zhing / /mdangs nag tshad ni thung ba la/ /bde chen ngo bo khro ④gar gyis/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma gsol 'debs⑤ / /trīḥjiḥsngags dang gar gyis khyod/ /srid pa yigasum gyi 'khrul pa chod / /snying rje khros pa'i ngang sgrol ⑦gar/ /'gro bas dad ni ⑧ngo mtshar 'gyur//de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bzlas pa yi ni mtshan nyid mchog /bzlas pa gang zhig rab bzlas na/ /dngos grub yangs pa thob pa ni/ /myur bar ⑨ma yin dal bar min/ /ring du ma yin thung du min/ /sngags ni cung zad thos par bzlas/ /gshin rje slob dpon mi mchog gi/ /ma he mi dang so gnyis dang —/ /ba lang dang ni rta dag ⑩dang / /bong bu rnga mo'i rus pa las/ /bzlas pa'i phreng ba rab bsgrub bya/ /zla ngo gcig gi bcu bzhi la/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /sha lnga dag ni bsdu (nyabyas nas/ /bzlas na dngos grub 'grub pa'i mchog / ril bu yidag ni so so la/ /rnal 'byor pa yis gshin gshed bsgomayi/ /mkhas pas ni yang mi mgo ste/ /khrag gis bkang ba'i mgo bsgom bya/ /khri tsam gyis ni 'byung po rnams/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams 8stong phrag gisali/ /bdud dang yi dgas tshogs kyang 'chili/ /gshin ⑩gshed rdo rje'i sbyor ba yis/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid 'bum bzlas nas/ /des ni (shelas kun byed pa yin/ /bye ba bzlas nas 9)dngos grub ster/ /bye ba lnga bzlas smos ci dgos / /nyin re'am ( rteyang na zla 87re 'am/ /de bzhin lo ni re re la( ge/ /83—456

gtor ma drug cu ①ma bzhi sbyin/ /dbyug gu drug cu ②rtsa bzhir shes/ /rtag tu cung zad ci za dang / /de bzhin cung zad 'thung ba dang / /gzhan yang bza' ba thams cad kyi/ /phud ni gshin rje'i gshed la dbul/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bla ma la ni yon dbul ba'o/ /las ni thams cad bsgrub ②pa dang / /bdag nyid zhi bar bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul ba dang / /rta dang ba dang ༷glang po dang / /gser dang de las gzhan pa dang / /rang gi chung ma de bzhin bu/ /ma dang sring mo tsha mo dang / /de bzhin du ni spun zla dang ske/ /na bza' sna tshogs dag dang ni/ /gdugs dang rdul yab ⑤mdzes pa dang ske/ /khyim dang gdan dang dri zhim dang / /de bzhin glu dang rol mo dang / /ral gri dang ni rgyan dag dang / /brtul 6)zhugs can gyis bla mar ⑦dbul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las nye bar mkho (kyeba'i las kyi khyad par thams cad 5༄zhes bya ste rim par phye ba ⑩bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdig pa dag ni ji snyed pa/ /de dag gcod pa'i gri gug ste/ /zhe sdang gcod pa'i shubs can no/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /ring ba'i thos /nyapa bsgrub 5)pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sgrub thabs/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi tu dbus gtogs par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog bsam 8bya/ /gnas der rtse lnga pa yang bsgoma'i/ /de yi steng du gnas dgod bya/ /mthing mdog nag po 'jigs tshul la/ /phyag drug 'jigs su rung ba ste/ /phyag na rdo rje rnam bsgom bya/ /phyag gzhan dag la gzhan dag 83—457

dgod / /shar du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug gti mug rdo rje mtshungs / /lag na 'khor lo 'jigs par byed/ /bsgom bya sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug phra ma dang mtshungs ①pa/ /phyag na rin chen rab 'bar ba/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /nub tu pad+ma'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug pad+ma 'dzin pa'o/ /byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /ral gri 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor rim (9pa'o/ /me sril sogs pa mtshams 6)bzhi ru/ /lha mo bsgom bya brtul (5)zhugs can/ / lā gye mā (7le de bzhin gar( )/ /glu ma yi ni khyad par ro/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis(nya /der ni sgo skyong bsgom 6)par bya/ /tho ba dbyig pa dang 7pad+ma/ /de bzhin gzhan ni ral gri'o⑩/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nidhi/oṃ pad+ma 87 ki nī/ oṃ nas 87 ki nī/ lo rna gi mi/ mtshams su'o/ /oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥ7tsha daṇ+ḍa 0rtsu/ oṃ pad+ma baṃ/ oṃ khaṅga hoḥ(rte/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can gyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa'o/ /ring po'i thos pa bsgrub lhoshedon du/ /rdo rje mkha' 17'gro ma bsgom bya/ /der ( — )ni gsang sngags kyi dngos grub 'grub ( nyapar 'gyur te/ oṃ ā ki nyasha tsa ra badz+ra ḍā ki nī swā hā/ de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rdo rje sa 'og sgrub thabs so/ /sa 'og rnam par bsgrub don du/ /gnod mdzes rdo rje bsgom ( nyapar cibya/ /phyag drug mdog sngon /'jigs pa yi/ /phyag tu gtun ni shing dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni dkyil dag tu/ /'di ni rab tu dgod par bya/ /shar du spyan ma dgod par bya/ /de bzhin lho sa5ru mā ma tī/ /nub tu lha mo gos dkar mo / /sgrol ma byang gi phyogs su dgod/ /me tog spos dang de bzhin dri/ /mar 83—458

me la 0)sogs mtshams su dgod/ /tho ba la ②sogs sgo drung ste/ /sbrul gyis brgyan ③pa'i ska rags byas/ /las kyi cho ga mthong nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sa 'og sbyor ldan pas/ /rmi lam du ni lam mthong 'gyur / /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /bdun pa'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor te / /mkha' spyod nyid ni rab bsgrub ④phyir/ /rta yi mchog ni rab tu bsgruba'i5)/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /sku mdog ljang gu ⑥'jigs par byed/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du gzhag⑦ /rta yi gdong ③pa rab mdzes pas/ /g.yas pa srad 6)bu khu tshur bcas/ /phyag g.yon pa ni thod pa'o/ /oṃ sum̐ sum̐ sum̐ hi hi gyi7/gsang sngags hunye'adi ni mkhas pas ⑩bzla/ /rta yi mchog tu gyur par grags/ /shar du ba ḍa dzi bsgom 7bya/ /lho phyogs su ni rim gro ma/ /nub tu bdun pa'i rgyal po ste/ / rta mchog ma ni byang phyogs dgod/ /tsobadag po'i zhal phyag 'ji lta bar/ /thams cad de dang 'dra bar bsgom/ /sngags tso'adi yis ni thams cad du/ /gshegs su gsol bar nyu tshorab tu grags/ /smyug (sema'i 4gling bu pi bang (nadang ske/ /rnga zlum rnga bran mtshams su gzhag /ban glang khri )sna dang glang po'i sna/ /de bzhin gdong bzang 'chagadong ngan te/ /gtun shing dang ni sta re zhunadang / /lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa dang / /gar la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /sgo bzhi ru ni rtag tu bsgoms / /sngo chags g.yon par sanabasgom zhunyepar bya/ /rang gi phyag mtshan de bzhin g.yas/ /ji ltar rta mchog sngags kyis ni/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi yang gter/ /rta mchog rnal ri 4'byor nyid kyis ni/ /khams gsum nam mkha'i khams su 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las dngos grub nges par bstan pa ste rim par 83—459

phye ba bcu gsum pa'o// //de la 'di ni srad bu brkyang ba'i ①dam tshig gi mchog ste/ ②a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tsā āṅgā nud pan na twadage/ dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed bsgoms dul / /slob ⑤ma rnam stisnang mdzad du bsgomag/ /ye shes thig mchog rtse mo rtse/ /shin tu mnyam par (mi bzhag nas btab6)/ /de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen po'i dam tshig mchog⑩ /oṃ āḥrgyu dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur rim par bya de yi sgo yi nyi shu'i tshad/ / ba yi yirnam lnga mnyam byugs pa'i/ /skud pa sangs rgyas kyis rab brtags8/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje chen po gsol ba gdab ⑩pa'i dam tshig go/ /e ma'o dhisangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma'o 8chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /dam tshig de nyid ⑩bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol / /de la 'di ni sa chen po yongs su gzung (1ba'i cho ga ste/ rdo rje sa'i lha mo bkug la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du 'gyur/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /spyod pa yi ni khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la'o4nya/ /sgo ni dkyil 'khor cha brgyad de/ /khyams chen dag ni bor ba la/ /bdag nyid chen pos shes par bya/ /yid du 'ong zhing legs spras yi pa'i/ /mu khyud sgo tsam shes par bri( nya/ /lha yi snam bu'ang de tsam mo/ /rdo rje lha mo ldan pa yis/ /glu (medang rol mo gar yang dgod/ /mchod snam sgo yi phyed nyid de/ /'gram dang ngos kyang de tsam mo/ /do shal se ( stemo do dang ni/ /nyi ma zla ba me tog phreng / /de la gos dang 'phan dag go/ /rtsa ba sa yi thig rgyab tu/ / tshon rtse'i ( stesnam bu de yi phyed / /de la snying po chen po 'dis/ /bdag nyid 'khor lo rnam par dgod/ /83—460

der ni yonyerang gi phyag rgya'ang bsten②/ /dam tshig ye shes gzhug ①pa ste/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor bsgrub par bya/ /shar du dkar po chen po ste/ /lhor ni ser po dang ldan pas/ /nub kyi char ni dmar po'o/ /byang du ljang gu ④dang ldan par / /in+d+ra nī la'i ⑤'od 'dra ba'i/ /dbus kyi char ni yang dag bri/ /de la phyag rgya dgod par bya/ /las kyi cho ga mthong nas ni/ /rtag tu phyag rgya mkha' mnyam pa/ /phyag rgya de nyid rtag tu bri/ /de yi dkyil du rdo rje bri/ /shar du 'khor lo yang dag bri/ /de lta dubu la sogs pa blta/ /phyag ⑦mtshan kun tu zhal dang mtshungs/ /de la 'di yi dgang gzar ni/ /de yi yu ba'i tshad du byani/ /khru gang dang ni ldan par bya/ /de yi dkyil 'khor rtse mo ni/ /sor bzhi po la zlum por bya/ /gting du sor gnyis zab pa la/ /de la sor phyed mchur byas pa'o/ /blugs gzar pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra ba'i/ /kha ni mthe bo'i sto gang la/ /de la sor 6tagacig tsam zab pa/ /rgyud 'di ru ni rab tu bsngagasatso/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs dang / /mtshams med lnga ni byas pa dang / /sems can srog ni gcod pa dang / /nya dang sha ni mngon 7za dang / /chang la mngon par dad pa dang / /chad lta'i brtul tsozhugs 'dzin pa dang / /mngon par dbang ni ma 'baskur sadang / /kun tu 'khyam zhing snyisdom bu yidang / /grong gi ⑩gla mi byed pas kyang / /gshin rje'i gshed rgyud mngon gzhol na/ /nag po'i tshig ni ji lta bar/ /grub par (she'adi la the tshom med/ /de nas byams pa la sogs kyis/ /rdo rje nges pa 'di mthong nas/ /rdo rje byang chub sems dpa' (7kun / /mi smra bar ni sdod par gyurakhri )/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje dbab pa'i cho ga'o/ /'byung bzhi'i sa bon chen po yis/ /'khor lo bzhi ni rab bsgrub bya/ /gnas 83—461

bzhir ①rab tu sbyor ba bsam/ /nam mkha' ②la ni g.yo bar byed/ /rkang pa dag gi 'og tu yo/ /lte bar ro ste snying gar lo / /mgo bo la ni yi ge baṃ/ /yi ge ya ni nag chen po/ /drag la rngam pa rab 'gyur ba'idu/ /gru gsum sreg pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bur dmar/ /rdo rje sa gzhi 'dzin bzod pa'i/ /ser po chen po gru bzhi pa/ /ri rab ri yis mnan pa yiphyi/ /nor 'dzin de ni bsgom par bya/ /dkar po zlum po bsil chen po/ /sprin bzhin du ni char pa 'dzin/ /rgya mtsho du ma chus gang ba'i/ /gangs kyi ri bo ltar bsil ba'i/ /gnas bzhi ru ni sbyor bas na/ /khar ni snang ba mtha' yas te / /slob ma rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /myur ba ru ni 'bebs par byed/ /de la 'di ni spro ba'i yicho ga'o/ /rdo rje chos ni mgon chen po/ /snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che/ /gsungs shig 'dod chags chos chen po/ /dge dang mi dge legs par drig/ /khru gang nas ni brtsams ⑧nas ni/ /ji srid khye ni stong gi bar / /slob ma chen po 'phar khyabar 'gyur/ /de ni dbab pa'i cho ga'o/ /'jigs gzugs ri mo'i mtshan nyid ni/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /sa ni 'jam po blangs ⑩byas la/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bzlas pa bya/ /sran gre'u 7'o ma de bzhin sha /bu ram ⑩tin ni ni la 8sogs/ /snum dang nim pa'i 'o ④ma dang / /na ti de bzhin dza ge saraX/ /dang por ⑩dkar por bri bar ⑩bya / /kha dog gzhan gyis de nas bsgom(nye/ /rdo rgyus dang ni btsag dag las/ /rgya skyegs lta bu'i mdog tu 'gyur/ / yung ba ()de dang rams (gyedag las/ /de bzhin kha dog ljang gur (nya'agyur/ /sngon po dag ()ni rams kyis bya/ /de bzhin du bas nag po'o/ /ldong nyaros kyis (steni ser po ste/ /dmar po de bzhin mtshal du83—462

gyis so/ /de la bil ba'i snying po bzhag① /ha cang nyung dang mang ba min/ /mang ②na nag por 'gyur ba ste/ /nyung dun de bzhin 'thul bar 'gyur/ /gzugs ni khro dang zhi ba'o/ /mtshan nyid dag ni bshad par bya/ /rol ba zhi bar gsungs pa ste/ /khro bo sbom dul thung bar bshad/ /sna ni sor bzhi bya ba ste / /dpral ba kos ko mchu de bzhin/ /mgrin pa 'gram pa de bzhin mtshan/ /sor bzhi dag tu bya ba yin/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi lag pa la/ /gyen du sor ni nyi shu yin / /lag pa rkang pa gdong ji ltar/ /mig ni mthe bong gang tsam ste/ /rna ba gnyis la sor gnyis bsgrags/ /'bras bu gnyis la de bzhin bzhi/ /mchu ni sor gnyis bsdoms dupa'o/ /lte ba ⑥sor gcig zab pa yin/ /lus ni mgrin pa bor ba yi/ /gdong ni gsum ⑦'gyur lus la dgod/ /ral pa cod pan de yi tshad/ /rin chen cod pan sor drug pa'o/ /ral pa gcig ma rab sgrub thabs / /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gnod sbyin mo ni sgrub ⑧'dod pas/ /ral pa gcig ⑨ma rab sgrub thabs/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig ste/ /gri gug dang ni thod pa la/ /shin tu sbom la mdog sngo ba/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su bsgom par bya/ /dzam+bha la ni shar du bsgom/ /ba 0su dha ra lho phyogs su/ /chu dbang nub tu dgod par bya/ /byang du rna cha kos 0ko 'phyang / /me la sogs pa'i mtshams dag tu/ /gnod sbyin mo bzhi rab bsgom 4)bya/ /ku tal kye he ni gyi ⑩lha/ / ba su tsodha ri chog bzhin dgod/ /der ni sgo ba rnam 8bsgoms te//tho ba la sogs mnyam par ro/ /'khor lo snga tsom mthong ba bzhin/ /de bzhin mdog ni rab sbyar bya/ /phyag mtshan bdag ni ltar ⑩'dzin pa/ /mkhas pas phyi nas sngags bzlas te/ /oṃ e ka dza ṭī (nyeb su dhā ri (6ṇi swā hā/ puk+ka sī ( )ni rab 83—463

sgrub ①thabs/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /gang zhig bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum la 'tshe ②nus pa/ /sku mdog ser po zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag bzhi bong bu la bcibs pa/ /puk+ka sī ①yi lus bsgom bya/ /zhags pa tho ba mda' dag dang / /brtul zhugs can gyis gzhu bcas bsgom④/ /oṃ puk+ka sī ⑤e zhes sngags brjod do/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /de yi mod la mi snang bar/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje grags 'gyur ba / /'bar ba'i gser 'od 'dra ba yiyi/ /ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /gzhon nu'i gzugs ni 'dzin pa'i mgon/ /mi mthong bya ba'i don du bsgomal/ /shar du mdzes ma dgod par bya/ /de bzhin lho ru spa can ma/ /nub tu ser po bsgom par bya⑤/ /byang du nye ba'i skra can ma/ /thams cad phyag na ral gri dang —/ /'khor lo la sogs gzhan la dgod/— /thams cad zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /sa bon yi ge yaṃ ⑨las byung / /dkyil 'khor gyi ⑩ni dbus na bzhugs/ /thams cad zhabs ni g.yon brkyang (nyebs / /ri bong can gyi gdan la bzhugs/ /'od zer can dang ri khrod ma/ /de bzhin nor 'dzin skul byed ma/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi ru/ /bsdus pa dgod bya snying po la'o/ /mya ngan med dang yal 'dab dang / /'bras kyi snye ma dbyig pa'o/ /ser dang ljang dang yang ser po/ /dkar po'i lus ni bsgom par bya/ /kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /dkyil 'khor dag tu gdab par bya/ /tho ba la sogs sgo ba bzhi/ /bsgoms na mthong bar mi 'gyur ro / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las 'jam pa'i rdo rje sgrub ‘/)pa'i thabs zhes bya yi ste rim par 83—464

phye ba bcu bzhi pa'o// //'phags pa rdza gu li'i sgrub ①thabs/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /gang zhig bsgom ②pa tsam gyis ni/ /chu yi steng nas 'gro 'gyur ba/ /ser po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /sa bon phuḥnilas yang dag byung / /sku chen phyag na sbrul bsnams pa/ /rma bya la ni zhon pa dudagod/ /shar du rma bya dgod par bya/ /sde bzhin lho ru khro gnyer can/ /nub tu ri khrod lo ma can/ /byang du rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ /rma bya'i sgro dang spyi blugs dang / /lo ma dang ni lcags sgrog ma/ /de dag rnam par bsgom par bya/ /ser dang dmar dang de bzhin ljang / /kha dog sngon po dbye ba nyid/ /mkhas pas 'di ⑤ltar bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin sngags 'di dag kyang bzlas/ /oṃ phuḥdzaḥyi/ tho ba la sogs sgo ru dgod/ /me tog la sogs mtshams su dgod/ /rdza ⑦ku li yi sbyor ba yis/ /chu yi steng nas rtag tu 'gro/ /ku ru kul+le rab sgrub thabs/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /gang gis bsgoms ⑧pa tsam gyis ni/ /klu yi bu mo rab 'gugs pa/ /kha dog dmar po zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag brgyad ⑨dang ni rab tu ldan/ /hrīḥ0yi sa bon las byung bas/ /klu ni 'gugs tunyepar byed pa yin/ /phyag brgyad du ni klu dgod de8/ /mtha' yas la sogs klu rigs brgyad/ / lus ni sbrul gyis rab tu brgyan/ /0brtul zhugs can gyis mdzes ma bsgomatshu/ /sngags ni oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥphuḥswā hā/ de nas gsang ba bshad par bya/ /bsdus nas yin gyi 8rgyas pa min/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha yi bu mo 'gugs byed pa/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig ⑩ste/ /phyag na mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ /lus ni 83—465

ser po chen po yil/ /rdo rje lus med bsgom par bya/ /shar du dga' ma bsgom par bya/ /lho ru 'dod pas mdzes ②ma bsgomadu/ /nub tu 'dod pa'i lha mo bsgomadu / /byang du 'dod pa'i lcags kyu'o/ /'dod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyi/ /phyag tu mda' dang gzhu bsgom bya/ /ser dang dmar dang de bzhin ljang / /dmar skya dag ni bsgom par bya/ /mtshams rnams su ni rtag ⑤dgod pa/ /mi 'gag de bzhin mtshams kyi bdag / g.yi dang spre'u'i ༷rgyal mtshan ni⑦/ /sgo yi phyogs kyi bshad par bya/ /'dod pa 'gying dang 'gying bag can/ /dran dang de bzhin mda' gri canani/ /lha rnams de dag thams cad kyi/ /dbu la gshin rje'i gshed po bsgomakha/ /bud med kyi ni pad+ma ru/ /rdo rje lus med bsgom par bya/ /yi ge hrīḥyilas yang dag byung ⑩/ /kun tu 'khor bar rnam par 'phro/ /bslus shing tsogayengs pa bsgom par bya/ /myos nas bde ba'i 'dod yid kyis8/ /dmar po'i gos kyis yongs dkris te/ /yodza pa'i drung du lhung bar 'gyur/ /der ni sngags kyang bzlas par bya/ /yi ge oṃ ni ring por drang ske/ /yi ge swā hā mtha' byamar sbyin/ /yi ge si ti'i 8sngags bzlas bya/ /che ge mo zhig bdag dbang 'gyuratso/ /thams cad du ni bsgoms byas na⑩/ /nag po'i tshig ni ji bzhin gyis/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pas de 'thob tso'agyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las lus med rdo rje'i sgrub ()thabs rim par phye ba ste bcwa du)lnga pa'o// //he ru ka chen ( 1sgrub ( pa'i thabs/ /de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bar bcings pa la/ /gang zhig shes pas so myur grol ba/ /phyag 83—466

gnyis pa la zhal gcig ste/ /kha dog sngon po phyed gar can/ /rdo rje phyag tu bsgom par bya/ /gzhan yang thod pa bsgom par bya/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du 'greng ske/ /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan①/ /kha ṭī ga ni g.yon phyogs su/ /phreng ba dag gis ②kang pa brgyan / /sa bon hūm̐ las yang dag byung / /yi dgas ④la gnas rtag tu dgod/ /sangs rgyas lnga ru rab sbyor ba/ /thod pa lnga ni dbu la'o/ /cod pan la ni mi bskyod bsgomadu/ /he ru kur grags bsgom par bya/ /shar du chos kyi 'khor lo ma/ /sangs rgyas byang chub lho ru'o/ /'dod pa kun gyi 'khris ma nub/ /byang du he ru ka nyid 'dra/ /rgyan kun gyis ni rnam brgyan dupa'i/ /kha dog sna tshogs rnam par dgod/ /gzugs mdzes yi dgas rgyal bzhugs pa/ /gti mug thams cad nyer ⑧'joms byed/ /chos 'khor a shwat+tha'i dbyug pa⑨/ /de bzhin yid bzhin nor bu'i ⑩shing / /lha mo rnams kyi phyag g.yas su/ /rdo rje yang ni bsgom par bya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad la/ /thod pa'i snod ni g.yon pa la/ /spyan ma mā yim tī sgrol ma/ /gos dkar yid du 'ong ba rnams/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhi ru/ /'khor lo phyi rol gshin gshed do/ /shes rab mthar byed rta mgrin dang / /'khyil bar bcas pa tibasgom par bya/ /'khor lo yi ni sgo srungs te/ /cho ga'i ⑫las ni mthong bas so/ /cigashin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las byate ru ka bsgrub tsopa'i rim par phye ba ste bcu drug pa'o// //rnam pa lnga ni bsgoms ⑩byas la/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom par bya/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni bsgom 8pa yis/ /mkhas pas 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /83—467

gru ①bzhi yi ②ni sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo bskyed par bya ba ste/ /tsartsi kā ②sogs glu dang ni/ /drug pa duskyes sogs len 0par byed/ /snying rje khros pa'i dad sgrol bzhengs/ /khams gsum kun gyi gti mug soladu/ /dad sgrol gsol bas ma bzhugs bzhengs/ /bdud 'di dag las rgyal bar mdzod/ /'jig rten mgon po stong nyid ji stiste bzhugs/ /dad sgrol 'jig rten bsod nams kyis bzhengs shigadu /byang chub 'dod pa'i 'jig rten mgron pos nas/ /khyod ni stong pa nyid la sems par byed/ /ji ltar skar mda' 'pho ⑨ba bzhin/ /byang chub sems la zhugs par gyur⑩/ /rdo rje 'chang rang ngo bo nyid/ /snying rje dang ni 'dod chags semasayi/ /dang por bsgom 8pa rnal 'byor te/ /gnyis pa rjes kyi 8rnal 'byor yin/ /gsum pa shin tu rnal 'byor te/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdzogs pa yin/ /rnal 'byor yin par 'di ltar 'dod/ /de ni rgyu mthun ④lha yi sku/ /rjes kyi rnal 'byor yin par grags / /'khor lo thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /shin tu rnal 'byor yin par gragasali / /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams dang / /lha yiyi mig sogs byin rlabs tshidang / /ye shes 'khor lo gzhug pa dang / /bdud rtsi myang ba dag dang ni / /mchod dang bstod pa chen po dag /rnal 'byor chen po zhes bya'o/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /de bzhin spun la khro ba dang / /nyes pa bsgrag tu par mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems kyang gtang 37mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /sems can la ni byams pa dag /nam yang gtang so bar mi bya'o/ /yongs su ma smin sems can la/ /gsang ba dag ni bstan mi bya/ /bdag sogs phung po brnyas mi bya/ /grong pa'i 83—468

chos ni sun mi gdon/ /gdug la byams pa rtag tu spang ①/ /chos la tshad gzhal bar ②mi bya/ /sems can dad pa can mi bslu/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ /bud med shes rab rang bzhin la/ /smod pa nyes pa de bzhin no / /rnal 'byor slong ①mos rgyu mi bya/ /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par ④rgyun du gsang sngags bzla/ /rtag tu dam tshig la sogs bsten⑤/ /gal te bag ⑥med byung gyur na⑦/ /bla ma dam tshig la gnod na/ /des ni dkyil 'khor bri ⑧byas la/ /bde gshegs rnams la nyes pa bshags/ /snying rje can gyis mi brtag ⑨par/ /dad pas bla ma'i dam tshig bsrung ⑩/ /nyes pa ma lus rnam spangs sems kyis ni/ /bsam gtan la sogs bzlas pa mchog gzhol bar// byas la yirtag tu 8bla ma 'abla mar bya/ /brtan zhing 8dul la snying rje gcig tu sems / /dad dang lhag pa'i bsam pas bzod pa 'dzin/ /slob ma bla ma la ni gus pa dang / /dad pas gshin rje'i gshed la gus pa la/ /brtul zhugs ldan pas de ni yongs sbyin bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu dga' ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang gi gsung nye bar thos nas cang mi smra bar gyur te⑩/ 'di lta bu'i ched du brjod pas tsoched du brjod do/ /brtul zhugs mthar thug thod pa chen po ltar/ /'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje'i gshed kyi rgyud/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug pa ni 'dus pa ste/ /byung bar ma gyur 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /e ma'o zhi ba chen po'i chos e ma'o khro bo 'jigs mdzad pa/ /e ma'o dzi mya ngan 'das pa'i mchog /e ma'o 'khor ba zhi ba nyid/ /e ma'o 'di ni rab tu mtshar/ /nyes pa gang de yon tan 'gyur4ste/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs 4)med/ /dngos po ma yin 83wa 469

bsgom bya min/ /khams ma yin zhing rnam shes min/ /nam mkha'i khams dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po ste/ /sa yang ma yin chu min te/ /me min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /bskyed pa yang ni rab gnas nas/ /dngos po thams cad dngos med bshad/ /dngos po med ces ma bsgrags pa/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba dang 'brel phyir/ /chad pa ma yin rtag pa min①/ /yan lag med cing kha dog med/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' spangs pa/ /dngos po thams cad med par 'gyur/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das tsartsi kā ②chen po la sogs pas ched du brjod pas ①ched du brjod do/ /bsod nams sdig pa dag dang ma 'brel bas/ /mchog tu dga' ba dri med dag pa'i ④mgon⑤/ /de bzhin nyid kyi gter chen gcig pu dang / /kun kyang snying rje'i sems kyis mgon yi'adi yod/ /chos rnams ngo bo bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /mchog tu dga' ba 'di yi ngo bo nyid/ /de la gzugs med bsod nams med cing sdig pa med/ /skye ba dang ni ⑦'gag pa dag ni yod ma yinani/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las byang chub kyi sems kyi rim par phye ba ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas gtam rgyud bshad par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la byang chub kyi bar du gcod yo)pa'i phyir shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i 'jigs pa chen po ston cing / bdud kyi dpung chen po lhags te/ de'i dus na bdud chen po las rnam par rgyal ba zhes 83—470

bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ①nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams las gshin rje'i gshed kyi khro bo nges par phyung ste/②nges par phyung nas kyang lag na rdo rje thub pa chen po'i bka' bzhin byed pa la/phyag na rdo rje khyod 'di lta bu'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi khro bo'i gzugs su bsgyur te/bdud dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / lha rnams kyang choms shig /chings shig /rtogs shig ces gsungs so/ /de'i dus na ji ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa thos te/ skad cig la bzung zhing don bzung ste bsdus nas rab tu yid la byas so/ /zhes gsang ba chen po'i bdag po chen po rdo rje rigs kyi gtso bo nā da ①ku be ra'i yab kyis de skad ces gsungs so/ / au can ④gyi yul nas yang dag par byung ba dngos grub thams cad skyed ⑤par byed pa rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum phrag bdun pa las phyung ba gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las le'u bcwa ⑥brgyad pa'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud rdzogs sol// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po mkhas pa dī dupe ka ra shrī ⑨sto na dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ()ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa(spre/slad kyis lots+tsha 8ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis bcos la/ de las kyang dge slong rdo rje grags kyis bcos so tso83—471
