nas ra ti'i tshad kyis mnan te zangs la bsnun na gser du 'gyur ro/ /lus la byugs pas skra dkar gnyer ma dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang dngul chu dang bā lā'i rtsa ba mnye ①bar bya'o/ /slar yang tsaṇ+ḍa ⑤li'i me tog dngul chu dang mnye bar bya'o/ /rtsabs dang rnam par snang mdzad kyi khu bas slar yang mnye bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su bzhi cha'i tshad kyis gser gyi phye ma la byin pas rdog ①por 'gyur ro/ /'dab byam bdun pa'i lugs kong gi nang du glang po che'i rkang pa'i tshad kyi thum po la byin pa las rdog por 'gyur ro/ /de bton nas ra ti'i tshad kyis zangs la bsnun na gser du 'gyur ro/ /lus la yang ra ti'i tshad kyis nyes pa gsum 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor chen po rnams kyi 'du ba'i nang 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zos pa tsam gyis rgyang grags brgyar ⑤'gro nus sol/ /de nas gzhan yang dngul chu tsam gnas pa la rdo rje dang nges par ti ṣa dang tri 4)hrī'i rtsa ba dang / ka rañdzañtsa dang ma nu'i rtsa ba dang mnye bar bya'o/ / pa ṇi ṭa ⑦pa shu ra ṇa sbyar te lugs kong tshunang du sbyar bar bya'o/ /mtshan mo ril po 6)bsregs pas de 'grub ste/ ra ti'i tshad blangs nas zangs la bsnun pas de 'grub bo/ /ra ti tsam gyis bza' bas 7spa dkar dang gnyer ma dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba drug tu rab tu sbyor bas lo stong 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang sbyor ba de bzhin du dngul chu srang gcig bzung nas shing 4)bī'i khu ba dang mnye bar bya'o/ /a bh+ra ṭaṃ dang gser gyi gzegs ma sbyar la/ shring gī tsodamar po dang mnyam ste 8tsi ṭi pā'i 'khu ba blangs te/ nyi ma bcu gnyis de'i rjes su lugs kong gi nang du bcug nas sbyar bar bya'o/ /glang po che'i rkang pa'i tshad las phyung ste mnyam du blangs nas ra ti'i tshad gzhug par bya'o/ /zangs ma 83—631

la bsnun na ma lus pa nges par gser du 'gyur ro/ /zos pas yun ring du 'tsho zhing mkha' spyod du 'gro bar the tshom med do/ /gnod sbyin dang mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnams zham ring byed par 'gyur zhing gshin rje'i 'jig rten du mi 'gro'o / /de nas gzhan yang lhang tsher nag po sung gcig dang sbal pa'i lo ma'i khu bas sbyar ba'i dngos po zla ba phyed mtshal (37dang ro mnyam par byas te zla ba gcig gi tshad kyis chu grang mo dang bcas te bza' bar bya'o/ /zla ba'i sbyor bas rnal 'byor gyi bdag nyid nad dang 'chi ba med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang lcags srang tsam bzung ste re (sat+ya'i phye ma'i rab tu byed pa dang / ka shī'i khu ba dang mnyam du sbyar te nyi ma'i 'od zer las bskam par bya'o/ /dngul chu dang lhang tsher dang mu zi rnams de'i bzhi cha'i tshad sbyor ba las ka ko la dang li shi'i phye ma rnams sngon ma'i tshad las phyed dang gnyis so/ /thams cad gcig tu byas te/lcags dang mnye bar bya ste rdo brtan po la'o/ /lugs kong gi nang du bcug ste kha bcad nas sbyar te lci ba'i me la bsreg par bya'o/ /de nas phyung ste lcags chen po dang mā sha'i dzo tshotshad kyis zos na skra dkar gnyer ma rnam par 'joms shing nad dang 'chi bas mi tshugs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las mi snang ba dang mig sman dang bcud len sgrub pa ste rim par phye ba bdun pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal pos grib gnon gyi rab tu byed pa gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ dgra bo rkang bzhi pa rnams kyi chad snapa'i rab tu sbyor ba 'di gsungs te/ dang por re zhig 5gshin rje gshed 'jigs so(6) sems 83—632

can kun gyi rmongs byed bsgom par bya/ /rang gi khyim du mtshan mo'i 6)dus/ /stag gi pags ②pa'i stan la gnas/ /zhal gcig dmar po ①shin tu rngam/ /zhags pa dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /ro yi steng du 'jigs chen gnas/ /spyan gsum shin tu 'jigs par byed/ /lha rnams thams cad rmongs byed pa/ /me stag tshogs pas 'khrigs pa ste/ /de bzhin bsgom zhing bzlas pa 'bum/ /phyi ④nas cho gas spyad par bya/ /ka ra bī ra dkar po'i rtsa/ /de bzhin darnyi dhidamar po'i rtsephyi/ /sbal pa'i khrag gis sbyar byas te/ /brtul zhugs can gyis thig le gzung ⑦/ /gang gi grib ma rkang pas mnan/ /de ni brgyal bar byed 'gyur te/ /rkang gnyis pa dang rkang bzhi dag /thams cad rmongs par the tshom (shemed / /gza' ni nyi ma'i dkar phyogs la/ /lto ba las byung srin bu la/ /de rnyed nas ni 'bad pa yis/ /shing 6)gli ṇa tsoyis (nyethig le bya/ /dpral bar thig le byin pa yis/ /gang gi grib ma 'phro bar byed/ /gal te myos thob grol byed na / /'o mas gtor bas bde bar byed/ /darnyi ro ha lung thang nag /de rnams rtsa ba gcig tu byas/ /bya rog khrag gis sbyar byas te/ /brtul zhugs can gyis thig le bya/ /thig le 'di yi mthu yis ni/ /lha rnams kyang ni rab tu g.yo'i / /phyag ni btsal bar (/— mi bya ste/ /byas na de ni brgyal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzhan yang rab sbyor ༄te/ /ra sa shing gī tsoku thā yiri/ /pha ṇi nā ga pha ṇi dang / /de rnams thams cad zla ba yis/ /brtul zhugs can gyis ril bu bya / /nam mkha'i rang bzhin chu yis ni/ /thig le spyi bor gzung nyu bar bya/ /phyag 'tshal gdong du bltas pa yis/ /mi de khrag tu skyug par 'gyur/ /kā ma tsā yigedang ma dhu dkar/ /khu byug dkar po'i mig rnams ni/ /nam mkha'i chu dang 83—633

yang dag ldan/ /spyi bo ru ni thig le bya/ /thig le de yi mthu yis ni/ /dgra rnams dbang du 'du bar 'gyur/ /gang la phyag ni btsal gyur na/ /de ni nges par rmongs 'gyur te①/ /de nas gzhan yang rab sbyor te/ /ltos 'gro nag po'i lce dang ni/ /de bzhin na ku la yi lce/ /byi ba'i mkhris pa yang dag bsres//ril bu khri phrag lnga byas nas/ /'di yi thig le'i ②mthu yis ni/ /khro bo'i sngags cha'ajug de la 'gro/ /rgyal po rtag snyitu rmongs 'gyur te/ /gdug pa can dang lhan cig go/ /de nas gzhan yang rab sbyor te/ /bdud rtsi rtsa ba an dkar / /ba ku ri yi zhi)'bras de bzhin/ /de rnams cha ni mnyam po ru/ /mkhas pa yis ni ril bu bya/ /'di yi thig le rtag bzung phyin/ /'jig rten gsum ni rmongs par 'gyur/ /kha yi bdud rtsi blangs nas ni/ /g.yon pa yi ni ming med kyis/ /sngags 'dis ril bu thams cad la byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā dhi pa ta ye ma hā dur daste 97da ma kā (nyaya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/bi nā naya bi nā sha ya/ bi tā pa ya bi tā pa ya/ r+ghaṃ hūṃ sarba dus ṭ+wāṃ 7phaṭa/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 7sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las grib gnon bsgrub pa ste/ rim par phye ba brgyad pa'o/ / //'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis ro langs la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs gsungs (spepa ni/ oṃ hūm̐ 'dzāḥ.a pa rā dzi taḥ.o hūṃ dzaḥ.a dzi taḥ.o hūṃ dzaḥkyisu ra ṇali/ oṃ hūm̐ dzaḥ.a pū ra ṇa'i/ oṃ shrī dzaḥshra shā nā dhi pa tiḥ7/ oṃ rgyu dza 7ku le shwa raḥ/ oṃ r+ghaṃ dzaḥbhū nye te shwa raḥ/ oṃ e dzaḥ/ ki 6)ka ro ta ta maḥ nyazhes pa 'di rnams 'byung 83—634

po'i bdag po chen po rnams so/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa sgrub par gyur na dpal ldan rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa'i mdun du sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum bzlas pa byas nas de rdzogs pa dang mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas zas dkar po dang zho dang bu ram dang 'o ma'i thug pas ji ltar gsung ba'i 6)mchod pa bya'o/ /gu gul gyi spos phul nas mtshan mo hril po bzlas pa bya'o(mi/ /shin tu snga ba na nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma 'ongs na de'i skad cig la 'chi bar byed do/ /'ongs nas gnang ba zhu bar byed de②/ bdag gis ci bya zhes so sgrub pa pos smra bar ④bya ste/ bdag gis gang bsgo ba gyis shig ces so/ /de nas bzung ⑤ste gang bsgo ba'i las rnams byed do/ /rig pa 'dzin pa dang rgyal po yang ster ro/ /dgra rnams la chad pas gcod par byed do/ /zla ba'i lha mo yang blangs nas ster rol/ /rgyab la zhon pas lha'i 'jig rten du 'gro zhing brgya byin yang ster ro/ /bskal pa bdun du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas a dzi ta sgrub par gyur na mchod rten gyi mdun du mtshan mo stong phrag brgyad bzlas pa byas te/ nyi ma bdun pa'am brgyad pa la mchod pa rgya chen po byas te gtor ma phul nas gu gul gyi spos phul te bzlas pa bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i mtha' la nges par 'ong bar 'gyur te/kyai (5)sgrub pa po bdag gis ci bgyi zhes so/ /sgrub pa pos smra bar bya ste/ bdag gi bya ba gang yin pa bya dgos so zhes so/ /de nas bzung (7nyenas bsgo ba'i las rnams byed par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang rgyal po ster zhing lo stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gang sgrub (kyepar gyur na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i khang par zhugs te stong phrag brgyad bzlas par thodabya'o/ /nyi ma bdun pa'am nyi ma brgyad pa la gtor ma dang mchod pa rgya chen po byas te/ kha zas dkar po dang zho dang ji skad 83—635

bshad pa'i mchod pa phul nas ji srid nam phyed kyi bar de srid bzlas par bya'o/ /ji srid nam phyed du gyur pa na rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /me tog dang mchod yon phul te tshim par byas pas rgyal po ster bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /lo stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /ji srid 'cho3re bar du gang bcol ba'i las rnams byed do/ /che ge mo sod cig ces pa dang ske/ che ge mo 'tsho bar gyis shig ces pa yang byed do/ /de nas ma gang ba sgrub par gyur na bdud 0)dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du ⑤sngon du khri bzlas te bsnyen pa byas par gyur pas de nas zla ba yongs su rdzogs pa la ji skad bshad pa'i dngos pos mchod pa byas nas ji srid nam phyed du gyur pa de srid du bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nam phyed na myur du 'ong bar 'gyur (kyete 'ongs nas mdun du bsdad de kye 3)bu ci bya zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa pos smra bar bya ste bdag gi bya ba gang yin pa bya dgos so zhes so/ /de nas bzung (5)ste ci bcol ba'i las rnams byed do/ /gnod sbyin gyi bu mo mchog rnams blangs nas ster ba dang / 'dod pa'i kha zas mchog rnams ster ba dang / nyi ma so so la gus pas gos zung dang yidong tse lnga bar (77tu ster bar 'gyur ro/ /lo lnga brgyar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dur khrod kyi bdag po sgrub par gyur na mtshan mo dur khrod du phyin nas bzlas pa stong phrag gcig bya'o/ /nyi ma bdun pa dang brgyad pa la rab tu mang po'i nya dang til dang rdza bu li ka dang dkar ba'i zas dang 8)zho dang bu ram dang dhū (9)pa dang 'bras bu dang nye bar spyod pa rnams dang ji skad rtagasungs pa'i gtor ma byin te gu gul gyi spos phul te ji srid nam phyed kyi bar de srid bzlas pa bya'o/ /de'i nam phyed na hā hā sgrogs pa thos par 'gyur te1me/ de la 8(3—636

'jigs par mi bya'o/ /de 'khor gyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa dang gtor ma byin pas tshim par 'gyur ro/ /'byung po thams cad gang bsgo ba byed do/ /nyi ma re re zhing dong tse brgyad blang bar 'gyur rol/ /dgra thams cad 'joms shing lo stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rigs kyi dbang phyug sgrub par gyur na lha'i gnas su phyin nas dri dmar po dang /me tog dmar po dang gu gul phul nas sngon du bsnyen pa khri bzlas par bya'o/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi bcu bzhi'i mtshan mo la nya sha dang / til dang / rdza bu li ka dang / kha zas dmar po dang / ji lta ba'i mchod pas gtor ma dbul ①bar bya zhing si bla'i spos phul nas ji srid nam phyed kyi bar bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas 'bar ba chen po mtha' med pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ bu bdag gis ci bya zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa pos smra bar bya ste/ bdag gis gang bsgo ba gyis shig ces so / /de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gang bcol ba'i las byed par 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma re re la dong tse (kyelnga thun mtshams (migasum du ster bar byed do/ /'dod pa'i kha zas mchog ster zhing lo lnga brgya 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas 'byung po'i dbang phyug sgrub par gyur na liṅga gcig pa'i drung du phyin te/ nyin mtshan gsum du dmar ba'i zas dang nya sha dang til dang / rdza bu li ma'i ④gtor ma byin pas nyi ma gsum pa la bdag nyid myur du 'ongs nas mdun du 'khod de bdag gis ci bya zhes smra bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa pos smra bar bya ste/ bdag gis gang bsgo ba gyis shig ces smras pas rtag tu rjes su 'brang zhing lha'i bu mo blangs nas ster bar byed cing / rang gis zas blangs te steng g.yogs nas rnam pa so sor ster bar 83—637

byed do/ /lo nyis stong du 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas mngag gzhug pa mchog sgrub par gyur na rdo rje 'dzin pa'i khang par zhugs nas nag po'i bcu bzhi la bzlas pa khri phrag gcig bya'o/ /sngon du bsnyen pa byas nas nyi ma bdun pa la de nas sgrub pa brtsam par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor la tsan+dan gyis byugs te gu gul gyi spos phul nas dkar ba'i zas dang / zho dang / mar dang / 'o ma dang /ku sha chun po'i steng du mar gyi mar me rab tu sbar te/ mtshan mo ji srid pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /nam phyed na mngag gzhug ①pa mchog nyid 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa na tsan+dan gyi mchod yon phul bas tshim par bya'o/ /bdag gis ⑤ci bya zhes 'dri bar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa pos smra bar bya ste/bdag gis gang bsgo ba gyis shig ces so/ /de nas bzung ste gang bcol ba'i las rnams byed par 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad ster zhing 'dod pa'i don thams cad phun sum tshogs par byed do/ /de nas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma sgrub par gyur na gro ga'i lo ma la gi wang ①gis gzugs brnyan bris te / rang gcig pu nyal ba'i steng du bsdad la stong phrag gcig bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas zla ba'i mthar mchod pa rgya chen po byas la mar gyi mar me rab tu sbar te mi smra bar gyur pas bzlas par libya'o/ /de'i nam phyed na nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa na 'dod pa byas pas chung mar 'gyur ro/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bza' ba dang bcas shing nyal te nyin mo yongs su spangs shing 'gro'o/ /bud med gzhan dang 'grogs pa (5) spang bar 95)bya ste/ gzhan du na rnam par 'jig par byed do/ /de nas ka na ma nī sgrub par gyur na n+ya gro dha'i shing drung du phyin te cho gas nya (7sha'i gtor ma sbyin no/ /bdag nyid 'thungs pa'i lhag mas 83—638

mchod yon byin la bzlas pa stong phrag gcig bya'o/ /de bzhin du nyi ma bdun pa'i mtshan mo bdag nyid 'ong bar 'gyur te/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing 'khor brgya phrag gsum dang lhan cig tu nam phyed na nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro//'ongs pa na 'dod pa 0)byas pas chung mar 'gyur (/ro/ /skye ba ①bcu gnyis kyi gos dang rgyan dang bza' ba rnams ster bar byed do/ /nyi ma so so la dong tse dubargyad rab tu ster bar byed do/ /de nas dga' ma sgrub par gyur na thang ka la ri mo bri bar bya ste/ gser gyi mdog can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa lag na ut+pa la dang ldan pa'o/ /dza (geti'i me tog gis mchod par bya'o/ /gu gul gyi spos byin nas stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /zla ba'i mtha' la ji lta ba'i dngos pos mchod pa bya ⑥ste/ mar gyi mar me rab tu sbar la ji srid nam phyed kyi bar du de srid bzlas pa na rang nyid 'ong bar ga'agyur ro/ /'ongs pa na mi smra bar bsgom zhing 'dod pa byas pas chung mar 'gyur (sher/ /sgrub pa po'i 'khor rnams ni 5)skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i bza' ba mchog rnams dang dngul chu dang bcud len rnams ster zhing dong tse nyi shu rtsa lnga rab tu ster bar byed do0/ /de nas pad+ma tunyeni sgrub par gyur na rang gi khang par spyi bo'i gnas su dkyil 'khor la tsan+dan byugs te gu gul gyi spos phul la zla ba gcig la stong phrag gcig bzlas so / /de nas zla ba yongs su gang ba na yinaji lta ba'i dngos pos mchod par bgyis (nyete / ji srid nam phyed pa de srid du bzlas pas nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa na ci'adod pa byas pas chung mar 'gyur ro/ /'dod pa'i mchog rab tu ster zhing dngul chu dang 'bacud len dang dngos grub kyi rdzas kyang ster bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ral pa gcig ma'i sgrub thabs bdag gis yang dag par 83—639

rab tu bshad par bya'o/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams sgrub pa'i dus su ral pa gcig ma rnam ①par bsgom par bya'o/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa kha dog sngon mo/ 'jigs pa chen mo bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom par bya'o/ /shar gyi 'dab ⑤ma la dzam+bha la bsgom par bya'o/ /nor bu 'dzin pa ni lho ru'o/ /chu dbang ni nub tu'o/ / tsi bi 'khyil ⑧ba ni byang du'o/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams ④bzhi la gnod sbyin mo bzhi bsgom par bya ste/ kuṇ+ḍa s+t+waṃ dang —/ ha ḍho ⑤ni dang / ro traṃ dang / mdzes ma rnams cho gas dgod par bya'o / /de nas sgo skyong bsgom bya zhing / /dbyug pa la sogs mtha' dag la/ /sngon du 'khor lo ji lta bzhin/ /de bzhin kha dog rab tu sbyor/ /kun la bdag po'i mtshan ma 'dzin/ /phyi nas kyang ni sngags bzlas te/ /oṃ e ka dza ṭi ba su sā dha ni swā hā/ de nas puk+ka sī yi ni/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis bshad par bya/ /gang gis bsgoms tsam skad cig las/ /'jig rten gsum la puk+ka sī/ /kha dog dmar ser zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag bzhi bong bu la zhon sgom(7/ /las kyi puk+ka sī yi ni/ /bya rog dang ni tho ba dang / /mda' gzhu brtul zhugs can gyis bsgomal/ /sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ puk+ka sī (7o/ de nas 'jam pa'i rdo rje yi / /sgrub thabs bdag gis (gurab bshad bya/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i grub pa las skad cig gcig las mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las ro langs 6)gnod sbyin mo bsgrub pa ste rim par phye ba dgu pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal pos ro langs dang / gcan gzan tigadug 83—640

pa can la sogs pa bsrung ba'i sngags bshad par bya'o/ /'bum phrag bzhi ni bzlas pa yis/ /don grub sa bon gtor byas na/ /ro ni don byed langs 'gyur te/ /'tsho bar yang ni the tshom med/ /zhi la gshin rje gshed dkar po/ /rnal 'byor bsgom byar ①rtag tu rig /lag na don 'grub dus bon la/ /'bum phrag bzhi ni bzlas pa yis/ /ro ni mdun du phyogs byas nas/ /yungs kur ①gyis ni bsnun gyur na/ /de nyid ldang bar the tshom med/ /gal te nag pos bzung ④gyur na/ /hūṃ mdzad dkar po dang mtshungs pa/ /bsgrub bya yi ni snying gar dubasgom/ /trīḥdhīḥl sogs sngags rnams bzlas/ /'od zer gyis ni dug rnams dgug /lag pa g.yas dang de bzhin g.yon/ /pad+ma 'dab dum brgyad pa 'dzin/ /de dbus hūm̐ mdzad dkar po ste/ /'od zer gyi ni bdud rtsi 'bab / /de yi mgo bo'i steng du yang / /bsil zer byed pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus / /mkhas pas haḥyig bsam par bya/ /hrīḥdhīḥl sogs sngags de yi/ /rgyud kyi dug rnams drang bya ste/ /oṃ hrīḥjiḥhaḥl〉ཿdzaḥphuḥzhes pa'i sngags kyi yi ge sa mgo bo nas brtsams nas rkang pa'i mthar thug pa sngags kyis byab par bya'o/ /bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bab par bsgom/ /de yis 'tsho bar the tshom med/ /sa bon yi ge las grub pa'i/ /gzungs kyis 'ching ba mchog tu 'gyur/ /rma yi gnas la 'di bsgom ste/ /kha dog ser po las byung ba'i/ /oṃ yig la sogs mthar tsheg ( drag /ha ja'i rnam pa sbyar byas la/ /sbyor ba yis kyang brda 6)bar bya / /mgo gzer rab zhi blo mchog ldan/ /de bzhin gzhan yang sdom dang ni/ /bi ka ṭa dang rkang shu sogs/ /rab tu sbyor ba mang po rnams/ /lag pas nges gzung 7'tsho bar byed/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 83—641

rab sbyor ba/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gdug pa rnams/ /brtul zhugs can gyis gzhom bya'i phyir/ /bdag nyid dpal ldan dbyug 'dzin gyi/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo rab tu sbyor/ /dbyug pa'i 'od kyis rang lus khyab/ /sku gsum las ni skyes pa'o/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /gshin rje'i gshed kyi dkyil 'khor dusti/ /slob dpon bdag gis dkyil 'khor bri / /gos kyis gdong nas ②bcings byas la/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sgo drung du / /kye ma 'bod pa su zhig lags/ /skal bzang bdag ces brjod par bya/ /yol ba yi ni nang byas nas/ /bla ma mgon la mkhas pas zhu/ /gus pa chen pos dbang gi phyir/ /rjes su mgon byed lan gsum brjod/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bde chen gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag kyang mgon pos chadabang bskur nas/ /mchog kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ /glu dang rol mos de bzhin mchod/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil de bzhin du/ /slob mas gus dang bcas te dbul/ /bstod pa yang ni de la bya/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /stod nyid gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ༷ko3nyaphyi/ oṃ pū dzā badz+ra swa bhā ba 6) ād+ma ko3rta(pe/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba ād+ma lako3rta'-i/ de nas zhi ba la sogs pa'i/ /sbyin sreg ⑩rab dbye bdag gis bshad/ /gang gis las kun rab sgrub pa/ /sbyin sreg (1gis ni 'grub par 'gyur / /zhi la zhi ba'i sems kyis te/ /rgyas la rgyas pa'i sems kyis so/ /dbang la rjes su chags sems te/ /gsad 7pa la ni khro sems kyis/ /zhi la maṇ+ḍal rnam pa ste/ /rgyas la rdzing gi rnam pa'o/ /dbang la zla ba phyed pa ste/ /83—642

nam mkha'i khams ni gsad ①pa la/ /zhi la khru gang tshad yin te/ /rgyas la de bzhin khru do'o/ /rgyas pa ji lta de bzhin dbang / /gsad ②la sor mo nyi shu'o/ /zhi la khru phyed gting du'o/ /khru yi tshad kyis rgyas pa la/ /gsad ⑧pa la ni lnga gnyis so/ /rgyas pa ji ltar de bzhin dgug /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg 0tshes gcig la / /rgyas pa zla ba gang ba la/ /bcu bzhi la ni mngon spyod do/ /brgyad la dbang gi las yin no/ /nya skyogs dang ni shel dag dang / /zhi la mu tig 'bras bu mchog /dung gi bu ni 'tsho ba la/ /nad med pa la mu men ⑤rna/ /tsan+dan dmar po dag dang ni/ /byi ru dmar po'i khyad ①par dang / /rasna ⑦dang ni lung thang nag /mi yi rus dang de bzhin du/ /nā ga pha tsā ⑧zhes bya rnams/ /zhi ba la ni brgya phrag gcig⑨ /rgyas pa brgyad kyis lhag de bzhin/ /dbang dgug nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /mngon spyod drug cu 0rtsa bzhi'o/ /rdog po rnams ni sngags kyis tibasku/ /brgya phyed sngags kyis bsgrub par bya/ /phreng ba kun la mthar mdud bya/ /de bzhin du ni ri rab gnyis/ /mdzub tsomo'i steng nas zhi ba la/ /gung mo la ni rgyas pa'o/ /dbang dgug dag la ming med las/ /chad pas bcad la 'amathe chung las/ /zhi la kha dog dkar po dang / /kha dog ser po rgyas pa la/ /dmar po dbang la rtag tu bsgom/ /nag po shin tu gsad la tso'adod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 8sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las sbyin sreg snyigi cho ga ste rim par phye ba bcu pa'o// // rnal 'byor bzhi dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas sna tshogs pa'i bca' ba la 83—643

sogs pa dang / bza' ba dang / myang ba dang / btung ba dang / bldag pa la sogs pa dang yang dag par ldan pa'i dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang ske/ phye ma dang / gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyul mtshan dang / dril bu dang / ba dan la sogs pa rnams kyis rab tu gang ba la rol mo'i sgra chen po lnga bsgom par bya'o/ /mdun du gtor ma bzhi khyogs dang khur dang dpung thegs dang mtha' na zan tsam chu dang bcas pa khyor ba gsum dang ji ltar rnyed pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas dang ldan pa bshams nas de stong par dmigs te brtsam ①par bya'o/ /nam mkha'i khams su pad+ma 'dab ②ma brgyad pa bsgom par bya ste/ ge sar dang bcas pa'i ze'u ①'bru la yi yig las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ④kha dog nag po gzhu'i rnam pa la rtse mo gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan dkar po brgyad kyis spras pa'o/ /de'i steng du ro yig las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum dmar po zur gsum na ra yig dugis spras pa'o/ /de'i steng du ru yig gsum kyiyongs su gyur pa las mgo bo dmar po'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du āḥyig las skyes pa'i pad+ma'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba de la chu skyes 'dab lam brgyad pa'i rnam par ⑧bsam par bya'o/ /de'i shar la sogs pa'i 'dab 6)ma la oṃ ā+o ⑩smra khaṃ hūm̐ gi yi ge rnams las rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rang gzugs rnams so/ /de bzhin du me la sogs pa'i mtshams 11rnams la lī māṃ r+pā ṭ+wāṃ bī gi yi ge 7rnams las spyan ma la sogs pa'i rang gzugs rnams bsgom par bya'o/nya/ /yi ge bcu po 'di rnams yongs su gyur pa ni go ku da ha na rnams dang / bi ra shu mā mū (stezhes pa ste/'di rnams kyi sa bon gyi yi ges mtshan pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas bcu po de pad+ma'i snod du bltas te/ de'i steng du oṃ yig kha dog dkar pos bkab pa'i gzugs 83—644

su bsgom mo/ /oṃ yig las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po las byung ba'i rdo rje ①dbyug pa/ de sa bon gyis mtshan pa bltas te/de yang pad+ma'i snod las 'og na skyed pu la oṃ āḥs lan gsum bzlas ②shing brjod par bsgoms ③te sngon ma rgyun ma chad par rlung gi dkyil 'khor rgya chen po dang /rab tu 'bar ba me'i dkyil 'khor bsgoms te/ rgya chen po 'bar zhing bar dum lus pa'i rang gzugs go ku ⑤la sogs pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas bcu zhu ba las rdo rje dbyug pas dkrugs par blta'o/ /de yang rdo rje dbyug pas bdud rtsi zhu ste nyi ma gsar pa'i kha dog gam/ dngul chu'i rnam par bsam par bya'o/ /de dul yang oṃ āḥ/ gsum gyi yi ge bltas te/ de las yi ge gsum gyi 'od zer gyi tshogs chen po rnam par 'phros te 'jig rten gsum na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi rab tu mang po 'od zer gyis bkug ste/ de la rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /de rab tu zhugs pas zla ba'i 'od zer tshogs pa shin tu lhag pa yongs su gyur pa las kha ba lta bu sbrang rtsi'i tshogs pa'i gzugs kyis mnan ⑦par bya'o/ /phyi nas yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ kha dog dang dri dang ro bcud dang ldan pa ston ku'i (7zla ba dri ma med pa'i 'od lta bu ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i sbyor bas gtor mar grub par 'dun ⑨pa bya'o/ /gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i sngags kyis khro bo rnams la phyag na zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin cing 'phro bas phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying ga yinas lcags kyus 'bigs shing mgrin pa la zhags pas bcings te 'gugs par bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ ⑩tā na na hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa satsān+d+ra sa pa tsori wā ra mā kur+sha (nyeya dzaḥsngags 'dis dbang po mig stong ser bskya glang po che dkar po la zhon pa/ lag pa g.yas pa dang g.yon 83—645

pa rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub ①can bkug ste shar du rnam par dgod par bya'o/ /de bzhin du de'i sngags kyis nye ba'i dbang po bya khyung la gnas pa/ rin po che'i cod pan can/ g.yas na dbyug pa dang 'khor lo/ g.yon na dung dang nor bu 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yon mi ring ba na gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du gshin rje nag po ma he la zhon pa/ dbyug pa 'dzin pa lhor gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du chu bdag kha dog dkar po sbrul la gnas pa/ lag na klu'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/nub tu rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du lus ngan po ser po gter la gnas pa/ lag na bī ②dza pū ra ka dang na ku li bsnams pa/ byang du rnam par gnas pa'o/ /de bzhin du sna ldan dkar po byi ba tshul gnas pa/ g.yas na bgrang phreng dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ g.yon na la phug dang la du'o/ /de bzhin du dbang ldan dkar po khyu mchog dkar po la gnas pa/ ral pa 'dzin pa rtse gsum dang thod pa lag na bsnams pa/ lag pa gnyis gi rī la 'khyud (7pa/ dbang ldan du rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du me lha ⑤dmar por la gnas pa/ lag na bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs bsnams pa/ me'i phyogs su rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du srin po ni ro la zhon pa/lag na gri gug dang thod pa/ kha dog sngon po khro zhing gtum pa bden bral ⑥gyi phyogs su rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du rlung lha ⑦bu ba'i kha dog ri dgas ser po la gnas pa/ rlung gi ba dan bsnams pa/ rlung gi phyogs su rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du nyi ma ni dmar po/ lag pa gnyis na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rta bdun gyi steng na (87steng gi (9)phyogs su rnam ⑩par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du zla ba ni dkar po/ lag pa gnyis na ku mu da bsnams pa/83—646

shing rta ①la zhon ②pa/ steng gi phyogs na rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du tshangs pa ni ser skya gdong ③bzhi pa/ spyi blugs dang mi 'jigs pa/ dbyug pa dang bgrang phreng bsnams pa/ ngang pa la zhon pa/ steng gi phyogs na rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du sa'i lha mo phyag g.yon na bum pa bsnams pa/g.yas na dam 'cha' dudang khas len gyi phyag rgya ⑤ste/ 'og gi phyogs su rnam par gnas pa'o/ /yang de bzhin du thags zangs ris dusngon po shing rta la gnas pa/ g.yas dang g.yon na ral gri dang sdigs ⑦mdzub ⑧'dzin pa/ de yang de bzhin du rnam par gnas pa'o/ /de rnams khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs la lag na phur bu 'dzin pas khro bo'i mgrin pa dang snying ga'i ṇis bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug ste/ de rnams kyi snying ga tsodang mgrin pa dang spyi bo dang rkang pa'i mthar thug ⑩'dis phur bus gdab par bya ste/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ ⑩tā na na hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa rtsu sar+sān+ta di (gyen tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa ces pa ni phur bu bar ma chad par grub pa'i khu ba'i tshogs pa la sogs pas de thams cad kyang gshin rje mthar byed kyi rnam par grub pa'i mthar byang chub sems kyi khu ba'i gzugs rlung gi sa bon gyi rtags kyi go rims kyis grub pa'i mtha' la/ de la hrīḥyig gi sa bon las grub pa ni dbang po'o/ /thiḥyig gi sa bon las grub pa ni gshin rje'o/ /bi ④yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni chu bdag go/ /kṛ tsoyig gi sa bon las grub pa ni lus ngan no/ /tā tsoyig gi sa bon las grub pa ni dbang ldan no/ /a yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni me'o/ /na yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni bden bral 7lo/ /na yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni rlung ngo / /rtsu yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni zla ba'o/ /hūm̐ yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni nyi ma'o/ /phaṭa yig gi sa 83—647

bon las grub pa ni tshangs pa'o/ /phaṭa yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni nor rgyun ma'o / /swā yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni thags zangs ris so/ /hā yig gi sa bon las grub pa ni 'byung po thams cad do zhes te/ de bzhin du grub par bsam par bya'o/ /de rnams kyi mig la sogs pa rnams la ji ltar gnas pa/yang mig la sogs pa rdzogs pa'i sku la sogs pa rnams la yang sku rdo rje la sogs pa ji ltar mngon par dbang bskur ba bzhin du gshin rje mthar byed kyis dbu brgyan pa nyid do/ /yang mchod yon la sogs pa'i bsang gtor dang / zhal bsil la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /phyi nas gtor ma nye bar dbul ba ni bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i go rims (17sngon du rdzogs pa la de nyid gsum gyis mngon par bsngags ②te yang de rnams kyi ljags rab tu sbyor bar bsgom par bya'o/ /sngags 'dis bdud rtsi dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ rak+ta mu ku ṭā ya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/ rak+ta mu khā ya/ rak+ta sha rī rā ya/ rak+ta bhu dzā ya/ rak+ta muṇ+ḍa gamā lā ༷bha ra ṇa ya/rak+ta ra tha sa mā rū ṭ+wā 97ya/ rak+ta pad+mā sa nā 6)ya/ rak+ta bha ra ṇa ཿ stiṣa ṇa (gyiya/i rda ba dzi griṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa99ni/ ma ma bisdi ha ra ha ra/ tsa tur mā rādzi bā ra ya/ni bā ra 7ya/ tā sha ya tā sha ya/ bhā ma ya bhā ma ya/ tshin+da sbyin ste/ dharnya girnya/nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ts+tsha da ts+tsha datu / bhe da bho da/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phyi nas so so'i cha yis spyad par bya/ /oṃ yirnyi ya na maḥtrīḥ/ ya mā ya na maḥjiḥ1ste/ ba ru ṇa ya na maḥwi'i/ ku be rā ya na maḥ kṛ/ i shwa lirā ya na maḥta4/ asna 1 tshoye na maḥ ā/ nai ṛ t+yā ya yonyen maḥn/ bā ya be na maḥn/tsan+d+ra ya nyarten maḥhū/ ar+gha da ya na maḥrtsa/ brah+ma 81khe na maḥphaṭa/ ba su dha rā yi (nyan maḥphaṭa/ be ma tsi tri ṇi ni na maḥswā/ sasba zhi 7 bhū te 9 saskyo na maḥhā/ ha ha ha tso803—648

hi hi hi rgyu rgyu hūṃ/ dze dze dze/ phyi nas me tog dang spos dang mar me dang zhal zas la sogs pa yang dbul bar bya'o/ /de rnams kyang sgrub pa po'i ①mngon par rab tu dad pas ro bcud thams cad myong zhing longs spyod par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dal gyis 'khrol bas gnas de la bstod par bya'o/ /gti mug dga' ma la sogs pa rnams la phyi nas mngon par 'dod pa zhus te mchod pa'i mthar bzhad pa (7sngags rnam pa brgyad brjod par bya ①ste/ de la sngags 'dis gshegs su gsol lo/ / ha hā (thu he hai (kyeho ho hūm̐ hūm̐/ bi sa radz+dza ye ta/ oṃ āḥmu zhes pas kyang ngo / /phyi nas sgrub pa po'i mngon par 'dod pas / sems can kun gyi don mdzad phyir/ /ji ltar rjes 'jug dngos grub stsol / /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'dir ni byon par zhu/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las gtor ma'i rim par phye ba ste bcu gcig pa'o // //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' chen po la bstod pa mdzad de/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po shin tu 'jigs/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /rdo rje'i 6)sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod / /gshin rje gshed po shin du 'jigs/ /rdo rje'i thugs dang rab mtshungs pa / /rin chen rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod / /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ / dbyangs mchog kun gyi 83—649

mchog gi mchog /①rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /gshin rje gshed po las kun pa/ /rdo rje'i sku dang rab mtshungs pa/ /phyag na ral gri phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab mchog gtso/ /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje'i mig dang rdo rje'i rna ba dang rdo rje'i sna dang rdo rje'i lce dang rdo rje'i lus dang rdo rje'i yid ces bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa ni ②mig la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa'i dam tshig go/ /de nas gshin rje gshed 'jigs kyi / /dkyil 'khor bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /gshin rje gshed po dang mtshungs pa/ /don rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /srad bu gsar pa legs bsgrims gshing / /mdzes shing tshad dang yang dag ldan/ /gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /shes rab can gyis thig gdab bo/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa/ /don med thams cad rnam po par 'jig(6 /zhi ba la sogs rab sgrub pa'i/ /maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor rnam pa la/ /las kyi rdo rje bri bya ste/ /de la rtse lnga mtha' dag la/ / de yi ⑦dbus su rdo rje bri/ /rdo rje 'bar bas kun tu 'khrigs/ /shar gyi chibazlo la 'khor lo bri/ /'khor lo'i 'od zer kun tu 'khrigs/ /lho ru rin chen bri bya (7ste/ /'od zer phreng bas kun tu khyab/ /nub tu pad+ma bri bya ste/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od zer mdzes/ /byang du ral gri bri bya ste/ /sprin gyi kha dog 'od zer mtshungs/ /shar gyi mtshams 997su 'khor lo bri/ /lho ru rdo rje bri bar bya/ /nub tu pad+ma bri bya ste/ /pad+ma gdong bcas rgyas pa'i zhal/ /byang du ral gri bri bya ste/ /'od zer lnga dang mtshungs par ldan/ /shar gyi sgo ru tho ba ste/ /rdo 83—650

rje dbyug pa lho ru'o/ /nub kyi sgo ru chu skyes te/ /rdo rje ral gri byang du'o/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par shes byas la/ /khyad par can gyis mchod bya ba/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis/ /the tshom med pas sangs rgyas mchod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i ①rgyud las dkyil 'khor chen po'i rim par phye ba ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang chen po la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba gdab bo/ /phyag rgya gsungs pas rab sbyor ba/ /gang gis rdo rje rnams la bstod/ /phyag rgya rdo rje phyag rgya yis/ /dngos grub mang po sgrub par mdzod/ /de nas rgyal po rdo rje 'chang / /tshig 'di dag ni gsung bar mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams thams cad kyi/ /spyi bor gshin rje gshed po bsgom/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor zlum byas la/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg ②mchod pa dang (mi/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsgrub bya zhing / /de yi sdom pa gzung bar bya / /dang po cod pan dbang bskur te/ /gnyis pa ral gri sbyin par bya/ /gsum pa rdo rje dril bu ste(pe/ /bzhi pa zla ba'i bza' ba'o/ /dbang bskur chen po bzhi pa ni/ / dmar po'i zhal nas 'byung ba stengage/ /dbang bskur 'di yi mthu yis ni/ /byang chub rgyal ba'i ro bcud 'thob/ /de nas bdag gis sngags bshad pas/ /'byung po kun la gtor ma bya/ /sngags chen po ni brjod pa yis/ /'byung po thams cad rab tu 'bar/ /sngags kyi sa bon hrīḥjiḥ83—651

sogs / /mthar ni swā hā nges par sbyar/ /bi ṭa ma ṭa 0)chu bsres kyis/ /maṇ+ḍal zur gsum byas nas ni/ /lha rnams mnyes bya rnal 'byor pas/ /hā hā zhes sgrogs slar dran bya/ /'khor lo rim gsum bya ba ni/ /brgyad dang bcu gnyis bcu drug dang ②/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bri/ /sngags ni kun tu dgod par bya/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bcu chaganyis par/ /grub pa'i sngags rnams dgod par bya/ /khams gsum g.yo dang mi g.yo ba/ /ma lus lus pa med pa 'grub/ /ya ma rā dzā (gas do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe (snyeya/ ya k+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya/ ya dbus (yik+ṣi ni shar du ste/ /ma yig 'jam pa'i rdo rje lhor( )/ /me yig nub tu bri bar bya/ /byang du da ni dkar po ste / /bsgrub bya'i ming ni bzung 98)byas nas/ /stong pa'i mtshams la dgod par bya / /hūṃ gnyis dag gis brten par bya/ /dgos pa thams cad sgrub par byed/ /yats+tsha ni ra dzā sa do ru/ ṇa yo ni ra zhes pas kyang ni phyi rol du/ g.yon nas brtsams shing po)yang dag bri/ /don kun rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /re'u yimig gsum pa'i mdun nas ni/ /re'u (1mig cha re spangs par ni/ /shar nas brtsams te bri bar bya/ /hrīḥthiḥzhes pa'i sngags rnams kyis/ /re'u 7mig brgyad kyi bar bar du/ /re'u yo mig rnams la yang dag bri/ /che ge mo ku ru mā ra ya/ uts+tsha ṭa ya/ ba shaṃ ku ru/ bi de ṣa ya shārnyi yiku ru/ puṣ+ṭi ku ru/zhes pa la sogs pa ni las kyi rjes su 'brangs te/ oṃ ni dang por 7na maḥmathar / /mthar ni ba shaṃ bo ṣa ṭa/ /hūm̐ phaṭa yi ge dang ldan pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang du byed pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las dbang bskur ba dang 'khrul 'khor gyi 83—652

snang ba zhes bya ba'i rim par phye ba ste bcu gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das kyis brtse bar mdzad/ /gshin rje gshed chen yang dag gzugs / /zhe snang gis mnan 'gro la gzigs/ /zhe sdang thams cad zad par mdzad / /bcom ldan 'das kyis brtse bar mdzad/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed mchog gzugs/ /gti mug gis mnan 'gro la gzigs/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis brtse bar mdzad/ /phra ma gshin rje gshed mchog gzugs/ /phra mas tu)mnan pa'i 'gro la gzigs/ /phra ma thams cad zad par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis brtse bar mdzad/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed mchog gzugs/ /'dod chags kyis mnan 'gro la gzigs/ /'dod chags thams cad zad par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis brtse bar mdzad/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed mchog gzugs/ /phrag dog gis mnan 'gro la gzigs/ /phrag dog thams cad zad par mdzad/ /byams pa tsartsi kār gsungs te/ /phag mo de bzhin snying rje'o/ /dbyangs can dga' bar shes bya ste/ /btang snyoms gi rī'i gzugs su'o/ /bdag nyid dngos po thams cad kyis/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs pa/ /rnal 'byor snying ga'i 95)sa bon spro'i / /'grub (ge)'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas spyod pa'i mtshan nyid mchog /bdag gis yang dag bshad par bya/ /gshin rje gshed po'i 'jigs gzugs kyi/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams dag /dgon pa chen po'i phyogs rnams la/ /ma he mchog la zhon byas te/ /sbrul gyi (5)rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /lcags kyi rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /skra ni dmar ser gyen du 83—653

'khyil / /khyad du 'phags pa'i gzugs can bya/ /mgo la thod pas yang dag bskor / /sma ra ①dmar ser brjes pa ste/ /hrīḥdhīḥl sogs sngags rnams brjod / /rdo rje dbyug pa yang dag gsor/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pas / /seng ge'i sgra ni bsgrag (snyepar bya/ /cung zad mthu ni thob ①pa yis/ /grong khyer zhugs te rol par bya/ /rab mdzes gar ni bya ba dang / /drug 'gyur la sogs glu blang ngo / /srang du rgyal mtshan de blta zhing / /de la 'o ma rab tu bsgrub / /'o ma la 'dris rtse gcig sems/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub bya/ /phag ④mo'i gzugs su bsgom byas la/ /'dod pa'i mtha' la btsun mo kun/ /seng ge bzhin du 'jigs med pas/ /'dod don kun 'grub rnal 'byor pa'i/ /de nas phyag rgya phyirab bsgrub pa/ /bdag gis yang dag rab bshad bya/ /yi ge gcig gi sngags chen te/ /de yi bzlas pa nges par bshad/ /jiḥyig sa bon las byung ba'i/ /ma he'i gdong pa rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ /ma he'i steng du bsgom par bya/ /gang zhig sa la gnas pa yi / /sna tshogs ma tshon cha'i rang gzugs rnams/ /blo dang ldan pas lag na bsgom(nyam/ /ma he'i gdong can sgrub pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje dbyug pa yi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /yi ge hrīḥni gsang sngags che/ /ma he chen po la zhon pa/ /'bum phrag gnyis ni rdzogs pa'i phyag /thal ba'i rdul gyis lus la byugs/ /ri rab bzhin du mtho ba la/ /ro ldan 'og du yang dag gnon/ /de nas phyag ni bye ba yi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /wi kṛ gtā na na gsang sngags che/ /hūm̐ yig las byung gtso bo ste/ /oṃ wi kṛ (7tā na na haṃ hā hi dzi)hoḥ/ hūm̐ he heḥ0hoḥhaḥswā hā/ dgos pa thams cad rab sgrub pa'i/ /dam tshig 83—654

sgrub pa 'dir bshad do/ /sngags kyis dub la kha zas bza'/ /kha na ma tho med rnyed blang / /sha chen de bzhin rta dang ni/ /de bzhin glang chen khyad par can/ /ba lang ①gzugs dang khyi dang ni/ /bong bu rnga mo ce ②spyang ngo / /rams dang bsres nishing btso byas nas/ /zhag chen lus la mngon par byug④ /'di yis lus la byugs tsam gyis/ /'gro ba mtha' dag dbang du byed/ /rnam snang sin du bā rañtsa/ /de bzhin bil ba'i lo ma dang / /so phag phye ma lhan cig tu/ /gser shing lo ma'i khu ba (snyernams/ /'di yi (7lus la dril phyis bya/ /rdo rje chen po'i bdud rtsi bzhin/ /rang 'byung me tog btung ba bzhin/ /'di ni rnal 'byor rab mchog go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las spyod pa'i dam tshig sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i dam tshig tsartsi kā'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / rdo rje phag mo'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / dbyangs can ma'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / gi rī ma'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa las mchod pa'i glu 'dis gsol ba gdab bo/ /e ma gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i rang bzhin te/ /bdag ni khyod mthong bas 'jigs pas/ /bla ma khro bo'i (cherang bzhin spangs(9/ /mtho ris sa steng 5nyes 'og rnams/ /khyod kyi gar gyis g.yo bar byed/ /khrag gi mig sman khro ba'i sems / /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs gzugs/ /dmar zhing thung ba'i tshad 83—655

ldan pa/ /rnam pa mang po'i sprul gzugs byed/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis zhus / /khyod kyi gar mdzad bde ba che/ /khyod kyi hrīḥdhīḥ'i sngags kyi gar/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul ba sol/ /brtse bas khro ba'i rje btsun khyod/ /'gro la blta zhing gar mdzad do/ /de nas bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid mchog /bdag gis yang dag rab bshad bya/ /gang gis bzlas 0)pa rab sbyor bas/ /mang po yis ni dngos grub 'thob/ /myur ba ma yin bul (mib min/ /ring po ma yin thung ba min / /cung zad sngags ni thos par ro/ /gshin rje gshed kyi slob dpon mchog /mi dang ma he gnyis 'thung dang / /ba lang zhugazugs dang rta dang ni/ /bong bu rnga mo'i rus bzung (4)nas/ /bzlas pa'i phreng bas rab bsgrub ⑤bya/ /zla ba zla ba'i bcu bzhi la/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa yikhyi/ /sha lnga yis ni byug ⑦par bya/ /bzlas pa yis ni dngos grub mchog /so so'i rkang pa'i ril bu la/ /gshin rje gshed sgom rnal 8)'byor pas/ /mkhas pas yang na mi mgo ni/ /khrag 'dzag rlon pa bsgom par bya/ /khri yi sngags kyis 'byung po rnams/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams stong gis te/ /gshin rje gshed po rab sbyor bas/ /yi dgas rnams ni gzhom zhing bsad99)/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid 'bum bzlas na/ /las kun de yis byed par 'gyur/ /bye ba bzlas na dngos grub ste/ /bye ba sngo yis smos ci dgos/ /nyi ma so so'am yang na zla/ /yang na lo ni so so la/ /mkhas pas dbyug gu drug cu 1 tshobazhi'i/ /gtor ma drug cu 31rtsa bzhi sbyin/ /'ga' zhig rtag tu bza' ba dang / /'ga' zhig de bzhin btung ba dang / /gzhan yang bza' ba thams cad kyi/ /dang po gshin rje gshed la dbul7/ /de nas bla mar yon gyi mchog /dbul bar bya ba dag bshad bya/ /bdag nyid zhi 83—656

ba'i phyir dang ni/ /de bzhin las kun sgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi lus dbul ①nges par 'dud/ /rta dang ba lang ( glang po dang / /gser dang nor dang ①ma ma dang / /rang gi chung ma de bzhin bu/ /ma dang sring mo tsha mo dang / /gos ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /gdugs dang mdzes pa'i rnga yab dang / /khyim dang khri dang dri bzangs lidang / /glu dang de bzhin rol mo dang / /ral gri rgyan rnams de bzhin du/ /brtul zhugs can gyis bla mar dbul/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las thabs thams cad sgrub pa'i rim par phye ba ste bcwa phyi lnga pa'o⑨// //de nas sems can thams cad kyi bdud dang 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa gcod cing gzhom pa'i don gyi phyir sku mdog dmar po'o/ /spyan gsum ni 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi dus gsum mo/ /phyag gnyis ni dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa rnams 'joms pa'o/ /shes rab ma la 'khyud pa ni stong pa nyid dang snying rje tha mi dad par sbyor ba'o/ /klu brgyad ni rnam par shes pa brgyad du gsungs so/ /mgo bo'i brgya phyed phreng ⑦ba ni yi ge lnga bcu sbyor ba'o/ /g.yon na thod pa ni (kyeyi shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis yongs su gang zhing stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /g.yas na dbyug pa ni phung po dang nyon mongs pa dang lha'i bu dang 'chi ba'i bdud rnams 'joms shing snying rje'i rang bzhin no/ /zhabs g.yon brkyang ba ni khams gsum du bshad do / /lha mo'i phyag g.yon na thod pa bdud bzhi'i khrag dpag tu med pa dngul chu dang bcud len dang ro bcud do/ /g.yas na dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i 83—657

rnam par rtog pa gcod pa'i gri gug go/ /khro bo'i gzugs phyal rgyas pa ni gdug pa can rnams 'dul ba'o/ /skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa ni sprul pa dpag tu med pa'i phyir ro/ /gru bzhi ni sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden par bshad do/ /sgo bzhi ni bdud bzhi skrag par byed pa'o/ /zur bzhi ni tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi rab tu rdzogs pa'i phyir ro/ /ka ba brgyad ni sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad kyi phyir te/ sprul pa'i grong khyer dang sgra brnyan dang sgyu ma dang sprin dang ri dgas srid lhonyedang me long dang gzugs brnyan dang chu zla'o/ /nam mkha' ni dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i phyir ro/ /yang dag par spong ②ba ni dra ba dra phyed do/ /rta babs bzhi ni sbyin pa dang snyan par smra ba dang don spyod pa dang don mthun ①pa bzhi'i rnam par dag pa'o/ /de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'isti/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus song nas/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog bsams te/ /rtse lnga pa ni rnam par bsgom/ / de yi ⑤steng du pad+ma dgodasti/ /'di mdog nag la ⑦'jigs chen mo/ /phyag drug mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan ma/ /phyag na rdo rje rnam par bsgom/ /lhag ma'i phyag tu gzhan dgod do/ /shar du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug gti mug dang mtshungs pa/ /phyag na 'khor lo 'jigs chen mo/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ /phra ma dang mtshungs phyag drug ma/ /phyag na rin chen 'jigs chen mo/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /nub tu chos kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug pad+ma 'dzin pa mo/ /byang na las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor ral gri ma/ /me la sogs pa'i mtshams 98)bzhi la/ /brtul zhugs po)can 842—658

gyis lha mo bsgom/ /dri ma de bzhin gar 0)ma dang / /glu ma sgeg mo khyad par can / /de nas sgo skyong bsgom par bya/ /cho ga bzhin du las rnams blta/ /tho ba dbyug pa pad ral gril/ /oṃ bud+dha ḍā ①gi nī/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ④kyi nī/ oṃ dharma ḍā ①kyi nī/ oṃ rat+na ḍā duki nī/ lī rmā nī ṭ+wāṃ mtshams su'o/ /oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥ/oṃ daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma bam̐/ oṃ khan hoḥ7/ zhes pa ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can gyis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa'o/ /ring po dunas thos pa bsgrub pa'i phyir rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i sngags kyi tshig rnams ni 'di yin te/ oṃ ā kā dhisha tsa ra badz+ra ḍā ki nī kyiswā hā/ de nas/gzhan yang rdo rje sa 'og yigi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /sa 'og bu ga bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gnod mdzes rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /phyag drug kha dog sngon po la/ /phyag na gtun ⑩shing 'dzin par byed/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /'di ni rab tu spyod par byed/ /shar la spyan ma dgod ⑫bya ste/ /lho ru de bzhin mā ma tī/ /nub tu lha mo gos dkar mo/ /byang du sgrol ma dgod 8par bya/ /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri rnams me sogs rnams la dgod/ /sgo la tho ba la sogs te/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis ske rags byas/ /de bzhin 'khor lo bsgom bya zhing / /cho ga blta bas las rnams so/ /rdo rje sa 'og sbyor ldan pas/ /rmi lam du ni bu ga shes/ /de nas rgyal po bdun gyi ni/ /dkyil 'khor bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /mkha' spyod rab tu bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /rta mchog rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /zhal gcig pa dang phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog sngon po 'jigs par byed/ /nyi ma'i steng du gnas pa ste/ /shin tu 'jigs byed rta yi gdong / /g.yas na ral gri 8khu tshur te/ /phyag drug g.yon 83—659

na ①thod pa'o/ /oṃ phu phu tī tī/ shes rab can gyis sngags 'di bzla/ /rta mchog rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /shar la bhi da bī (snyebasgom bya/ /lho phyogs su ni myur 'gro ma/ /nub tu bdun pa'i rgyal mo ste/ /rta mchog ma ni byang du dgod/ /bdag po'i zhal dang phyag bzhin du/ /thams cad de bzhin mtshungs par bsgom//sngags 'dis thams cad mtshungs pa dang / /spro ba ru ni rab tu grags/ /gling bu pi wang rnga zlum dang / /rnga bran rnams kyang zur la dgod/ /ba lang gyisna dang glang chen sna/ /de bzhin bzhin bzang bzhin ngan ma/ /gtun shing dang ni sta re dang / /lcags kyu dang ni zhags pa'o/ /gar la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis//sgo bzhi la ni rtag tu bsgom/ /nas ljang snye (4)ma dang bcas bsam rang gi rtags rnams de bzhin g.yas/ /ji ltar rta mchog gi ni sngags/ /rdo rje sa 'og gi yang ngo / /rta mchog bsgom pa'i sbyor ba las/ /khams gsum mkha' la rgyu bar byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las dngos grub nges pa'i rim par phye ba ste bcu drug pa'o // //de la 'dir thig gdab pa'i dam tshig mchog ni/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ḍā (5)mā r+ya nut+pa n+da tāta )/ dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed gzugs/ /slob ma rnam par snang mdzad bya/ /ye shes thig mchog rtse dag gzung (pe/ /mnyam gzhag nas ni legs par gdab/ /de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por rab tu 'jug pa'i dam tshig go/ /oṃ āḥtsū/ dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur ring ba la/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha yis sbom/ /ba yi rnam lngas legs par byugan /skud pa gnyis su med par 8(3—660

brtag /de la 'di ni rdo rje chen por rab tu 'jug pa'i dam tshig ste/ kye ma sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /kye ma chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la byin/ /de la 'di ni sa chen po yongs su gzung ba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje sa yi lha mo spyan drangs la/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /sgo ni dkyil 'khor brgyad cha ru / /bdag nyid chen pos ①shes bya ste/ /khams chen po ni ma gtogs pa'i/ /tshad ldan shin tu mdzes pa'o/ /sgo dang sgo khyud des shes bya/ /de yi phyed kyis snam bu ste/ /glu ma rnga ma gar ma sogs/ /rdo rje'i lha mo yang dag ldan/ /de yi phyed kyis rdul tshon sa/ /sgo yi phyed kyis 'gram dang logs/ /'dir yang dra ba dra phyed dang / /nyi ma zla ba me tog phreng / / lha yi ⑤snam bu dang po'i tshad/ /de bzhin phyi yi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de la snying po chen po 'di/ /bdag gis 'khor lo nam mkhar dgod/ /rang gi phyag rgya'ang de ru brten/ /dam tshig ye shes gzhug byas nas/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /shar du dkar po chen po ste/ /lho ru ser po dang ldan pa/ /dmar po nub kyi cha la ste/ /byang du ma ra ka ta naldan/ /in+d+ra nī la'i 'od mtshungs pa/ /dbus kyi sa gzhir yang dag bri/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /de yi phyag rgya dgod par bya/ /dbus su rdo rje yang dag bri/ /shar la 'khor lo legs par bri/ /de lta bu la lasogs par blta/ /phyag rgya rtag tu nam mkha' mtshungs/ /de la blugs gzar dgang gzar tshad/ /'di yi tshad kyis yu ba bya/ /khru gang tshad dang ldan pa la/ /de yi rtse mor dkyil 'khor bya/ /sor mo bzhi yi tshad ldan la/ /gting du sor 83—661

gnyis zab pa la/ /de la sor phyed bcud khung du/ /blugs gzar pad ma'i rnam pa bzhin/ /mthe bo'i lto gang tshad la ni/ /gting du sor mo'i tshad ldan nol/ /rgyud 'di la ni rab tu bsngags6)/ /dkyil 'khor du ni ma zhugs shing / /mtshams med lnga ni byas pa dang / /gang gis srog ②chags gsod pa dang / /nya dang sha sogs za ba dang / /chang dang 'dod ma la chags dang / /chad lta'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa dang / /mngon par dbang ni ma bskur dang / /bya ba ma yin byed spro dang / /grong khyer dbyen byed bas kyang ni/ /dmar po'i gsung ni ji lta bar/ /gshin rje gshed rgyud mchog la gzhol/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa'i rdo rje'i byang chub sems dpa' kun gyis rdo rje chen po'i sngon med pa'i gsung thos pas cang mi smra bar gyur gto/ /de la 'di ni rdo rje dbab pa'i dam tshig ste/ de yang 'byung ba'i sa bon che/ /'khor lo bzhi po rab bsgrub bya/ /gnas bzhir rab tu sbyong ④ba yis/ /nam mkha' yang ni g.yo bar byed/ /rkang pa dag gi 'og tu yo/ /lte bar raṃ ste snying gar srilo/ /mgo bo la ni baṃ yig go/ /gzhu yi rnam pa nag po che/ /gtum po'i rlung ni 'jigs byed pa/ /sreg 'byed zur gsum me bzhin 'bar/ /nyi ma dmar po'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /rdo rje'i (pes gzhi'i rim pa ni/ /ser po chen po gru bzhi pa/ /ri rab ri yis mnan pa yi/ /nor 'dzin de (kyeni bsgom par byam/ /dkar po zlum po bum pa bzhin/ /sprin bzhin du ni char pa 'dzin/ /stong gis rab tu gang ba yi/ /gangs kyi ri bo lta bur bsil/ /gnas bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /slob ma rdo rje can la bsgom/ /rdo rje snang ba mtha' yas sbyor/ /myur ba nyid du 'bebs par byed/ /de la 'di ni dri ba'i dam tshig go/ /rdo rje 8(2—662

chos ni mgon chen ①po/ /snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che/ /gsungs shig 'dod chags chos chen po/ /dge dang mi dge legs par 'dri/ /khru gang nas ni bzung genas ni/ /ji srid khru ni stong gi bar/ /slob ma chen po 'phar bar 'gyur / /'di ni dbab pa'i dam tshig go/ /ri mo bri ba'i mtshan nyid rnams/ /bdag gis yang dag bshad par bya/ /sa ni snum pa blangs byas la/ /brtul zhugs can gyis mnan ①par bya/ /sran gre de bzhin 'o ma sha /bu ram bse yab la sogs pa/ /til dang nim pa'i lo ma dang / /de bzhin nā ṭī'i ④sa bon no / /dang po dkar po bri bar bya/ /de la kha dog gzhan gyis bri/ / thod lo kor ⑤dang btsag dag la/ /chu yis sbyar bas rgya skyegs bzhin/ /yung ba dang ni rams dag las/ /de bzhin kha dog ljang gur yi'agyur/ /sngon po rtag tu rams ⑦kyis so/ /de bzhin me drag nag po ste/ /skya ⑧bo de bzhin ba 0bla yis/ /de bzhin dmar po mtshal gyis so/ /ka bed khu ba de la sbyin/ /chung ngus ma yin lhag de bzhin/ /lhag pas nag po dman pa yis/ /skya bo ru ni 'gro bar byed / /khro dang zhi ba rnam gnyis kyi/ /gzugs kyi mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /zhi ba sgeg por gsungs pa ste/ /khro bo sbom la thung bar thos/ /sor mo bzhi yi ⑩tshad kyis ni/ /dpral ba de bzhin kha la'o/ /mgrin pa de bzhin 'gram pa dang / /gsang gnas la ni sor bzhi'i tshad/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi yis lag /sor mo nyi shu bar lhu'otun/ /lag pa rkang pa de bzhin gdong / /mig la mthe bo'i tshad yin te/ /rna ba la ni sor gnyis gsungs/ /sgo nga'i sbubs la de bzhin bzhi / /mchu gnyis dag la sor gnyis so/ /lte ba'i zabs su sor mo ste/ /mgrin pa ma gtogs lus la ni/ /gdong gi sum 'gyur dag tu 'dod/ /ral 83—663

pa rnams ni gdong gi tshad/ /rin chen dbu rgyan sor mo drug /de nas 'phags ma sor 0)mo yi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /gang gis bsgom ②pa tsam gyis ni/ /chu yi steng du 'chags par byed/ /ser nimo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /phu yig sa bon las byung ba/ /phyag na sbrul dang gzugs chen mo/ /rma bya la ni zhon ( )par dgyes/ /shar la rma bya ma dgod do/ /lho ru de bzhin khro gnyer can/ /nub tu ri khrod lo ma can/ /byang du rdo rje lcags sgrog ⑤ma/ /rma bya'i sgro dang spyi blugs dang / /yal ga de bzhin lcags sgrog ste/ /de rnams rnam par bsgom par bya/ /ser po dmar po ljang gu 6)dang / /kha dog sngon po'i dbye ba nyid/ /shes rab can gyis de bzhin bsgom/ /de bzhin du ni sngags 'di bzlas/ /o phu dzaḥr/ tho ba la sogs sgo la dgod/ /me tog la sogs mtshams (7)su'o/ /ār+ya dzi gu li'i sbyor ldan pas/ /chu yi steng du rtag tu 'gro / /de nas ku ru kul+le yi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /klu yi bu mo 'gugs par byed/ /kha dog dmar po zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag brgyad dang ni yang dag ldan/ /hrīḥyig sa bon las byung ba / /klu rnams 'gugs par byed pa'o/ /mtha' yas la sogs klu rigs brgyadam/ /phyag brgyad du ni dgod par bya/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis sku la brgyan/ /brtul zhugs can gyis mdzes ma bsgom/ /sngags ni ku ru kul+le hrīḥphuḥ(guswā hā/de nas rgyas min mdor bsdus pas/ /gsang ba pa ni bshad par bya/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha yi bu mo 'gugs par byed/ /zhal gcig ma dang phyag gnyis ma/ /phyag na mda' dang gzhu bsnams (9pa/ /lus ni ser po chen po yi/ /lus med rnam par bsgom par bya/ /shar du dga' ma bsgom par bya/ /8 2—664

myos byed mdzes ma lho ru bsgom/ /nub tu 'dod pa'i lha mo ste/ /byang du myos par spro ma'o/ /'dod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyi/ /lag na mda' dang gzhu bsgom mo/ /ser dang dmar dang de bzhin ljang / /dkar dmar nyid rnams bsgom par bya/ /mtshams 0)su rtag tu rgod ma dang / /ma 'gags ma dang dbang byed ma/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan zhes pa rnams/ /sgo yi cha la rab tu bshad / /'dod 'gying dang ni snyems can dang / /dran pa de bzhin mtshams kyi bdag /lha rnams de dag thams cad kyi/ /spyi bor gshin rje gshed po bsgom / /bud med rnams kyis nam mkha'i gdong / /mtha' la rdo rje lus med sgom ske/ /shīta yig ⑤sngags las yang dag byung / /kun du rnam par 'phro ba ste/ /bslus shing g.yeng ba bsgom par bya/ /myos pas (gebade ba 'dod yid kyis/ /gos ni dmar pos yongs dkris te/ /rkang pa dag gi drung du lhung / /de la sngags ni shin tu bzla/ /oṃ yig dbyangs kyi dbye ba dang / /swā hā'i yi ge mtha' mar sbyin/ /shī ta yi ge'i sngags rnams brjod/ /che ge mo ni bdag dbang gis/ /dmar po'i gsung ni ji bzhin du/ /thams cad du ni bsgoms ⑤byas na/ /rnal 'byor pa yi 'dod pa 'thob/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las lus (5)med pa la sogs pa'i rim par phye ba ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas he ru ka chen gyi/ /sgrub thabs bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bas bcings pa las/ /gang zhig shes pas myur grol ba/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis te/ /sku mdog sngon po gtum po che/ /phyag na rdo rje 83wa 665

bsgom par bya/ /gzhan la thod pa dgod par bya/ /spyan gsum spa ①ni gyen du brjes / /phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni g.yon gyi char/ /rkang gdub chen pos rnam par brgyan/ /ju yig sa bon las byung ba/ /yi dgas steng bzhugs rtag tu 'dzum/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rab sbyor bas/ /thod pa lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /mi bskyod pa yi cod pan bsam/ /he ru kur grags rnam par bsgom/ /shar du chos kyi 'khor lo bri/ /sangs rgyas byang chub lho ru'o/ /'dod lnga'i khro shing nub tu ste/ /byang du he ru ka dang mtshungs/ /sna tshogs gzugs can sgeg pa la/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gzugs mdzes yi dgas ②steng du ste/ /gti mug thams cad nyer 'joms ma chos kyi 'khor lo de bzhin gzhan/ /yid bzhin nor dang dpag bsam shing / /bum pa bzang po de (gubasgom bya/ /lha mo rnams ni byaphyag g.yas na/ /rdo rje yang ni bsgom (snyepar bya/ /dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor thams cad la/ /thod pa'i snod ni g.yon du'o/ /spyan dang mā ma tī sgrol ma/ /gos dkar shin tu yid 'ong rnams / /me la sogs pa'i mtshams 96bzhi la/ /phyi yi 'khor lor gshin rje gshed / /shes rab mthar byed rta mgrin dang / /bdud rtsi 'khyil bcas bsgom par bya/ /'khor lo yi ni sgo srungs te/ /las rnams cho ga mthong ba yis/ /rnam pa lnga ni bsgoms 97)byas nas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rnam par bsgom/ /'khor lo bsgom bya rnal 'byor pas/ /glu bzhi rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /'khor lo can ni bskul bar bya/ /tsartsi kā sogs snyan pa'i glu/ /drug 'gyur la sogs glu rnams kyis/ /brtse bas khro ba'i rje btsun bzhengs/ /sa gsum po yi gti mug sol(1—/ /bsam du med pa'i rje btsun bzhengs/ /bdud bzhi rnams las rgyal 83—666

bar mdzad①/ /'jig rten mgon pos stod ②par bzhugs/ /'jig rten bsod nams rje btsun bzhengs/ /byang chub dngos la 'jig rten mgon/ /khyod ni stong nyid sems par mdzad/ /ji ltar skar ma 'phro ba ltar/ /byang chub sems ni de la zhugs/ /brtse bas chags pa'i sems zhu ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid do/ /dang por rnal 'byor bsgom par bya/ /rjes su rnal 'byor gnyis pa'o/ /shin tu rnal 'byor gsum pa'o/ /rnal 'byor chen po bzhi pa'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdzogs pa la/ /rnal 'byor zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /lha yi sku ni rdzogs pa la/ /rjes su rnal 'byor zhes grags so/ /'khor lo thams cad rdzogs pa la/ /shin tu rnal 'byor yin par 'dod/ /lha yi mig sogs byin brlab dang / /sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams dang / /ye shes 'khor lo rab gzhug dang / /de bzhin bdud rtsi myang ba dang / /mchod dang bstod pa chen po ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po zhes 'dod do/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya / /bde gshegs bka' las mi 'da' ste/ /de bzhin spun la khro ba dang / /nyes pa bsgrag par mi bya'o/ /sems can kun la byams pa'i sems/ /nam yang gtang bar mi bya'o/ /byang chub sems kyang gtang mi bya / /bdag gzhan chos la sun mi dbyung / /yongs su ma smin gsems can la/ /gsang ba bsgrag par mi bya'o/ /bdag gi phung po smad mi bya/ /bcom ldan chos ni sun mi dbyung / /gdug pa'i byams pa rtag tu spang / /chos la tshad gzhal ④mi bya'o/ /sems can dad pa can mi bslu/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsten par bya/ /bud med shes rab rang bzhin la/ /smod pa'i nyes pa de bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor slong rinamos rgyu mi bya/ /rnal 'byor spang bar mi bya ste/ /rtag par kun du gsang sngags 83—667

bzla / /rtag tu dam tshig la ①sogs bsten/ /gal te bag med gyur pa yis/ /bla ma'i dam tshig las nyams na/ /des ni dkyil 'khor blum po bri/ /bde gshegs rnams la nyes pa bshags/ /dad pas bla ma'i dam tshig bsrung / /snying rje can gyis mi rtog par/ /nyes pa ma lus spang sems kyis/ /bsam gtan la gzhol bzlas mchog gzhol/ /brtan zhing dul la brtse ba'i sems/ /dad dang lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / /mchog tu bzod pa 'dzin pa yi/ /skyes bu rtag tu bla mar bya/ /slob ma bla ma la gus dang / /gshin ②rje gshed la rab gus pa/ /brtul zhugs can gyis yongs smin bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba chen po mchog tu dga' ba'i ngo bo nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i gsung nye bar thos nas cang mi smra bar gyur to/ /'di lta bu'i ched du ②brjod do/ /'khrul 'khor mthar thug gshin rje gshed/ /brtul zhugs mthar thug thod pa che/ /rgyud kyi mthar thug 'dus pa ste/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /e ma zhi ba chen po'i chos/ /e ma khro bo 'jigs mdzad pa/ /e ma mya ngan 'das pa'i mchog /e ma 'khor ba zhi ba nyid/ /e ma 'di ni rab tu mtshar/ /nyes pa gang de yon tan 'gyur/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa'ang med/ /khams kyang med cing rnam shes med/ /nam mkha'i dkyil dang mtshungs pa nyid/ /nam mkha' bzhin du bdag med pa/ /chos 'di bde ba chen po'o/ /sa yang med cing chu yang med/ /me med rlung med nam mkha' med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab sbyor bas/ /bskyed pa 'di ( 7ni rab tu gnas/ /dngos po thams cad dngos med bshad(57/ /des na rang bzhin med ces bsgrags/ /rnal 'byor 83—668

sbyor ba dang ldan pas/ /chad pa ma yin rtag pa min/ /yan lag med cing kha dog med/ /dngos po thams cad bden par med/ /thog ma bar dang mtha' ma spangs/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /de nas tsartsi kā la sogs pas ched du brjod pa 'di brjod do/ /bsod nams sdig pa dag dang ma 'brel bas / /mchog tu dga' ba dri med rnam dag pa/ /de bzhin nyid kyi gter chen gcig pu ni/ /kurno nas snying rje'i sems kyis rab tu gnas/ /mchog tu dga' ba 'di yi ngo bo ni/ /chos rnams ngo bo bde ba chen po'i dngos/ /gzugs med bsod nams med cing sdig pa med/ /skye dang 'gag pa dag ni yod ma yin/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las byang chub sems kyi rim par phye ba ste bcwa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gtam rgyud rab tu bshad par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das mngon par byang chub pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la byang chub la bar du gcad 0)pa'i phyir shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i 'jigs pa chen po ston cing bdud kyi dpung gi tshogs chen po dpag tu med pa lhags te/ de'i dus na bdud chen po las mchog tu rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams las gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo nges par phyung ste/ nges par phyung nas kyang phyag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i bka' bzhin byed pa la/ phyag na rdo rje khyod 'di lta bu'i gshin rje gshed kyi khro bo'i gzugs su bsgyur na te/ bdud dang / gnod sbyin dang /83—669

lha ma yin dang / lha dang / srin po rnams skrag cing 'jigs pa dang sod cig ces gsungs so/ /de'i dus na ji ltar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa thos te/ skad cig la bzung ①zhing don bzung ②ste/ bsdus nas shin tu dga' bas legs par sems bskyed do/ /gsang ba'i bdag po chen po la / /'di skad ces ni bka' stsal to/ /pha rol grong du rab 'jug pa'i/ /thabs rnams rab tu gsal bya ste/ /'gro dang 'ong bar 'dod pa yis/ /ting nge 'dzin dang gsang sngags bzla/ /bye ba bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur te/ /bye ba lnga yis smos ci dgos/ /dang po de nas brtsam par bya/ /bdag nyid nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /dang por goms par bya ba'i dus/ /sems la sems nyid gzhug par bya/ /dper na sems 'di rmi lam na/ /'gro dang slar yang bzlog par bya/ /skad cig la ni de bzhin gnas/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sbyor goms pas / /dper na mtshon cha gnas byas nas/ /gzhu yis mda' ni 'phen pa ste/ /de bzhin 'dir yang yid kyi lagazhus/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'gro bar byed/ /zla ba nyi ma sbyor ba yis/ /rlung gis sems ni gzhug par bya/ /lus ni rnam par spangs nas ni/ /de la yid ni 'gro dang 'jug /cung zad drod ni rnyed pa yis//thob pa'i phyogs su sgom pa po/ /lus kyi nang du 'jug pa ni/ /dper na grong gzhan las 'gro zhing / /zla ba nyi ma'i 'gros 'joms shing / /sgra gcan 'jug pa sbyor ba yis/ /bgrod pa'i gnas ni thob pa na/ /rlung gi bzhin pa'i sbyor ba yis / /'chi ltas ④mtshan nyid shes byas la/ /cho ga mtshan nyid ldan pas bgrod / /ji ltar 'dod pa g.yo mi g.yo/ /rang 'dod kun tu skye bar 'gyur/ /thur (5)sel 'og lam gsang ba'i mtha'/ /gtong zhing lte bar rtsom par byed/ /83—670

ṇa yo ni ra ya yig la sogs pa gshin rje 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /gti mug k+ṣe yig la brjod bya/ /phra ma nyid brjod ma yig la'o/ /'dod chags nyid kyang me yig la/ /da yig la yang phrag dog yin/ /lnga rnams gshin rje 'joms par bsgragasal/ /dza yig tsartsi ka ru brjod/ /sa yig la ni phag mo ste/ /dbyangs can ma brjod do yig la/ /ru yig la ni gi rīr 'dod/ /ṇa yo ni ra zur bzhi ru / /mi yi thod pa bzhi rnams so/ /de nas nges par bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnga' bdag gshin rje gshed ①rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ zhe sdang chen po'i rigs 'di sgom pa'i rnal 'byor 'di gsungs so/ /sbyin pa tshul khrims bzod par ldan/ /blo bzang sems can don dang gcig② /byams sogs yon tan yang dag rdzogs/ /dad dang thos pas rnam par brgyan / /brtse ba'i bdag nyid can snga dro/ /thog mar kha sogs dag byas te/ /skye bos dben phyogs dur khrod sogs/ /bde ba'i stan la rang brtsam bya/ /rang nyid pad+mar nyi ma la/ /rnam bkod shin tu gsal ba'i blta/ /de 'od rnams kyis sems can don/ /phun tshogs byas nas spyan drangs te/ /bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas bsgom bya/ /ma lus mkha' dkyil rnams khyab pa/ /dmigs te de rnams la ni phyag /lus kyi tshogs kyis rnam par brtson / /tsartsi ka sogs rnams kyis mchod/ /de nas sdig pa rab bshags bya/ /lus ngag yid kyis yang dag sdig /byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin du/ /gang yang rjes su yi rang ba/ /mgon po dus gsum byas de bshags/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang mtshungs rnams kyi/ /bsod nams tshogs la rjes yi rang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dam chos bcas/ /tshogs mchog rnams la skyabs su mchi//83—683

yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la①/ /rang lus dag ni dbul bar bgyi/ /dam chos thams cad ston mdzad cing / /shin tu mthar thug mdzes par bzhugs/ /yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas dam chos/ /de nyid sbyin sogs rang bzhin la/ /sku gsum ye shes thob phyir du/ /rab tu dang bas gnas par bgyi/ /sems can rnams kyi don bsgrub ②phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ /bsod nams yang dag nyer sgrub gang / /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs bsngo/ /dpal ldan gshin rje mthar byed du/ /gyur nas bdag gis 'gro phan bgyi/ /smon lam 'di ni btab byas te/ /de dang de rnams blos gshegs bya/ /brtse bas cho ga bzhin bltas te/ /sna tshogs stong par rnam bsam bya/ /sbyor ba bral ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rgyu nyid kyis dang mtshan ma med/ /rnam par rtog dang bral nyid phyir/ /smon pa rnam par spangs pa'o/ /oṃ shun+ya tā dz+nyā nā ①badz+ra swā bha wa ād+ma ko3rtali/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ lo dkyil 'khor bzhin(snye/ /bsdus pa'i r+ghaṃ yig las skyes pa'i/ /khang pa brtsegs pa bsgom par bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi yis brgyan pa ste/ /do shal do shal phyed pas spras/ /lha dang lha mos legs par mdzes/ /sna tshogs rtse mo rlung bskyod pa'i/ /ba dan dril bu mnyam par ldan/ /de yi dbus gnas paṃ yig gis/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rnam (yebasam bya/ /der ni lte ba'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /sna tshogs rdo rje dbyug par bcas / /mtshan ma mtha' dag yongs gyur nas/ /zhe snang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom97 / /pad+ma nyi ma mnyam mnan cing / /ma he dmar po'i steng bzhugs pa/ /g.yon brkyang pa yi zhabs kyis ni/ /bdud rnams thams cad nges 'joms pa/ /nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ldan lha/ /ro langs ma yis mgrin mkhyud cing / /dpa' bo 83—684

so / /oṃ ā+oṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣa yaṃ ka rā ya/ grisna grisna ①rgyu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā snyi pa ta ye ma hā dur dān+ta da ma kā ya nā sha la nā sha ②ya/ bi drwa pa ya bi dā pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ phreng ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ de ṣa ra ti nu da nu da tru ṭa tru ṭa hūṃ dzaḥswā hā/ rje btsun ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ mo hā n+ta ཿkṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pi shu nān+ta ཿkṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ra gān+ta ཿkṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ khrir ṣ+ṭhan+ta ཿkṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ dpa' bo bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ mo ha ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ.i pi shu na ra ti rgyuḥdzaḥ/ oṃ rā ga ra ti rgyuḥdzaḥ/ oṃ yir ṣ+pe ra ti hūṃ dzaḥ / dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ma bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ mame marma bi gha te/ oṃ badz+ra tsartsi ke/ /ha ra ha ra/ ṭak+ki mā ra ya/ a mu kā ya dzaḥ/ oṃ gho ṇi/sugho ṇi/ badz+ra mā ma tī/ bha ra bha ra/ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ dzaḥ/ oṃ mame marma khyo bha ṇi badz+ra sa ra swa ti/ da ra da ra/ tha ra tha ra/ pha ra pha ra/ rka pa kai pa/dhu na dhu na hūṃ a mu kai dzaḥ/ oṃ gi dhī re/ badz+ra kurti ke/ gha gha rak+ta sho ṇi ta bri ye / gi rī ye a mu kai dzaḥ/ gdengs can mtha' yas sngon po yis/ /skra bcings shin tu 'jigs par mdzad/ /klu ni 'jog po dmar po yis rna bar drag po'i ⑦rna rgyan byas/ /rigs ldan sna tshogs dpung ba'i rgyan/ /gdengs can ser po dung skyong ni/ /lag gdub dag tu 'dzin pa ste/ /pad+ma dkar po do shal mdzes/ //rko ṭa ni sngo bsangs kyang / /mchod phyir thogs pas mdzes pa ste/ /gdengs can nor rgyas bdud rtsi yi/ /kha dog lta bu'i ska rags byas/ /pad rtsa lta bu dkar ba'i mdog /pad+ma chen pos rkang gdub byas / /thams cad phud kyi rnam pa sgrog(nya /lce gnyis phreng ba'i mche ba can/ /zhes pa 'khor ba myang 'das kyis/ /gzugs can gshin rje gsod pa ste/ /83—686

rnam rtog thams cad gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sngags kyis yang dag byin brlab ①bya/ /rang nyid sa bon lcags kyus dgug /zhal nas zhugs te thams cad du/ /mkha' khyab rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /zhal nas zhugs rnams snying gar ②zhu//der ni sa bon phyung byas te/ /rdo rje'i lam nas zhu ba ste/ /rang 'od pad+ma'i nang gnas pa/ /sa bon rang bzhin can blta bya/ /sa bon de rnams kyis byin brlabani / /'od zer mi bzad 'phro ba ni/ /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin bsgom bya/ /bltas te snying gar duzhu byas la/ /rdo rje ⑤lam nas nges phyung ste/ /rang gi rig ma'i pad+ma yi/ /ze 'brur lha mo'i tshogs blta bya/ /me tog sna tshogs nyer spyod sogs / /lag pa'i yal gas bzung ba dang / /yid 'phrog klu yi mchod pa dang ske/ /sna tshogs gar gyi rang bzhin nyid/ /bde ba chen po rab ster ba/ /rol bcas de rnams kyis mchod bya/ /kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /khyod mthong kho bo rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ /khyod kyis gar mdzad sa steng ⑥dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ /chags pas brgyan pa'i khro bo yid/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags/ /sku ni dmar zhing thung ba ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul pa / /rdo rje dbyangs can mas btud zhusag/ /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /hrīḥdhīḥgasang sngags dag gis khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul pa sel/ /snying rje'i khro bo rje btsun khyod/ /gar mdzad 'gro ba rnams la gzigs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra sri bha wa ād+ma ko3rta(kye/ sgra yi tshogs rnams thams cad ni/ /sgra brnyan dang mtshungs rnam par blta/ /'khor lo'i gtso la bstod byas te/ /de yis de rnams de lta bzhin/ /gti mig kyi)rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /shin tu 83—687

'jigs pa gshin rje gshed/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal / /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /khyab bdag chags pa'i chos 'byung gnas/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /las kun byed pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pas//sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal / /aḥyig las skyes pad+ma'i snod/ /mi mgo gsum gyi steng gnas pa/ /dag par rnam pa 6)bskyed byas te/ /der ni 'og tu me dkyil 'khor/ /zur gsum raṃ yig las byung ba'o/ /der ni 'og tu rlung dkyil 'khor/ /sngon po g.yo ba gzhu lta bu/ /ba dan gyis mtshan yaṃ las byung / /der ni de'i ming dang po las/ /bskyed de rnam snang la sogs pa/ /rda (miyig sogs las yang dag byung / /glang po che la sogs pa lngas/ /hūṃ skye rdo rje'i kha chod kyis/ /bkab pa mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /me la rlung gis bskyod pa na/ /der ni zhu ba rnam bsam bya/ /rdo rje'i ro mnyam dag gyur cing / /shin tu dri ma med bltas te/hūṃ yig 'od kyis sangs rgyas rnams/ /spyan drangs ye shes rang bzhin can/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis rab gzhug cing / /mchog gi bdud rtsi lngar bltas nas/ /de nyid gsum gyis byin brlab k+ṣ-i bya/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po tshim bya ste/ /lce la rdo rje gtsang ma nyid/ /hūṃ yig yang dag byung blta der/ /de 'od sbu gu'i 83—688

rnam pa lasasti/ /yang dag bkug pa de yis kyang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kun sna tshogs gnas/ /dkyil 'khor ba rnams de bzhin gzhan/ /ye shes 'od kyis ②snying gar ③bkug /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spang ④/ /thog ma tha ma dbus dbye bas/ der yang gzung ba gcig yod min/ /de nyid kyis ni 'khrul gzugs med/ /gang la 'khrul pa gnyis la gnas/ /thams cad tshe na sems 'khrul med/ /lus ni spro dang dud ⑤pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ mngon par rtogs pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis skyobacom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba btab pa/las kyi dbye dang rab dbye las/ /ji ⑦ltar sems can rab tu 'jug /rdo rje chen pos bshad du gsol/ /ye shes rgya mtsho rnams nyan 'tshal/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang rgyal po/ /nyes pa thams cad gso ba'i bdag /las kun rab tu sgrub pa po/ /gsung ni 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i mthu mnga' ba la mchod pa byas te phyag 'tshal ba/ bcom lda na'adas la lan gsum bskor ba byas te yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung mnyan to/ /de nas rdo rje 'chang rgyal pos/ /dbang byed 'khrul 'khor rab gsal byed/ /gshin rje gshed nag 'khrul 'khor rnams/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bud med dbang byed phyir de bzhin/ /bsrung ba'i don du bya ba nyid/ /gi wang gzung (nye83—689

bya zhi ba la/ /gro ga de bzhin smyug lashun la/ /'khor lo gnyis ni mngon bris te / /na maḥming ni nang du spel/ /nag po rtsa ba sogs spangs te/ /kham phor gnyis ni kha sbyar la/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i dbus bzhag ste/ /srad bu dkar pos dkri bar bya/ /me tog dkar pos thun gsum du/ /shar du kha bltas mchod par bya/ /gshin rje mthar byed zla shel 'od/ /bdag nyid bsams ②te 'du 'god bya/ /bsgrub bya zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /zhen pa bltas te dbang bskur bya/ /bum pa dkar po zla 'dra ba/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis gang rnams la/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khrus byed pa/ /bltas nas bzlas pa brtsam ③par bya/ /oṃ hrīḥjiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ lha sbyin la ④shārnyi ku ru na maḥ/ zhi ba'i dam tshig gsungs pa'o/ /skyes pa rnams kyi zhi ba la/ /gur gum gyis bris rgyas pa la'ang / /kha che rnams kyis ⑤'khor lo gnyis/ /swā hā ming gi nang du spel/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni blangs nas ni/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi'i dbus bzhag nas/ /kham phor kha sbyar du bzhag ste/ /srad bu ser pos dkri bar bya/ /me tog ser pos thun gsum du/ /byang du kha bltas mchod par bya/ /gshin rje 'joms pa sku mdog ser/ /bdag nyid nges par blta bar bya/ /bsgrub bya ser po zla bar gnas / /bum pa ser pos dbang bskur bya/ /dbang bskur ba ni bsgoms nas su / /rgyas par byed 'dod yang dag bzla6)/ /oṃ hrīḥjiḥwi kṛ tā na na tsā hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lhas sbyin gyi puṣ+ṭi ku ru swā hā/ bo ṣa ṭa oṃ hrīḥjiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ bo ṣa ṭa lhas (7sbyin gyi puṣ+ṭi ku ru bo ṣa ṭa ces ⑧gsungs te/bcom ldan 'das kyi rgyas pa'i dam tshig go/ /gro ga'am yang na ras dag la(3/ /rgya skyegs khu ba'am tsan+dan dmar/ /ming med khrag dang bsres pa yis/ /'khor 83wa 690

lo gnyis ni mnyam bris te/ /hoḥyig gis ni nang du spel/ /nag po la sogs spangs 'khrul 'khor/ /kham phor gnyis ni kha sbyar te/ /mar dang sbrang rtsis yongs gang bar/ /srad bu dmar pos dkri bar bya/ /nub tu mngon par phyogs byas te/ /me tog dmar pos mchod par bya/ /bdag nyid gshin rje 'joms pa po/ /sku mdog dmar po cher 'bar ba/ /bsgrub bya zla ba dmar po la / /zhon pa nyid kyang rnam bsam bya/ /rang lus las 'phros 'od zer ni/ /dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs rnams kyis/ /bsgrub bya bkug par bsams nas ni / /spro ba'i sngags ni khri bzla ①bya/ /de yis bsgrub bya brgyal 'gyur zhing / /rkang pa dag ni ②de bzhin 'gyel/ /gos dang bral ba'i skra grol ba/ /bsams te bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /gal te dbang du ma gyur na/ /bud med seng ldeng me la ni/ /mar sogs dor bcas brtul zhugs can/ /'khor lo de ni gdung bar bya/ /oṃ hrīḥjiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hoḥlhas ③sbyin gyi mchod sbyin ba shi ku ru hoḥ/ oṃ trīḥrdziḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ bo ṣaṭa lhas ④spyin gyi ba shā mā na mchod sbyin bo ṣaṭa/ ces ⑤gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbang du bya ba'i dam tshig go/ /dur khrod ras sam yang na ni/ /rang byung bskus pa'i ras dag la/ /rgya skyegs sga rlon khrag bsres pas/ /'khor lo gnyis ni mnyam bris te/ /dzaḥyig dang ni hrīḥyig gis/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni nang spel bya/ /btsun mo'i pad+ma'i snod du ni/ /kha sbyar bzhag ste mchod par bya//srad bu dmar pos dkris nas ni/ /me tog dmar pos mchod par bya/ /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed po ni/ /mtshams ⑥kyi nyi ma ltar 'bar ba/ /lcags kyu kha dog dmar po yis/ /bsgrub bya bkug pa nyid bsgom bya/ /lcags kyu 83—691

rnams kyis snying phug cing / /zhags pas rked pa la bcings te/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sbyor ba las/ /seṅge dmar po mnyam zhon pa/ /rdzas lnga yis ni gsang ①bya ste/ /de ni 'ong bar rnam bsam bya/ /gal te bsgrub bya ma 'ongs na//seng ldeng shing me 'bar ba la/ /'khrul 'khor de gsos chabartul zhugs can/ /der ni bzlas pa yang dag brtsam/ /oṃ hrīḥtriḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa hrīḥ.ā mu ka ā kur+sha ya hrīḥ/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ ta (min na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ dzaḥlhas ④phyin ā kun+ta ya dzaḥ/ zhes nyagasungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'gugs ⑥pa'i dam tshig go/ /blo ldan dur khrod ras ma la/ /yung ba yi ni khu ba yis/ /'khor lo gnyis ni mnyam bris te/ /lo yig gis ni nang du spel/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni yang dag blang / /kham phor kha sbyar du bzhag ste/ /kham phor ser po steng bzhag nas / /der ni mkhas pas ri mo bri/ /dang po ri mo bzhi bcu bdun/ /mnyam cipar bzhag (7ste mnyam bri bya/ /lcog (8)brgyad du grags ri rab ni/ /de yi steng du yang dag bri/ /hūṃ yig dang ni baṃ yig ste/ /de yis ri rab nang du spel/ /de yi nang du lo yig gis/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dgod par bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rjes mnan pa la/ /srad bu ser pos dkri bar bya/ /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed po ni/ /sku mdog ser po rnam bsam bya/ /lho (9)ru mngon phyogs rnal 'byor pas/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa'i/ /bsgrub bya ser po rnam tibasams nas/ /ri rab kyis mnan myur dgod bya/ /sna tshogs rdo rje mnyam mnan la/ /dbang chen dkyil 'khor las 'og tu/ /marnya (ster sogs 'jigs rung ri/ /gangs ri g.yo med mtshungs rnams kyis/ /bsgrub bya mnan pa bsgom bya ste/ /de nyid bzlas pa bya ba nyid/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥli kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ 83—692

phaṭa phaṭa/ lo lhas ①sbyin swa d+dhā na s+t+waṃ bha ya lo swā hā/ zhes gsungs te/ bcom lda 'das kyi rangs pa chen po'i dam tshig go/ /ngag ni rengs par 'dod pa yis//rang bzhin 'khor lo gnyis bris nas/ /bsgrub bya'i ming rnams nang spel te/ /de las (mispros shing sngags bzlas bya/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥli ③yo tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/yaṃ lhas ④phyin ya thā ṅgāṅgā kār+ya su kṛ te tai ni ba ra ya to bi ru pa kai/ ba ra ta ya to bi ru pa kai /ba ra ta ya dz+nyā data su nā ga s+t+waṃ bha na ku ru yaṃ/ zhes ⑤gsungs te/bcom ldan 'das kyi ngag rengs pa'i dam tshig go/ /de ltar dgongs pa gsungs pa 'di/ /nang du shin tu legs spras ⑥pas/ /gshin rje gshed dmar rab sbyor las / /nyi ma gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /dur khrod ras la 'khor lo gnyis / /sngar bzhin bri bya brtul zhugs can/ /ske 7tshe dang ni lan tshwas kyang / /dug dang nim pa yis kyang ste/ /de bzhin lan tshwa tsha ba gsum/ /dur khrod sol ba nyid dang ni/ /smyo byed 'dab (shema'i khu ba dang / /de bzhin gtum po'i sa bon nyid/ /mdzub mo'i khrag ni blangs 5)byas te/ /tsi tra ka yi khu ba 'am/ /tshwa sgo can gyi sa blangs te/ /gdol ba'i rdza ma'i dreg pa dang / /stogs pa can gyi smyu gu yis/ /gdug pa'i sems kyis bcu bzhi la/ /nyi phyed yin bri brtul zhugs can/ /ma rungs pa rnams bsad rgyu yi/ /sna tshogs sems can rnam 'joms pa'i/ /hūṃ yig gis ni rnam spel bya/ /lho (steru mngon phyogs rnal 'byor pa / /bdag nyid gshin rje gshed po ni/ /gtum po chen po khro bo'i gzugs/ /thod pa'i dum bus rnam par brgyan/ /ma he la zhugs ljags 'gyur ba/ /gsus pa che zhing 'jigs su rung / /gtsigs shing gyen du 'bar ba'i skra/ /de bzhin sma ra smin ma ser/ /g.yas pa rdo rje'i dbyug pa che/ /g.yon pa thod pa 83—693
