nyid kyang ste/ /rnam 'gyur mche ba gtsigs pa'i zhal/ /bskal pa'i me ltar yang dag mtshungs/ /de ltar bdag nyid rnam bsams te/ /de mdun bsgrub bya myur dgod bya/ /dri ldan rims gzir nad rnams kyis①/ /gdug pa'i lus la gzir ba dang / /gos dang bral bas 'dar ba dang / /nyam ②chung lus ni rma dang ldan/ /'bras kyi phreng bas yan lag bskor/ /mtshon cha yis ni gzir bar bya/ /grang ba'i rlung gis nye bar gtses/ /me yi dbus su yang dag gnas//ma he dag dang stag dang ni/ /khyi dang mchu ring ③can rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas sde ni rnam 'joms pa'i/ /ma rungs chen po za byed cing / mthar byed lto ba'i nang na gnas/ /tsher ma rnams kyis lus gang ba/ /gdos dang sgrog gis durkang par bsdams/ /de bzhin dum bu dum bur byas/ /pags ⑤pa med par byas bsams te/ /ske tshe dang ni lan tshwas byug /srid yig brjid pas bsam par bya/ /de yi lus kyi sung ba sogs/ /bcangs dunas bdag mdurne dgod par bya/ /de yi go cha bgos byas te/ /stong pa'i lus bzhin bsgom ⑦par bya/ /bdag lus las byung gshin rje gshed/ /khro bos bdag nyid sku rnams kyi/ /de ni gdung bar bsgom bya zhing / /zhag dang tshil dag 'thung bar byed/ /de mdun gshin rje bsam bya ste/ /lag na dbyug pa stobs po che/ /gdug pa de yis gdungs pa ni/ /ma rungs de la rnam bsgom bya/ /de yi nang grol blang ⑧bya ste / /bya rgod kyis khyer mkha' dkyil 'gro/ /klu rnams kyis ni sa 'og dgug⑨dran med la sogs rnam par gzir/ /de ltar bsgrub bya rnam bsams te/ /sems ni snying rjes nges 'khyud 7pas/ /'khor ba las ni bton byas te/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams su skyes 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 83—694

gshegs pa thams cad thugs rab tu dgyes te tshig 'di gsungs so/ /e ma'o gsod pa 'di ni bzang / /gsod pa gsod pa ma yin te/ /ci srid sdig pa las grol ba'i/ /'chi ba 'chi ba nyid ma yin/ /sdig pa stong phrag rnams byas nas / /mnar med sogs par gnas 'gyur ba/ /e ma sangs rgyas bdag nyid che / /gsod pa byang chub thob par mdzad/ /slar yang snying rje rnam mdzad nas/ /gsad ①thos sems can gsod par mdzad/ /e ma snying rje mchog gi stobs/ /snying rje dman pas mi 'grub bo/ /oṃ hrilaḥjiḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ de ba dalta mā ra ya hūṃ/ oṃ hrīḥstuḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ phaṭa de ba dalta mā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces chagasungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rnam par rtog pa chen po gsod pa'i rdo rje 'khrul 'khor dang rjo/ sngags dang / rgyud kyi gsod pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig go/ /de nas 'khor lo gnyis bris te/ /phaṭa kyi yi ges rnam spel bya/ /bsgrub bya'i ming ni blangs byas te/ /thod pa kha sbyar du dgod bya/ /srad bu nag pos yang dag dkri/ /snang ba'i sems kyis nyin phyed na / /dur khrod rnams su sba bar bya/ /gshin rje mthar byed du yang dmigs/ /mdun du bsgrub bya dgod par bya/ /rta dang ma he mnyam zhon pa/ /lag na mtshon thogs de gnyis dang / /khro bo 'dus pa rnams kyis bskor/ /gnyis ku'i phyogs su rnam bsam bya/ /khro bos dkris pa yi sems kyis/ /gnyis po de dag dbyug 'gyed par/ /bsgom bya 'thab mo'i bsam pa can/ /bsgom te bzlas pa brtsam par bya/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ba dalta ya dz+nyā dasto bi dwo ṣā ya phaṭa/ ces gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbye ba chen po'i dam tshig go/ /sngar bzhin cho ga de nyid kyis/ /'khor lo gnyis ni bri 83—695

bya ste/ /hūṃ dang phaṭa yig rnam spel bas/ /thod pa kha sbyar du bkod de/ /srad bu nag pos yang dag dkris/ /ma mo'i tshal rnams su sba bya/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor gzung / /mdun du bsgrub bya rnam bsgom bya/ /yaṃ byung rlung gi dkyil 'khor ni/ /nag po gzhu yi rnam pa la/ /rnga mo chen po mdog sngon po/ /de yi steng du rnam bsgom bya/ /de la ma rungs che bskyon te/ /lho yi phyogs su de khyer la/ /khro tshogs rnams kyis gdungs pas na/ /nges par sangs rgyas rnams kyang skyod0)/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ de ba dalta uts+tsha ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa / ces ②gsungs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bskrad pa chen po'i dam tshig gol/ /khros pa gshin rjer bltas rnal 'byor/ /khrag bcas ro bsregs thal ba dang ske/ /dug dang lan tshwa ske tshe dang / /til mar smyo byed 'dab gde bzhin/ /dur khrod ras la 'khor lo gnyis/ /de ltar rim pas bri bar bya/ /gshin rje'i lus gnas bsad pa la/ /rta dang ma he dag las dbye/ /rnga mo'i lus gnas bskrad pa la/ /zhi ba zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /rgyas pa zla ba ser po la/ /btsun mo'i snying gar 4)dbang du byed/ /lkugs pa ra yi lus la gnas/ /lhun po'i dbus su rengs pa ste/ /seṅge sha ra bha gnas dgug /de ltar gzhan rnams las mtshon bya/ /gi waṃ rgya skyegs nyid dang ni/ /kha che yi ni bye brag gis/ /gro ga'i 'dab 5tshom la bris dbang / /'dir ni 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /kham por kha sbyar du bzhag ste/ /dge ba'i sems kyis yang dag gzung (7)/ /bya rog sgro yi smyug gu yis/ /nyi ma'i gung la nges par brtsam/ /ro bsregs pad+ma kha sbyar la/ /gshin rje gshed bdag rnal 'byor las/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥsogs 9)sngags brjod cing / /lho ru gnas pa'i tshar gcod bya/ /zhi la mtha' yi yi ge ya/ /8 3—696

dbye ba ni gnyis kyis yang ngo / /phyi nas dbus kyi ya yig gis/ /lhag ma'i yi ge ci bde ba'o/ /sngon du bsnyen pa khri bzlas te/ /las 'di rab tu sgrub pa ni/ /gshin rje gshed dmar rab sbyor las/ /ye shes rdo rje yis bya ste/ /drag po chen po'i 'khor lo 'di/ /bris pa gang du gnas pa dang / /yi ge bris pa'i khyim du yang glu/ /rtag tu 'thab mo 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ 'khrul 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //ri bo skye bos dben phyogs dang / /legs sbas yid brtag 0)khyim rnams so/ /thang sku bkram ste rnal 'byor bdag /sngags kyis dgug pa yang dag brtsam/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa mo/ /khrag 'gugs pa yi rab sbyor la/ /tsartsi kā sgom rnal 'byor pa/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje chen po 'joms pa'i rdo rje khrag 'gugs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te rdo rje tsartsi kā'i sngags 'di dag gsungs so/ /oṃ badz+ra tsartsi ke sidhi n+d+ra nī la hā ri ṇi rat+na tra ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi ru dhi raṃ a (mikar+ṣa ya dzaḥ / kha ni rab tu gdangs bya ste/ /sngags 'di rjes su dran par bya/ /khams gsum pa yi khrag chen po/ /'dir ni 'gugs par the tshom ( )med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gshin rje gshed pos chang dgug pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje phag mos chang dgug pa'i dam tshig 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ gho ṇi su gho ṇi badz+ra mā ma tī bha ra bha ra/ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra / trī dhā tu ku (4)ma r+ya ā kur+sha ya dzaḥ/ rdza mkhan lag pa phyis pa'i sas/ /83—697

bum pa byas te kun nas bsgribs/ /rkun po'i spa yi gzhir bzhag ste/ /sngags ni rjes su dran par bya/ /paṇ+ḍi tas ni mchod rten du/ /sngags 'di'i bdag nyid che ba bstan/ /'bad pas brtan par dmigs byas nas/ /chang dgug pa ni rab tu 'grub/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje chen po 'joms pa'i rdo rje shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs sol/ /dbyangs can mas sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra dz+nyā warta ni/dz+wa la dz+wa la/ me dhā wadha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bu warta ①ni swā hā/ bzung nas ji srid tshes gcig nas/ /kun nas zla ba rdzogs pa'i bar/ /legs sbyar byed 'dod brtsam bya ste/ /ji srid zla ba'i rjes 'jug las/ /ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas tshigs bcad brgya phyed ②cing / /khams gsum pa ni dum lus shing ④/ /ma lus lus pa med par 'khrugs/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mthar byed chen po 'joms pa'i rdo rje'i khu ba 'gugs pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te khu ba 'gugs pa gi rīs sngags 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ā (5)kar+ṣa ni ā kur+sha 6)ni gi rī dzaḥhriḥduṣ+ṭa pra ⑦duṣ+ṭa ya/ shu kra ā kun+dha ya dzaḥdzaḥrgyu swā hā/ mkha' sgo rdo rje lam dang rlung / /dril bu lcags kyu'i sbyor ba las/ /bzlas dang sgom par rab sbyor las/ /khu ba'i tshogs rnams 'gugs par byed/ /dben pa'i nags khrod rnams su yang / /las 'di rab tu bsgrub bya ste/ /mtshan mo bdun gyi (nyarab sbyor gyis/ /'dir ni 'grub par the tshom med/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed chen po dus 'jigs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te dbang bskur ba mchog gi dam tshig 'di nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje rnams las nges par phyung bar gyur 83—698

to / /u dum wa ①ra mas phyir/ /pa ri dzā ta kai mā li ka /ka r+ṇa ②ka ra'i phreng ba yang / /bu khyod zungs dul byin gyis rlobs/ /khams gsum pa yi ral gri che//sangs rgyas thams cad phyag mdzad pa/ /bzung nas bdud las rgyal bar 'gyur//las kyi ral gri dang mtshungs mchog /shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin ni/ /rdo rje dril bu ⑤bsgrub ⑥pa'i phyir/ /mnyes shing gsang ba'i rdo rje zung / /khyod ni slob ma bsdu bar gyis/ /'di ni btung ba rin chen te/ /'grub pa'i lus ni rab sgrub byed/ /skyes bu byung ba'i chu 'thungs shig⑦ /mnyes gshin kun tu ye shes nyid/ /slob ma'i kha yis btung bya ste/ /gshin rje gshed ni rab bsgrub ⑧phyir / /rdo rje slob ma bdag nyid che/ /sems ni shin tu dga' bar mdzod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ sngags kyi dgug pa'i rab tu sbyor ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'ol// //de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /ral gri'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /khab lan lcags kyi rang bzhin las/ /ral gri yang na dngul chu yis/ /phyed byas khru gang tshad kyis ni/ /ral gri rnam bsam brtul zhugs can/ /bcu bzhi yang na brgyad pa la/ /dur khrod dbus su gzung 5)bar bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /thun gsum khri phrag bzla 7bar bya/ /zla ba so so'i bcu bzhi las / /gtor ma mchod pa sngon 'gro bar/ /zla ba gcig gis 'bum phrag bzla(nyam/ /'bum phrag lngas ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /grub nas ral gri rab tu 'bar / /snang ba chen po'i 'od zer lnga/ /de nas gzung bya 'grub par 'gyur/ /83—699

'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal mi/ /'jigs byed gshin rje gshed sbyor las/ /gang tshe ral gri grub rnal 'byor/ /rtsed rmod sa ni grub byed de'i/ /g.yul du de yi bzod par dka'/ /rkang pa gnyis dang rkang bzhi dang / /blta phyir phyogs bcu rnams su 'gro/ /lha dang lha min rnams mi bzod/ /mi yi 'jig rten smos ci dgos/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jim pa blangs byas te/ /zla ba gcig gis yang dag bsgrubatu)ske/ /oṃ phu'iḥyi ge snying gar (midagodag/ /hrīḥdhīḥl sogs sngags bzla ④bya / /char pa mi 'bab dus rnams su/ /khri khrag bzlas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sbrul nag dag gi sha rnams dang / /nim pa'i lo mas bsres byas te/ /de yis ri lur byas nas ni/ /rgya mtshor zhugs byas brtul zhugs can/ /khri khrag (getsam zhig rab bzlas pas/ /chu rlabs rengs pa'i mchog yin no/ /gtum po sa bon brgya blangs te/ /sran ma 'bras dang bsres pa ni/ /'bum phrag bdun du rab bzlas pas/ /lha ni sbyin sreg las gzigs 'gyur/ /dur khrod kyis ni gso ma blang 6)/ /gzugs brnyan bya ba brtul zhugs can/ /smyo byed khu bas byug pa yis/ /khri khrag lagacig gis 'gugs par byed/ /'bum phrag bzhi ni bzlas pa yis/ /don grub sa bon kun bsags pas/ /gnyid log langs te bya ba dang / /tshor bar yang ni the tshom med/ /rgyun lam gyi ni sa blangs te/ /sngags ni 'bum phrag bzlas pa las/ /spyi bor rab tu byugs tsam gyis/ /spyi bo'i nad ni rnam par 'joms/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags byas te/ /lag pas spyi bor mnye bar bya/ /nad kyis nyams pa med 'gyur te/ /'dir ni the tshom yod ma yin/ /bram ze yi ni sha dag dang / /dur khrod thal ba sa des (gni / /gshin rje gshed kyi sku gzugs bya/ /phyag gnyis dang ni zhal gcig pa/ /83—700

g.yas pa rdo rje chen po ste/ /de bzhin g.yon na mi mgo 'o/ /sku mdog dkar po 'jigs byed chen/ /de yis ma rungs 'joms par byed/ /sha dang bdud rtsi lnga yis ni/ /nyi ma so sor gtor ma dbul/ /rtag tu gsol btab rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag gi dgra bo 'joms par mdzod/ /ces pa brjod de mtshan mo nyal/ /dgra ni tho rangs 'chi bar 'gyur/ /yang na na bar 'gyur ba ste/ /myos pa la sogs kun tu 'khrug /dgra bo'i rnam snang blang bya ste/ /mi yi rkang ni rab bkang 6)bya/ /'bum phrag bzlas pas rdzogs nas ni/ /shing gi rtse mor sbyang bya nyid/ /rtag tu yi dwags ②tshal du bskor/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mnyes na bde / /de nas gzhan yang rab bshad bya/ /ro langs chen po'i sgrub thabs so/ /thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i mchog /sna tshogs bya ba rab sgrub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ 'jigs byed ces bya ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas rgyal srid sgrub thabs mchog /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /'phyang ba'i shing ni gzung (5)bya ste/ /ma nyams de bzhin rma med pa/ /blangs la gdud par bya de yang / /bzlas pa'i phreng bar rab bsgrub bya/ /zla ba zla ba'i bcu bzhi la/ /sha lnga yis ni byug par bya/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /bzlas pa 'grub par byed pa'i mchog /'di yis 'bum phrag bzlas pa yis/ /nges par rgyal srid 'grub par 'gyur/ /e ma sngags kyi nus pa ni/ /gnyid log sgra ni sgrog (4)par byed/ /gshin rje gshed kyi sbyor ldan pas/ /skad cig kyang ni 'jigs mi bya/ /gang gang 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de dag thams 83—701

cad thob par 'gyur/ /ma he dang ni chu srin dang / /stag dang de bzhin gzhan rnams kyis/ /dom dang lce spyang dag dang ni/ /spre'u yang ni bye brag las/ /ske tshe lan tshwa de bzhin du/ / sho bhā 6)dza na tshwa ba gsum/ /'di yis sku gzugs yang dag bsgrub(9/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can gshin rje gshed/ /de la gsol btab rnal 'byor pa/ /hrīḥdhīḥl sogs sngags bzlas te/ /rgyal po che ge bsad nas ni/ /bdag de rengs par sbyar bar bya/ /bye ba bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur te/ /bden zhing bden par the tshom med/ /de nas gzhan yang rgyal zla yi / /dkar phyogs khro nyi ma (5)bsgrubs ldan tsheyi/ /rdul ldan gos ni yang dag blang / /thang sku mchog ni bri bar bya/ /bri bya bkra shis mchog snag tsha/ /chen po yang dag ldan rnams kyi/ /sku mdog dkar po drag shul che/ /phyag gnyis dang ni zhal gcig mchog /g.yas pa rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /g.yon pas 'dzag pa'i mgo bo 'dzin/ /zhabs ni g.yon brkyang rnam 'gyur dang / /rin chen cod pan rnam par brgyan/ /rin chen rgyan rnams yongs su rdzogs/ /'od zer phreng bas kun tu 'khrigs/ /gsod pa'i bsam pas ( rgyal po ni/ /'og gi cha la nges par sbyar/ /thun mong kha dog yang dag ldan/ /ji lta'i dbyibs ni rnam par gnas/ /'dus byas lha ni bsgrub par bya/ /ji (7ltar 'byor pa'i tshad la ni/ /de yi mdun du sbyin sreg kyi)bya/ /nges par zur gsum dkyil 'khor la'o/ /sbyin sreg 7'bum gyis de rgyal srid/ /thob 'gyur 'di ni the tshom med/ /de nas gzhan yang zla gzas bzung yime/ /gal te nyi ma la blta bya / /dur khrod thal ba yang dag blangs/ /gzugs brnyan bya ba brtul zhugs can / /shrī bī rā dzī sha lnga dang / /nim pa dha du ra'i 7lo mas/ /mkhas pas cho 83—702

ga 'di yis ni/ /gcig tu byas te gzugs brnyan bya/ /sku mdog sngon po drag shul che/ /phyag gnyis dang ni zhal gcig pa/ /ma he la bzhugs rnam 'gyur zhal / /rdo rje dang ni thod pa 'dzin/ /bsgrubs te sku gzugs rang bzhin las/ /mchod pa byas na slar yang ni/ /rgyun du hrīḥdhīḥl sogs sngags/ /'bum phrag bzlas te mnyes par bya/ /sde bcas g.yog 'khor bcas pa yis/ /rgyal po che ge gzhom bya ste/ /bzlas pa 'bum gyi bdag rnal 'byor/ /byas nas 'bum phrag khyad par las/ /mchod pa'i las ni yang dag ldan/ /bzlas pa'i sbyin sreg cho ga 'dis/ /sems can don mchog blo dang ldan/ /rgyal srid thob 'gyur the tshom med/ /de nas gzhan yang bkra shis kyi ras la rdo ba'i nam mkha'i chus 6)zla mtshan gyi gos bkrus te thang sku mngon par bri bar bya'o/ /zhal gcig ( pa dang phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog nag po 'jigs rung ba/ /dbu skra 'bur ba yang dag ldan/ /mgo bo'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang / /gri gug dang ni thod pa phyag /ma he'i steng du bri bar bya/ /de ni sgom pa brtsams (5)byas te/ /dgra yi mdun du rnam par bsgom( no/ /gri gug gis ni bcad byas te/ /tshil dang zhag rnams 'thung ba dang / /rgyu ma rnams dang 'jim pa dang / /khrag ni mang po 'thung bar 5)byed/ /'bum phrag tsam gyis bskur bar 'gyur/ /yang na rma yis snying gar ri ragazir/ /de nas gzhan yang mi'i tsunarus pa sor bzhi pa blangs la / hrīḥdhīḥl sogs pa'i sngags nang du spel ba dgra bo'i sgor mnan pa byas na/gal te brgya byin dang mtshungs pa 'ang 'khor dang bcas pa skyod par 'gyur ro/ /gcig pur rin skye bos dben par 'dug ste rje btsun gyi thang sku bkram nas phyogs bcu na zhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams mdun du 83—703

byas nas mi'i rus pa bcad pa'i khrag chen po dang bsres pa'i bya rog gi khrag gis sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad/ rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo la sa bon bcu gnyis dang / de nyid du dgra bo'i ming dbus su spel la/ /tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i kha sbyar ba tha yig gsum gyis phyi rol tu bskor ba bya rog gi mgrin par btags te/ gal te 'bab chu la bskyur na/ de'i tshe 'khrug par 'gyur ro / /de kho na ltar sa bon bcu gnyis bri bar bya ste/ phaṭa phaṭa hūṃ hūṃ na na tā kṛ wi ①jiḥhrīḥ.o/ ji ltar 'byor pas (nyamachod byas phyinas/ /stobs po che yi bdug pa phul/ /gal te 'bab chu la bskyur na/ / de gzhung du med do④/ /gal te ma gyur na bya rog gi gshog (51pa la lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa byas nas dgra bo'i sgo nang du ming dang spel ba ni/ 'phral du 'khor dang bcas pa skyod par byed do/ /de kho na ltar (6)rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su tsha ba gsum dang dug dang ske tshe rnams rus pa chen po'i 'bri (7sgyug gis me'i sa bon gyi dbus su tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i ghaḥyig gnyis kha sbyar ba'i tha yig gsum gyis (87phyi rol tu bskor ba'i me'i bud shing gi me la gdung bar bya ste/de'i skad cig la bu dang chung ma dang g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa 'chi bar 'gyur ro / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ rgyal srid kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas pha rol sde rnams 'joms/ /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /bram ze mo 59 yi rdul gos la/ /rgyal dang nyi mas yang dag brtsam/ /ma he'i zhal gyi thang sku bri/ /brgya phrag phyag ni rab gsal ba/ /de ni phyag mtshan rnon po 83—704

bsnams / /thams cad du ni bri bar bya/ /thang sku dkar po bri bya ste/ /pad+ma dkar pos mchod par bya/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa 'bum phrag rnams/ /byas te de bzhin pad+ma slar/ /thang sku bkram 6)pa mngon phyogs par/ /ba dan steng du 'dzin pa ni/ /rkang gnyis rkang bzhi la sogs pa/ /skye bo rnams kyis ⑤mthong gyur gang / /de nas thams cad gdong gzhan 'gro/ /seṅge mthong ba'i glang po bzhin(gu / /de nas gzhan yang / tshangs pa'i sa bon mar khu che/ /ku dā ra sbyin gyis ldan pa/ /rnga mo'i gcin gyis yang dag ldan/ /ril bu bya'o brtul zhugs can/ /rang gi rtsigadong par thig le bya/ /pha rol sde ni rnam par 'joms / /a shī ka shing rtsar song ste/ /brgyad pa 'am yang na bcu bzhi la/ /thun gsum du ni zla ba gcig /sngon bsnyen 'bum phrag gcig byar 'gyur/ /oṃ sirnyi a nan+ta nā la hā ri ṇi pa ra sri n+ya bi nā sha ni hrīḥswā hā/ 'di nyid kyis ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /mthong ba las pha rol gyi sde rnam par 'joms shing gang la bltas pa de 'bros par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang / shing gcig rtsa bar phyin nas ni/ /mchog gi ro la 'dug byas te/ /g.yas na ral gri 'dzin pa dang / /g.yon brkyang ba yi zhal gyis ni/ /hrīḥjiḥl sogs pa'i sngags mtshan mo mtha' dag bzla (5)bar bya ste/ de'i tshe ral gri yongs su 'phro zhing de'i tshe pha rol gyi sde rnams srung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ pha rol gyi sde rnam par 'joms pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// // cide nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos/ /mi snang 'grub par rab gsal mdzad/ /83—705

thog mar mi snang bsgrub pa'i don du rnal 'byor pas rgyal dang nyi ma'i nyin mo brtsam zhing sngon du yang dag btags la 'bum phrag bzla 6)bar bya ste/ de'i drod 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzas bzung ba'i dus nas pa ṇi ṭa dzubaka ri'i rtsa ba dang /ro dang / khaṃ gha ri dang / e ra ba ḍa'i rtsa ba dang thams cad gcig tu byas te ril bu byas nas khar bcug na mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gzhan yang kho ṭi dzā la dza ya na ti dang / bridha ra ku'i rtsa ba dang thams cad mnyam por gcig tu byas te bhe ga'i gcin la nyi ma gsum bskams 5)la ril bu byas nas khar bcang bar bya ste/ mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang nyi ma gzas bzung ba'i dus na urdzi'i mchu dang / ro dang / dha du ra ka na ka hā ya nyid ba ḍa rnyi'i gcin gcig la yang dag par bzhag ste ril bu byas nas khar bcug na/mi snang ba'i mchog go/ /de nas gzhan yang byi ba'i mig dang / bya rgod kyi mig dang / sa 'og skyong bas kyang cha mnyam por gcig tu byas pa'i ril bu bshang lam du gzhug par bya ste/ skad cig de las de mi mthong bar 'gro bar byed do/ /de nas yang nyi ma'i res la byi ba'i mig rab tu blangs te/ rams dang (4)tsi tra (5)ka sngon po'i rtsa ba dang lhan cig bya rgod kyi khrag gis btags (67par bya ste/ mi snang ba'i mchog go/ /de nas gzhan yang pā shī mān sa dang / ba la mān sa dang ske/ ba hūṃ ra pha la bsnyams te dar gos kyis dkris nas bram ze'i thod pa la me lce'i dreg pa 'chags par bya'o/ /de'i mig sman gyis mig gnyis la byug 7)na mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang gdol pa'i me tog dang / shā tā ba dha dang / 'dab bzang gi 8mig rnams ril bu byas te khar bcug na/ de mis mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang 'dab bzang 9blangs la nyi 83—706

ma bdun gyi bar du dngul chu ma shā (3)gcig kun)byas te bza' bar bya'o/ /des brun du gyur (7pa gang yin pa de dang lhan cig bdag nyid kyi khu bas thig le byas na / mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /'di gi)ni/ mi snang ba'i rab tu bya ba'o⑤/ /mig sman bshad par bya ste/ thog mar re zhig ⑥mig sman gyi don du bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags 'bum phrag lnga yongs su bzlas te mig sman sgrub pa brtsam par bya'o / /dung dang bya rgod dang ku ra ra rnams kyi mig blangs te ma nyams nas sa 'og gi sbrang rtsi'i khu ba la ( nodar gos kyi sdong bus dreg pa 'chags par 'gyur ro/ /gang gis 'di'i (8)mig sman byugs pa tsam gyis sa'i 5)bu ga mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /skar ma lag la bṛ tshaha ti dkar po'i rtsa ba dang / dza yarnyi nag po'i rtsa ba dang /lce spyang gi mig bsnyams te sbrang rtsis lhan cig btags nas thig le byas na/sa'i bu ga mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bhū mi la ta'i til mar dang / ba shaṃ ka tunyera'i rtsa ba'i khu ba ra dza dang bcas pas/ dar gos la gzhon nu mas byas pa'i srad bus dkris nas sdong bu byas te mi'i mthod pa la dreg pa 'chags par byas la mig sman byas na/ nges par gter mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang rgyal gyi zla ba dang / skar ma snubs la zla mtshan gyi gos blangs te brgyad pa'am bcu bzhi pa la rdo rje tsartsi ma'i sna thang sku mngon par bris la mchod pa chen po byas na / mtshan mo 'bum phrag gcig bzlas na nges par rmi lam gyi gter mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang shing nim pa'i rtser song ste brgyad pa'am bcu bzhi pa la thang sku'i mdun du tsartsi ka bsams nas lce spyang gi mgo'i steng du khri phrag bzlas na/ tsartsi ka drung du 'ongs nas bdag gis ci bya 'dri bar 'gyur zhing sgrub pa pos bdag la mig sman gyi grub pa rab tu stsol /geces pa dang /83—707

bdag la ro'i bcud len stsol ①ces brjod par bya'o/ /gi wang dang lce spyang gi mig dang / dngul chu dang / shing ta la'i khu ba dang / sbrang rtsi mnyam pa rnams mkhas pas ril bu bya'o/ /'dis mig sman byas pa'i mig ni/ sa'i bu ga mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lce spyang gi mig dang / bya rgod kyi mig dang / ku ra ra'i mig rnams (gede kho na ltar g.yon pas g.yon pa dang / g.yas pas g.yas pa bzung ste til mar chen pos dreg pa 'chags par bya'o/ /'dis mig sman byas pa'i mig ni/ sa'i bu ga mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang gi wang dang / mi'i mkhris pa dang / ga bur (gyidang / dngul dang / de bzhin du ha raṃ libyin nas brtag par bya'o/ /'dis mig sman byas na sa'i bu ga mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang / grub pa sna tshogs gnas kyi don/ /nor dang 'bru sogs phun sum tshogs/ /lcags brgyad 'joms shing nam mkha' la / /spyod pa nyid kyang ster bar 'gyur/ /sngon du bsnyen pa'i don du sngags 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas dngul chu'i sgrub thabs brtsam par bya'o/ /thog mar dngul chu blangs te tsi tra ka dmar po'i khu bas bsnur bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la zangs kyi khu ba dang / gser gyi phye ma byin nas shā kho ḍa'i (5)khu bas bzhi cha tshad kyi nor bu bya'o/ /glang po che'i sha dang / sdong ros kyis mnyam por btags te kong (6)bu kha sbyar gyi nang du ra dza byin nas bsro bar bya'o/ /gong bu gyur pa phyed mar byas nas ra ti'i tshad kyis zangs 'joms shing gser dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro/ /ro 'di dag til mar chen pos bsdur nas lhang tsher dang ske/ mu zis til mar chen po nyi ma gsum btso bar bya ste/ ji srid slar gong bur gyur gyi bar du'o/ /sbrang rtsi dang lhan cig cung zad zos pa la skyes bu lo 83—708

stong phrag tu 'tsho bar 'gyur la/ dngul bcos nas gser du 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bā lī 0)pa'i khu ba byin nas dngul chu bsnur bar bya ste/ ji srid gong bur gyur gyi bar du'o/ /sha tā la dang dzartsi ②ra'i khu ba dang / shā kho ḍa ku'i 'bras bu'i shun pa so sor mnyam por byin nas kong bu'i nang du bzhag ste/ de nyid kyis rab tu byug (2)par bya gozhing bskams la phyi nas kong ①bur bsreg ⑥par bya ste/ myur du gong bu'i tshad du 'gyur ro/ /ra ti gnyis kyi tshad kyi nyi ma nyi shu rtsa gcig ji srid par lo ma dang skyur po spangs shing thams cad du bud med bsten ⑦pa yang spang bar bya ste/ skyes bu lo stong phrag bcu gnyis su 'tsho zhing / mkha' la spyod pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /paṃ ga bcom nas dngul chur 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang ran dzā ni la'i khu bas/ su pa ra na (0māk+ṣi dang / pasbyo sa yonyer ta'i rtsa ba mnye bar bya ste/ lhang tsher dang / na ra do ṇi'i khu bas gong bur bya'o / /kong bu'i nang du bzhag nas pha ri'i til mar la sbyar bar bya ste/ zla ba drug gis gong bur 'gyur na lcags brgyad rnams nges par gser du 'gyur la/zos pas mkha' la spyod pa nyid thob par 'gyur ro/ /mthong ba dang reg pa tsam gyis lo lnga brgya rnams su 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang dngul chu ku ma ri'i khu bas bsnur bar bya ste/ so ma ha dang / ba lā sha'i rtsa ba dang / nā ga ke sha ra'i shun pa dang / btsag yodang / ka thi zhanarmā tsodang / de bzhin du slar ba ḍa'i 'o ma dang mnyam pos bsro bar bya ste/ thun gnyis kyis ( gong bur 'gyur ro/ /cung zad zos pa tsam gyis nges par sa gsum du 'gro bar byed cing /ra ti tsam gyis nges par zangs srang gser du 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang dngul chu shrī khaṇ+ḍa'i 7so dzu'i 'o mas cung zad mnyes te mu zi dang zangs kyi snod du 83—709

dzasnyi ra'i khu bas mnye zhing nyi 'od la bskam par bya'o/ /gong bur gyur pa kong bu'i nang du bzhag ste thun gnyis su bsro bar bya'o/ /su ki ti'i kong bur bcug la ra ti'i tshad kyis dbug par bya ste zangs bcom nas gser du 'gyur ro/ /lus kyi yang mnyer ma dang skra dkar spong zhing phan par 'gyur ro/ /de nasagazhan yang dngul chu ba la'i rtsa bar bsdur bar bya zhing / slar yang gdol pa'i me tog gi khu bas bsdur bar bya'o/ /slar yang skan tsa ka dang / ba ha ri'i khu ba la bsdur bar bya'o/ /de'i la ra ti'i tshad kyi gser gyi phye ma byin nas gong bur bya'o/ /'dab ma bdun pa'i kong bu'i nang du kun dzā ra'i rkang pa'i tshad kyis dum bu byin na gong bur 'gyur ro/ /de blangs te ra ti'i tshad kyis zangs 'joms shing gser du 'gyur ro/ /lus la'ang ra ti'i tshad kyis skyon gsum 'phrog par 'gyur ro/ /gcong nad la yang 'tsho ba dang / rnal 'byor pa chen por 'gyur ro/ /zos pa tsam gyis rgyang grags su 'gro bar byed do/ /de nas gzhan yang dngul chu snod du bzhag ste rdo ba'i gzhi la bsdur zhing tri hri'i rtsa ba dang / ka ra na dza dang / bā ba'i rtsa bas bsnur bar bya'o(1)/ /gong bu byas nas kong bu'i nang du bzhag ste mtshan mo mtha' dag par bsre (7bar bya'o/ /de nas rdzogs par 'dus byas te ra ti'i tshad kyi cho ga la zangs 'joms pa dang /zos na ra ti'i tshod kyis (da spa dkar dang gnyer ma spong bar 'gyur ro/ /zla ba drug gi rab tu sbyor ba las lo stong phrag rnams su 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang rab tu sbyor ba nyid de / dngul chu sung gcig blangs nas shisgo be ra'i khu bas bsnur bar bya'o/ /lhang tsher dang gser cung zad dang ldan pa/shisgo dmar po dang mnyam pos ga ḍā ya'i khu ba blangs te nges par zhag bcu gnyis 83—710

rnams so/ /de'i rjes la kong bu'i nang du bzhag ste bsro bar bya'o/ /kuñdza'i rkang pa'i tshad las/ de nas blangs te ra ti'i tshad kyis yang dag par blangs la gzhug 0)par bya ste/ zangs ma lus bcom nas nges par gser du 'gyur ro/ /zos nas mkha' la spyod pa nyid thob cing lo stong (5)du 'tsho bar the tshom med do/ /gnod sbyin dang mi 'am ci'i bdag po rnams kyis bsten (5)cing gshin rje'i 'jig rten rnams su 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang lhang tsher nag po srang gcig khu)dang / bha ka dang paṇ+ḍa dang dngul chu dang ldan pa rnams kyis zla ba phyed du sbyar te rtsi bo che dang ro mnyam du byas pa za ba'i tshad kyis chu grang mo dang yang dag par ldan par bza' bar bya ste/ zla ba sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor pas bdag nyid rgas pa dang 'chi ba med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas gzhan yang lcags zhu)srang gang tsam po)blangs te ra gan phye mar byas te ka shi'i khu bas mnyam par ldan pa me lce'i 'od zer la bskam par bya'o/ /dngul chu dang mu zi 57)rnams der bzhi cha'i tshad sbyar ba las/ gak+ko la dang / li shi'i na phye ma rnams phyed dang gnyis snga ma'i tshad las te/ thams cad gcig tu byas la rdo ba'i gzhi la lcags bsnur bar bya'o/ /gser kong bur bzhag nas bsro bar bya'o/ /de nas blangs te lcags chen po zla ba'i tshad kyis bza' bar bya ste/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma rnams 'joms shing rgas pa dang 'chi ba med par byed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i (9)rgyud las/mi snang ba la sogs kyi le'u bdun pa'o// //de nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ji rgyal pos 1 5grib ma 'phrog pa'i rab tu dbye ba 83—711

gsungs pa/ rkang gnyis dang rkang bzhi pa rnams kyi dgra bo tshar gcod pa'i phyir rab tu sbyor ba 'di brjod par bya'o/ /thog mar re zhig ①sems can thams cad rmongs par bya ba'i phyir dpa' bo gshin rje gshed bsgom par bya'o/ /rang khyim rnams sam mtshan mo'i dus/ /stag lpags gdan la 'dug byas te/ /zhal gcig chadamar po mi bzad pa/ /zhags pa dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /ro la bzhugs pa drag shul che/ /spyan gsum shin tu 'jigs rung pa/ /thams cad rmongs par byed pa'i lha/ /mi bzad pa yi me stag 'phro/ /'di ltar bsams nas 'bum phrag bzlas/ /phyi nas cho ga kun spyod pa/ / kā ra bī ra chadakar rtsa ba / /de bzhin darnyi ④dmar rtsa ba/ /sbal ba'i khrag gis bsdur byas te/ /thig le bcang bya brtul zhugs can/ /gang gi grib ma 'phrog byed pa/ /rkang pa de yang rmongs pas 'thob/ /rkang gnyis rkang bzhi thams cad ni/ /rmongs par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /nyi ma rengs dang dkar phyogs la/ /srin bu lto ba nas skyugs pa/ /rab tu 'bad pas de blangs te(5)/ /rwa co yis ni thig le bya/ /dpral bar thig le byin byas pa/ /gang gi grib ma 'phrog par byed/ /nges par rmongs pa 'thob par 'gyur/ /'o ma rnams kyis rab dkrus 6)dag /darnyi ro ha u ha raji'i/ /rtsa ba 'di rnams skam mnyam par/ /bya rog khrag gis bsnur nas ni/ /thig le bya'o brtul zhugs can/ /thig le 'di yis byin rlabs kyis/ /lha yang rab tu bskyod par byed/ /nges par som nyi mi bya ste/ /bya ba la yang rmongs par 'gyur/ /de bzhin rab tu sbyor ba gzhan(77/ /ra sa shiji ku thā rī/ /pha tī na ga pha tī dang 8/ /'di rnams kun gyi sha bcas pa/ /ril bu bya 'o brtul zhugs can/ /nam mkha'i rdo ba'i chu nyid kyis/ /spyi bor thig le bcang 83—712

bar bya/ /nges par reg ste gdong bltas na/ /mi ni khrag tu skyug par byed/ /kā ka ma rtsi sprang rtsi dkar/ /khu byug dkar po'i mig gis ni/ /nam mkha'i chu dang mnyam par ldan/ /spyi bo la ni thig le bya/ /thig le 'di yi byin rlabs kyis / /dgra bo rnams ni dbang du 'gyur/ /gang du phyag ni 'tshal byed pa/ /de rnams nges 6)par rmongs par 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang rab ②sbyor ①te/ /sbrul nag po yi lce dang ni/ /de bzhin sre mo'i lce nyid dang / /byi ba'i mkhris dupa yang dag bsres/ /khri phrag lnga yi ril bu rnams/ /thig le 'di yi byin rlabs kyis / /dgra bo bran du byed par 'gyur/ /ma rungs 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /rgyal po rmongs par byed par 'gyur/ /de nas gzhan yang rab ⑧sbyor yite/ /'chi med rtsa ba'i sī ta ka /de bzhin ba hu ḍā pha la/ /'di rnams mnyam po'i cha yis kyang / /ril bu bya 'o mkhas pa yis/ /thig le 'di yis yang dag bzung —/ /'jig rten gsum po rmongs par 'gyur/ /kha yis bdud rtsi blangs byas te/ /g.yon pa'i ming med kyis kyang ni/ /'di ni/ ril bu byin gyis brlab (7pa'i sngags te/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa se na a dhi pa ta ye ma hā dur dān+ta da ma kā ya / nā sha ya nā sha ya/ bi drwa pa yi bi dā pa ya/ hūṃ hūṃ sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ le'u brgyad pa'o// //'dir (8)bcom ldan 'das kyis ro langs la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs gsungs te / oṃ rgyuḥdzaḥs pa rā dzi taḥ/ oṃ rgyuḥdzaḥ.a dzi ta/ oṃ hūṃ dzaḥpu ra ṇaḥ/ oṃ hūṃ dzaḥ.a (1)pu ra ṇaḥ/ oṃ shri khodzabla sa na a dhi pa ti/ oṃ sum̐ dzaḥ ku le shwa ra/ oṃ 83—713

hūṃ dzaḥbudhe shwa raḥ/ o yaṃ dzaḥkyi ka ra ut+ta ma/ zhes 0)pa 'di rnams 'byung po'i bdag po chen po rnams so/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ dpal rdo rje dbyug pa 'dzin pa'i mdun du 'bum phrag bzla (mibar bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen par 'gyur ro/ /de nas zla ba nya la mchod pa chen po byas nas zho dang /bu ram dang / 'o ma sbyar ba'i zas dkar po rnams kyis ji ltar gsungs pa'i nimachod pa bya'o/ /gu gul gyi dud pa byin nas mtshan mo mtha' dag bzla ④bar bya'o / /nges par tho rangs 'ongs par 'gyur te/ gal te 'ongs par ma gyur na skad cig de la 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs nas kyang bdag gis ci bya zhes bka' stsal du gsol/ sgrub 5pa pos bdag gi bran du mdzod ces smra bar bya'o/ /de nas brtsams te ci bya ba'i las rnams byed de/phyi / rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal srid kyang ster ba dang / dgra rnams tshar gcod par byed do/ /lha mo ri bong can blangs te ster bar byed cing rgyab tu khur te lha'i 'jig rten du 'gro ba dang /brgya byin nyid ster bar byed do/ /bskal pa bdun du 'tsho ba byed par 'gyur ro//de nas mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs 'di yin te/ mtshan mo mchod rten gyi mdun du 'dug ste zhag bdun du stong phrag brgyad bzla bar 977bya'o/ /zhag brgyad pa la mchod pa chen po byas nas gtor ma phul te gu gul gyi dud pa dbul zhing bzla bar /bya'o/ /bzlas pa na nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /kye sgrub pa po bdag gis ci bya zhes so/ /sgrub pa po bdag gis ci bya ba khyod mkhyen no/ /zhes smra bar bya'o/ /de nas brtsams nas ci bya ba'i las rnams byed do/ /slar yang rgyal srid ster ro/ /lo stong phrag tu 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du ci bya ba'i las rnams byed do/ /che ge 'tsho bar gyis shig /ces pa dang /843—714

che ge 'chi bar gyis shig 6)ces pa thams cad byed do/ /de nas gsang ba'i sgrub thabs yin te/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khang par song ste nyi ma bdun du stong phrag brgyad bzla bar ②bya'o/ /nyi ma brgyad pa la mchod pa chen po byas nas zan zho dkar po ji ltar gsungs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /mtshan phyed pa ji nisrid pa de srid du bzla bar ④bya'o/ /ji srid mtshan phyed pa de nas rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /me tog gi mchod yon dbul bar bya ste/ mnyes par gyur na rgyal srid ster zhing bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de nas kun tu gsang ba'i sgrub phyithabs yin te/ gdung dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du khri phrag bzla bar (6)bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen par 'gyur ro/ /de nas zla ba nya ba la ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas mtshan phyed pa ji ri srid pa de srid du bzla bar ⑧bya'ol/ /de nas mtshan phyed na myur du 5)'ongs shing mdun du gnas te/ kye mnyes gshin ci byed ces smra bar byed do/ /sgrub pa pos bdag gis yici bya ba khyed mkhyen ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas brtsams te ci bya ba'i las rnams byed do/ /gnod sbyin gyi bu mo mchog bkug nas ster bar byed do/ /'dod ldan gyi mchog ston mo ster bar byed do/ /nyi ma so sor bza' ba dang / gos zung dang / dī nā ra lnga rnams rab tu ster ro/ /lo lnga brgya rnams 'tsho bar byed do/ /de nas dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs yin te/ mtshan mo dur khrod du song nas nyi ma bdun du stong phrag brgyad bzla bar yinabya'o/ /nyi ma brgyad pa la nya dang / sha dang / til dang / dzasbu /geli ka dang / zan dkar po dang / zho dang / bu ram dang / bdug pa dang / 'bras bu ji ltar gsungs pa'i nye bar mkho ba rnams kyi gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /gu gul gyi bdug pa 83—715

dbul par bya'o/ /mtshan phyed pa ji srid pa de srid du bzla bar 6)bya'o/ /de nas mtshan phyed nas ha ha'i sgra thos par byed do/ /de la 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /'khor dang bcas pa tshogs kyis yongs su bskor nas 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa na mchod pa chadabul zhing mnyes par gyur na/ 'byung po thams cad bran du 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma nyi mar dī nā ra brgyad rnams rab tu ster bar byed do//dgra thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro/ /lo stong phrag 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rigs kyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs yin te/ lha'i gnas su song ste dri dang ldan pa'i me tog dmar po dang / gu gul gyi bdug pa byin nas khri phrag bzla bar (0bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen par 'gyur ro/ /nag po'i phyogs la mtshan mor nya dang / sha dang / til dang / dzasbu lili ka dang / bza' ba dmar po'i cho ga gtor ma bzhin dbul bar bya'o/ /tu ru ku'i bdug pa byin nas ji ⑤srid mtshan phyed kyi bar du bzla bar 95)bya'o/ /de nas 'bar ba chen po zab cing 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur te/ de la 'jigs par ⑦mi bya'o/ /mnyes gshin 98)ci byed ces smra bar byed do/ /sgrub pa pos bdag gis (9)ci bya ba khyed mkhyen ces khubarjod par bya'o/ /de nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du ci bya ba'i las rnams byed do/ /nyi ma nyi mar thun gsum du dī nā ra lnga ster ro/ /'dod pa'i lha rdzas kyi ston mo ster ro/ /lo lnga brgya 'tsho bar byed do/ /de nas 'byung po'i 11dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs yin te/ mtshan ma gcig par song ste gcig pus zhag gsum du mtshan mor bza' ba kha zas dmar po dang / nya sha dang /til dang / dzasbu k+ṣ-i li ku'i gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /nyi ma gsum pa la rang nyid myur du 'ong zhing mdun du gnas so/ /de 'di ltar bdag gis ci bya zhes 83—716

smra'ol/ /sgrub pa pos bdag gis ci bya ba khyed mkhyen ces brjod par bya'o/ /rtag tu rjes su 'brang 6)bar 'gyur te/ nges par lha mo blangs nas ster bar byed do/ /rang nyid kyis bza' ba dang gos blangs te rnam pa ster bar ②byed do//lo stong phrag gnyis rnams 'tsho bar byed do/ /de nas pho nya mchog gi sgrub thabs yin te(mi/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khang par song nas nag po'i bcu bzhi la bzlas pa khri bya'o / /nyi ma bdun rnams su sngon du bsnyen pa ④bya'o/ /de nas sgrub thabs brtsam par bya ste/ tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal byas nas gu gul gyi bdug pa byin la/ zho dang mar dkar po sbyar ba'i zas dang / ku sha'i chun po (5)la nye bar 'dug pas mar gyi mar me rab tu sbar te mtshan mor ji srid (nyamatshan phyed gyur pa de srid bzla bar ji bya ste/ rang nyid pho nya mchog tu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa na tsan+dan gyi chus (8)mchod yon sbyin par bya'o/ /mnyes par gyur na bdag gis ci bya zhes dri'o/ /sgrub pa pos bdag gis ci bya ba khyed mkhyen ces brjod par bya'o//de nas brtsams te ci bya ba'i las rnams byed do/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thams cad rab tu ster ro/ /yid la 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par byed do/ /de nas 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma sgrub pa ni/ gro ga'i 'dab tshuram la gi wang gi gzugs brnyan bris te gcig pu stan la 'dug nas bzlas pa stong phrag bya'o/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dzomathar mchod pa chen po byas nas mar gyi sgron me rab tu sbar te mi smra bar bzla bar yi bya'o/ /de nas mtshan phyed nas nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro//'ongs pa na 'dod pa byas te chung mar 'gyur ro/ /lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang bza' ba la sogs pa gdan la bzhag ste 'gro'o/ /bud med dang 'grogs pa dor bar bya ste / gzhan du na rnam par 'joms par byed do/ /de nas ka na / ka ma ti'i 83—717

sgrub thabs yin te/ shing ba ḍa'i rtsa bar song nas nya dang sha'i gtor ma cho gas dbul bar bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyang 'thungs te lhag mas mchod yon sbyin par bya'o / /stong phrag gcig bzla bar 6)bya ste/ 'di ltar zhag bdun gyi mtshan mo rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i 'khor brgya phrag gsum dang mnyam du 'di rnams mtshan phyed nas nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa na 'dod pa byas te chung mar 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bcu gnyis rnams kyi gos dang rgyan chadang bza' ba rnams ster ro/ /nyi ma so sor dī nā ra brgyad rnams rab tu ster ro/ /de nas dga' ma'i sgrub thabs yin te/ ri mo mkhan la gtad la thang sku bri bar bya'o/ /gser gyi mdog can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na ut+pal can dzā (5)ti'i me tog gis mchod par bya'o/ /gu gul gyi bdug pa byin pa stong phrag brgyad bzla bar (4 bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i mthar ji ltar 'byor ba'i mchod pa byas nas mar gyi sgron me rab tu sbar te ji srid mtshan phyed de srid par bzlas pa bya ste/ rang nyid 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs nas mi smra bar 'dod pa byas te chung mar 'gyur ro/ /sgrub po'i 'khor rnams skyong zhing / lha rdzas kyi 'dod pa dang ston mo rnams dang / dngul chu'i bcud len rnams ster bar byed do/ /dī nā ra nyi shu rtsa lnga ster bar byed do/ /de nas pad+ma ma ni'i sgrub thabs yin te/ rang gi khyim du spyi bo'i gnas su tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal byas te/ gu gul gyi bdug pa byin nas stong phrag gcig tshad bzla bar (5tshobya'o / /de nas zla ba nya la ji ltar 'byor ba'i mchod pa byas nas ji srid mtshan phyed pa de srid du bzlas pa bya tsiste/ nges par 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /'ongs pa na 'dod pa byas te chung mar 'gyur ro/ /lha rdzas kyi 'dod pa rab tu ster zhing /843—718

dngul chu'i bcud len dang / grub pa'i rdzas kyang ster bar byed do/ /de nas ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs/ /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams sgrub dus su/ /ral gcig ma ni rnam bsgom 6)gya②/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ste/ /gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa mo/ /sku mdog sngon mo 'jigs byed che / /bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /shar du dzam+bha la bsam bya/ /nor 'dzin yang ni lho ru ste/ /chu dbang nub tu dgod par bya/ /byang du tsi bi kuṇ+ḍa li / /me la sogs pa'i zur du yang / /gnod sbyin mo bzhi rnam bsgom bya / /kuṇ+ḍal ha tī nī ro hi/ /mdzes ma cho gas dgod par bya/ /de nas sgo skyong bsam bya ste/ /dbyug pa la sogs mtha' dag las/ /ji ltar snga ma'i 'khor lo mthong / /de ltar kha dog rab sbyar bya/ /thams cad gtso bo'i mtshan ma 'dzin//slar yang phyi nas bsngags bzlas bya/ /oṃ e ka dza ṭi ba su sā dha nī swā hā/ de nas puk+ka sī'i sgrub thabs/ /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /skad cig gang gis bsgoms tsam gyis/ /'jig rten gsum po puk+ka sīr/ /sku mdog ser skya zhal bzhi pa/ /phyag bzhi bong bu la zhon pa/ /bsgom bya puk+ka sī yi las/ /bya rog tho ba mda' dang ni/ /gzhu rnams bsgom bya brtul zhugs can/ /sngags bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ puk+ka sī oṃ/ /de nas (5)'jam pa'i (6)rdo rje yi(7)/ /sgrub thabs yang dag rab bshad bya/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa las skad cig las mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //83—719

de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos/ /nyal ba slong bar byed pa dang / /sbrul gyi sos btab la sogs pa/ /srung ba'i gsang sngags las gsungs pa/ /'bum phrag bzhi ni bzlas pa yis/ /don grub sa bon bsags rnams kyis/ /nyal ba slong bar byed pa dang / /'tsho bar yang ni the tshom med/ /zhi ba gshin rje gshed dkar po/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor rigs rnams bsgom6)/ /phyag tu don grub sa bon rnams/ /'bum phrag bzhir ni bzla bar ②bya/ /sos btab yang dag kha bltas te/ /nyungs (gekar gyis ni brab par bya/ /gal te gang gis bzung ba yang / /the tshom med par ldang bar 'gyur/ /hūṃ yig kha dog dkar po ni / /bsgrub bya'i snying gar cibasam bya ste/ /hrīḥdhīḥl sogs sngags bzla (5)zhing //'od zer rnams kyis dug dgug bya/ /phyag g.yas de bzhin g.yan 6)pa la/ /'dab ⑦brgyad pad+ma dgod par bya/ /de dbus su yang hūṃ yig gis/ /'od zer rnams kyis bdud rtsi 'dzag /de nyid kyis ni spyi bor yang (she/ /'od dkar dkyil 'khor gyi 99)dbus su/ /mkhas pas ha yig bsam par bya/ /de nas hrīḥthiḥl sogs sngags/ /byugs pas dug ni dgug par bya/ /oṃ hrīḥha t+t+waṃ dzaḥphuḥyig /sngags kyis spyi bo nas brtsams te/ /rkang mthar bya ba sngags bzlas kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i 7char pa bsgom bya ste/ /'tsho bar yang ni the tshom med/ /sa bon yi ge rdzogs pa ni/ /'dzin pa bcings pa'i mchog yin no/ /kha dog ser po yang dag byung / /sos btab gnas la nges par bsgom 11/ /oṃ yig dang po tsheg drag mtha'/ /cho ga nges sbyar ha tha dag /dug gi bya bas bcings pa la/ /sbyor ba rnams kyis bcings pa la/ /spyi bor gser 'joms legs par rtogs/ /de ltar gzhan rnams kyang g.yon pa dang / phol mig dang / dmu chu la sogs 83—720

pa gos pa legs par tshar gcod pa'i rab tu sbyor ba mang pos kyang ngo / /de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal pos/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor mdzad/ /bgegs dang log 'dren gdug 0)pa rnams/ /dgug pa'i don phyir yang gsungs pa/ /bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor las/ /'bar ba'i sku dang dbyug pa yis/ /lus gsum las skyes dgas par bya/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas rnams kun gyi/ /lha mo khyod ni dbang por gyur/ /slob dpon gshin rje 'joms dkyil 'khor/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /gos kyis gdong ba bcings nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'i nang bzhag nas/ /kye khyod su zhes brjod bya ste/ /bdag skal bzang zhes smra bar bya/ /blo bzang yol ba nang byas nas/ /bla ma mchog la gsol btab bya/ /dbang bskur ⑧don du gus chen gyis/ /mgon po'i rjes su gsum brjod bya/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas chos chen gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpas dbang bskur las/ /bdag la mgon pos yang dag dbang / /mchog kyang dag la stsal du gsol/ /glu dang rol mos (kyide bzhin mchod/ /mchod yon zhabs bsil de bzhin nyid/ /slob mas mchod pa la dbul bya/ /yang na der ni bstod par (4)bya/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /stong nyid yang dag gsung bar mdzad/ /oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta(5) / oṃ pu (dzinadza badz+ra swa bhā (beb ād+ma ko3rta58)/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā ba ād+ma ku3 lhadzin/ de nas sbyin sreg rab bshad bya/ /zhi ba la sogs rab dbye las/ /gang gi sbyin sreg gis te'agrub 'gyur/ /las kun rab tu sgrub pa po'i zhi ba'i sems kyis zhi ba la/ /rgyas pa'i sems kyis rgyas pa la/ /rab dga'i sems kyis dbang la nyid/ /drag po yis ni gsod pa la'o/ /zlum po rnam pa zhi 83—721

ba ste/ /rdzing bu rnam pa rgyas pa'o/ /dbang la zla ba phyed par brjod/ /mkha' khams mdog can gsad 0 pa la'o/ /zhi ba la ni khru gang yin/ /de bzhin khru gnyis rgyas pa la'o/ /ji ltar rgyas pa de bzhin dbang / /sor mo nyi shu gsad (7pa la'o/ /khru phyed brtsigs pa zhi ba la/ /rgyas pa la ni khru gang ngo / /lnga gnyis gsad 2pa las byas te/ /ji 47ltar dgug pa de bzhin dbang / /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg tshes gcig la/ /zla ba nya la rgyas pa ste/ /bcu bzhi pa la mngon spyod do/ /brgyad pa la ni dbang gi 55 las/ /shel dang nya phyis zhi ba la/ /mu tig 'bras bu rab bsngags te/ /dung dang po de tsi ta dang / /nad med pa la mi rus so/ /tsan+dan dmar pos bsgos 96pa yis/ /byi ru yi ni khyad par las/ /drag mig lung thang de bzhin du/ /mi rus nā ga pha ṇi yi/ /brgya phrag gcig ni zhi ba la/ /de bzhin brgyad lhag rgyas pa la/ /dbang dang dgug pa nyi shu lnga/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi mngon spyod la'o/ /brgya phyed 7sngags kyis bsgrub pa la'o/ /ril bu rgyu bar bya sngags la/ /phreng ba rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /de bzhin lhun po gnyis rgyu bya / /zhi ba mdzub 8mo la bzhag ste/ /gung mo la ni rgyas pa'o/ /dbang dang dgug pa ming med la/ /tshar gcad 9pa ni mthe chung la'o/ /kha dog dkar po zhi ba la/ /kha dog ser po rgyas pa la/ /dbang la dmar po rtag bsam bya/ /nges par gsod la nag po 'dod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //rnal 'byor bzhi dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i sna tshogs pa'i bza' ba dang /83—722

ston mo dang / myang ba dang / bldag pa dang / btung ba la sogs pa yang dag par ldan pa'i dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang/ dril bu dang / ba dan la sogs pa rnams kyis yang dag par gang ba'i rol mo'i sgra chen po lnga bsgom par bya ste / mdun du gtor ma'i snod skyogs sam zangs gzhong gi nang du bza' ba tsam bcas pa'i chu khyor ba gsum ji ltar rnyed pa'i dam tshig gi 6)rdzas dang ldan pa bzhag la/ de rab tu gsal bar drung du bzhag la sgom pa brtsam par bya'o/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su pad+ma 'dab dzom brgyad pa ze ba dang bcas pa bsgom par bya'o / /ze 'bru la yaṃ yig las rin)rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ mtha' gnyis su g.yo ba'i ba dan dang rgyal mtshan brgyad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i steng du raṃ yig dmar po las skyes pa'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dmar po zur gsum la raṃ yig gis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i steng du ru yig gsum yongs su gyur pa las (4rimago bo gsum gyi skyed bu la gnas pa'i āḥyig dmar po las (5༄skyes pa'i pad+ma'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'o/ /der pad+ma 'dab (6)ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa bsam par bya'o/ /de la shar la sogs pa'i 'dab (nem la rgyu 86 dzi khaṃ hūṃ gi yi ges rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rang bzhin rnams dang / de bzhin du me la sogs pa'i zur du māṃ rmā r+pā t+t+waṃ bī gyi 5)yi ges spyan ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin rnams bsam par bya zhing / yi ge bcu po 'di rnams yongs su gyur pa las go ku da ha na rnams dang / bi tsor shu mā mū tsho zhes pa 'di rnams kyi yi ge rnams kyis mtshan pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas bcu po 'di rnams pad+ma'i snod du blta bar bya'o/ /de'i steng du oṃ yig kha dog dkar po des 83—723

bkab pa'i rang bzhin bsams la/ oṃ yig las skyes pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rol/ /de'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po las byung ba'i dbyug pa de'i sa bon gyis mtshan pa blta bar bya'o/ /de nas slar pad+ma'i snod las 'og gi skyed bu la oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum 0)bzlas shing (mibarjod la bsgoms te/ snga ma bar ma chad par rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed de me'i dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar bas gdungs shing bskol ②te sbar bas 'bar ba'i gong bu la sogs pa dam tshig gi rdzas bcu'i rang bzhin mtha' dag zhu bas rdo rje'i dbyug ༷4)pas dkrugs (5)pa blta bar bya'o/ /de nas slar rdo rje'i dbyug pa zhu bar gyur te bdud rtsi nyi ma 'char kha'i kha dog gam ⑥dngul chu'i rnamapar bsam par bya'o/ /de las slar oṃ āḥrgyu gi yi ge gsum las thon ⑦pa'i 'od zer gyi tshogs rnams kyis khams gsum ma lus pa la gnas pa'i bdud rtsi shin tu mang bar blangs par bsgom tshonazhing / de nyid rab tu gzhug par bya'o/ /de nyid rab tu bcug pa la mkha'i rnam pa shin tu gsal ba'i tshogs bsil ba'i sbrang rtsi 'dus pa'i gzugs su brtan par bya zhing / phyi nas yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs/ /dri med ston ku'i zla ba'i 'od/ /ye shes bdud rtsir rab sbyor gyis/ /'bad nas gtor ma rdzogs byas te/ /gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'i sngags pa khro bo phyag na zhags pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa spros nas phyogs skyong rnams kyi snying la lcags kyus phug cing / mgul pa la zhags pas bcings te bkug par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas oṃ hrīḥdhīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa duṣ+ṭa in+d+ra sa pa ri wā ra ā kun+ta ya dza/ sngags 'dis mig stong pa dkar ser glang po che dkar po'i gdan la g.yas pa dang / gcig shos na rdo rje dang / sdigs mdzub mdzad pa 803—724

bkug ste shar du gzhag ①par bya'o/ /sngags de nyid kyis nye dbang mkha' lding gi gdan la rin po che'i cod pan can g.yas na be con dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/g.yon na dung dang kostu bha 'dzin pa/ de nyid kyi g.yon du ha cang mi ring bar gzhag (snyepar bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis gshin rje ma he la zhon pa dbyug pa 'dzin pa lho ru gzhag ③par bya'o/ /yang de'i nyid kyis chu lha kha dog dkar po brang 'gro la zhon pa/ phyag na klu'i zhags pa can nub tu gzhag ④par bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis lus ngan ser po gter la gnas pa/ phyag na bī dza pū ⑤ra ka (gyedang /na ku li can byang du gzhag ⑦par bya'o/ /de nyid kyis glang sna dkar po byi ba la gnas pa/ g.yas na bgrang phreng dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ g.yon na la phug dang la du 'dzin pa dbang ldan du'o/ /de nyid kyis dbang phyug dkar po khyu mchog la zhon pa ral pa 'dzin pa/ phyag na rtse gsum dang thod pa can/ phyag gnyis dkar mo la 'khyud pa dbang ldan du gzhag gshepar bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis me lha dmar po ra (9)la gnas pa/ phyag na bgrang phreng dang spyi blugs can mer gzhag ⑩par bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis srin po ro la zhon pa/ phyag na gri gug dang thod pa can sngon po mi sdug pa khro ba dang bcas pa bden bral du gzhag (1par bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis rlung lha du ba'i mdog can ri dwags nyugeser po la gnas pa rlung du gzhag ( par bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis nyi ma dmar po phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rta bdun la gnas pa steng du gzhag tso)par bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis zla ba dkar po phyag gnyis kyis ku mud 'dzin pa/ shing rta la gnas pa steng du gzhag snyipar bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis tshangs pa ser po zhal bzhi pa/ spyi blugs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / dbyug pa dang / bgrang phreng 'dzin pa ral pas 83—725

brgyan pa/ ngang pa la gnas pa steng du gzhag (1)par bya'o/ /yang de nyid kyis sa'i lha mo pad+ma la gnas pa g.yon na bum pa 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yas na dam bcas khas len pa 'og tu gzhag (5par bya'o/ ri/yang de nyid kyis thags bzang ②ris sngon po shing rta la gnas pa/ g.yas pa dang gcig (geshos na ral gri dang /sdigs (snyemadzub 'dzin pa de nyid du gzhag (ne par bya'o/ /de nas khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi gzugs phyag na phur bu 7'dzin pa rnams la khro bo mgrin pa 'phyang ba nyid thugs ma'i sa bon gyis bkug ste/ de rnams kyi snying ga (nyadang / mgrin pa dang / spyi bo rnams su rkang pa'i mtha' yang sngags 'dis phur bu gdab par bya'ol/ /oṃ trīḥdhīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa sarba in+d+ra ā dī na tī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ces pas phur bu (7btab pa'i mthar grub pa'i bcud bsdus la lha de rnams thams cad kyang gshin rje mthar byed kyi rnam par bskyed par bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems khu bas sam/ yang na de'i tshe sa bon dang mtshan ma'i rim pas bskyed par bya'o/ /de las sa bon hrīḥyig las rdzogs pa dbang po'o/ /sa bon jiḥlas rdzogs pa gshin rje'o/ /sa bon wi 7las rdzogs pa chu lha'o/ /sa bon kṛ yig las rdzogs pa lus ngan no/ /sa bon ta yig las rdzogs pa dbang ldan no/ /sa bon ā yig las rdzogs pa me lha'o/ /sa bon na yig las rdzogs pa bden bral lo / /sa bon na yig las rdzogs pa rlung lha'o/ /sa bon hūṃ yig las rdzogs pa zla ba'o/ /sa bon hūṃ yig las rdzogs pa nyi ma'o/ /sa bon phaṭa yig las rdzogs pa tshangs pa'o/ /sa bon phaṭa yig las rdzogs pa nor 'dzin ma'o/ /sa bon swā yig las rdzogs pa thags bzang (11ris so/ /sa bon hā yig las rdzogs pa 'byung po thams cad do/ /zhes pa'o(12/ /de ltar bskyed de rnam par bsams 83—726

nas de rnams kyi mig la sogs pa rnams la gnas ji hu)lta bar mig la sogs pa bskyed cing / lus la sogs pa rnams la sku rdo rje la sogs pa rnams dang /gshin rje mthar byed kyi cod pan nyid dang / dang por mchod yon bsang gtor dang zhabs bsil la sogs pa phul/ phyi nas gtor ma'i yo byad bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i rim pas sngon du ste/ de nyid gsum gyis mngon par bsngags shing (mi/slar de rnams kyi ljags kyi rab tu sbyor ba rnam par bsams la phyi nas sngags 'dis bdud rtsi dbul bar bya'o/ /oṃ rak+ta mu ku mā ri riya/ rak+ta dza ṭā ya/ rak+ta mu khā ya/ rak+ta sha ri rā ya/ rak+ta bhu dzā ya/ rak+ta muṇ+ḍa mā lā bha ra nā geya/rak+ta ra tha sa mā ru sgyu ya/ rak+ta pad+ma ā sa nā ya/ rak+ta bha ra ṇa bhu ṣa ṇa ya/ si rda ba lo groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍi/ ma ma bi sdi ha ra ha ra/ tsa tur mā 'on ni ba rā ya ni bā ra ya / tā sa ya tā sa ya/ bh+ra ma ya bh+ra ma ya/ sbyin hrīn+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ ts+tsha da ts+tsha da/ bhe da bhe da/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/phyi nas yan lag so sos dbul bar bya ste/ oṃ irnyi ya na maḥhrīḥ/ ya mā ya na maḥjiḥ / ba ru ṇa ya na maḥwi skur/ ku be rā ya na ma kṛ/ yī shwa ra ya na maḥta/asne ye na maḥ.āḥ/ ne+e ri byā ya na ma na/ bha ya be na maḥn/ tsan+d+ra ye na maḥ/rdza ya na maḥrgyu/ brah+ma ṇi na ma phaṭa/ ba su dha rā ye na maḥphaṭa/ bai ma tsi tri ṇi na ma swā/ sarba bhu te bh+yo na ma hā/ ha ha ha/ hi hi hi no/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ dze dze dze / phyis ( nanas me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / lha bshos la sogs pa dbul bar bya'o/ /de rnams la sgrub pa pos phul ba'i bcud thams cad gsol zhing nye bar longs spyod par mdzad do/ /de gnas pa rnams la rdo rje gsor la 'gying ba dang bcas par dril bu 'khrol zhing bstod pa byas te/ gti 8(3—727

mug dga' ma la sogs pas mngon par 'dod pas gsol ba gdab cing /bzhad pa rnam pa brgyad kyi sngags brjod par bya'o/ /de la sngags 'di yin te/ha ha he he ho ho hūṃ hūṃ/ gshegs par bya ste/ o aḥmuḥ zhes 6)pa 'dis kyang ngo ske/ /phyi nas sgrub pa po'i mngon par 'dod pa yang mdzad do/ /khyod kyis sems can thams cad don/ /ji lta'i rjes mthun ((grub pa stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs mdzad de/ /slad nas kyang ni 'byon par mdzod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ gtor ma'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas nges par bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das sems dpa' chen po la bstod pa/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /shin tu 'jigs rung gshin rje gshed/ /ston pa sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /sku yi rdo rjer (guphyag 'tshal lo/ /phra ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /shin tu 'jigs rung gshin rje gshed/ /thugs kyi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /rin chen rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /dbyangs mchog kun gyi mchog gi mchog /gsung gi rdo rje khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phrag dog rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod/ /las kun byed pa'i gshin rje gshed/ /sku yi rdo rje rab gsal ba/ /phyag na ral gri khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa/ /sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje spyan dang / rdo rje snyan dang / rdo rje 83—728

shangs dang / rdo rje ljags dang / rdo rje lus ①dang / rdo rje thugs zhes gsungs pa ni②/ bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje'i spyan la sogs pa byin gyis brlab pa'i dam tshig go/ /de nas drag shul gshin rje gshed/ /dkyil 'khor 'di las rab bshad bya/ /gshin rje gshed po rab gsal ba/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub par byed/ /gsar pa legs par bkal ②ba dang / /legs pa'i tshad ldan gtsang ma yi/ /srad bus thig gdab shes rab can/ /gshin rje 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam par 'joms/ /zhi ba la sogs rab ston pa/ /zlum po'i dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /der ni kun nas rtse lnga pa/ /las kyi rdo rje bri bar bya/ /rdo rje 'bar bas yang dag 'khrigs/ /de yi dbus su rdo rje bri/ /rdo rje'i 'od zer yang dag 'khrigasaskyi/ /'khor lo shar rtser bri bar bya/ /'od zer phreng bas yang dag 'khrigs(snye/ /rin chen lho ru bri bar ⑥bya/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od 'phro ba/ /sprin ( gyi mdog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od/ /ral gri byang du bri bar bya/ /'khor lo shar gyi zur du bri/ /lho ru rdo rje bri bar bya/ /nub tu pad+ma bri ba ste/ /kha khyer ze 'brur bcas pa'o/ /'od zer lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /ral gri byang du bri bar bya/ /shar gyi sgo ru tho ba ste/ /lho ru rdo rje'i dbyug pa yang / /'dam skyes nub kyi sgo ru'o/ /byang du ral gyi (kyerdo rje can/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par shes bya ste/ /mchod pa'i khyad par rnams bya'o/ /'dod yon lnga yis sangs rgyas rnams/ /som nyi med par mchod par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //83—729

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 6)bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis gsol ba 'debs par mdzad de/ gang gis rdo rje can mnyes pa/ /phyag rgya'i rab tu sbyor ba gsungs/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas phyag rgya rnams/ /slar yang 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /tshig 'di dag ni gsung bar mdzad/ /dkyil 'khor ba rnams thams cad kyi/ /spyi bor gshin rje gshed bsgom bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bri bya zhing / /rtag tu sbyin sreg gis mchod bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsgrub bya ste/ /sdom pa gzung bar bya de nas / /thog mar cod pan dbang yin te/ /gnyis pa ral gri sbyin par bya/ /gsum pa rdo rje dril bu yang / /bzhi pa zla ba bza' ba'o/ /'di rnams dbang bskur chen po bzhi/ /dmar po'i zhal nas 'byung ba ste/ /dbang bskur 'di dag byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal ba'i sras 'gyur byang chub thob/ /de nas 'byung po thams cad kyin/ /gtor ma bya ba sngar rab bshad/ /sngags chen brjod par gyur pa na/ /'byung po thams cad rab tu 'bar/ /hrīḥdhīḥsogs sngags sa bon dang / /swā hā mtha' yis nges par sbyar/ /bshang gci chu dang bsres pa yis/ /maṇ+ḍal gru gsum byas nas ni/ /lha rnams tshim byas rnal 'byor pa/ /hā hā'i rnam pa slar dran bya/ /dkyil 'khor gsum ni gubyas nas ni/ /brgyad ( )dang bcu gnyis bcu drug rnams/ /mkhas pas cho gas yang dag bri/ /sngags rnams thams cad dgod bya ste/ /grub pa'i sngags rnams brtul zhugs can/ /re mig bcu gnyis la dgod bya/ /mi rgyu rgyu bcas 'jig rten gsum/ /ma lus lhag ma 843—73()

med par 'grub/ /ya ma rā ①blo sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni rā yak+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya/ ya dbus shar du k+ṣe dgod bya/ /lho ru 'jam pa'i rdo rje ste/ /me yig nub tu bri bar bya/ /byang du da yig dag byed do//bsgrub bya'i ming ni blang bya zhing / /phyogs bral stong pa la gzung ②bya/ /hūṃ dag gis ni nang spel bya/ /las rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /yats+tsha ni rā dzā sa do ru/ /ṇa yo ni ra zhes (0phyi rol/ /thams cad don phyir sgrub pa la/ /g.yon nas brtsams te yang dag bribya/ /re mig rim pa gsum pa yi/ /mdun du gcig (snyedor re mig la/ /hrīḥdhīḥzhes (7sogs sngags rnams kyis/ /shar nas brtsams te bri bar bya/ /de mthar dor ba'i me (7)mig la/ /re mig brgyad po yang dag bri/ /a mu kai ((ku ru mā ra ya uts+tsha ta sgyu ya/ ba shaṃ 7ku ru/ bi de ṣā yal/ shārnyi ku ru/ puṣ+ṭi ku ru/ zhes /97pa de lta bu la sogs pa las kyi rjes su mthun 7pa las/ /dang po oṃ yig mthar (1 na maḥ/ /mthar ni ba shi tsho smibo ṣa ṭa/ /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge ldan sa bon/ /zhi ba rgyas pa dbang mthar byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ 'khor lo snang ba zhes bya ba'i dbang bskur ba'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //thugs rje mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das/ /zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mchog /zhe sdang gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /zhe sdang thams cad zad par mdzad/ /thugs rje mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das/ /gti mug gshin rje gshed sku mchog /gti mug gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad//83—731

thugs rje mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das/ /phra 6)ma gshin rje gshed sku mchog /phra mas mnan pa'i 'gro gzigs nas/ /phra ma thams cad zad par mdzad/ /thugs rje mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das/ /'dod chags gshin rje gshed sku mchog /'dod chags kyis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /'dod chags thams cad zad par mdzad/ /thugs rje mnga' ba bcom ldan 'das/ /phrag dog gshin rje gshed sku mchog /phrag dog gis mnan 'gro gzigs nas/ /phrag dog thams cad zad par mdzad/ /byams pa tsartsi ( kā rab brjod/ /de bzhin snying rje phag mo'o / /dga' ba dbyangs can ma rab grags/ /btang snyoms gi rī gzugs can ma/ /bdag nyid dngos po thams cad kyis/ /rdzogs gyur dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor pa/ /snying ga'i ( ris bon las spro bya/ /'dir ni 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /de nas spyod pa'i mtshan nyid mchog /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /'jigs 4byed gshin rje gshed gzugs kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub phyir/ /dgon pa chen po'i sa phyogs su/ /ma he mchog la zhon bya zhing / /sbrul rnams kyis ni brgyan byas nas/ /ljags kyi rdo rje bsgom bya ste/ /gyen 'greng khyad 'phags la sogs pa/ /dbu skra dmar ser dag tu bya/ /spyi bor cod pan rnams kyis bskor/ /sma ra ser po dag byas la/ /hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥl sogs sngags brjod cing / /rdo rje dbyug pa yang dag gsor/ /de nas seṅge'i sgra byas te/ /gshin rje gshed dmar rab sbyor las/ /cung zad nus pa thob pa ni / /rol cing grong du 'jug par bya/ /skal ba bzang po gar bya zhing / /drug las skyes sogs glu blang bya/ /de nas rgyal mtshan khyams bltas te/ /de ni 'o ma rab sbyar bya/ /'o ma goms pa'i sems gcig gis/ /phyag rgya chen po rab 83—732

bsgrub bya/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bsam bya zhing / /btsun mo kun la 'dod pa bya / /seṅge ltar spyod rnal 'byor pa/ /'dod don thams cad grub par byed/ /de nas phyag rgyar sgrub pa'i thabs/ /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /sngags chen yi ge gcig po ste/ /de yi bzlas pas rab brtan bya/ /hrīḥdhīḥsogs sa bon yang dag byung / /ma te'i gdong ni rnam par bsgomadhi/ /rdo rje dkyil 'khor mnyam zhugs pa/ /ma ho'i steng du bsgom par bya/ /gang zhig ②sa la 'bigs byed pa/ /sna tshogs mtshon cha'i rang bzhin can/ /ma he'i gdong ni sgrub pa la/ /blo ldan phyag rnams las bsgom (mibya/ /de nas rdo rje dbyug pa yi / /sgrub thabs 'di las rab bshad bya/ /hrīḥyig sngags ni chen po ste/ /ma he chen po la zhon pa'o/ /'bum gnyis yang dag rdzogs pa'i phyag /thal ba'i rdul gyis byugs pa'i sku/ /ri rab lhun po dang mnyam pa/ /sa yi 'og tu mnan pa'o / /de nas bye ba'i phyag sgrub thabs/ /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /sngags chen bi kṛ tā na na/ /gtso bo hūṃ yig las byung ba/ /oṃ wi ④po tā na na hā hā /tī tī hūṃ hūṃ he he ho ho swā hā/ dgos pa thams cad rab bsgrub ( phyir/ /'di las dam tshig sgrub thabs bshad/ /sngags kyis 55)dub pa'i bza' ba ni/ /bzang po (pernyed par dka' (kyeba'i zas/ /sha chen dang ni rta nyid dang / /glang po che yi khyad par nyid/ /ba lang (9norang bzhin khyi nyid dang / /bong bu rnga mo ce 7spyang nyid/ /mar khu chen pos lus la byug /sngon po bsres pa btso bar bya/ /'di ni lus la byugs tsam gyis/ /'gro ba thams cad dbang du byed/ /gi waṃ yonargyam tsha'i khu ba dang / /de bzhin bil ba'i lo ma nyid/ /so phag bye mar bcas pa'am / /gser shing lo ma'i khu bas kyang / /'di yi lus la dril phyis bya/ /de 83—733

bzhin rdo rje bdud rtsi che/ /'di ni rnal 'byor mchog rtse'o/ /rang 'byung me tog ltung bar ldan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ /spyod pa dang dam tshig sgrub pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i dam tshig tsartsi ①ka'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / rdo rje phag mo'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / dbyangs can ma'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / gi rī'i rnam pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te mchod pa'i glu 'di rjod gupar mdzad do(gu/ /kye kye gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /khyod mthong khro gabo rnam par 'jigs / /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ /khyod kyis gar mdzad sa steng sustadang / /sa bla dag dang sa 'og g.yo/ /chags pas brgyan pa'i khro bo'i yid/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags/ /sku ni dmar zhing thung ba ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can mas btud zhus(6)/ /gar mdzad bde ba chen po khyod/ /hrīḥdhīḥgasang sngags dag gis (7)khyod/ /sa gsum po yi 'khrul pa sel/ /snying rje'i khro bo rje btsun khyod/ /gar mdzad 'gro ba rnams la gzigs / /de nas bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid mchog /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /gang gis bzlas pa'i rab sbyor gyis/ /rgya chen dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /myur ba ma yin bul ba min/ /ring po ma yin thung ngu min/ /sngags ni cung zad thos pa ste/ /gshin rje'i slob dpon mi yi mchog /ma he mi 83—734

dang glang po che/ /ba lang rang bzhin rta nyid dang / /bong bu rnga mo'i rus pa gzung ske/ /bzlas pa'i phreng ba rab bsgrub bya/ /zla ba zla ba'i bcu bzhi la/ /sha lnga yis ni byug bya zhing / /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /mchog gi dngos grub rgyur bzlas te/ /tshes gcig ril bu rnal 'byor pa/ /mkhas pa gshin rje gshed bsgom bya/ /yang na mi yi mgo bo ni/ /khrag dang ldan par rnam bsgom bya / /khri phrag tsam gyis 'byung po rnams/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams stong phrag gis/ /gshin rje gshed kyi rab sbyor las/ /yi dwags (1)tshogs rnams gsang ②bar bya/ /bzlas pa 'bum gyis rnal 'byor bdag /de ni las kun byed pa yin/ /bye ba bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur te/ /bye ba lnga yis smos ci dgos/ /nyin re zla 50ba so so 'am/ /yang na lo rnams so so la/ /dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhir mkhas/ /gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi sbyin/ /rtag tu cung zad zla (peb gang / /de bzhin cung zad gang 'thung ba/ /gzhan yang bza' ba thams cad kyi/ /phud ni gshin rje gshed la dbul/ /de nas bla mar yon dbul ba55ra/ /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /bdag nyid zhi ba nyid phyir dang / /las kun grub pa'i phyir du yang / /phangs pa med par dbul byas te/ /bdag nyid dngul gyi rna rgyan dang / /gser dang nor dang ma ma dang / /de bzhin bu dang chung ma dang / /skyed (6)byed sring mo bu mo dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs na bza' nyid/ /gdugs dang rnga yab mdzes pa nyid/ /khang pa khri dang dri bzang dang / /de bzhin glu dang rol mo nyid/ /ral gri dang ni rgyan nyid kyang / /bla mar rab dbul brtul zhugs can/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ nye bar mkho ba thams cad sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste 83wa 735

bco lnga pa'o// //de nas sems can thams cad kyi bdud 'joms pa'i don du/ dmar ba nyid ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa 'josam pa'i don to/ /spyan gsum ni/ 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus gsum mo/ /phyag gnyis ni/ dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'joms pa'i phyir ro/ /shes rab dang 'khyud pa ni/ stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i sbyor ba las so/ /klu brgyad ni/ rnam par shes pa brgyad mtshon pa'i phyir ro/ /mgo bo'i zhu)phreng ba brgya phyed ni/ yi ge lnga bcu pa'i sbyor ba las so/ /g.yon na thod pa ni/ ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi'i ro yongs su rdzogs pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /g.yas na dbyug pa ni/ phung po dang /nyon mongs pa dang / lha'i bu dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms pa snying rje'i rang bzhin no/ /g.yon brkyang ba ni/ khams gsum pa rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /lha mo'i phyag g.yon na bdud bzhi'i khrag dang bcud len gyi ro du ma myang ba'i phyir thod pa'o/ /g.yas pa na dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa gcod pa'i phyir gri gug go /ma rungs pa 'dul ba'i phyir khro bo'i gzugs dang gsus pa 'phyang ba nyid do/ /mya ngan las mi 'da' ba nyid las dbu skra ser po gyen du 'greng ba nyid do/ /gru bzhi ni/sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam gyi bden pa bzhi rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /sgo bzhi ni/ bdud bzhi kun tu skrag par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zur bzhi ni/ tshangs pa'i gnas yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir 83—736

ro / /ka ba brgyad ni/ rmi lam dang / dri za'i grong khyer dang / brag ca ①dang / sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / me long gi gzugs brnyan dang / chu'i zla ba lta bu brgyad kyi rang bzhin ②las nam mkha' ltar dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa'i don no/ /gang gis skyes pa rab tu 'joms pa nyid las dra ba phyed pa rnams so/ /rta babs bzhi ni/ sbyin pa dang /snyan par smra ba dang / don spyod kun)pa dang / don mthun ④pa nyid dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i / /sgrub thabs 'di las rab bshad bya/ /mkha' dbyings dbus su gnas pa yis/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mchog bsam bya/ /phyag tu rdo rje rnam bsgoms nas / /lhag ma phyag gzhan rnam dgod bya/ /shar du sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug gti mug yang dag mtshungs/ /phyag na 'khor lo 'jigs byed che/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug phra ma yang dag mtshungs/ /phyag na rin chen 'jigs byed che/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bsgom bya/ /nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ /phyag drug pad+ma 'dzin pa 'o/ /byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /dkyil 'khor snying po ral gri ma'o / /me la sogs pa'i zur bzhi ru/ /lha mo rnam sgom brtul zhugs can/ /sgeg mo phreng ba gar de bzhin/ /glu ma dag gi khyad par nyid/ /de nas sgo skyong bsam par bya/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /dang po tho ba dbyug pa dang / /pad+ma de bzhin ral gri'o/ /oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki ni/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki ni / oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki ni/ oṃ kurma ḍā ki ni/ māṃ māṃ ṭ+wāṃ nā (5)zur du'o/ /oṃ muṅga ra dzaḥ/ oṃ daṇ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma baṃ/ oṃ khaṅga hoḥ/ zhes gsungs bcom ldan rdo 83—737

rje can/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgrub thabs/ /ring po nas thos bsgrub 0)don du / /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgom (2bya/ /de ltar rab tu 'grub pa'i sngags kyi tshig tu gyur pa ni/ oṃ ā kā sha tsa ra badz+ra ḍā ki ni swā hā/ de nas rab tu bshad bya gzhan/ /rdo rje sa 'og sgrub pa'i thabs/ /sa 'og 'jug pa bsgrub (5)don du/ /gnod mdzes rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /phyag drug sku mdog sngon po mdangs/ /phyag tu gtun shing dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor snying po'i dbus su ni/ /'di dgod rab tu bsgom par bya/ /shar du spyan ma dgod bya ste/ /de bzhin lho ru mā ma tī/ /nub tu lha mo gos dkar mo/ /byang du sgrol ma dgod par bya/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dri/ /me la sogs pa rnams su dgod/ /tho ba la sogs sgo rnams la/ /sbrul gyi rgyan dang ska rags te/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis / /'khor lo 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /rdo rje sa 'og rnal 'byor ldan/ /bug pa rmi lam du shes 'gyur/ /de nas rgyal po bdud dkyil 'khor/ /'di las yang dag rab bshad bya/ /mkha' la spyod nyid bsgrub snyidon du/ /rta mchog rab tu bsgrub par bya/ /phyag gnyis pa dang zhal gcig pa/ /sku mdog ljang gu (pe'ajigs rung ba/ /nyi ma'i steng du yang dag bzhugs/ /shin tu 'jigs byed rta yi zhal/ /g.yas pa ral gri khu tshur te/ /g.yon pa'i phyag na yithod pa ste/ /oṃ phu phu hi hi/ sngags 'di bzla 97bya shes rab can/ /rta mchog rab tu bsgrub (kyepa'i phyir/ /shar du rdo rje ma rnams bsam(9)/ /lho phyogs su yang myur 'gro ma/ /nub tu rgyal po bdun pa ste/ /byang du rta mchog dgod par bya/ /gtso bo'i zhal dang phyag dag gis/ /thams cad g.yas kyis bsgom bya nyid/ /sngags 'di yis ni thams cad nyid/ /spro ba dag tu rab tu grags/ /gling bu pi wang rdza lnga dang //803—738

rnga zlum yang ni zur du'o/ /ba lang sna hurab glang chen sna/ /bzhin bzang bzhin ngan de bzhin du/ /gtun shing dang ni dgra sta dang / /lcags kyu zhags pa nyid kyang ste/ /gar la sogs tshul rnal 'byor las/ /sgo bzhir rtag tu bsam par bya / /g.yon du ya ba si bsam bya/ /de bzhin g.yas su rang rtags so/ /rta mchog sngags ni ji lta ba/ /rdo rje sa 'og g.yo bar byed/ /rta mchog sgom ②pa'i rnal 'byor las/ /khams gsum mkha' la yongs su bskor/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud las/ rnam par dag pa dang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas 'di la thig gdab pa'i dam tshig las/ ā (5༄kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā tsā/a r+ya nut+pan+da 0tā ta/ slob ma rnam snang du byas te/ /gshin rje mthar byed dpal gzugs kyis/ /ye shes srad bu rtse gzung mchog /legs par mnyam bzhag (5)gdab par bya/ de la 'di ni/ dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug pa'i dam tshig go/ /oṃ āḥrgyu/ ring ba dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur la/ /sgo yi nyi shu cha dag ste/ /ba yi rnam lngas yang dag byug /srad bu gnyis ni yang dag brtag /de la 'di ni/ rdo rje chen po la gsol ba btab pa'i dam tshig go /e ma sangs rgyas slob dpon che/ /e ma chos dang tshogs kyi gtso/ /bdag la dam tshig de nyid stsol(5)/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsolardo zhi/ /de la (8༄'di ni/ sa chen po yongs su gzung ba'i dam tshig go /rdo rje sa'i lha mo spyan drangs te/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang / /sa 83—739

dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni brgyad cha sgo/ /shes bya bdag nyid che 917rnams kyis/ /khyams chen dag ni dor bya ste/ /yid du 'ong ba legs par spras/ /sgo mnyam sgo khyud shes bya ste/ /de phyed lha yi snam bu'o/ /rdo rje lha mo yang dag ldan/ /glu gar rol mo sogs rnams kyis/ /sgo yi (miphyed kyi 'gram dang logs/ /zhes ③pa dra ba dra phyed kyang //nyi zla me tog phreng snam bu/ /'di 47yi phyed kyi rdul tshon sa/ /de bzhin dkyil 'khor phyi rol thig /de la 'di ni snying po che/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor mkha' la dgod/ /de nas phyag rgyar bcas pa brten/ /dam tshig gis ni yi ge gzhug /de ltar dkyil 'khor rab tu bsgrub(5)/ /shar phyogs su ni dkar po che//lhor ni ser po yang dag ldan/ /nub kyi cha ni dmar po ste/ /ljang gu (6)byang du yang dag ldan/ /'od 'bar in+d+ra ni 7༄la'i tshul/ /dbus kyi sa gzhi yang dag bri / /de nas phyag rgya dgod par bya/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /dbus su rdo rje yang dag bri/ /'khor lo shar du mnyam par bri/ /de bzhin lho ru rin chen te/ /nub kyi phyogs su pad+ma'o/ /ral gri de bzhin byang du dgod/ /de ltar sgyum ma mkha' mtshungs pa/ /rtag tu phyag rgya blta bar bya/ /de la 'di ni dgang gzar dang / /blugs gzar ( yu ba'i tshad bya'o/ /kun nas khru gang tshad dag gis/ /de phyed dkyil 'khor bya ba ste/ /sor mo bzhi yi tshad dang ldan/ /zabs ni sor mo gnyis pa la/ /phyi rol tshad ni sor gsum mo/ /dma' ba mthe dzistebo'i lto gang ste/ /rgyar ni sor mo gnyis pa'o/ /pad 'dab (7rnam pa'i blugs gzar gang / /tshad ldan rgyud du rab tu bsngags/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu ma zhugs shing / /mtshams med lnga ni byas pa dang / /gang zhig srog chags gsod 83—740

pa dang / /nya dang sha la sogs pa za/ /chang dang 'dod pa dag la chags/ /yod pa min pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /mi gang mngon par dbang ma bskur/ /gang zhig rtsed mo du ma byed/ /grong pa'i skye bor dga' ba yang 6)/ /gshin rje gshed rgyud pha rol bgrod/ /ji ltar dmar po'i gsung bzhin du/ /som nyi med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas byams pa la sogs pa rdo rje chen po'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i tshig thos nas cang mi smra bar gyur to(ge/ /de la 'di ni/ rdo rje dbab pa'i dam tshig go /de yang 'byung chen sa bon gyis/ /'khor lo bzhi la rab bsgrub bya/ /gnas bzhir tshurab tu sbyor ba yis/ /nam mkha' la yang g.yo bar byed/ /rkang bar yaṃ yig lte bar raṃ/ /snying gar gi)lo yig spyi bor baṃ/ /gzhu yi rnam pa nag po che/ /gtum po 'jigs par byed pa'i rlung / /gru gsum bsregs pa'i me ltar 'bar/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bur 'bar/ /gru bzhi ser po chen po ste/ /rdo rje'i sa gzhi 'dzin pas mnan/ /ri rab lhun pos mnan pa yis/ /nor 'jin mar ni bsgom par bya/ /skum zhing 'khyil ba mdangs dkar po/ /sprin gnas kyis bzhin char pa'i rgyun/ /stong phrag yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /g.yo ba med cing bsil ba'i gangs/ /gnas bzhir (gerab tu sbyor ba yis/ /slob mas rdo rje can bsgom bya/ /rdo rje snang mtha' rab sbyor las/ /myur ba ru ni 'bab par byed/ /de la 'di ni/ /dri ba'i dam tshig ste/ mgon po chen po rdo rje chos/ /snang ba mtha' yas bde ba che/ /dge dang mi dge gang dris pa/ /gsungs shig 'dod chags chos chen po/ /khru gang nas ni yangad ga brtsams/ /ji srid khru ni stong gi bar / /slob ma chen po 'phar bar 'gyur/ /'di ni dbab pa'i dam tshig go/ /83—741

de nas sku gzugs ri mo yi1)/ /mtshan nyid 'di las yang dag bshad/ /snum pa'i 'jim pa blang bya ste/ /sbyar bar bya'o brtul zhugs can/ /sran ma 'o ma de bzhin sha /bu ram tirnyi ḍa (snyel sogs/ /til mar nim pa lo ma dang / /de bzhin nā ḍā'i 'bras bu yis/ /thog mar ri mo bri de yang / /dkar po kha dog gzhan yang ste/ /dkar rtsi dang ni btsag dag gis/ /sbyar ba rgya skyegs mdog tu 'gyur/ /yung ba dang ni rams dag gis/ /de bzhin kha dog ljang gur ①'gyur / /sngon po dag ni rams kyis te/ /de bzhin drag po nag po 'o/ /ser skya ba bla ldong ros kyis/ /de bzhin dmar po mtshal gyis so/ /bil ba'i snying po lo ma sbyin/ /dman min de bzhin lhag pa'ang min/ /lhag pa nag po dag tu 'gyur / /dman na skya bo 'gro bar 4)'gyur/ /zhi ba khro bo rnam (sheganyis so/ /sgom pa'i mtshan nyid bshad par bya/ /zhi ba rol par rab tu gsungs/ /khro bo sbom 76)thung zhes 7par thos/ /sor mo bzhi yi tshad kyis ni/ /dpral ba shangs dang de bzhin zhal/ /sor mo bzhi yi tshad dag gis/ /mgrin pa mgul pa de bzhin brtag /nyi shu rtsa bzhis 98khru gang ste/ /gyen du sor mo nyi shu skyes/ /phyag dang zhabs dang gdong ji bzhin/ /mig gi tshad ni mthe bong ste/ /rna bar sor mo gnyis rab gsungs/ /de bzhin sgo yi shubs la bzhi/ /mchu dang sor mo gnyis rab gsungs/ /lte ba'i zabs ni sor bzhi'o/ /zhal gyi cha ni lus la ste79 / /mgrin pa'i rnam pa bor bar 'dod/ /ral pa dang ni zhal gyi tshad/ /sbyor ba sor mo cod pan drug /de nas 'phags pa dzasgru li'i/ /sgrub thabs 'di las rab bshad bya/ /gang gis bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /chu yi steng du 'gro bar byed/ /zhal gsum phyag drug ser mo ste/ /chu yi sa bon las byung ba/ /843—742

phyag na sbrul dang sku chen mo/ /rma bya'i bzhon pa dag la dgyes/ /shar du dgod bya rma bya ma/ /de bzhin lho ru khro gnyer can/ /nub tu ri khrod lo 0stem can/ /byang du rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ /sgro dang spyi blugs yal ga dang / /lcags sgrog rnams kyang bsgom par bya/ /ser po dmar po de bzhin ljang / /sngon po'i kha dog rab dbye las/ /de ltar bsgom bya shes rab can/ /de nas sngags kyang bzla bar (mibya/ /oṃ phu dza phu dza/ sgo ru tho ba sogs dgod cing / /zur du me tog ma sogs dgod/ /'phags ma dzasgru li rnal 'byor/ /ldan pas rtag tu chu steng cha'agro/ /de nas ku ru kul+le yi/ /sgrub thabs 'di las rab bshad bya/ /gang gis bsam 6)pa tsam gyis ni/ /klu yi btsun mo 'gugs par byed/ /sku mdog dmar mo zhal bzhi ma/ /phyag brgyad dang ni yang dag ldan/ /hrīḥyig sa bon las byung ma/ /klu rnams 'gugs par byed pa mo/ /mtha' yas la sogs rigs brgyad klu/ /phyag brgyad la ni dgod par bya/ /rgyan rnams thams cad brgyan pa'i lus/ /rang bzhin bsgom bya brtul zhugs can/ /sngags ni ku ru kul+le hrīḥphu swā hā/ de nas 'di la gsang ba bshad/ /mdor bsdus pa ste rgyas par min/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /lha yi bu mo 'gugs par byed / /phyag gnyis pa dang zhal gcig ste/ /phyag na mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa / /sku mdog ser mo sku chen ma/ /lus med rnam par bsgom par bya/ /shar du dga' ma bsam bya ste/ /lho ru 'dod pa mdzes pa mo/ /nub tu 'dod pa'i lha mo ste/ /byang du 'dod pa la spro ma'o/ /'dod pa'i lha mo thams cad ni/ /phyag tu mda' gzhu bsgom par bya/ /ser po dmar po de bzhin ljang / /dkar dmar dag ni bsgom par bya/ /zur nyid du ni rtag tu yang / /ma 'gags uṣ+ṭha 83—743
