cing / /skad cig nyid du 'gro bar byed/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i yul / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhing kun tu/ /rig pa'i rigs ni brgya dag dang //de ni rtsen zhing 0)'gro bar byed/ /'jigs med yan lag kun spangs pa/ /thog ma tha ma med 'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis mkhyen sbyor bsal/ /dgyes pa'i rmad mchog gcig tu 'gyur/ /rdo rje'i nang na rdo rjer 'gyur/ /rin chen nang na rin chen 'gyur/ / pad+ma'i nang na pad+mar (mi'agyur/ /sna tshogs nang na sna tshogs mchog /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /mnyam dang mi mnyam chos kyi dbyings/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes byin brlabs ④pas/ /dam pa sna tshogs nyid du 'gyur/ /gzugs mi sdug (gepa gzugs mchog 'gyur/ /mig med pa yang mig ldan 'gyur/ /rna 'on pa yang sgra thos te/ /glen (9)pa yang ni yid rnor 'gyur / /de la ⑦sogs pa dpag med pa/ /mig gi phyag rgyas btab par 'gyur / /de yis (8༄lus la yon tan ni/ /yon tan dam pa mdangs cher 'gyur / /ji tsam de ni nam mkha'i mthongs/ /'phur 5)zhing 'og tu 'bab par byed / /de ni ri yang phug nas 'gro/ /sa dang sa yi 'og tu ni/ /sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul rnams byed pas/ /de ni skad cig 'gro bar byed/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /sngags mkhan 'gying ba gar byed pa/ /bde ba chen po bskyed pa yis/ /sems can de ni 'jug par byed/ /mi g.yeng blta yiba'i bsgyur ba yis/ /las rnams thams cad de yis 4)byed/ /'degs 7pa dang ni lta (steb yis/ /gar dang rnam par skebaskor ba dang / /'gro ba thams cad 'bab byed de/ /ri dang tsosems can thams cad la/ /smra ba dang ni sgra 'byin dang / /ci dga' ba ni mngag yipar byed/ /gdug dzinapa'i lta 5nyebs srog chags rnams/ /83—867

rdeg pa dang ni sgrol 6)bar byed/ /gtum (midang gdug (mi'ajigs che ba dang / /khro bo'i lta bas sgrol rtsibar byed/ /shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i rdo rje spyan dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i yi ge'i phyag rgya ye shes kyi mthu chen po'o// //dang po oṃ gyis rnam par brgyan/ /tha mar 'brug gi sgra 'byin pa/ /rdo rje rab tu dgyes pa'i sku/ /bde ba skyed 55)byed bshad pa yin/ /phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje dpa' bo yi/ /gang gis 'di ni bsgoms ma thag /rdo rje gsum gyis byin rlob 'gyur/ /bdag gam yang na gzhan yang rung —/ /'di yis nyid kyi snying ga (6)ru/ /bsgoms te gnyis med sbyor byas na(7/ /sangs rgyas sku ni rab tu 'grub/ / bsgrubs na tshonasangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bud med kun dang rtsen byed de/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas/ /sems can dman pa'ang 97dngos grub po/ /shin tu skal ldan thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas skal ldan 'thob 'gyur te'i/ /skal dang ldan pa thams cad kyis(te/ /chu skyes zhabs la bsnyen par byed/ /lha dang lha min bu mo de'i/ /rig mas mthong na dga' byed de/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes brgyan pa yi/ /sna tshogs 'dod pa'i gzugs su 'gyur/ /spyod dang mi spyod mi dag dang / /lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / /mi 'am ci dang skyes bu yi/nya/ /dngos grub pas ni 'phrog mi nus/ /de la sogs pas stod byed de/ /'jigs par 'gyur ba'i sems kyis spre ni/ /bla ma bzhin du mchod byed cing / /kun gyis bstod mchod bsti khasang byed/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /nam mkha' mtha' klas lha rnams dang / /nyi ma bcu yi 'od zer bzhin/ /rnal 'byor chen po 'grub pa 'gro/ /sangs rgyas 83—868

kun gyi zhing kun du/ /'od kyis thams cad mnyes yo)byed cing / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /zil gyis mnan te gnas par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid la/ /sras rnams 'dud cing phyag byed de/ /lha dang lha min grul bum dang / /tshangs pa gtogs 'dod lha chen po/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes byin brlabs ②der/ /'jigs shing skrag pas 'ong bar byed/ /bcom ldan dngos grub bka' stsal stsol/ /ji ltar thugs la dgongs pa bzhin/ /spyi bos bka' blangs ( tagadul dka' rnams/ /de dag thams cad bsgrub par bgyibu / /mdor bsdus rnam pa bzhi po yi/ /dam pa rnams kyang bskyang bar bgyi / /zla gsang thig le'i mchog nyid kyi/ /dbang bskur ba yang blang bgyi ste/ /rigs lnga rnams kyi sdom pa nyid/ /rnam pa bzhi po thams cad blang / /chu skyes dngos grub khyod zhabs (shedrung / /'tsho ba'i bar du bdag cag 'bangs/ /khyed kyi (6)spyan sngar zham ring ri nidu/ /ci bgyi zhes ni bka' nod do/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas gdab (8)na/ /spyod bcas mi spyod dga' byed de/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas rnams kyi mchog /shin tu bde dang mdza' ba myong / /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa'i sku chen mo bde ba dpe med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i phyag 5)rgya'i ting nge 'dzin to / / //dang por oṃ steng thig le ste/ /gzhan gyis 7mi phyed khros bcas pas/ /gnyis kyi dbus su bzhag tshonapa ni/ /gsung gi rdo rje shin tu dgyes/ /bde gsang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /mchog tu ro ni myong byed pa/ /dam chos sgra yis gang byas pa'i/ /gsung gsal rna ba dga' bar byed/ /yi ge'i phyag rgya chen po 'di/ /byang chub chen por grub byed de/ /yon tan yon tan sdug mtho 843—869

ba'i / /tshad med yon tan 'dzin pa'o/ /dpal ldan phyag rgya 'dis btab na/ /dpal kun bdag po de ma thag /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid 'thob/ /phyag rgya 'di yis bdag gam gzhan/ /rgyas btab 'dod pa spyad byas nas6)/ /dngos grub rmad du byung ba yi/ /de yis myur du 'thob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /sgrub pa po yi bka' nyan te/ /ci ste rmongs pas 'da' byed na/ /de yi srog ni tha ma yin/ /de yi ②bsrung pyo rib byas na dpal/ /tshe dang lang tsho bde ba'i mchog /rdo rje gsung gis bstan pa bzhin/ /gdon mi za bar 'thob par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya ye shes rjes bsdus pas/ /sgrub pa mi byed cung zad med/ /bdag nyid thams cad sprul (pa pa ni/ /mchog gi ye shes dngos grub 'gyur/ /phyag rgya'i ye shes byin brlabs (5)la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mi ldog dang / /chos dbyings mi mnyam rab klas 96)pa/ /dngos grub bdag nyid gshegs nas kyang / /shin tu 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /sems dpa' chen po de khrid do/ /rang gi ting 'dzin ldang ba'i tshe/ /dam tshig mchog tu bsrung bya ba/ ski / /ji snyed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du/ /'dod pa thams cad de spyod de(7/ /rnal 'byor chen po mi 'da' (8)zhing / /ngan song gsum yang mi 'gro byed/ /de ni cung po)zad 'og sdug bsngal / /'gro ba thams cad myong mi 'gyur/ /rdo rje gsum de rmad 'byung ⑩bas / /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags byed de/ /bag chags mtshams sbyor rnam grol bas/ /nam mkha'i rim pas 1nya'agro 'ong byed/ /lha yis 7rtag tu mchod byed de/ /mchod par byas pas shin tu mchod/ /sems dpa' chen po 'gro 'dug kyang / /bde byed kun gyis bdag nyid dge/ /gnas dang zas dang 842—870

btung ba 6)sogs/ /nam mkha' (gyilas ni skad cig rnyed/ /bud med rin chen mchog mkha' las/ /bsams (7pa tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /las kyi dbyings rnams (gem lus pa/ /de yis khams gsum 'thob (7par byed/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba dngos grub kyi/ /rnal 'byor grub chen 'phrog par 'gyur/ /'di las brtul zhugs drag pa med/ /dka' yithub 'di dang 'dra med de(7)/ /bud med mchog tu bde ba las/ /'dod pa'i longs (7spyod spyad (9)pas 'grub/ /dge ba'i pad+mo'i rigs kun tu/ /sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang 'gyur/ /gzungs yim kun gyis (1bde chen po/ /rgyal po chen por de 'gyur ro/ /gsung thams cad kyi rdo rje dpe med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba chen pos yo'athob par byed pa khams gsum kun tu snang bar grags pa pad+ma'i tu rigs kyi tshogs zhal gyi gsung gis dgongs pa thams cad 'grub par byed pa'o// //oṃ bcas mi phyed tha mar tetshu/ /rab tu sems ni bde ba ste/ /rdo rje rab dgyes bde byed che/ /dbus su ming ni sbyar bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di yis dngos grub che/ /byang chub sems ni rab bsgrubs pa/ /'di yis byin gyis brlabs ma thag /bdud rtsi'i mchog ni chud par 'gyur/ /thams cad 'dod pa ldan byas na/ /de ste thams cad sems kyang rung / /bde ba chen pos sems thams cad/ /sngags mkhan reg pa'i rgyas btab na/ /'di yis rdo rje 'dzin nyid dang / /rdo rje dpa' bo nyid du yang / /lha mo'i 'phyag rgyas byin brlabs tsopa / /skad cig tu ni 'thob par 'gyur/ /lha mo rnams dang gar byed cing / /de ni rab dgyes bdag po khrid/ /pho 'obrang dga' byed rab dgyes che/ /rab 83—871

tu chen po bde 'thob tu/ /seng ge'i gdan rab 'jog byed do①/ /bzhi dang bzhi yi mchog nyid kyi/ /rdo rje pad+mo ②sbyor ba yis/ /de ni khrid ①nas dbang bskur ro/ /de nas rdzogs sangs tshe dpag med/ /byang chub sems dpa' brtson 'grus che/ /yod dang med pa'i 'dod spangs pa/ /de la phyag ni byed par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems mchog 'jog byed de/ /rang gi spyod pa'i tshul gyis ni / /pha rol phyin pa thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas kun gyis mdun du bskor//sa gsum thams cad kun tu ni/ /sems dpa' chen pos ston byed pa/ /res 'ga' shin tu dga' spyod pa/ /res 'ga' khab ④nas 'byung ba dang / /res 'ga' byang chub res 'ga' lhums/ /res 'ga' ⑤skye dang res 'ga' 'pho/ /res 'ga' spyod chen rol pa dang / /res 'ga' bdud las rgyal bar mdzad/ /res 'ga' byang chub mngon byang chub/ /res 'ga' 'khor lo skor stimadzad de / /res 'ga' sna tshogs 'jug par mdzad/ /res 'ga' dus su 0shin tu mdzes / /res 'ga' bud med skyes pa dang / /res (kyi'aga' lha dang skye dgu'i bdag /res 'ga' 'dod dbang rgyal po ste/ /res 'ga' 'dod la rgyab kyis 6)phyogs/ /res 'ga' zhi la res 'ga' drag /res 'ga' gdon chen bgegs mdzad de/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa/ /phyag rgya 'di yiyis rgyas btab pa/ /ci dgar dngos grub 'dod pa la/ /bdag gis ngo bor ston (nyapar byed/ /mi phyed cho ga sbyor ba yis/ /'dren pa mi phyed nye 7byas te/ /phan tshun reg pa chen po yis/ /rdo rje can gyis de 'bigs te/ /gzungs ma mang po tshogs kyi rnams/ /bde byed chen po gzhan ci smos/ /spyod bcas mi spyod bde dam pa/ /'bad pa mi dgos thob (nyapar 'gyur/ /brjid pas byang chub snying po 83—872

ru / /rtag pa ru ni gnas 'gyur te/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rnal 'byor pa/ /sbyor ba rjes sdud ①ldan pas so/ /thams cad cha ni rnam phyibral ba/ /byang chub sems ni mchog bzhin deni/ /yi ge 'dis ni sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid chen por de 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa chen mo 0tshim pa'i yid las skyes pa dudape med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i yi ge'i phyag rgya ste/ las thams cad grub par byed pa'o// //dang por oṃ ni sbyor ba ste/ /tha mar gnyis po rdza rnga'i 0sgra/ /rab dgyes rdo rje byin rlabs ⑦pa'i/ /lha mo dngar byed dbus su gzhagani /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rab dgyes thob pa rmongs byed ma/ /rdo rje ye shes thugs gnas pa/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par byadhi/ /sngags mkhan yi ge phyag rgya 'dis/ /bdag gam gzhan la rgyas btab ste/ /rdo rje 'dam ⑩skyes bcug byas na/ /de nas de myur dngos grub bo/ /thams cad las byed dpal dang ldan / /tshe dang lang tsho skal ldan pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang 'dra 'thob ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu 'grub/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang dpa' bo yi sangs rgyas kun dang rtsen byed cing / /sde dbang rnams dang lha rnams kyi/ /'phrul gyi (nyabud med 'phrog byed do/ /rdo rje rab tu dgyes pa chen mo dngar 7byed kun tu myang ba me tog gi rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i yi ge'i tunyephyag rgya ste/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba las thams cad byed pa chen mo gdon mi za ba'i gzhan gyis mi phyed ma'o// //tshangs pa'i gsung gi tsong ror bcas/ /tha mar dril bu'i nga ro gnyis/ /dbus su ming gi phreng ba ste/ /yi ge 'di ni chu 'dzin mchog /'di ni sangs 83—873

rgyas thams cad kyi/ /yid kyi dngos grub thob 6)byed de/ /'dod pa yi ②ni thams cad rnams/ /yi ge skad cig 'grub par byed/ /'di yis rgyas btab bud med rnams/ /bdag dang ①rang gi slob ma'ang rung / /de nyid sbyor bas bsten byas na(pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin dpal (ge'adra bar 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams bdag por ni/ /myur du mkha' la 'gro byed de/ /tshangs pa gtogs 'dod dbang chen dang / /lha rnams kyis ni mchod par 'gyur/ /lha mo'i tshogs dang rtsen tshone)byed cing / /lha mo kun gyi bdag por 'gyur/ /'phrog byed la sogs bdag po che/ /'jigs (7par (nyabyed dang rku po)byed pa/ /sems can kun gyi mchog dam pa/ /sems dpa' chen por de 'gyur ro/ / sdug pa'i ⑩tshogs kyi dbus su ni/ /brjid la sogs pa'i (nyaspyod pas 'gro/ /brjid che pad+mo (nyachen mo la/ /thams cad kun tu brjid 1nyapa yis/ /bde byed chen po myong byed de te/ /rab tu dgyes pas sgeg 7pa bzhin/ /rab tu skal ldan mgrin 'khyud ⑫pas / /rnal 'byor chen por de gnas te/ /'di ni snying la bris pa yis ci 'dod par ni 'dod pa thoba'o/ /phyag rgya chu skyes btab byas te/ /de ltar byas na phyag rgya dgyes/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa chen mo'i dri ma med pa'i mdog dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i yi ge'i phyag rgya ste thams cad las byed pa dge ba'o // //dang po nyid du oṃ bya ste/ /thig le'i rgyal pos nye bar brgyan/ /tsheg drag bcas pa 'dren pa gnyis/ /ldan pa mtha' /18mar gzhag 19byas te/ /rdo rje rab dgyes brgyan byas pa/ /rdo rje ston ka dbus su bsam/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ma/ /ye shes snang ba rab sgrub ( 1pa/ /yi ge yi ni phyag rgya 'dis/ /803—874

nyid kyi snying gar ①rgyas btab na/ /sangs rgyas ye shes mchog byed pa/ /de yis ston ka ma dngos grub/ /sde phyidabang lhar bcas ②lha rnams dang / /gnod sbyin srin por bcas pa dang / /sbrul dang mi 'am ci gnas pa/ /thams cad 'di yi g.yog tu 'gyur/ /'di ni 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba yis sangs rgyas mchog gi thugs ldan de 'gro ste/ /sna tshogs rab 'byung dpal gyis ④yang dag khyab/ /chos mchog dam pa byed pa gtong byed cing / /spyod bcas mi spyod 'jig rten snang byed de/ /sprin dang bral ba'i zla ba'i 'od mchog byed/ /mkha' dbyings rnam par bsgyings ⑤pas rab dga' bas4)/ /ā li kā li pad+mo ⑦bde (nyamachog la/ /myong zhing mchog byas bskal par gnas par 'gyur/ /'di yis sdig pa 'phrog byed de/ /'di yis myur du dga' bar 'gyur/ /'dis ni bde ba'i ngo bo de/ /'di yis dngos grub grub 5)par 'gyur/ /skye ba'i sdug bsngal rgyab phyogs pa/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par kyi'agyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 4)rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa ye shes kyi snang ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya chen mo ste thams cad mkhyen pa'i 8ye shes 'grub par byed pa'o// //dang po oṃ dang yang dag ldan/ /tha mar dgyes pa'i yi ge gnyis/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa che/ /dbus su gsal ba'i yi ge bsam/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sna tshogs chen mo'i mdun du 'gro/ /sna tshogs chen mo 'di yis ni/ /sna tshogs ye shes dngos grub bo/ /sngags mkhan nyid kyis byin brlabs 4 pa/ /sna tshogs bdag po chen por kha'agyur/ /sdig pa'i yan lag kun spangs te/ /bsod nams kun gyi yan lag dge/ /kun tu 'gro ba'i 83—875

dngos grub ni/ /'di nyid kyis ni rab tu 'grub/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i bde chen gyis / /sna tshogs chen po'i bskal par gnas/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid brgyan pa yi / /bud med kun dang rtsen 6)par 'gyur/ /de nas de yi chos dbyings gnas②ske/ /dbang phyug mchog gi dngos grub bo/ /pad+ma'i ①mdun du thog ma'i lha / /byas te rdo rje bsgrub par bya/ /mthe bong srin lag de phyung ste/ /kha yi ④nang du gzhag ⑤par bya/ /chang bzhin myang bar byas na ⑥ni/ /mod la 'dod pa'i gzugs su 'gyur/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor bas/ /bud med rnams dang rtsen par byed/ /blo ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /'di ni shin tu dgyes zhes bya / /bsil ba dga' byed chen mo ste/ /sna tshogs 'di ni 'gro la gnas/ /dang po oṃ ni gnas pa ste/ /tra ta dang ldan tha mar bya/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes che ⑦ho / /sgeg mo dbus su bskul ba'o/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sgeg (shepar bya ba sprul pa yin/ /'di dag mnyam par sbyor ba yis/ /sgeg mos ye shes bskyed (9)par bya/ /rdo rje blo ldan brtan 7po yis/ /bde bar 'dod pa'i pad+mar (lhagazugs/ /'dod pas 'dod pa spyad par bya/ /myur du 'dod pas dngos grub bo/ /de nas rdo rje 'dod dpal te/ /bde byed thams cad nye bar sgrub / /sems can kun gyis 'dod bskyed 7pa/ /bde ba chen por de 'gyur ro / /mthu yis pha rol phyin pa'i mchog /pad+mo'i ()tshul du sgeg dhipa yis rdo rje sbyor thabs la gnas pas/ /rdo rje chen po de dngos grub/ /ci dga' tso'adod pa'i 'dod chags kyis/ /rtag pa'i lam dang yang dag ldan/ /rtag pa'i chos kyis rjes mthun saspyod/ /bsgrubs na brtag khri 7pa rtogs par 'gyur/ /'di yis kun tu bzang zhes bya/ /de ni dngos po tu kun yin te/ /'dod pa med 83—876

cing nyon mongs med/ /nga rgyal med cing 'dzin med pa/ /sangs rgyas mchog tu brtag ①pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chen po de yi dngos/ /dpal ldan thog ma tha ma med / /chos rnams kun gyi rjes ②mthun ②pa'idu/ /'dis ni dngos po thams cad kyi/ /sangs rgyas bdag por bdag nyid 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad dang / /'di la khyad par cung zad med/ /shin tu dgyes pa chen po rdo rje bdag po'i dpal shin tu dgyes pa sgeg mo dpe med pa dang ldan pa'i yi ge'i ⑤mchog i sku'o// //dang po oṃ bcas lha mo yi/ /tha mar tsheg drag mi phyed gnyis/ /de gnyis dbus kyi kyiphyogs nyid du/ /he zhes bya ba rnam brgyan te/ /shin tu dgyes pa ⑦rdo rje che/ /bzhad pa nyid ni rab tu sbyar/ /yi ge yi ni phyag rgya 'dis/ /nyid kyi snying dul rgyas btab na/ /phreng ba'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan par⑨/ /dpal ldan de ma thag tu 'gyur/ /yid kyis ji ltar bsams pa bzhin/ /de ni sangs rgyas yul du 'gro/ /de ni de phyir sangs rgyas mthong / /chu skyes de dang rtsen par byed/ /de nas 'dus pa dgyes ⑩'gyur te/ /sangs rgyas yang dag zhing nyid nas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis (nyabade ba che/ /dngos grub rnal 'byor de la sbyin / /byed pa dang ni bzlog 8pa dang / /bde ba chen po 'phrog pa yis/ /rnal 'byor gsang ba'i dbang phyug la/ /gsang ba chen pos mgu bar byed/ /thabs bcas shes rab chen po la/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis stobs byed de/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas/ /bde ba chen po mgu bar byed/ /bde ba thabs kyi dngos grub rnams/ /sgyu ma'i tshul gyis bsgrub par bya/ /yi ge yi ni phyag rgya 'disatso / /shin tu dngos grub mchog tu brtag /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa'i bde ba'i phreng ba 83—877

rgyas pa dpe med pa dang ldan ma zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya ste/ las thams cad kyi don gyi dngos grub sbyin pa'o// //oṃ ni dang por gtsug tor bya/ /te de ①skad snyan tha mar te②/ /dbus su he dga' zhes bya ba/ /bde chen dga' ba rdo rje dbyangasal/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes che ④yi/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rab dgyes 'brel/ /bris pa dang ni 'dzin pa dang ske/ /dran pa yis kyang dngos grub ster/ /sdig pa kun las grol byed cing / /bsod nams thams cad nye bar 'gro/ /mi dge thams cad ma lus spong byed cing —/ /sems ni phyag rgya'i yi ge brgyan te 'gro/ /'jig rten thams cad kun tu bkur (nyaste byed/ /rig ma stong gis mngon par mchod byed cing / /rig 'dzin mu sman bud med rnams kyis yini/ /g.yag rnga dkar po'i tshogs kyis g.yob byed pa'i/ /'jig rten dbang po bde mchog 'brel pa 'thob/ /blo ldan nam mkha' ngos ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyi dgyes pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /yid du 'ong ba'i spyan ni rgyas pa dang / /rnal 'byor spyod pa'i bde bas 'bigs pa yis/ /mgul nas 'khyud pa'i rtsen (7pas rol par byed/ /pi wang (9gling bu ya mtshan sgra snyan gyis/ /glu blangs dngos grub rgya che po)thob par byed/ /ji snyed ⑩yid du 'ong ba'i glu dag ni/ /'jig rten grags pa'i bde ba'i bde ba dag /bde ba'i sgra yis bskyed par rnam (1bsgyur ba'i/ /de dang mthun 7pa'i dbyangs 'dis sgrub par byed/ / kha ṭa tu ba da gar dza'i dbyangs/ /glu ru blangs pas pad+ma skiganas/ /dngos grub myur du 'thob par byed/ /'di yis byin rlabs ⑫dag pa dang / /'di yis byin rlabs yibade ba'i rnams/ /sbyor ba 'di yis sbyar ba yis/ /'dod byed thams cad 'thob par 'gyur/ /shin tu dgyes pa 83—878

chen po rdo rje sems dpa' 6)mchog tu dgyes pa chen mo'i dbyangs dpe med pa dang ldan pa'i ()yi ge'i phyag rgya'o// //de bzhin oṃ ni dang por te/ /dbus su te chadagyes bde ba che/ /rdo rje gar byed bde ④ba gnyis/ /'di ni thams cad bde byed de/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ⑤rab dgyes nyid/ /rnal 'byor yis ⑥ni rgyas btab na/ /bde dang ldan par byed cing 'gro/ /'og min gyi ni gnas chen du/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang thabs cig ⑦'grogs/ /bde byed chen po'i dbang chen dang / /chos kyi rgyal po bde chen thobani/ /ji snyed gar gyi gtsug lag las/ / sgyur bar 6)byed pa shad ⑩pa dang / /ji snyed de snyed phyag rgya'i rnams/ /gnyis min 'dus pas 'di ⑪dngos grub/ /kye ma'o dgyes pa bde byed che/ /kye ma'o bde ba bde chen po/ /kye ma'o 'dod pa 'dod chags che/ /kye ma'o sna tshogs bdag nyid che/ /de la ⑫sogs pa tshad med pa/ /'jig rten gyi ni yo byad rnams/ /pad+mo chagasal ba gar gyis ni/ /rnal 'byor gar byas dngos grub bo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi phyag rgya 'di/ /sna tshogs gar ni ston byed pas/ /myur du gar ni mang byas pas/ /gar gyi gtsug lag dngos grub bo/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i dpal bde ba chen po dga' byed gar 8zhes bya ba'i yi ge phyag rgya phan tshun bcu pa rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gsum pa'o// //bcu gsum yi ge dang po nyid/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa che/ /rdo rje'i sku ni sna tshogs che/ /tha mar 'bar dang 'dra ba'i dza/ /nam mkhar 7zla skar tso'adra ba yi4) / /phyag rgya'i ye shes rmad byung yi ba'i/ /'di yis 4)thabs kyis mnyam gzhag ( )ste/ /gzung ba gsal bar gzung ba yi rim/ /tsha ba'i gser gyis ( )gzi 83—879

brjid 'dzin/ /ye shes snying gar bsam ①par bya/ /nam mkha' nyi ma bum 'dra bar/ /de ni de ma thag tu 'gyur/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /shin tu rmad byung ②thob par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi bde 'brel pa/ /rdo rje blo mchog dngos grub bo/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin dge yi/ /sna tshogs chen po thob 'gyur nas/ /'dod pa'i chos kyis mi gos blo / /'dod pa chen po sten par byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po shin tu dgyes pa chen po dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i ④rdo rje ma lus pa lus pa med pa'i rdo rje'i sku dpe med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i yi ge chen po'i phyag rgya'o// //de bzhin oṃ ni gzhag ⑤bya ste/ /rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa che/ /rdo rje'i sgra ⑥ni bde 'brel pa/ /tha mar khro bcas sbyar bar bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bde mchog ste / /bar bcad ⑦pa yang thos par 'gyur/ /khams gsum dungo bo thams cad ni / /sgra yi thos pa dngos grub bo/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /tshe 'di nyid la dngos grub ste/ /bud med pad+mo 0ut+pal dang / /ma lus rgyal ba ⑩rnams dang rtsen/ /rdo rje pad+mar 7sbyar bas na/ /dga' byed myur du dngos grub bo / /rab tu dgyes pa chen po dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i tshad med pa'i yon tan gyi sgra dpe med pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i 8don gyis 'dapal thams cad grub par byed ma'o8// //oṃ ni spyi gtsug thig ler babs/ /rab dgyes chen mo rdo rje can/ /rdo rje dri bder 'brel pa yi8/ /tha mar gnas shes tsorab sbyar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sna tshogs chen mo ⑩mdun du 'gro/ /sna tshogs chen mo 'di yis ni/ /sna tshogs ye shes grub par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid rdo rje brgyan pa yi/ /83—880

de ni mtshan ldan kun dang rtsen/ /de nas chos dbyings gnas pa des/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor bas/ /dga' byed lhan cig rtsen byas na/ /dbang phyug dam pa dngos grub 'gyur/ /'di ni rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /blo ldan rab tu dgyes ①zhes bya / /rdo rje'i dri ②dpe med pa dang ①ldan ma zhes bya ba'i yi ge'i phyag rgya'o// //oṃ mchog gtsug tor rnams byas te/ /shin tu dgyes che dbus nyid du/ /rdo rje ro ni sbyor che bsti/ /tha mar he ⑤ste thig le gnyis/ /'di yis durab tu dgyes par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan dpe med bde ba dang / /bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /sna tshogs sbyor ba sna tshogs bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi rol pa yis/ /mchod pa mi zad ⑦byed par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gnas thams cad/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa nyid thob bo/ /rab tu dgyes ⑧pa'i dbang po shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i ro mchog gi rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa zhes bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad grub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung 6)dang thugs rdo rje'i bdag po zla gsang thig le bshad pa'i rgyal po las/ chos kyi 'khor lo ste tsoganyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu dgyes pa chen po dpal rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang po nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las shin tu dgyes pa chen po gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bshad nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad kyi rdul phran dang mnyam (nyapa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad gsang ba'i gzungs (nyedang g.yog 4 tu bcas pa rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ byang chub sems 83—881

dpa'i 'khor chen po dang bcas pa rnams kyis mdun du byas pa ma lus pa lus pa med pa'i nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i tshogs dang ldan pa / phyi nang gi pho nya dang pho nya mo rab tu rgyas pa rnams shin tu ngo mtshar rmad du gyur te/ dgyes ①shing spyan ni rgyas pa yis/ /bzhengs nas dgyes pa chen po yi / /brjid pa'i phyag gis gar mdzad cing / /thal mo sbyar nas gtsug nyid du//bzhag pa yis ni 'dud pa ②byed/ /bskul ba yis ①ni dbyangs 'di yis/ /de dag gtso la mnyes par byed/ /kye ma'o chos ni ngo mtshar che/ /kye ma'o spyod pa ngo mtshar rgyache/ /kye ma'o sbas pa ngo mtshar (nyache/ /kye ma'o bde ba yang dag 'byung ske/ /kye ma'o kun tu bzang po'i don/ /kye ma'o rab dgyes yang dag 'grogasayi / /kye ma'o bde ba dag pa che/ /kye ma'o bde ba bde mchog ste/ /kye ⑦ma'o sngags kyi yang dag sbyor/ /kye ma'o snying po yang dag bsdus/ /kye ma'o phyag rgya mnyam par bzhugs/ /kye ma'o sgrub pa rmad 'byung ba'o/ /kye ma'o pha rol phyin ma yin/ /kye ma'o ji ltar mthur (kyirig ma'i6)/ /kye ma'o sna tshogs dgos pa che / /kye ma'o dag pa gsum sbyar ba/ /kye ma'o rdo rje mnyam sbyor tiba'i/ /kye ma'o pad+ma rnam bye 1stobs/ /kye ma'o dbang po gnyis sbyor ba'o/ /kye ma'o mchog dang mnyam pa'o/ /kye ma'o gar 7ni dag pa che/ /kye ma'o ñtsa rab dri ma med/ /kye ma'o sil snyan rnam par 'brel7/ /kye ma'o brdab dang mun pa sel/ /kye ma'o dag byed me tog phreng / /kye ma'o spos yisnod dge ba ste/ /kye ma'o mar me mun pa sel/ /kye ma'o dri ni shin tu bsil/ /kye ma'o rnal 'byor mnyam par sbyor / /kye ma'o sgyur ba nam mkha' 'dra/ /kye ma'o sangs rgyas rdo rje mchog /kye ma'o rin chen bde mchog skyed(7/ /kye ma'o sna tshogs pad mchog ldan/ /kye 83—882

ma'o sna tshogs sgyu ma mdzad/ /kye ma'o ngo mtshar sangs rgyas dang / /kye ma'o ngo mtshar dpa' bo rnams/ /kye ma'o ngo mtshar sems dpa' rnams/ /kye ma'o ngo mtshar lha yi rnams/ /shin tu dgyes che rdo rje la/ /rgyan pa kun gyis bstod byas te0)/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 'gying ba yis/ /dga' dang bde byed skyes par 'gyur / /de nas pha rol phyin thams cad/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dgyes 'gyur te/ /sems dpa' che la phyag byas nas/ /mchog gi dbyangs kyis stod ②par byed/ /chu skyes zhal ni 'dzum bcas pa/ /yangs pa'i spyan gyis gar mdzad de/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsgyur ba yis/ /rab tu dgyes ldan smin ma bsgyur / /yid tsam 'dzum pa'i spyan zur gzigs/ /sha ①rgyas brla ni nu mar mdud / /rked pa'i dbyibs ni rnam par yangs/ / snams kyi ④ngos kyang che la mdzes / /chags pa chung (gezad tshems kyis gnon(na/ /tshems kyi phreng ba kun+da zla//mig (7drag zlos pa'i dbugs 'byin cing / / a la la la ho/ dam tshig rjes su chags pa'i bdag nyid sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing / /(nyerab tu dgyes che dgyes par bstod/ /bde bas bde la longs spyod mchog tu bde ba'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab bstan6)/ /dgongs pa'i dbang dang ldan pas 'gro ba ⑩ya mtshan chen po'i sgo nas 'dul mdzad cing / /gsang ba'i thig le 'jig rten gsum po 'dir ni dngos grub gtsor bstan /nate/ 'jig rten gsum po sbyang bar bya ba'i chos de bde tsogashegs don du mdzad/ /ngo mtshar yon tan ldan pa dam tshig bde (snyelas 'byung / /bde mdzod bde spyod dga' la rol pa tshul bzhin mdzod/ /thams cad dga' ba'i ngang nyid thig le'i dkyil du bskyed mdzad de/ /byang chub snying po 'gro ba'i lam 'di bde bar bskul tsol bsnyen pa tī83—883

mdzod / /ngo mtshar de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam tshig rig pa che la dgyes shing bzhugasal/ /bdag cag 'du shes rnams ①dang bral ba nyid kyang bzhugs spyod 'dzem bcas pas/ /tshangs pa'i rgyal po dbang dang ②ldan pas kyang ③ni de la rag lus so/ /a la ④la la ho/ yangs pa'i spyan can drangs ⑧shing bcug ste rol pa tshul bzhin mdzod/ /rnam dag ye shes chu des 'gro ba rnams kyi dusdig pa khrus / /byams ma'i gzungs ma bdag nyid che dang rab tu brtson ⑦mdzod la/ /thugs rje chen po durang bzhin dag pa'i chu des bdag cag dbang skur 0cig /mi g.yo mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin ye shes thob 'dod phyir/ /dam tshig chen po gsum po gsum po ⑩'di la gnas nas ni⑩/ /zla gsang thig le'i dbyings su bdag cag dogs med 'gro bar bgyi/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal po 'di yis ni/ /shin tu srid pas skyo ba yis8/ /sangs rgyas kun kyang 'dod pa bzhin/ /glu blangs myur du bskul bar 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la dbyangs kyi rgyal po 'dis bstod pas shin tu dgyes te de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpar bcas pa dang / rdo rje dang rin po che dang / pad+mo dang las kyi rigs kyi btsun mo de dag thams cad la rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa'i bde ba chen pos mnyes par mdzad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po'i tshogs rnams dang / byang chub sems dpar ()bcas pa dang /nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro 7ma'i tshogs su bcas pa ⑫rnams dang / phyi nang gi rdo rje'i 7rigs las skyes pa ⑩rnams la (steshin tu dgyes pa 7chen po'i gar dang dbyangs dang / brdung (nyab dang zhi ba'i thal mo la sogs pa rnam ( nyapar mdzad pa chen pos rab tu mdzad nas/ dam tshig chen po rdo rje 83—884

shin tu dgyes pa 'dod pa'i dbang mo ①dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas bde bar cang (0mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas de dag kun dgyes nas/ /shin tu dgyes pa nyid byas te/ /thal mo sbyar nas sa steng du / /pus mo'i lha byang btsugs mdzad de/ /chos kyi phyir ni gsol ba 'debs/ /dkyil 'khor dam tshig bdag nyid la/ /bcom ldan ④dgyes ⑤pas bshad du gsol / /gang gi sems can bde nyid kyi/ /bde bas dkyil 'khor bsgrub ⑥par bgyiX/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dam tshig 'dod pa nye bar longs spyod pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ dkyil 'khor mdzad do/ /phyag gnyis gar dang bcas pa yis/ /mdun du thal mo bkan par bya/ /sor mo kun gyi rtse mo la/ /pha rol phyin pa'i tshogs rnams bsam /de dag ming gi brda yis ni/ /sor mo thams cad brtag par bya/ /sbom po phan tshun bsnol byas te/ /shes rab mchod rten du ni brtag(kyi /rdo rje mchod rten phyir 6)byas te/ /lhag ma 'od bzhin spro bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma dge/ /gang gis bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas byang chub byin rlob bo/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab pas//rtag pa'i pho brang 'gro 'ong byed/ /sangs rgyas snang mdzad dpal dang ldan/ /btso ma'i gser gyi kha dog 'dzin/ /shes rab ldan pas sbyor byas na/ /'di yis myur du dngos grub bo/ /skal ldan 'phrul gyi bu mo la/ /'di yis byin rlabs cigar byas te/ /rdo rje pad+mor gzhug 4stebyas nas/ /sems ni bzhugs tsopas bsgrub byas la/ /de nas sems de blang yi byas te/ /blo ldan de yis btung byas te/ /grub pa gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /yang dag dngos grub 'gro 83—885

bar byed/ /shes rab dang ni 'phul gyi 'am/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'phrul brtag ①'thob/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje blo ldan gyis/ /kun tu 'phrog par yong mi nus / /shin tu dgyes pa kun tu longs spyod pa'i bde ba zhes bya ba'i ②zhes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'o①// //thal mo de nyid khro skyes pa/ /sbom po skyil krung ④gzhag ⑤byas te/ /sna tshogs phreng ba 'bar byed pa/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni lhag ma khyespro/ /'di ni rdo rje thams cad kyil/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma gsal/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab pas/ /rdo rje ye shes bla na med/ /'di yis myur du 'thob par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab pas/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /ring du sdig pa 'jig par byed/ /tshe dang dpal dang ye shes skal/ /rdo rje 'dzin gyis thob par 'gyur/ /'di ni dbang bskur tsam gyis kyang / /rdo rje 'dzin rjer de 'gyur te/ /rdo rje dkyil gyis (kyematshan btab pas/ /sa chen 'ong zhing 'gro bar byed/ /'di ni dga' byed rdo rje rigs/ /rdo rje bud med 'grogs pa dang ske/ /rdo rje gzungs kyi 6)dkyil 'khor du/ /rdo rje sems nyid 'thob par 'gyur / /ji ltar dngos grub 'dug pa dang / /sangs rgyas rdo rje dpa' bo rnams / /skad cig gcig gis 'dren par byed/ /bsgral dang mnyes par bya ba dang —/ /rgyas btab de bzhin rmongs pa dang / /gso bar byed dang za ba dang / /phan tshun du ni skyed ⑩par byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi (7rdo rje chen po'i dbang bskur 1 ba rdo rje'i 6)phreng ba zhes bya ba shin tu dgyes pa bde ba thob par byed pa dpe med pa'i rdo rjer byed pa'i phyag rgya'o// //rdo rje'i thal mo de nyid las/ /khro mo rgyab ni bskum byas te/ /sor mo lhag 83—886

ma snga ma bzhin/ /phyag rgya 'di ni dbang bskur ba'o/ /rims dang gdon dang dug la sogs/ /de ma thag tu 'phrog par byed/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas kyi ni dgyes pa thob6)/ /'di nyid kyi ( ni dbang skur ②dang / /'di nyid kyis ni bde dam pa/ /'di nyid kyis ni rgyal po che/ /'di nyid kyis ni dpal dam pa/ /'di yis rtsen ④pa byas pa yis/ /rab dga' 'gugs (nyapa dngos grub bo/ /mi la 'di yis byin brlabs yite/ /nyi ma phyed na spyad byas na/ /'di ni de ma thag tu yang / /dpal ldan rdo rje gzi brjid 'dzin / /nyi ma bcu gnyis 'od 'drar (7)'gyur/ /zhag bdun gyis 'gyur gzhan gyis min/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis (kye'adul ba dang / /dge ba thams cad dbang du byed/ /grol 'dod rnams kyi mun pa sel5)/ /blo ldan phyag rgya mchog tu 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba chen po gzi brjid dpe med pa dang ldan pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba ba dan gsum pa'i 'jig rten gsum du bde ba chen po thob ⑩par byed pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya chen po'o// //pha rol phyin pa'i phyag rgya nyid/ /dge ba'i khro mo dang bral ba/ /pha rol phyin pa'i chos yin te/ /tshig dang tshig tu tshogernam tsho bral ba'o/ /phyag rgya 'di ni bcings pa yis/ /chos kyi dbyings nas rje ru 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur bas/ /dbang phyug dam pa 4stede 'gyur te/ /thams cad dag pa rmumos pa yis/ /pad+mo lidamar po mchog 'dzin 'gyur/ /pad+mo 7sgyu ma rnam ⑩mdzad pas/ /sna tshogs chen por de 'gyur ro/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'phrog par 4)byed/ /sems can kun la thams cad sbyin/ /'dod chags chen po nyes spangs te/ /de ni bdud rtsi 'dra bar 'gyur/ /'di ni myur du gar 83—887

byas pa/ /bsgrub ①par mi byed cung zad med/ /'di ni pad+mo sbyor ba yis /bde mchog rtag pa thob par 'gyur/ /shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i myos par byed pa'i dpal pad+mo ⑤phreng ba zhes bya ba thams cad kyi don dpal shin tu dgyes par byed pa'i phyag rgya'o// //'di nyid gnyis pa'i spyi gtsug tu/ /bsgyur nas gzhag ②par byas pa ni/ /ma lus dri ma 'phrog byed pa/ /sna tshogs chen por de (9'gyur ro/ /'di yis dbang ni bskur ma thag /khams gsum sna tshogs byed par 'gyur/ /sna tshogs dbang po rgyal po che/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang sna tshogs bdag /sgrub ①pa thams cad bde dam pa/ /'dod pa kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub (7byed pa/ /thams cad 'di yis ⑦dngos grub ⑧bo/ /bud med 'di yis byin rlabs (9)nas/ /sngo bsangs mkhur 7tshos dkar mo dang / /de dang lhan cig gar byas pas/ /sna tshogs bdag po chen por 'gyur/ /sngo bsangs zhing ma phreng ma dag /byin gyis brlabs nas dus gsum du/ /mtshan gyis 31mthar ni bsnyen byas nas/ /las kyi 7dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /rigs ngan can dang sme ma dang / /gar mkhan de bzhin gar byed dag /phyag rgya ye shes byin brlabs nyi te/ /bsnyen dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /shin tu dgyes pa sna tshogs bde ba sbyin par byed pa zhes bya ba 7'dod par byed pa thams cad kyi mchog sgrub 7par byed pa'i phyag rgya'o// //phyag rgya de dag bsten nya pa'i rnams/ /gar gyi tshul gyis rang gi gnas/ /dam tshig mchog gi dam tshig gis/ /dngos grub chen po'i mthur 'gyur ro/ /thal mo de nyid sbyar byas te/ /rdo rje bcings pas bcing bar byedag/ /de nas 83—888

dga' ①byed dbang bskyed de/ /mnga' ②yi tshul gyis gzung ①bar bya/ /'di ni rab dgyes gtso bo yis④/ /pha rol phyin mchog sdug pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi myos byed pa/ /dpa' bo ⑤rnams kyang rmongs par byed/ /'di ni bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /mi shes byed pa 'jigs par yibyed/ /las kyi don ni bka' ⑦bzhin du/ /dga' nas bran bzhin byed par 'gyur/ / 'di yis byin gyis brlabs pa yis/ /bde chen rgyal po 'dra bar 'gyur/ /⑧dga' dang lhan cig gar byed cing / /'dod ⑨dbang sar ni 'gro bar byed/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' shin tu dgyes pa kun tu bzang mo'i ⑩dgyes pa chen mo'i bde ba gnyis su med pa dang ldan ma zhes bya ba sbyor ⑨ba'i phyag rgya chen po'o// //snying gar gzung ⑩ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /'di yis las kun byed 'gyur te/ /bdud rnams thams cad 'bigs par byed/ /rgyal ba 'dod chags bral spyod pa//bde gshegs mya ngan 'das kun dang / /thams cad 'di yis slong bar (nyebyed/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes byas nas/ /myur du las la sbyor bar byed/ /dbang po nye dbang dbang chen gyi/ /gdug pa thams cad 'joms byed de/ /'jigs byed drag po chen po yis/ /gdug pa thams cad gdung bar byed/ /rdo rje pad+mor snyibacug pa yis/ /mche bas ma mchu bzung byas te/ /sor mo phan tshun bsnol ba yis/ /dpung pa brkyang 8ste gar du bya/ /sna tshogs chen po rab rgyas pas/ /bde chen po yi bde 'thob bo/ /'di 4ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi / /'dod dang thar par grub byed deli/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab na/ /'dod pa bzhin du 'phur bar /nyebyed/ /rab dgyes 'brel pas gar byas shing / /83—889

nam mkha' gzungs ma'i thabs 6)nyid kyis(mi/ /phan tshun gcu ③ba'i gnon pa yis / /bcings na (ge'adi yis dngos grub bo/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /lha dang lha min mchod byed de/ /dbang po nye dbang dbang chen dang / /nyi zla gshin rje chu dbang rnams/ / spyi bo yis ⑤ni phyag byas nas/ /rang gi dpal mchog stobs byed de/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyang / /nyid kyis dpal can stobs pa yis/ /brtan pa de la mgu byed cing / /sangs rgyas dgos pa rab sgrub 6byed/ /'di yis las kyi tshul gyi rnams/ /las dang rjes su mthun ⑦'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnam (nyamadzad pas/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor te/ /gzungs dang gnyis med sbyor ba yis/ /yid la 'dod pa'i las kun byed/ /'dzum dang gnas dang sbas pa dang / /spyod pas gar gyis byas pas so/ /gzhan dag kyang de dngos grub che/ /pad+mo'i 6)'dab ⑩ma rnams phye bas/ /byang chub sems ni rab sgrub pa/ /sgrub yi1pa pos ni pad+mo sgrubatunya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /bde ba gnyis su med pa'i dpal/ /shin tu dgyes pa'i pad+mo 3nya'adab 1 ma zhes bya ba shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba thob par lobyed pa'o// //thal mo de nyid bcings pa yinas/ /bcings pa gyen du bzung byas te/ /mthe'u chung gnyis ni bsgreng 1 byas te/ /de bzhin sbom po gnyis kyang bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni chu srin zhes/ /rgyal mtshan ldan par bshad pa yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sprul pa ste/ /'dod bral chags par bsgrub (18pa yin/ /phyag rgya 'di yis bde ldan gyi/ /pho brang chen por 'gro bar byed/ /der phyin chos kyi (6'khor lo dag /bla med par ni skor 2 bar byed/ /sangs rgyas pha rol phyin mas ( mebaskor/ /8(3—890

sdig spangs rnams ni bkug nas kyang / /spyod pa drag po'i tshul gyis ni/ /bskal pa bye bar bsnyen par byed/ /yang dag byang chub gnas pa yi/ /sangs rgyas 'di yis yo)mnyes par byed/ /de nas dgyes te sna tshogs che/ /sna tshogs ye shes skye ba yi/ /rang gi dam tshig gsungs pa yi/ /sems dpa' chen po sgrub par byed/ /bla med dngos grub thams cad kyang / /'di yis thams cad 'grub ⑧par byed/ /sbyor dang ldan pas byin rlabs ①te/ /snying gar ④nye bar bsam byas na/ /las kyi ngo bo tshul 'di yis/ /thams cad las ni byed du gzhug /gar dang dbyangs kyi ro dga' dang / /sil snyan brdung ba rnam ⑤byed dang / /pi wang 6)gling bu rdza rnga yi/ /phyag rgya 'di yis bsgrub par bya/ /dpal rdo rje shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i thugs kyi dgyes pa dpe med pa dang ldan ma zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o// //thal mo de nyid mnyam bzung nas/ /'gying zhing 'gying bas gar byas te/ /bcing ba chen pos (7)bcings byas nas/ /sbyong (kyeb chen po gnyis su bya/ /khu tshur gnyis po dku kyi)nyid du/ /g.yon du 'gying bas brtan 7par bya/ /phyag rgya 'di ni rgyal la 47sogs/ /bde ba dam pas mchod 42byas te/ /'gying ba'i sbyor bas gar byas na/ /dngos grub thams cad grub par byed/ /'gying ba tsam gyi /gesbyor ba yis/ /'gying ba thams cad 'phrog par byed/ /lha dang lha min rig ma yis / /'bum phrag brgya 4yis mchod par byed/ /rab tu dgyes pa bde mchog che / /kun tu gar byas gnas par 'gyur/ /klu mo lalha dang lha min dang / /de bzhin mi 'am bdag por 'gyur9/ /nam mkhar lco 'gro ma'i khyor 'gyur te/ /rnal 'byor ma kun bde ba che/ /gzungs ma rnams kyi dag pa bdag /gsang 83—891

ba pha rol phyin pa'i rje/ /las kyi sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /thams cad las ni byed par bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba che/ / gsang chen sbyor ①bas dngos grub bo/ /dpal shin tu dgyes pa bde ba chen mo sems can thams cad sgrol ②bar sbas pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya thams cad 'grub pa'o// //phyag rgya de nyid mnyam bzung ste/ /lag pa'i 'dab ma gar dang bcas/ /myur bar steng du dor ba yis/ /mgyogs su 'gro ba dngos grub bo/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rmad 'byung chadam pa mchod byas pa/ /sbyor ba gar gyis mchod byas na/ /thams cad las byed dngos grub bo/ /gang dag dngos grub med pa dang / /gang dag bde ba med pa'i rnams/ /de dag phyag rgya 'dis btab na/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de yis thams cad las rnams ni/ /med 'byung 97dam pa 'grub par byed/ /btsun mo chen po de bzhin 57gshegs/ /'di yis de ni 'grub par byed/ /gzhan yang mchog tu rgya che ba/ /mnyam dang mi mnyam chos kyi dbyings/ /btsun yimo dam pa de bzhin gshegs / /phyag rgya'i sbyor bas dngos grub po/ /dpal bde ba chen po rdo rje rab tu dgyes pa'i me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba'i phyag ⑦rgya'o// //de nyid 'og gi ngos 3)su dor/ /steng du cung zad bsgrub par bya/ /'di yis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bde mchog yid ni tshim byed pa/ /'dis ni bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /bdud rnams shin tu ring bar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya bcings te bsdigs pa yis/ /skrag nas dngos grub sbyin par byed/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig gsum gnas pa'i/ /'di yis mchod pa byas par 'gyur/ /de nas gtso bo 'dis mnyes nas/ /mchog gi thabs 6)ni stobs ⑩par byed/ /83—892

phyag rgya bcings pa sbyor ba yis/ /'di ni thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /rgyun du byas na rnal 'byor pa/ / dgos pa ①thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /sdig pa thams cad 'phrog ②byed de/ /bde ba dam pa ①'thob byed cing / /tshe 'di dang ni pha rol tu/ /phyag rgya'i gnas su de 'gro'o/ /dpal shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba tshim par byed pa zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya ste/ dri ma thams cad spong ba dpal shin tu dgyes ma'o// //thal mo de nyid sbom po bsgreng / /lhag ma ④gsal ba'i nyi ma bzhin/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyitso/ /ye shes mchog tu snang byed pa'o/ /thog ma med nas bskor ba yidu/ /'di yis ⑦gti mug 'phrog nibyed de/ /mnyam par bzhag yo)nas bcings ma thag /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis rlob/ /mnyam nyid ye shes dri med dang / /pad+mo dra ba dga' ba che/ /sna tshogs dra ba dpal chen po/ /bde byed 0chen po 'thob par 'gyur/ /rdo rje dgyes pa chen mo'i dpe med pa'i dpal dang ldan ma zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'o// //g.yas dang g.yon pa'i lag pa yis/ /brjid pa'i gar gyis (nyagar bya zhing / /thal mo de nyid mnyam sbyar te/ /g.yon gyi khu tshur spyi bor gzhagatso /rgyal ba rnams kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /mchod pa thams cad grub byed do/ /thams cad don rnams grub pa dge/ /bkra shis rgyal ba 'thob par byed/ /gang zhig bcings pa tsam gyis kyang / /mchod pa'i sprin nyid rgyas pa che/ /mtha' yas dri med gzi brjid dang / /sangs rgyas zhing ⑩ni dngos grub po/ /phyag rgya sbyor bas sbyar byas te/ /skad cig gcig gis sbyar tsobyas natso/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang sras mchog dang ⑫/ /'di yis thams cad 'bab par 'gyur/ /sna tshogs kyi ni sbyor 83—893

ba yis/ /sna tshogs gar gyis gar byas na/ /dpa' bo thams cad kun tu 'gro//phun sum tshogs pa 'dis 'grub po/ /dpal shin tu dgyes pa chen po bde ba'i sems 'phel bar byed ma 6)zhes bya ba'i (nyaphyag rgya'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi bdag po dpal kun tu bzang po shin tu dgyes pa ②chen po bde ba'i bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad chen po bshad pa mthas klas pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba zla gsang thig le mchog tu pha rol tu phyin pa/ gsang ba chen po dam tshig gi 4)phyag rgya'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu dgyes pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po bskal pa'i mtha' 'a)klas pa zhes bya ba gsum pa ⑥rdzogs so// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen po (7gsang ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam tshig gi 37ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor 'di bshad nas slar yang bde bar cang mi gsung bar gnas par gyur to6nye/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dang / pha rol tu phyin ma rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i tshogs thams cad dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ma'i tshogs thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur nas phyi nang gi rdo rje'i 7rigs su gtogs pa 'phrog par byed pa'i tshogs thams cad la slar 31dbugs phyung ste/de las bzhengs nas gar mdzad cing rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan rgyas pas bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du lta zhing dbyangs kyi mchog bde ba 'di glu yi blangs te dgyes par byed do/ /rnam mang bde ba'i rol pas bdag nyid chen po yis/ /83—894

skye dang mi skye'i chos nyid ya mtshan rmad dag dpal bstan 0)pa/ /shin tu bde ba'i dkyil 'khor 'jig rten 'dir byung (miste/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i gzungs ma'i dkyil nas bskyed par mdzod/ /ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos nyid ①bde bas rol mdzad cing / /bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dus pa rnams la dbugs 'byin cing / /gsang ba'i thig le'i gi)dngos nyid nam mkha' 'dra ba rnams spyad de / /bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod rgyu la (5)dbang mdzad pas/ /byang chub mchog gi (nyalam 'di nyon mongs mtha' dang rnam bral zhing / /bde ba'i 'byung gnas skye shi med pa'i sgo mor pad+mo rnam (medag pa/ /nyon mongs mi gos sgyu mar gnas pa chu zla'i dkyil 'khor bzhin/ /e ma'o kun tu bzang po rig pa rgya chen bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /dngos nyid med pas (8)chos la dga' ba'i rol pas gzungs su 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi (9ribade mchog bdud rtsi ra sa yanayi//ji ltar bde la rten cing kun tu gnang tshonabar mdzad/ /kye ma bde mchog bde bas rol pa tshul bzhin mdzod/ /sdug bsngal 'gro ba'i las can bde bas tshim ⑫par mdzod/ /byams pa'i spyan can 1 thugs rje nyi tshu mas 'gro ba kun la tsoshar mdzad nas/ /gti mug thibs po'i mun nag byang chub sems kyis gsal bar ston / /de ni 'dus pa'i tshogs la bde sbyin rol pa'i rgyal pos gsungs/ /byang chub mchog gi smyosems des snying po mchog tu tsho dbang bskur /shecig /dbyangs kyi phyag rgya 'di yis ni/ /skad cig skad cig bskul byas na/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i bdag nyid kyis49/ /mdun du gnas te dngos grub sbyin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba'i bdag po kun tu bzang po chen po rdo rje zla gsang thig le chen po la/ rdo rje nam mkha' la 'gro ba gsang ba 83—895

chen po tshad med pa dang / mchog tu pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnal 'byor dang /rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs chen mo 6)de rnams kyis bstod cing bskul ba bya ba ②dang /gsang ba thams cad ②kyi bde ba chen po shin tu dgyes pa longs spyod pa'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po 'di la snyoms par zhugs nas/ shin tu dgyes pa chen po gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig duces bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di rang gi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo // //gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs rnam ⑤pa bzhi yis brgyan/ /dar ⑥dang dril bu'i chun po dang / /nyi ma zla bas ⑦rnam par brgyan/ /rin chen mu tig 'bras bus spras/ /do shal gdu bu rnams kyis brgyan/ /sna tshogs gdugs ni rnam 'u) bres pa6)/ /sna tshogs phreng ba gos kyis ⑩brgyan/ /srad 0bu bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ /ka ba brgyad mchog yang dag gnas/ /dbus kyi dga' byed stan la ni/ /dngul la sogs pas rnam par brgyan/ /sna tshogs pad+mo tsodar gyis g.yogs/ /thams cad stan de dag ces bya/ /dbus su rdo rje shin tu dgyes / /stan de la ni gzhag 7par bya/ /tshad med pad+mo tsodamar 'dra ba'i/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis bornam par bklubasayi/ /yid bzhin nor bu dbu rgyan ldan/ /rin chen gtsug gis rnam par mdzes/ /tshad med dar ni dpyangs (rtepa yis/ /dbu la chu 1nyabos mdzes par bya/ /sna tshogs sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /sna tshogs ye shes rab tu gnas/ /chu skyes spyan ni yid tsam rgyas6)/ /dga' byed yid tsam g.yon du 'dud/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis 6)rdo rje che/ /snying gar (megasor la shin tu brtson/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /thog ma nyid du rnam par gzhag /slob ma'am yang na gzhan yang rung / /mtshan kun gyis ni 83—896

rnam brgyan pa/ /tshul bzhin byin gyis brlab ①bya ste/ /dbus kyi dkyil du gzhag ②par bya/ /bdag nyid kyang ②ni mnyam gzhag ④ste/ /de la sogs pa yon tan gtso/ /dbus kyi stan dul 'dug pa na/ /bdag ni rab dgyes zhes su smra/ /des ni slob ma byin brlabs nyute/ /thams cad las byed phun sum tshogs / /rdo rje pad+mo ⑦las byung ⑧ba'i/ /gsang ba yis kyang dbang bskur nyaro/ /rab dgyes la sogs yon tan ldan/ /yid 'ong bu mo btsal byas te/ /mgrin pa dpral ba snying spyi bor/ /lha la sogs pa'i 'bru bsgoms te/ /mtshan ma phyag rgyar rab 'bar ba/ /rdo rje pad+mor mnyam 0sbyor ba'i/ /rang la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /tshul bzhin thams cad gzhag nyunyepar bya/ /mdun du lha mo smyo ⑫byed ma/ /ma mchu 'dzin pas 8ro la dgyes/ /dkar dmar kha dog 'dres pa yi8 / /thams cad rgyan dang yang dag ldan/ /lo ni bcu drug lon pa'i mchog /shes rab can gyis mdun du gzhagatso /g.yas su lha mo gsod byed ma/ /mtshon cha'i mda' ni 'dren par brtson/ /do shal rkang gdub dag gis brgyanatso/ /lo grangs nyi shu lon pa ste/ /gser gyi ri bo zhu ba 'dra/ /chu skyes spyan ni yid tsam sngo / /sems dpa' che la dgyes mdzad cing / /'di ni tshul bzhin gzhag (nyepar bya / /rgyab tu lha mo rmongs byed ma/ /pad+ma (nyedamar po mdog gi 'od/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan mdzes ma'o/ /sku che'i ()tshad ni nyi shu gcig /dga' byed 'dod pa'i ro la dgyes/ /sna tshogs na bza' yang dag gsol/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs( )/ /sna tshogs pad+mo (7sbyor la sogs/ /gar gyi bya ba rab bslabs sogegazhagadun /g.yon du sna tshogs chen mo (geste/ /sna tshogs dgos pa'i rjes bslabs pa/ /sku tshe'i tshad ni bcu gnyis ldan/ /rnal 'byor la ni ru shin 83—897

tu brtson/ /lha dang lha min mi yi nyu)rnams/ /'gro ba thams cad myos 'gyur ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par bklubs(7/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /grwa rnams kyi ni thams cad du/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg gi rnams/ /bdug pa me tog bsung ②ldan pa/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od dang ldan/ /ci rigs par ni gzhag 0par bya/ /sgo yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /rang gi las kyi phyag rgyar ldan/ /skal ldan dga' la rnam mos pa/ /sgo srung (5)bzhi ni gzhag ⑥par bya / /gzhan yang rnam pa ( sna tshogs rnams/ /pi wang (8)gling bu brdab pa dang / /rdza rnga rnga chen mu ku dang / /mu ra dza dang da ra dang / /gar dang dbyangs dang bzhad pa che/ /rol mo'i yo byad sna tshogs rnams/ /dga' byed dkyil 'khor gzhag 997par bya/ /phyi yi bodakyil 'khor thams cad do/ /dkyil 'khor 'di yi 17phyi rol du/ /rdo rje nam mkhar nyana'agro ma gzhagatu /yi dgas yirgyal po yang dag zhon/ /dpa' bo 'jigs byed gzugs 'dzin te/ /skal ldan rang gi lag char 8ldan/ /gdug pa'i sems kyis sdigs tshebyed cing / /sha khrag dang ni rgyu ma dang / /rkang dang tshil bu za spyod pa/ /dkyil 'khor byas te 'dug pa ni/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gzhag 1 par bya/ /dga' bar byed dang 'dren par byed//gsod par byed dang spro bar byed/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro tshogs kyi rnams/ /shar gyi phyogs su gzhag 1 par bya/ /gzi brjid che dang 'bar byed ma/ /'jigs byed bong bu lho 19ru ste/ /gtsug lag mthong ba'i rgyu yis ni/ /mkhas pas tshul bzhin gzhag tshopar bya/ /chags chen mo dang chags bral dang / /'khor lo mo dang rgyas 'debs mo/ /rab tu sbyor bas sbyor byas te/ /ci rigs nub tu gzhag 7par bya/ /sna tshogs lus dang bsrung 52ba dang / /gnod sbyin ma dang 83—898

yang dag 'phrog /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs 6)te/ /sngags mkhan ci rigs byang du ②gzhag② /shar gyi grwa ru gzhag ④pa ni/ /bya rog gdong ste mig 'dra zhing / /'jigs (9pa'i mig dang 'jigs pa'i gdong / /ji ltar rjes su mthun 6)byas te/ /yi dgas (7)stan la yang dag 'dug /sna tshogs mchog gi mdog 'dzin te/ /lag pa gri dang 'khar (nyagazhong thogs/ /mchog tu sha dang khrag za ba'o/ /nub dang lho yi mtshams gzhag (9)pa/ /bzhad dang kyi'ug pa'i gdong ring ma/ /khros pa'i khyi dang phag gi gdong / /gsus po che la lto 'phyangs ma / /nub byang gi ni mtshams dag tu/ /rnga mo bong (1)bu'i gdong 'dzin dang / /khros pa'i ra dang byi la'i gdong / /rgyu 1 ma'i mgo nas za byed rnams/ /shar dang byang gi mtshams dag tu/ /keng rus dkar po (ste'adzin pa ste/ /khros pa rus pa'i phreng bas bklubs7/ /lto 'phyangs mo la bum pa 'dzin/ /phan tshun 'thab par brtson pa yi/ /ce skuspyang gi ni 'khor gyi rnams/ /'jigs byed gdong ni mche ba 'byin/ /rnam par 'gyur bas tsogazugs 'dzin pa'o/ /sgo sung gi smyo ni phyogs kun du/ /sgo bzhi rnams su gzhag tshonyebya ba/ /byang gi phyogs su 'bod 'grogs 37te/ /bum pa'i ne rin ni shar nyid du/ /nub tu rnam par 'jig pa'o/ /lhor ni gshin rje'i ri :rgyal po gzhag /de dang gzhan yang rgyal po mchog /nam mkha' ( ge'agro bas kun tu bskor/ /bum pa rnam pa sna tshogs te/ /gser dang dngul sa las byas pa la / /sna tshogs gos kyis yang dag dkris/ /me tog 'bras bu rnams kyis brgyan/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis gang byas pa/ /sman lnga dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rin chen lnga dang ldan byas pa/ /'bru sna su lnga yis brgyan byas pa'i/ /bum pa bcu drug gzhag zugabyas te/ /bcu gnyis brgyad 83wa 899

dam yang na phyed/ /tha na 7chung ngu gcig tsam yang / /ji ltar rim ②bzhin gzhag ③byas te/ /dbus su bum pa ro yi mchog /dam tshig chus ni gang byas pa / /gser ram dngul lam zangs kyang rung / /lcags sam sa las byas pa la//zla ba nyi ma dri chu dang / /btung ba snum por ldan pa yi/ /dbang po kun las ci'abyung ba rnams/ /sha srang gcig gis rab bsres pa/ /kun las 'phags pa ro yi mchog /tshogs kyi dbus su bsgrub byas te/ /btung ba bzhin du myangs pa yis/ /rdo rje blo ldan bskal par gnas/ /rnam pa sna tshogs nye ba'i duzas/ /bza' ba dang ni bca' bas dumachod/ /mchod pa nye ba'i 0zas lnga dang / /tshad med 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas/ /tshad med rnal 'byor ma tshogs la/ /skad cig skad cig mchod par bya/ /sngags mkhan tshul bzhin mnyam gzhag ⑦sto//'byung po rnams la gtor ma sbyin⑤/ /lha rnams kyi ni thams cad la/ /he ru ka yi phyag rgya yis/ /nyid kyi gtor ma byin brlabs 6)te/ /spyan drangs gtsang sbra ⑩byas pa dbul/ /gzungs kyi tshogs ni de rnams la/ /mnyes par ⑩byas nas slar gshegs so/ /rnal 'byor ma chen dkyil 'khor du/ /slob ma'i mchog ni gzhug 7par bya/ /mtshungs par spyod pa rab mdzes ma/ /sna tshogs gos ⑩kyis yang dag dkris/ /lag pa g.yon gyis gzung tsobyas te/ /rab dgyes longs spyod phyag rgya yis/ /bcug nas sgo yi grwa nyid du/ /blo ldan dam tshig bsgrag ⑫par bya/ /'di las mi bya cung zad med/ /thabs dang shes rab sems nyid kyis7ske/ /rtag tu dogs pa med byas te/ /'dod pa lnga yi yon tan spyodakyi/ /gzhan yang dam tshig nyams pa dang / /skye bo gang dag dam la gnon/ /brtul zhugs khyod kyi kyi de drangs te/ /khrag chen po ni btung bar bya/ /gang dag slob 83—900

dpon smod byed dang / /gang dag bka' rnams mi byed pa/ /de dag bros 6)nas khrag chen po/ /blo ldan snying ②las btung bar bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed dang / /slob dudapon la yang gnod byed pa/ /rdo rje khro bo ④bsdus pa yis⑤/ /dam tshig bsgoms te bsgral bar bya/ /de nas dam tshig blud byas te / /rdo rje bdud rtsi ro yi mchog /dung chen por ni gzhag ⑥par bya/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu blud do/ /kye ma ⑦dmyal ba yi ni chu 'di steni/ /khyod kyi snying la kun du gnas/ /dam tshig bsrungs pas dngos grub ster⑨/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung / /oṃ badz+ra u da 0ka rtsu ṭha0/ dam tshig 'di 8ni brgyar bzlas pa'i / /byin gyis brlabs te 'thung du gzhug /gzhan du dam tshig mi 'gyur te / /dngos grub nyid du'ang 'di 'gyur ro/ /bdag ni dam tshig skal dga' zhes / /slob ma tsosngags ni brjod du gzhugatso /sgo gyur gnas nas dri tsobya ba/ /kye 0khyod dga' ba ci la dad⑩/ /'jug pa yis kyang smra bya ba/ /bdag ni skal ldan bde mchog la/ /rab dgyes 'phrul la bdag dga' 8ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba yibadag dga'o()/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma mchog gi⑥/ /dkyil du me tog bor byas te/ /me tog gang la lhung ba yi/ /lha nyid du ni dngos grub bo/ /dbang bskur pa yi phyag rgya tsoyis/ /de nas spyi bor dbang bskur bya/ /bum pa rnam pa bzhi yis kyang / /mnyam par bzhag ( ste lnga po yis/ /pad+ma'i (stedakyil 'khor zhugs byas te/ /de nas yang ni dbang bskur bya/ /ci rigs par ni gzungs mo'i ()rnams/ /bdag nyid liskal ldan zhes su smra/ /gang dag 'gro bar gyur pa yis()/ /lha de nyid ni bsten (nyepar bya/ /dga' bar byed pa'i gzungs (tem 'di'i(na/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsgrub puspepar gyis(nye/ /de nas rgyal 83—901

dbang slob ma de/ /nang gi sbas pa bsdus pa yi0)/ /gsang ba mnyam par 'jug pa yis/ /sbyor dang ldan pas dbang bskur bya/ /rdo rje pad+mo ②las drangs pa / /sbom po dang ni dbang gis blang ③/ /rdo rje dkan ④du gzhag (nyabyas la(7/ /rtag pa dge ba 43)bde ba che/ /kye ma'o dam tshig bde ri brjod cing / /kye ma bde ba blang bar bya/ /'di ni gsang ba zhes bya ste/ /dbang bskur ba yi thabs mchog go/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid ches(9)/ /rang gi khar ni rdo rje gzhag /sems dpa' chen po drangs byas na/ /sems kyis byang chub bde ba 'thob / /'di ni mchog tu gsang ba ste/ /dbang bskur ba yi bde ba'o/ /slob ma mi shes pa rnams la/ /'di dag thams cad bsgrag 6)mi bya/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyis bya ba/ /yang nas yang du brtag par bya/ /'di yis dbang ni bskur ma thag /slob ma tshogs kyi bdag por 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin pa yi/ /slob dpon nyid du bde bar 'gyur/ /gzungs kyim rnams kyis tu dga' ba'i bdag /sangs rgyas rnams kyi rjer bshad yido/ /mkha' la 'gro ba'i khyor 'gyur te/ /ri dang 'gro ba kun gyi bdag /de nas shes rab ye shes dbang / /slob ma mchog la sbyin par bya/ /gzungs yim de ni bdag nyid la/ /bla ma nyid kyis byin brlabs sate/ /dngos grub 'bras bu myur 'thob phyir/ /slob ma la ni sbyin par bya/ /dbang bskur shin tu sbas pa yis/ /rdo rje slob dpon tshul ji bzhin/ /blo ldan the tshom yi med pa'i phyir/ /rnam pa bzhi po 'di sbyin no/ /de tshun cad 1 tshoni slob ma la/ /rgyud kun las ni gang chung 17zad/ /yi ge'i tshul gyis sbas pa rnams/ /gsang ba mchog ni bstan ( )par bya/ /de nas de nyid langs byas te/ /slob dpon rkang par gtugs byas nas/ /rgyal 843wa 902

po dbang phyug bde dam pa/ /thams cad yon ni dbul (1)bar bya/ /gzungs de dag ni thams cad la/ /ci dga' bar ni yon yang 'bul/ /slob dpon cung zad gang 'dod pa/ /yid la bsams pa'i yon yang rung / /dam tshig 'das pas 'jigs pa yis/ /de dag thams cad dbul (gyibar bya/ /slob dpon la ni yon gyi mchog /rigs kyi khyad ri par dbul byas te/ /seng ge'i gdan la nyid kyi (snyam/ /sangs rgyas byin ni yon mchog yin/ /glang po rin chen gser dag dang / /sring mo bla ma'i yon mchog yin/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs yin te/ /yon de mchog gi yon yin no/ /rin chen pad+ma'i (5)chung ma dang / /shing rta rta ni shin tu brgyan/ /sna tshogs rin chen rnam dag pa/ /mu tig phreng bas shin tu mdzes / /bu mo rin chen dra ba 56)yis/ /brgyan te sna tshogs rdo rje la'o/ /rgyal po yi ni dbang phyug dang / /chung ma bla ma dbul bar bya/ /'phrul gyi bzhon (7)pa rnam (8)sna tshogs(9ri/ /glang po rta ni shin tu brgyan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rje / /nan tan bla ma dbul bar bya/ /bla ma'i yon gyi phyag rgya 'di/ /rdo rje blo ldan slob ma yis/ /ci ste 'ibade byed kun 'dod na/ /dga' dang mos pa'i sems kyis bya(sto/ /de la sogs pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab dgyes gdon mi za ba'i bde/ /gang gis myur du thob / 'gyur te/ /slob dpon gtso mchog nyid du 'gyur / /chos rnams kun gyi 1 dbang phyug rgyal/ /rdo rje blo ldan mchog tu 'gyurali / /rin chen kun gyi rigs kyi rgyal/ /de bzhin sna tshogs rigs kun tu / /pad+mo'i rigs kun dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje rigs kun bdag por de/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni rigs kun dang / /rgyal ba'i gtso bo mchog tu 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni 'khor lo'i gar/ /nyid dang slob ma'i tshogs gyur pas/ /83wa 903

rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /sems dpa' bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /phan tshun la sogs tshul gyis ni/ /shes rab mchod pa'i sbyor ①ba yis/ /rdo rje che yis ②thabs gnas te/ /mkha' 'gro kun la mchod par 'gyur①/ /phyi yi sbas pa gsang la sogs/ /nang gi mchod pa mchog gi ④rnams/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba tshul gnas te/ /tshul bzhin rgyas btab ⑤dbul bar bya/ /lus dang ngag sems bde byed kyis/ /mchod pa'i bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /'dod pa'i rol pa myong ba yis/ /myang dun mchod pa thob ⑦par 'gyur/ /mchod pa kun gyi cho ga yis/ /rang rig (kyikhyad par shes byas te/ /sgrub ⑨pa thams cad bsgrubs ⑩byas na(nya/ /dngos grub thams cad myur du 'thob/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'di mthong bas/ /dga' mgu rangs 8pa'i yid kyis ⑩ni/ /rdo rje sems la phyag byed cing / /rang gi dkyil 'khor gsol ba 'debs/ /bde byed chen po'i dkyil 7mo brgya(7/ /rigs kyi khyad par gyis ni lnga/ /lha rnams kyang ni re re yang / /sems kyi khyad par mchog tsomatha' yas/ /'das pa'i dus ni ⑩ma byung ba/ /mtha' yas chos ni yangs pa bstan(sre/ /'dod chags rnams kyis dkris khri7pa yi/ /sdug bsngal gzir ba'i mtha' nas 'gro/ /'dod pa'i mchog gi mnyalongs spyod rnams/ /mos pa'i rjes su zhugs shing spyod/ /kun tu chags par mi 'gyur zhing / /bde bas langs 6nyapa'i yid dang ldan/ /byang chub snying por bgrod pa ni/ /dam bcas rnams dang sems kyis so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu dgyes pa thams cad kyi bdag po kun tu bzang po chen po / rab tu bzhad cing spyan zur gyis ( stegazigs pa'i thugs kyis shin tu dgyes pa / kun tu longs spyod pa'i skyil mo krung ( gegi dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin 83—904

'grub par 'gyur/ /rin po che yi skyil 6)mo'o/ /de bzhin rkang pa gnyis bzhag pa/ /pad+mo ②'dra ba ①sbyar byas te/ /bdag gam de bzhin gzhan yang rung / /blo ldan pad+mo ④bde bsgrub bya/ /'di yis sems can thams cad dang / /mdor na sangs rgyas rnam 'a)dag dang / /rdo rje nyi ma ma lus kyang / /dbang du 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ /bde ldan pho brang chen po yikhyi/ /bde byed 'di yis thob ⑦par byed/ /sems can khams rnams thams cad du/ /sems dpa' chen po 'gro 'ong byed/ / pad+mo'i skyil (8)mo'o/ /de bzhin skyil 6nyemo rgyas byas te/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis sbyor ba bya/ /sngags mkhan chen po'i sbyor ba yiti/ /sngags mkhan yi ge shin tu brtson/ /zlos pa byed cing rnams bsgoms 4spren/ /dngos grub rtag pa thob 8par 'gyur/ /mi g.yeng sngon gyi bdug (nyepa yi/ /las rnams thams cad 'phrog par byed/ /sna tshogs dkyil tsodu gnas pa yisatso/ /bla tso med dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /sna tshogs kyi ni skyil 5)mo'o/ /de nas mkha' 'gro ma'i ()skyil (khemo rgyas/ /thams cad khrag ni 'phrog byas te/ /gzungs ma yi ni rkang pa gnyis/ / nyid kyis gnya' bar ( )rkang pa bteg(ste /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sbyor ba yi( ste/ /bsnyen pas ( nakhrag rnams 'phrog par byed/ /mnyam par bzhag zhi )nas gzungs ma yi/ /rkang pa gcig ni mgul nyid du/ /sbyor dang ldan pas bteg ( gebyas na/ /zas rnams thams cad 'phrog byed de/ /btung ba 2zhebaza' ba bca' ba dang / /gos kyi 5 rgyan gyis bklubs khri pa yis( 6/ /de bzhin zhag bdun nyid kyis kyang / /thams cad las byed gdon mi za/ /tshangs pa gtogs zhi ci'adod dbang po yis / /dpal 〈chen mchog ni 'phrog par byed/ /lag pa bsgreng sa ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /khams gsum rim par rgal nu ribar byed/ /83—907

che / /sna tshogs ye shes bstod phyag 'tshal/ /gzungs kyi pad+mo 6)yang dag ldan/ /'dod byed thugs kyi mchog yin te/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba'i ye shes bstod phyag 'tshal/ /chos kyi ②don ni gnyis (0med tshul/ /stong pa nyid kyi lam rig pa/ /yangs pa'i spyan ni so sor gzigs/ /me long ye shes yang dag 'byung / /bya ba nan tan sems can don/ /rang gi yon tan mi mnyam shod/ /de nyid rig pa'i 50sems can kun/ /rdo rje gsum gyis byin rlabs (gepa/ /gang gis byin gyis brlabs ma thag /sangs rgyas gsum ni dbang du 'gyur/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po gnyis su med pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi rdo rje ye shes zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i 'bru 'di nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung (65ngo / /oṃ r+ghaṃ ri ri/ stong pa chen po'i snying po'o(8)/ /oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta ri95rdu/ oṃ badz+ra kā ya oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra bāka tshe.āḥ / oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa 〉tshon/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoḥyige/ de nas bcom ldan 'das (gyede bzhin gshegs pa thams cad shin tu mgu/ rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag byas te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang rang rang gi snying po bcom ldan 'das la 'bul lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dge'o zhes bde ba chen po'i tshul gyis rab tu spro bar mdzad do/ /dge'o dge'o rgyal ba kun/ /dge'o dge'o rgyal ba mchog /dge'o dge'o legs pa'i las / /dge'o dge'o sngon 'gro ba/ /dge'o dge'o sna tshogs che/ /nyid kyi snying gar tso drangs byas te/ /rang gi gsang ba bshad par mdzod/ /gang gis ma 8(3—919

rin chen 'byung ldan btsun mo che/ /dbang bskur yon tan 'thob byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa tshul khrims chen mo ste/ /de nyid chos don yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje chos kyi btsun mo ste/ /de sbyin dga' byed ma yin no/ /bzod pa chen mo byang du ste/ /gsod 1)pa'i bdag nyid zad pa sbyin/ /btsun mo rdo rje gdon mi za/ /dam tshig gnas ni skyong byed ma'i/ /grwa dag tu ni thams cad du/ /snga ma bzhin du mchod la sogs/ /sgo yi phyogs rnams thams cad du/ /sgo srung ②rnams ni rnam pa bzhi/ /ci 'dod par ni mchod bya ste/ /slob ma mchog ni gzhug (kyepar bya/ /phyag rgyas lag pa brgyan byas te( )/ /'dzum (5)dang bcas pa'i 'dod chags mig /rgyan kun gyis ni rnam par bklubs(6)/ /spro ba che bas gar bya zhing / /lha yi 'gying ba'i 'dun pa yis/ /dga' 3)byed dkyil 'khor gzhug (nyapar bya/ /mig ni dar gyi gos nyid kyis/ /g.yogs te lag pas bzung 6)nas kyang / /sgo yi grwar yang gzhag 7bya ste/ /smon lam mchog ni yi7smra ru gzhug8 /rdo rje chen mo yinabadag ces bgyi/ /rang gi lha rnams phyag bgyi ste/ /rang dgyes gnas las byung ba yimi/ /bde byed chen mos mnyes par bgyi/ /ji lta 7bzhin du mnyam nyid 'thob/ /me tog phreng ba dor byas te/ /lha mo chen mo bzhengs 7su gsol/ /khyod kyi 1 dkyil 'khor bdag 'tshal lo/ / lha mo gang la lhung ba yi/ /de yi lag nas bskor ba bya/ /lha mo 'di ni khyod dang mthunanyusnye/ /sems che khyod kyis 'dod par gyis19/ /de nas slob ma de yis ni/ /bdag gi nelharab dgyes smra bya zhing / /de la 'dod pa spyad par mdzod/ /khro bo rnams kyi mi phyed phaṭa/ /mtha' ni hoḥ21zhes sbyar bar bya/ /'byung ba'i dus su bya ba ni/ /a k+ṣ-i 2ho su kha bde zhes smra/ /de nas rdo rje phyung ba yi/ /mkhas pas de ni blang byas teri ge/ /843—922
