mkha' la 'gro ba sangs rgyas nyid/ /ci bde bas ni sgrub par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang pos yang rdo rje nam mkha' la 'gro ma de dag kun mgu dga' bar bsgrub par bya ba'i snying po 'di nyid kyi ①sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /oṃ ḍā ②kyi nī la.ā kur+sha ya pra be sha ya/ brnya ④ya to ṣa duya ā ⑥ sar+pā na gabadz+ra ḍā ki nī skṛ (kyed yo hūm̐ dz+dzaḥ6)/ dzaḥs rba hoḥ ṭak+ki kyi dz+dzaḥyi / oṃ te ru ka ma hā badz+ra/ ā gnu/ ā ku 8/ pra 'be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ bharnya ya bharnya rmuya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa snyiya/ rtsu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ⑩pad+ma ma hā pa byaḍa ba mu kha/ ā ku tunye/ pra be sha ya/ bharnya yayi/ mo ha ya/ to ṣa 63ya/ ha ha hi/ khro bo'i sngags kyi ⑥tshogs 'dis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang /mkha' la 'gro ma dang / nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / rdo rje 'phrog par byed ma de dag la sogs pa de dag dgug pa dang / gzhug pa dang / dbang du bya ba la sogs pa'i las bya ste/ gtor mas emachod pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig he ru ku'i phyag rgya dang / ṭak+ki ( stergyal po'i phyag rgya dang / rta mgrin gyi phyag rgya sbyin te/las thams cad la sbyor ro/ /rdo rje'i thal mo ji lta ba bzhin bcings te/ khro bo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bya/ sbom po gnyis phan tshun rtse sbyar zhing / zhi ba gnyis kyang rab tu bsgreng 8ste/ lhag ma gnyis brkyang rka nyeste 'od zer ltar gtang ( nyab 'di ni phyag rgya'i mchog yin no/ /phyag rgya 'di ni gzi brjid che(rte/ /lha dang lha min phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin la sogs/ /bsngags shing mchod pa byas pa yin/ /bcings pa de nyid 'bebs pa dang / /thams cad tshogs ni 'dzud par byed/ /gdug pa thams cad gsod byed ma/ /srin mo so thams cad za bar byed/ /rnal 'byor dam pa gnas pa yis/ /'di yis las rnams 83—944

thams cad byed/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub hu)pa po/ /mi ldan dngos grub mi 'gyur te/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /bsnyen pas dngos grub myur du 'thob/ /rdo rje bcings pa gnyis su (snyebyas te/ rgyab gnyis rgyab sbyar te /(gu mthe'u chung gnyis brkyang ste/ phan tshun bsnol khros pa gnyis gyen du bsgreng (7ste snying gar 6)bstan nas/ brkyang bskum gyi tshul du gnas pa 'di las thams cad byed pa'o/ /'di yis thams cad las kyi rnams/ /ji tsam yid 'dod byed pa ra 'gyur/ /tshe 'din sdig pa gang byas pa/ /'di yis thams cad 'phrog par byed/ /de dag thams cad myur 'gyur te/ /dngos grub yid bzhin rin chen no/ /ji snyed nam mkha'i lam dag tu/ /rnal yi'abyor 'di yis 'phur ⑦bar byed/ /rig (8)'dzin mchog ni mtshon par yang / /cho ga grub pa slar yang 'ong / /thal mo mnyam par 5)sbyar te/ sbom po gnyis dbus 7sbyar/lhag ma 'dab (nyam kha bye ba ltar byas pa ni pad+ma'i gdan no/ /sbom po gnyis rtse mo thur 'du bstan pa ni rta gdong gi'o/ /gang gis sbyor byas skad cig tu/ /de yis dngos grub chen por 'gyur/ /bcings ma thag tu 'phur 'gyur ba/ /'dod pa bzhin du nye bar 'gro/ /sa 'og dngos grub yina'adod pa bzhin/ /myur du slar yang ldog par 'gyur/ /de la sogs pa mtha' yas pa/ /phyag rgya 'di ni sbyor ba dge/ /nga ni bstan te rgyal ba'i rnams/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rdzidrang bar bya/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams thams cad kyang / /phyag rgya'i yan lag mchog des sbyar/ /de nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba chen mo de dag sogs snyi'adod pas gzir ba yinams rangs te/ rang gi gzugs ni bsgyur ba yis/ /bzhengs te gar ni rab mdzad cing / /dur khrod kyi ni sa chen du/ /mgu ba 83—945

chen pos brtags par byed/ /phyag na thod pa gri dag dang / /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnam par 'dzin/ /skal ldan rang gi phyag rgyas mtshan/ /dbu smug rnam par bsnyer 0)ba'i zhal/ /bde ba'i cha lugs sbyar ba yis/ /bde ba dam pa longs spyod myong ske/ /rab tu rmongs pas bsnyen byed cing / /rab dgyes khro la gsol ba 'debs / /zla ba dri med (gyistong rab (7rdzogs pa'i spyanali/ /thugs rje'i dbyings rum nyid du bdag cag bskyed sna/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal tsha bas gdungs pa yi/ /byang chub des ni phyirakun tu tshim par mdzod/ /a la la la ho/ mchog gi rol pas yang dag sgo 'byed cing / /byang chub mchog lam 7snying po nyid 'di 2ston/ /gsang ba'i bdag nyid bde bas zil gnon lho)te/ /rmongs shing bying ba'i ⑩rnams la thugs rjes sgrol/ /a la la la ho/ che ba'i ye shes lhun gyis mngar ldan pa/ /phyogs kyi thugs rjes ma zin snyoms par dgongs/ /bde ba mchog gis yornyegasang ba'i gnas nyid du/ /mya ngan 'da' ba'ang longs spyod bstan ⑫pas 7'grub/ /'jig rten gsum po 'dir ni dngos bstan kyang / /rmugs pa'i 'gro bas bdud rtsi'i dngos kham mthong / /kye ma'o lim skyes chos te snying po las byung 7ba/ /bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha'i mtha' 7dang mnyam/ /rab tu dgyes pa'i bde mchog 'bar ba'i gtso/ /rin chen sna tshogs kun 'dus 'di la gzigs / /sngon med rol mo 'di la rol mdzad cing / /dur khrod chen po'i dngos grub stsal bar mdzod/ / 'dul ba'i dbang gi grub pa'i cha lugs mi zad ma / /rnal 'byor mkha' 'gros gzi brjid 'bar ba 'dis/ /sdug bsngal gsum pos 'thoms shing rmongs pa la/ /bde ba'i spyod pas gnas nas spyod mdzad de/ /nya cithugs rjes pad+ma'i dbyings las bskyed par mdzod/ /a la la la 83—946

ho / ji ltar pad+ma 'di la chags med bzhin/ /sdug pa'i bcings pas ma 6)zin rnam (bgrol te/ / rol pas chub pa'i sa la gnas shing rnam mdzad pa/ /ni'ajig rten gsum po 'di la gzigs nas ④rol mo mdzod/ /bdag cag dam tshig 'di la 'dus shing ⑤snang ba'i (6)rnams(0)/ /mnyes mdzod shin tu bde ba bzhengs su gsol/ /'gal 9kyeba'i yid dang ma chags rdo rje la/ /nam mkha' ji bzhin mi 'gyur tshul bzhin gnas/ /khams kyi rang bzhin mnabs 6)shing rnam ⑩ khro yang / /byams pa'i thugs rjes kun du gnas khyab mdzad/ /e ma'o ⑫ bde bas dhibade sbyin phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin grub pa'i bde ba dngos grub gsol / /chags med chags dang ldan pa'i longs spyod kyis/ /dam tshig skyon med bdag cag rol pa mdzod/ /thugs rje yi gsal ba'i byang chub sems chen des / /'gro ba kun gyi bag chags rnam par sbyongs/ /rgyu dang rkyen la ma brten ⑫rang bzhin grub/ /ma chags dri med yongs gsal zla ba bzhinasnyi/ /'jig rten gsum po 'dir ni mnga' mdzad de/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun du bde bas rtsenatso/ /'di yis gtso la bskul byas na/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du dngos grub bo/ /yid gdung mnyen pa'i nga ro yis/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po 7klu blangs te/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba yi dri med pa'i/ /dgongs pa thams cad bstan byas te/ /rdo rje pad+mo (/7yid 'ong ba'i/ /dngos grub thams cad sbyar bar bya/ /bde byed chen po 'di yis ni/ /bskul bas dgyes pa sbyin par byed/ /rdo rje can gyi yi ger ldan/ /dus gsum rab tu sbyar bar bya/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje nam mkha' la 'gro ma thams cad kyi shin ri )tu dgyes ( nyapa'i longs spyod dpal gyi khri bde ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs khri 83—947

te / de dag thams cad la rjes su mgu bar mdzad do/ /g.yon gyi lag pas gzung ①byas te/ /gsang skyes pad+mo ②bye ba las/ /rdo rje chen po g.yas nyid kyis / /bcug na mchod pa 'thob 'gyur te/ /mkha' la 'gro ba dra ba 'dis/ /mnyes pas 'di nas dngos grub 'thob/ /oṃ dang oṃ dang mi phyed rdo rje bde/ /mtha' ru phaṭa kyis stobs rab sbyor ba yis/ /kye ma'o bde ba mkha' 'gro dra ba che / /rab dgyes dbang mo bde byed bde stabs mdzod/ /(7rnal 'byor ma tshogs gsal rnams la/ /'di yis rtsen ④pa rnam byas na/ /bde chen bde ba dgyes pa yirgya/ /rab dgyes dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma'i che ba rjes su mnyes par byed pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya ye shes so// //mgo la thal mo phyed sbyin te/ /chu skyes la ni yongs su rdzogs/ /rdo rje bcing ba 96)yang dag ldan/ / pad+mo'i skyil mo bcing bar bya/ /'di yis rtsen par byas na ni/ /bud med mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /bde ba chen pos gar byed cing / /rab dgyes bde byed gnod byed dang / /kun tu 'khyud dang sprod byed dang / /( sna tshogs gar gyis gar byas te/ /thams cad zas dang ros dngos 'grub987/ /mchog gi bde bas dngos grub 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya bcing 6)byas te/ /sangs rgyas sbyor ba bde chen po/ /myur ba'i thal mos bsgrub par bya'o/ /gsum gyis mtshams su rab bya zhing / / mkhur tsos (1so yis btab byas te/ /ma mchu yang nas yang du gzung yi / /'o ma 'dzin pa phyir zhing mnye1nya/ /g.ya' byed pad+mo sa rnam (skabazhi bya/ /pad+mo phyi phyir rab mnye zhing / /ze ba mtshan pas rab tu sbyar/ /sen mos mchan khung sum mdo dang / /rna ba gnyis su rab tu gzugs/ /dal nas rdo rje gzhug bya zhing / /khro bo'i rgyal pos 83—948

bskyod ①par bya/ /g.yas kyis shin tu bskyod byas nas/ /g.yon pa yis ni gtang (mibar bya/ /sbyor ba 'di yis rtsen ③pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo mchod par bya/ /kye ma'o bde zhes rab brjod deli/ /bde ba chen po dbyangs kyis bskul/ /yang dang yang du 'dzin pa na/ /blo ldan sgrub ( pas bsgrub ⑥par bya / /rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi mchod pa chen po'i spro ba ye shes so/ /de dag thams cad mgu nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /nye ba'i zarme ni thams cad dang / /de bzhin nye ba'i yo byad rnams/ /bde ba bsgrubs ⑦pas sgrub pa po/ /sna tshogs chen po bsgo bar shegasol/ /bsgrub 6)pa thams cad sgrub byed pas/ /gdon mi za dka' rtag bgyid zhipas/ /gang gis myur du mnyam sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu rnam bsgyur bgyi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis nye ba'i yo byad kha zas thams cad kyi phyag rgya gsungs pa/ yo byad phyi yi (1thams cad dang / /gos dang rgyan la sogs pa'o/ /nye ba'i kha zas rnams la ni/ /sha dang khrag las yang dag bsgrubatso/ /'bras bu rtsa ba tshad med do/ /mchog tu bde ba yid tshim pa/ /'di yis mchod pa byas pa na/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni dngos grub 'gyur/ /bus pa'i sha las rab bsgrub tu pa'i/ /'o ma dam pas thod pa dgang / /mkha' 'gro ma kun dbul byas na/ /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni dbyos grub 'gyur/ /gtor ma'i mchod pa'i yo byad kyi ye shes so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs 8pa thams cad dang / rdo rje 'dzin thams cad bzhengs te phyag 'tshal yinas yang yigacig tu stug por 'du ba mdzad de bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba 'debs so/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi ye shes mtshan/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /thams cad brda tsho rnams dran gyur pa/she/ /bcom ldan 'das 83wa 949

kyis bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i ro myong ba dang 'brel ba'i dpal zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/rdo rje nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / mkha' la 0)'gro ma thams cad kyi brda'i phyag rgya 'di gsungs so/ /ka ni 'dod pa byed 'dod phyir/ /bdag ni 'dod can smras yin te/ /gti mug ldongs rdzu pas ma (0byin na/ /myur du dam tshig de nyams so / /dam tshig dam tshig can mthong na/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang byas te/ /des (shekyang g.yon pa brkyang ba yisam)/ /rang gi nu ma rab bsdams na/ /mgo bos g.yon du 'dud byas nas/ /phyag byed bde ba dris pa yin/ /lag pa g.yon pa dkur brten na/ /de yis phyag ni byas par 'gyur/ /g.yon pa mgo ru gzhag 6)pa yi/ /g.yon du 'dud pas phyag lan no/ /g.yon gyi smin ma bskyod pa yis/ /myur du phyag ni byas par 'gyur/ /sbyor ba shin tu brtson pa yis / /g.yas kyi smin 7mas phyag lan bya/ /g.yas kyi lag pas snying ga (9ru/ /sbyor dang 37ldan pas mnye byas na/ /'di ni rdo rje slob dpon mchog /de yi mtshan mar shes par bya/ /g.yon gyi khro mo bsgreng 7ba yi/ /nam zhig de ltar bstan byas na/ /lus che de ni khros gyur (1zhes/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rtags zhes ⑫bya / /g.yon du 'gying ba 12bsgyings pa yiyi/ /lag pa snying gar 7brkyang bya ste/ /dbang mo gyen du rnam bstan na/ /de tshe mdza' bar rab tu brtag /chung ngu rtse mor byas pa yi/ /nam zhig bskyod pa mthong ba na/ /de tshe rig ma rnal 'byor dbang / /rdo rje pad+mo rtsen 7par 'dod/ /sbom po nam zhig mthong 'gyur na / /de la ston mo sbyin par bya/ /gang tshe shin tu mthor ston na/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal rab tu brtag /khro mo lcags kyu 'dra byas te/ /gang tshe sngags mkhan 83—950

gyis bstan na/ /de tshe nges par 'o byas tezhiste/ /gzhan du na ni dmyal bar ltung / /de nyid rnam par bzlog pa ltar/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni ma bstan na/ /de tshe myur du 'gro byas te/ /gzhan du byas na dam tshig nyams/ /gzhan rnams kyi ni phyag rgya yis/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rnam bskul (min/ /las kyi sbyor ba shes pa yis/ /las de dag ni (0brtsam par bya/ / brda yi laphyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /'dren pa med pa'i yi ge ( kun/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rab tu brtag /rtag tu tsheg drag rnams 4)bral ba/ /'dren tshul rnal 'byor ma yi'o/ /oṃ ni thig ler bcas pa'i brdal/ /sbyor ba sngags 'dzin rnal 'byor brtag /de la sogs pa mtha' yas mchog /sbyor ba'i dkyil du brtag par bya/ /rdo rje pad+mo (8)mnyam par sbyor bas rjes su mnyes par byed pa dpal dam tshig ma zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po kun tu bzang po chen po yang kun tu rgyas 'debs pa'i ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rdo rje pha rol tu phyin ma'i gsang ba rnal 'byor ma chen mo thams cad kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes 'di nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /rdo rje thal mo mnyam gzhag sgyurasteyi / /sbom po skyil yinamo bcing bar bya/ /khro mo gnyis ni sbyar bya ste/ /lhag ma 'od bzhin gtang tsobar bya/ /snying gar (//phyag rgya 'di bzhag yinas/ /thams cad las ni rab sbyar teli/ /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du/ /gdon mi za ba'i dngos grub byed/ /thal mo de gnyis mnyam sbyar te/ /mchog dang rdo rje mnyam du sbyar/ /chung ngu gnyis kyang gdong sprad de/ /snying gar yide bzhin sbom po sbyar/ /'di yis rdo rje thams cad rnams/ /dam tshig 'jigs byed 83—951

rab mdzad cing / /sems can thams cad phan mdzad ma/ /de ni dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nyid las ni rdo rje dang / /mchog nyid bsgreng ①ba'i tshul byas te/ /rdo rje thal mo gnas pa yis/ /drang ba'i tshul gyis drangs byas na / /mi g.yeng de nas dngos grub bo/ /gnod byed yang dag ldan pa 'dis/ /rgyal ba mchog kyang 'dren 'gyur na/ /lha dang mi yi bu mo dag(mi /lha min la sogs smos ci dgos/ /ji ltar yid la 'dod pa bzhin/ /'di nyid kyis ni dngos grub ste/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa mnyam sbyor bas/ /mchog tu myur du 'dren par 'gyur/ /thal mo de nyid las byung khro/ /rtse mo yid tsam bkug byas te / /lhag (sum 'od zer rtse mo bzhin/ /des ni myos byed thob pa yin/ /'di ni bcings ma thag tu yang / /bde bar gshegs kyang dbang bsgyur na/ /yid las skyes pa 'dod chags can/ /gti mug chos gnas smos ci dgos/ /ci dgar 'dod chags sbyor ba yis/ /de yis las rnams byed 'gyur te/ /yang dag sbyor ba thams cad 'grub/ /sbyor dang mi ldan dngos grub med/ /snying gar (4)'di nyid kyis byas te/ /mgu ba'i sbyor ba bde chen pos/ /rgyal ba mchog ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /mchog gi (snye bcing ba (6)'di kun dang / /'di yis las rnams thams cad dang / /yid la bsam pa byed pa la'athob phan tshun du ni mgu byed cing / /mgu bas (gudangos grub myur du 'thob6)/ /rdo rje thal mo mnyam sbyar te/ /rdo rje bkug nas sbom por sbyar/ /lhag ma 'od kyi tshul du gtang 7/ /dga' byed mchog ni phyag rgya 'di/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu dngos grub 67'thob/ /rgyal srid nor dang 'bru yi rnams/ /de bzhin nor bu 'di dngos grub/ /de ni de ma thag tu yang / /lha dang lha min mchod par 'gyur/ /83—952

bdag nyid kyis ni 'di bcings te/ /mkhas pa yis ni dus mtshams phyir/ /gnas lngar rab tu sbyor ba yis/ /spyi bor dbang ni bskur byas na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi dbang / /de nas de ni nges par 'gyur/ /lo gcig tsam du mnyam sbyor ①bas/ /phan tshun du ②ni dbang bskur bas/ /khams gsum rab dgyes bdag po ru/ /blo ldan rdo rje mi g.yeng ①'gyur/ /de nyid 'khor lo bskor byas te/ /snying gar ④'khor lo bzhin du bskor/ /zla ba gcig tsam mnyam sbyor bas/ /'khor lo bskor ba rab tu bsgrub⑤/ /de nyid g.yon par rab sbyar te/ /rgyal mtshan tshul du yang dag spro/ /zhag bdun du ni mnyam gzhag pas/ /'jig rten du ni rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de nyid kha nas bgad par sbyar / /mnyam gzhag yizla ba gcig tsam gyis/ /las rnams thams cad rab grub pa/ /bgad ⑦pa tsam gyis byed par 'gyur/ /thal mo de nyid mnyam bzhag (kyeste / /rtse mo kha phyed rnam 5)bsgyur bas/ /sbom po ze bar rnam byas te/ /lo ma lhag ma rgyas par bya/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni bcings pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las rab tu grol/ /bsod nams chen pos ⑩byin rlob ste/ /bde byed thams cad grub par 'gyur/ /thal mo de nyid snying gar (nyasbyar/ /mchog dang khro mo (nyeganyis sbyar te/ /de gnyis tshigs dzistegasum rab tu dgug /sbom po skyil tsomo tsam du bya / /rnal 'byor dag tu sbyor ba yis/ /'di yis lizla ba gcig byas na/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal rjer/ /dpa' bo chen por de 'gyur ro/ /thal mo de nyid mnyam sbyar te/ /rang gi snying gar yibaskor bar bya/ /de nas sngags mkhan chos ston par/ /mi g.yeng sems kyis de 'gyur ro/ /sbom po lce yi tshul bzhag 6 7pas/ /de nyid khar ni rnam bzhag /shen/ /'jig rten kun gyi 83—953

thams cad dag /mdor na zhag bdun tsam gyis kyang / /dbyig tu)dang gser dang gos la sogs/ /bdud rtsi btung ba mchog gi rnams/ /'di yis thams cad 'phrog byed de/ /'grub par 'gyur bar (migadon mi za/ /thal mo de nyid mnyam sbyar te/ /mchog rab gnyis ni 'og tu gzhug /chung ngu gnyis dang sbom po gnyis/ /sbyar te snying gar ri rab tu gzhug /yid la dga' ba'i las rnams thams cad byed/ /sgyu ma'i mthu dang srid pa mthar byed pa/ /rtag tu blo ldan lo ni phyed gnyis kyis/ /khams gsum rgyal srid mthu chen thob par 'gyur / /thal mo de nyid mnyam sbyar te/ /rang gi ma mchu dbus nyid nas/ /sbom po ro 'thob tshul gyis ni/ /khro mo 'khor lo yang dag spro/ /zhag bdun du 6)ni bsgrims pa yis/ /'di yis khrag 'dren dngos grub ste/ /sha zas bza' ba las kun byed/ /thal mo nyid ni bcings byas nas(nye/ /rdo rje gnyis ni pad+mor 6)sbyor / / sbom po'i 7bur ni sbrel nas kyang / /chung ngu gnyis kyang de bzhin te/ /mgrin pa nas ni rtse mo brkyang na// /thams cad las ni sbyar byas te/ /'di yis gdug 9pa thams cad dag /rab tu sbyar bas 'jigs par 'gyur/ /thal mo de nyid mnyam gzhag nas/ /bcing ba dam pos bcing bar bya/ /sbom po gnyis ni nang du gzhug /khro mo gnyis kyang bskul bar bya/ /'di yis gdug pa thams cad dag /'dzums par rab tu byas par 'gyur/ /skad cig tu ni gnod 7byed de/ /de bzhin bsdus dang btsir /lhabar 'gyur/ /phyag rgya yi 'di yis rgyas btab pas/ /de ni 1 dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub chen po bdag po dang / /thams cad las don 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab pas/ /rim par myur du 'gro 'ong byed/ /lo gcig gi ni 83—954

sbyor ba yis/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub par byed/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kun gyi las thams cad byed pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma de dag thams cad rab tu mgu nas ngo mtshar du gyur te/ rnam par 'gyur bas gar mdzad cing / /hi hi zhes pas glu ru len/ /ha ha zhes pas rab tu mgu/ /ho ho zhes pas mnyes par byed/ /he he zhes pas 'bod par byed/ /hūṃ hūm̐ zhes pas gad par 6)byed/ /hā hā zhes pas skyod par byed/ /phaṭa phaṭa zhes pas gsod ( par byed/ /hūm̐ rtsu zhes pas phur bus 'debs/ /dzā dzā zhes pas 'dren par byed/ /sa sa zhes pas dam par byed/ /dge ba dbang phyug gang ro mchog /rdzu r+ghaṃ zhes pas gsod par byed/ /hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hūm̐ ③④/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas 'bar bar byed / / hūm̐ hūm̐ (gezhes pas gzi brjid byed/ /tro tri zhes pas 'dren par byed / /traṃ traṃ zhes pas mchod par byed/ /dngos grub thams cad 'bras bu smin / / hre hre yizhes pas rmongs par byed/ /ཿdh+ri (7zhes pas 'dzums par byed / /hro hro zhes pas 'dren par byed/ / hūm̐ hūm̐ (shezhes pas 'phyan par byed/ /hre hro zhes pas rmongs par byed/ / hra hra (9)zhes pas gnon par byed/ /ho ho zhes pas mnyes par byed/ /haṃ haṃ zhes pas srung 7bar byed/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas gsod par byed/ /hu hu zhes pas mgu bar byed/ / traṃ traṃ zhes pas bdug par byeda'onya / / r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ 7zhes pas phreng bar byed/ /gi gi zhes pas dri /nyeru byed/ /ram̐ ro zhes pas brgyal yi/bar byed/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi li'akhor lo'i tshogs rnams 'ango mtshar cher gyur/ / rmad du byung ba chen por gyur te/ rang gi sems mgu bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 83—955

kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje'i bdag po kun tu bzang po chen po la phyag 'tshal 6)te gsol ba 'debs so/ /gnyis med mchog tu rmad byung ba/ /bcom ldan de nyid bshad du gsol/ /gang gis sems can grub pa 'di/ /gsang ba sbas pa grub par 'gyur/ /gar dang glu dang bzhad pa che/ /sgeg (mimo rol pa bde ba mchog /sil snyan gling bu rnam (bsna tshogs/ /brdab dang rgyud rnams rab 'byor pa/ /gsang rgyud cho ga'i rim pa rnams/ /rdzu 'phrul blo yi che ba che/ /dngos grub thams cad grub pa yis/ /sngags rgyal khyod kyis bshad du gsol / /de nas bcom ldan sangs rgyas rnams/ /thams cad bdag po rgyal po che / /thog ma med nas spyod rmad byung / /sna tshogs chen po rnam ④mi rtog /sna tshogs ye shes yon tan che/ /bla med chos kun dbang po ste/ rig dang sngags kyi bdag po che/ /de nyid chen po snying po mchog /blo rmongs phyag rgya rgyas 'debs (5)te/ /rgyas 'debs rmongs byed za ba po/ /gtong dang byed pa khyab pa che / / bskyod pa (6)sdig pa 'phrog par byed/ /sdig pa'i chos rnams sel bar byed / /dus ngan 'dod byed khros pa po/ /gti mug chos rjes 'debs par byed / /sa dang bar snang de bzhin bde/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pa la sbyin/ /tshangs dang gtogs 'dod dbang chen pos/ /de la phyag dang mchod par byed/ /de nyid skyong byed skyob pa po/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba bde ba che/ /zla gsang thig le las byung ba'i/ /sbas pa chen po gsang ba ston/ /nyid kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje / /bde ba chen po 'byin (7mdzad do(8)/ /skal ldan nye bar longs spyod kun/ /bud med thams cad dbang du byed/ /rang 'byung mtshan du thig le ste/ /bcu gsum dra ba dbu ru ldan/ /'di yis bud med bskyed 99)byas te/ /sa bon gyis 843—956

ni rgyal po 'du/ /'od zer gzi brjid 'bar ba can/ /rang las myu gur 'dra ba yis6)/ /'og gi phyogs su gzhag ②pa ni/ /hre ②byas myur du drang ④bar bya/ /dang po drang ba gnyis drangs pas⑤/ /tsheg 6)drag des ni lcags kyu byas/ /lha dang lha min mchog gi bdag /khams gsum thams cad drang bar byed/ /'di yi tshitshul gyis sbyor ba yis(nya/ /phan tshun du ni bsgrubs ⑨byas nas/ /rmad byung rnam pa sna tshogs kyikyi/ /dngos grub byed pa sbyin par byed/ /bdag nyid rang bzhin mthong bar bya/ /sbyor ldan zla ba'i gzugs nyid du/ /de ste sa bon gzhag par bya/ /de nyid de nyid thabs kyis (nyaganas/ /sngags kyi sbyor ba rab sbyor bas/ /de nas sngags mkhan der 'grub bo/ /de nyid sngags dang snying po dang ske/ /phyag rgya rig dang mi ldan pasaspyi/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' yang //'grub pa nyid du yong mi 'gyur/ /de nyid nang du sbyar byas na/ /snying po snying gar (stesbyor ba yis/ /phyag rgya phyag rgyas sbyar bar byayi/ /sngags dang sngags kyi 'bru bsgoms te/ /rig ma rig ma nyid du sbyar/ /'di yis myur du dngos grub ste / /mgyogs par 'gro ba rab tu 'grub/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sa chen tsopor/ /'byung dang 'byung las 'gyur ba nye/ /rnal 'byor 'byor don sgrub pa po/ /dpa' bo chen po 'gro 'ong byed/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rab tu mgu rangs par gyur yite/ rdo rje'i dbyangs 'di bsgrags /nyeso/ /kye ma'o kun tu bzang po yi/ /rdo rje'i theg pa bla na med/ /bshad pa gsang ba zhes bgyi (nyab/ /de nyid don du bsgrub 4)pa ste/ /snying po phyag rgya dam tshig ni/ /sngags rig rang gi lhanyid de/ /bdag gi de nyid ji bzhin pa/ /gsang ba rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor dang ni dam tshig dang / /gsang ba 83—957

sbas pa de nyid de/ /'jig rten gsum gyis 'dud pa'i rim/ /dpa' bo chen pos rab tu bsgrags①/ /rdo rje pad+mo ②rnam mdzad pas/ /rig ma dang ni lhan cig rtsen / /gdug pa thams cad mnye bya skyidang / /dam la zhe sdang bza' ba dang ske/ /slob dpon smod la bsgral ba dang / /gzungs ma'i bdag por bsgrub pa (9dang / /sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed bya dang / /rab dgyes bdag nyid bskul ba dang / /sdig pa thams cad sbyang ba dang / /bud med thams cad 'dod bya dang / /bdud rnams thams cad drang bya dang / /rdo rje kun tu gzhug bya dang / /pad+mo'i 67gnas ni dgang bya dang / /bsgrub ⑦dang nye bar bsgrub ⑧pa dang —/ /shin tu sbyor dang sbyor che ba/ /sbyor ba rab sbyor sbyor skye ba/ /de rnams de nyid mkhyen pa po517/ /bde ba chen po 7nyid kyis (nyagasungs/ /bsgrub ⑫pa yi ni sbyor che ba/ /sbyor dang sbyor mar yang dag sbyor/ /de nyid gsal bar sems dpa' che/ /phan par dgongs pa nyid kyis gsungs(ste/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba'i mdo rjes su dris pa/rang gi thugs la bzhag miste/ nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ba / sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig ni/ /kun du sbyor ba mnyam par tsoldan/ /de nyid phyag rgya chen po 7ste/ /ye shes lnga yis rjes su bskyed/rte/ /dkyil 'khor phyag rgya bzhi pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen pos rjes su bsgrubs3nye/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed mdzad de/ /kye ma'o bde ba rnam par 'byung / /snying po ye shes zhes 67bya ste / /ye shes bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /phyag rgya ye shes phyag rgya che/ /dam tshig mchog ni rig ma'o/ /sngags kyi yi ge tshul 'dra ba/ /yi ge'i phyag rgya don chen sbyin / /'di yis bsgrub pa byas pa'i gzungs me/ /bdag gi de nyid lha de nyid//83—958

de dag de nyid ci bzhin par/ /nga yis gsang ba rab tu bsgrags6)/ /dam tshig ma yin mi shes la/ /sngags rig pas ni bstan mi bya/ /phyag rgya thams cad gsang bya ste/ /dam tshig rgyas 'debs gsang ba yin/ /de nyid lha yi sbyor ba ni / /gsang ba gsang ba rab tu bsgrub(gyi/ /rdo rje pad+mo (kyernam stimadzad pas/ /rol pa phyi nang sbyor ba yis/ /rig dang lhan cig rtsen (5)bya ba/ /sprod (6)pa dang ni 'khyud pa dang / /de bzhin mchu ni so yis gzung tsa)/ /rdo rje brtan (nyapa gzhug par bya/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi tshul gyis ni/ /bskyod cing rnam par gar bya'o/ /gdug pa thams cad mnye bya ste/ /nu 5)ma mchan khung mkhur tshos ⑩gnyis / /'gram pa dang ni brla gnyis rgyab/ /rkang pa lag pa 'jam po gnyis/ / mnye ba'i (1sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /mdza' ba chen po de 'grub bo/ /'dod pa'i don gyi bar gcod dang / /dam la zhe sdang bza' ba dang / /zhe snang can gyis zos yo 'gyur ba/ /khyad par gzhan dang gzhan yang bza'/ /rtag par mi phyogs smra ba dang / /bla ma smod rnams tunyebasgral bar bya8/ /sha dang khrag dang klad 7pa ⑩rnams/ /drangs te tshogs kyi tshonamachod par bya/ /'di ni gsang ba drag po ste/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod pa dang / /bla ma smod byed brtson pa la/ /dam tshig phyir ni bsgrub par bya/ /gti mug de ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal ba yang 'thob 'gyur te/ /thams cad nad dang khros chen dang / /'jigs byed nye bar 'tshe ba yis/ /bskal pa grangs med bye ba ru/ /sdug bsngal chen po sten tsho byed cing / /'o dod 'bod par sbrul gyi bdag /bstir yinamed chen po brlag par 'gro/ /lus ngag sems ni bde dam pa/ /rig ma kun la bskyod byas te/ /byang chub chen po bde ba yisas ri/ /tshul bzhin du ni 83—959

bsngags par bya/ /bskul ba'i snying po 'di smras te/ /dzaḥdhizhes skad cig skad cig tu/ /rang gi gnas nas gnas pa yis/ /de nyid las ②ni bskyod par bya/ /bcu drug cha dang yang dag ldan/ /zla ba gsang ba'i thig le la/ /me tog dang ni 'dra ba nyid/ /rlung gis phul ba bskyod ①par bya/ /de ni bskyod pas 'grub pa ste/ /de bzhin du yang bskul bar bya/ /rgyun gyi phreng ni 'od gsal bzhin/ /blo ldan rtag tu bsgrub par bya/ /bdud rnams thams cad 'dren pa ni/ /lha mo rnams ni snying por bshad/ /zhags pa'i tshul gyis gzhug pa dang / /de bzhin dgang ba bcing ba'o/ /bsgrub ④pa lha yi sbyor ba ste/ /rjes su sgrub ⑤pa lha mo'i don / /sgrub yipa chen po gnyi ga'i rgya/ /mnyam par sbyor ba rdo rje'i mchog /nye bar sgrub ⑦pa gnyi ga gnas/ /shin tu sgrub 98)pa bde dam pa/ /so yi rtse mos mchu bzung lho)ste/ /ma mchu mchog ni bsdam par bya/ /sbyor ba rab sbyor skal ldan pa'i/ /rab dgyes ro myang ⑩bde dam pa/ /lha dang lha nyid yang dag sbyor/ /'di ni gnyis su med ces bya/ /snying po phyag rgya sngags rig gisayi/ /nyid kyi gzugs ni bsgrub bya ste/ /bdag ni sems dpa'o ⑩zhes bsams na/ /'di ni gnyis dzimed myur du 'gyur/ /gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa'i lha'i/ /dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /sbyor dang rab sbyor sbyor che ba/ /rgyal ba kun gyi mchog gis chagasungs/ /bcom ldan rdo rje sbyor ba ste/ /rab tu sbyor ba mkha' la 'gro/ /phyag rgya de dag skirab sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba chen po bsgrags pa yin / /'di yis dpa' bo thams cad dang / /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /sbyor ba'i dbang po bde ba che/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'thob par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya 'di yis rgyas btab na/ /rdo rje'i bdag po chen 7por 'gyur/ /mnyam 83—960

par sbyor ba sbyar 6)ba yis/ /'jig rten gsum po myur du rgyal/ /yang dag sbyor ba sbyar ②tshul gyis/ /drangs te rab tu bcug nas kyang / /rdo rje brtan pos bskul byas te/ /shin tu 'dod pas 'dod pa bskyedaphyi/ /mkha' 'gro thams cad thabs mkhas ldan/ /rgyas dang de bzhin zag par bya/ /'di ni yang dag sbyor ba sbas(pe/ /sbas pa rnal byor ma dkyil lo/ /'di yis yang dag dngos grub blang / /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'bras bu ⑤'thob/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bde che dang / /byang chub mchog rab yang dag 'thob/ /gsang ba chen po rmad 'byung (6)ba/ /de dag de nyid sbas pa che/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dris pa'i rgya/ /nga yis yang dag rab tu bstan/ /gang gis dzo)yang dag ldan mthong ⑧dang / /bdag po chen po mchod byed na/ /de yis ston pa kun mthong ste/ /rgyal ba mchog la mchod par 'gyur/ /srid pa gcod pa por 'gyur te/ /'gro ba'i ston pa mchog 6)tu 'gyur/ /de la lha kun mchod byed cing / /skad cig skad cig phyag kyang byed/ /ji ltar ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /phan byed 'jig rten skyes gyur pa/ /sna tshogs ye shes rjes bsdus pas/ /rnal 'byor chen por de bzhin 'gyur/ /rang 7gis dam tshig bsrungs pa yis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde skye ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i 57sbyor ldan pas/ /dngos grub chen po des 'thob bo/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i mtshan btab 5snyel/ /cung zad mi 'grub yod med de/nye/ /phyag rgya kun gyi bde ba che/ /bdag nyid so sor rjes su 'grub/ /rab dgyes mtshan dang mdza' chen mo/ /ro dang reg pa'i che ba'i che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sbyor ba yis/ /dpyad mi dgos par 'grub par 'gyur/ /de nas de dag mgu 'gyur te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde che ba/ /sbyor ba 'dod pa'i 83—961

gzir 0)ba yis/ /sbyor ba chen pos mnyes par mdzad/ /ra ma ra ma sa ma ho ma hā satwa/ rab dgyes gdon mi za la bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /zla gsang thig ler yang dag ldan/ /bdag cag kun kyang dam tshig ste / /skal ldan dri med rab dgyes kyi/ /rnal 'byor ma snying mchog nyid du/ /sbyor chen ②nyid kyis rol pa mdzod/ /theg pa chen po bde che yi(kye/ /pad+mo ④rdo rje ⑤rin chen gyis/ /rnal 'byor ma kun dkyil 'khor du/ /rab dgyes longs spyod nyid 6)bsten mdzod77/ /bdag cag thams cad 2nyes bral te/ /gnod med de ni gser dang 'dra/ /de nyid thams cad grub chen po/ /rab dgyes bdag nyid nyid bsten mdzod/ /sprod 6)pa 'khyud pa sbas pa dang / /gzhug pa dang ni gtong ba'i mchog /'di ni sgyu tshima'i brtan pa yis/ /ded dpon rab tu brtag pa 11mdzod/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po kun du bzang pos 'dod pa thams cad nye bar longs spyod pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal zhes bya ba'i 'chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi sbas pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi tu shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i kun du 'khyud ⑩pa dang / sprod pa dang / gzhug pa dang / 'dren pa dang /rab tu bskul ba dang / mnye ba dang / thigs pa dang / tshor bar bya ba dang /bskyod pa dang / kun du bskyod pa dang / bcing ba'i rdo rje dang / pad+ma (7chen mo mnyam du sbyor ba la yang dag par zhugs te/ shin tu dgyes pa'i bde ba chen pos / bde bas kun du rgyas par mdzad cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / gzungs ma'i tshogs thams cad la bskyod yipa dang / rab tu dgyes 1 pa dang / rab tu rnam par 'byin cing shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde 83—962

ba'i mnyam pa yo)nyid kyi tshogs kyis nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad kun du rgyas par byas te gnas so/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma chen mo ②shin tu dgyes pa'i bdag nyid chen po de dag nyid mgu zhing bde bar gyur te/ kye ma'o bde ba bde ba che/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas ni mgu ba che/ /bde ba chen po rangs par 'gyur/ /kye ma'o bde ba bde ba che/ /bde ba nyid kyis ①phyag byed de/ byang chub sems dpa' sems chen po/ /mgu ba chen po'i bde dang ldan/ /kye ma'o bde ba bde ba che/ /'jigs shing skrag pas sdug ④par byed/ /khros pa chen po mkha' 'gro ma/ /rab tu mi bzad (5)dug dang 'dra/ /bde byed chen po'i rol pa yis/ /bde byed che la mchod par byed/ /skal ba chen po srin (6)mo dang / /bde byed bde bas rab rmongs (7pa/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung bde ldan pa'i/ /rgya chen (kyemachog gis mchod par byed/ /drag mo ponyechen mo ma lta bu/ /rab tu gtum pa me 'dra ba/ /'ongs nas bde byed chen mo 7yis/ /gtso bo mchog la mchod par byed / /lha dang lha mo thams cad kyang / /klu mo dang ni rta gdong yang / /'ongs nas bde ba sbyor ba yis/ /yid du 'ong bas tunyamachod par byed/ /de nas dbang po lha chen po/ /bdag nyid chen po lha yi lha/ /kye ma'o bde ba sna (gyetshogs nyid/ /sna tshogs sbyor ba bde ba che/ /mgu zhing rab tu rangs pa yis/ /lha yi lha ni sngon du 'gro/ /dpa' bo bde la phyag byas te/ /kye ma'o bde ba bde ba che/ /rang gi (gebade bas mngon mchod cing / /'jigs shing skrag pas tso mnyes par byed/ /tshad med rangs pa bzhad pa che/ /glu gar mchog tu ldan pa dang / /bza' dang bca' ba sha chen dang / /sil snyan phreng ba ro chen dang / /gling bu rgyud limangs ardza rnga dang / /pi wang ( pal kyig ha la le/ /stag (shedang 83—963

dpa' bo 'jigs pa dang / /zhi dang rmad 'byung 5)'jigs byed dang / /bdag dang khros dang spyan rgyas pas/ /skad cig skad cig mchod byed cing / /byed pa dang ni bzlog pa dang / /'phrog pa dang ni gzhug pa dang / / sid ces pa ②dang hūm̐ rtsu dang / /ha ha zhes pas mnyes byed cing / /rab dgyes bdag nyid bde ba yi(kye/ /rang gi chung mas mnyes par byed/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen po rab tu dgyes pa bde ba chen pos/ nam mkha' dang nam mkha'i skabs thams cad la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / rang rgyal dang nyan thos dang / rang bzhin gyis 'gag pa dang spyo/ ngo bo nyid med pa'i chos nyid kyi ye shes la gnas pa rnams shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba'i thabs dang / shes rab kyi bde bas bkug ste dbang bskur nas/ shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin la yang dag par 'jog (7pa dang / shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bde ba'i chos nyid kyi rgyal po rjes su skyong zhing mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams chen po ma lus pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams su rab tu gzigs pas gzigs nas/ 'jig rten dang / lhar bcas pa rnams la bde ba chen pos khyab par mdzad do5tsho/ /sems can dang rigs thams cad dang / gnas thams cad dang / spyod pa dang mi spyod par bcas pa dang / 'byung ba dang /'byung ba las gyur pa dang / sa'i 'og dang / phung po dang / khams dang /skye mched dang / bsags pa'i dbang po lnga dang / rnam par shes pa dang /shes bya dang / bdag dang / bdag gi dang / sna tshogs dang / sna tshogs ma yin pa dang / bus pa dang / rgan po dang / gzhon nu dang / bud med 83—964

dang / skyes pa dang / skyes pa ma yin pa dang / srog dang / rab tu zad pa dang / 'jigs pa dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / mig dang / rna ba dang /sna dang / lce dang / lus dang / yid dang / shes pa dang / mi shes pa dang / shes rab dang / thabs dang / khyab pa dang / khyab byed dang / zla ba dang / dbang chen dang / nyi ma dang / me dang / gshin rje dang / chu bdag dang / lus srul po dang / tshangs pa dang / gtogs 'dod dang /dbang phyug ①chen po dang / lha mo dang / skal ba dang ldan pa dang / skal ba ②dang mi ldan pa dang / dngos po dang / dngos po med pa dang / mtshan dang /rdo rje dang / pad+mo (kyedang / rin po che dang / ral gri dang / tho ba dang /dbyig pa dang / rtse gsum pa dang / 'khor lo dang (4)/ sbyor ba (snyedang /rab tu sbyor ba dang / stong pa dang / stong pa chen po dang / mchog tu stong pa dang / shin tu stong pa dang / stong pa rab tu stong pa dang / byang chub dang /byang chub kyi sems dang / yi ge dang / yi ge med pa dang / dra ba dang /lcug ma dang / cha dang / cha med pa dang / thig le dang / ro dang / ro chen po dang / yid la byed pa med pa dang / rtag pa dang / zhi ba dang / mi zad pa dang / thar pa dang / thar byed dang / grol ba dang / rigs pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa dang / nam mkha' dang / skabs dang /skabs med pa rnams la gcig tu stug por gyur te/ rnam par phye yinas mi snang ba'i tshul du gnas so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rimidang / thabs kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin ma 58)dang / rdo rje'i pha rol tu phyin ma rnams kyis/83—965

bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag po shin tu dgyes pa rdo rje gdon mi za ba chen po gsang ba chen po'i dgongs pa nges par 'grel pa chen po la ①phyag mdzad de/ mngon sum du yang dag par bskul nas ②dris pa/su ra ta s+t+waṃ ②ma si hobya/ /gang phyir 'dod pa bde ba che/ /gang gis 'dod las byang chub 'gyur/ /'dod chags bral ba ji ltar bde/ /gang gis zhe snang rdo rje che / /gang gis gti mug rgyal ba che/ /gang gis 'dod chags pad+mor ⑤'gyur/ /gang gis nga rgyal nam mkha'i bdag /gang gis phrag dog gdon mi za/ /byang chub sems ni ji ltar bde/ /gang gis bde byed mchod par 'gyur/ lke/mchod pa yis ni ji ltar 'grub/ /ji ltar gzungs dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /yi ge mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /bsnyen pa yis ni myur du 'grub/ /ji ltar gsang ba (6)mnyam sbyor bas/ /rmad du byung ba'i dbang bskur 'gyur/ /ji ltar pad+mo ⑦mnyam sbyor bas/ /dkyil 'khor rab tu zhugs par 'gyur/ /ji ltar dri chu byang chub dang / /khrag (snyedang snang mdzad chen po yis/ /dam tshig nyid du ji ltar 'gyur/ /ji ltar btung ba rab tu brtag /de nas bcom ldan 'das shin tu dgyes pa chen po'i bdag po kun du bzang po chen pos(9)/ rdo rje pha rol tu phyin ma'i gsang ba chen mo de dag thams cad la ngarang gi bde bas mnyes par byas te/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sbas pa chen po shin tu sbas pa/ mchog tu gsang ba'i (medris lan chen po nyid kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo / /ngan song gsum gyi 'jigs 1 byed du/ /sems can nyon mongs sdang byas 9nyapas/ /de phyir nga ni ñtsa)rdo rje che/ /zhe sdang zhes ni bsgrags pa yin7/ /ngan song 'jigs pa chen po ru//83—966

sems can thams cad rmongs byed pas/ /de phyir 'di ni gti mug ste/ /rtag pa thub pa mchog yin no/ /thabs dang shes rab tshul nyid kyis/ /'gro ba thams cad dga' byed cing / /pad+mo'i 0)tshul du rab rtogs phyir/ /de phyir 'dod chags zhes bya'o/ /bde chen sbyin pa'i sprin gyis ni/ /sems can thams cad nga rgyal bskyed②/ /nam mkha'i bde ba bsdus pa'i (5)phyir/ /de phyir mkha' chen nga rgyal yin/ /ro la sogs pas (4)mnyam sbyor bas/ /phrag dog rdo rje gdon mi za/ /sna tshogs pad+mo ⑤rab 'jug phyir/ /de yi phyir ni sna tshogs che/ /'dod chags bral ba dga' med phyir/ /bdag ni rab dgyes sbas pa che/ /'dod pa ma gtogs (7bde byed med/ /bde che 'dod pa nga yin no/ /'dod chags med par byang chub med/ /byang chub med na'ang 'dod chags med/ /sdig pa'i nang na chags bral te/ /sangs rgyas bde mchog mnyes byed pas/ /'dod chags 'dod las bde byed kyi/ /bde ba mchog tu rmad 'byung (7)'gyur/ /byang chub sems med bde byed gzhan/ /'jig rten gsum po 'dir med do/ /thams cad byang chub sems ngo bo(8)/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim par 'gyur/ /bo (9stezhes pa ni rdo rjer bshad/ /dhi zhes pa ni gzungs ma'i mchog /ci 7zhes pa ni zag par bshad/ /ta zhes pa ni bde ba che/ /mchod pa med pas bde byed med / /bde ba med pas mgu ba med/ /mgu bas dngos grub thob par 'gyur / /grub na bde byed rtag pa yi/zhe/ /phyag na rdo rje bde ba che/ /'dod pa'i bde bas mchod byed cing / /tshe 'di nyid la 'thob kyi par 'gyur/ /bde ba kun gyi (gegazhir gyur pa'ikho/ /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam par 'dzin/ /rdo rje 'dzin phyir gzungs ma ste/ /trī skozhes pa ni pad+mo ri 'dzin/ /'di dang mnyam 83—967

par sbyor ba yinatu)/ /yi ge myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /'dod pa ⑧lnga yi yon tan kun/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi (9sprul pa ste/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rdo rje 'dzin / /mkha' 'gro sgyu ma'i longs spyod de/ /de phyir 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /de yis bsnyen na grub par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi sku 'dzin dpal dang ldan/ /dbang phyug mchog gis sngags rgyal lo/ /rdo rje sems kyi thugs las skyes/ /mtshan can mchog tu sbas par bshad/ /de dang mnyam du spyod pa ④yis/ /mchog gi dbang ni bskur bar 'gyur/ /pad+mo'i (snyedakyil 'khor zhes bya bas6)/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad sgrub par byed/ /blo ldan de ru zhugs gyur na'o⑦/ /dam tshig sbas pa tshogs kyi rnams/ /dri chu byang chub dmar po ⑧mchog /sha chen sbrang rtsi mar nyid kyis/ /lus la kun tu khyab gnas te/ /de yi po)phyir ni dam tshig che/ /dam tshig 'di yis dngos grub ste/ /dam tshig yi ger ldan pa yis/ /sbyor ces sbyang dang bskyed byas na/ / bza' ba 7dngos grub thob (nyapar 'gyur/ /de nas pha rol phyin ma kun/ /pad+mo'i tsogazigs pa rgyas pa yi7/ /'dzum bcas g.yon nas gar mdzad cing / /rtag pa la ni yang gsol pa/ /rigs de yirnam pa du ru bstan/ /ji ltar sbas pa gsum zhes bgyi/ /sna tshogs chen po de dag kun / /bde la gnas pas bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gnyis su med pa'i mnyam pa nyid kyi bde ba chen po zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sdi nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba pha rol tu phyin ma'i de kho na nyid rab tu phyung ngo / /nga 7nyid sbyor ba bcom ldan 'das / /rdo rje sems dpa' don chen sbyin/ /rigs kyi khyad par lnga rnams 83—968

kyis / /spyod bcas mi spyod rnams la rol/ /rtag pa mi bskyod ①rin chen mchog /'jig dbang gdon mi za grub rnams/ /rigs ni rnam pa brgyad bstan te/ /mdo ru bsdus na rnam pa lnga/ /lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis//khyad par theg pa rnam pa gsum/ /de nyid gsum po rdo rje mnga'/ /bde ba'i gnas la rol pa mdzad/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchog tu ngo mtshar du gyur ②te/ me rang gi sdom pa gsol ba 'debs so/ /sdom pa dngos grub kun sbyin pa/ /brtul zhugs dka' ②thub sngags mkhan gyidu/ /dam tshig mchog tu bsrung ba (snyernams/ /bcom ldan gsang ba nyid kyis rjogasungs / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kun tu bzang po chen po stimachog tu shin tu dgyes pa'i bde ba la mngon par chags pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab pas ⑧mkhyen te/ zhal rab tu bzhad pas rgyas 9)nas nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje lus 'di phyung ngo / /sku dang gsung dang thugs sbas pas/ /nan tan du ni bsrung bar bya/ /bsrungs pa yis ⑩ni bsod nams che / /dngos grub shin tu skye bar 'gyur/ /de ni 'di yis rgya che ba'i/ /yid kyis kha dog dbyibs tunyechen gyi/ /phyag rgya bcings la sogs pas btab/ /sbas pa'i sku ni rab bsgrub bya/ /rdo rje gsung du rab sbyor bar(gye/ /chos kyi ngo bo phyag rgyas tunyebarjod/ /ngag sbas gsang bar brjod pa ni/ /nga ro sbas 8pa rdo rje'i gsung / /rang sems rab tu 'bigs pa yis/ /zla ba rdo rje rnam par bsgomatso/ /rang bzhin gsum po gcig tu bsgomatso/ /'di ni yid sbas chen po yin/ /'di ni de nyid rgya chen mchog /rgyun du bsgom 7pa rnams tunyebyas te/ /gsum bsgoms tu pas ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /gzhan min rdo rje 'dzin gyis gsungs/ /83—969

sbas gsum la sogs cho ga yis/ /phyag rgya thams cad rgyas btab ste/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis6)/ /sbas gsum rnam par sba bar bya/ /rdo rje mchog 'dzin chen po dang / /gtso bo (2)chen pos byin gyis rlob/ /blun ①po gang gis 'das byas na/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'ang ri skad cig 'jig /sems dpa' che (5)dang bral gyur 67na/ /ngan song gsum du yang dang yang / /ji tsam nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor ba/ /shin tu mi bzad smin par 'gyur/ /de nas dam tshig de dag kun/ /rdo rje 'dzin la mgu gyur te/ /'jam po'i phyag gis ji zhigar mdzad cing / /g.yon gyis phyag byas slar gsol pa/ /gar dbang rnam gnon gnon par nagar mdzad cing / /mtha' yas phyag ni bcu pa'i bsgyings pa yis/ /pad+mo'i 9lo ma 'jam po brgyad phye (7nas/ /gnyis min bde bar rdo rje 'jog mdzad de/ /sbas pa de nyid mi mnyam sad par 'gyur(1/ /rdo rje 'dam yi skyes zla ba yang dag 'du/ /thabs dang shes rab dgyes pa bde byed sogs/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sbas pa nyid kyis nyi shod/ /sbyor dang sbyor min kha yang dag sbyor//zhi ba'i thal mo mchog tu bde/ /'dod pa lnga yi yon tan 'grub/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrubs tshapa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan dam tshig rgyal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che/ /de nyid sbas pa bskul ba yis/ /sbas pa ma lus 'chad par mdzodas/ /rdo rje pad+mo 7mnyam sbyor bas/ /cho gar ldan pas gang yo snyedabang bskur/ /bde bar 'dod pa'i slob dpon gyis/ /de nyid 'di ni de la 07bstan / /'di la khrus med nyes ‘ pa med/ /dka' thub med de dka' ba'ang med / /sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /nga 21nyid sbyor bas 'grub par 'gyur / /lus dang ngag sems rdo rje yi na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'gyur/ /843—970

rdo rje dbab pa skyes gyur 6)na/ /ji tsam 'dod pa nam mkhar ②'phur/ /snying gar ①rdo rje khu tshur bcings/ /rdo rje lta bas rnam bltas ④te/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bsnyen byas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' skad cig 'gyur/ /rnam sgeg dgyes pa'i rnam gnon pas/ /rab dgyes sar ni 'gro byed de/ /sangs rgyas bde ba chen po dang / /grub pa yis kyang mchod byed cing / /rdo rje sems dpa'i rgya che mchog /'gying ba'i langs ⑤pas gar byed pas/ /bde byed zla ba'i 'od 'dra zhing / /las kyi khyad par las ⑥sogs gnon/ /sbas pa'i gar gyis gar byas pas / /sbas pa sbyor ba'i bdag nyid 'grub/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor gar byed cing / /lag pa mang po rnam bsgyur dang / /phyir brkyang dbyings 9)su ldan pa dang / /khro bar dri med lta ba yis/ /gdul dka' gnon dupa 'jigs byed pa'i / /'jig rten gsum po rnam rgyal 'gyur/ /me 'bar nyi ma'i dbus nyid du / /khro bo hūm̐ mdzad bsgom 6)byas na/ /myur du 'jig rten don bsgrub kyiphyir/ /'jig rten gsum po rnam rgyal 'gyur/ /lha mo bzhi dang mnyam sbyor bas/ /su ra ta s+t+waṃ zhes smra zhing / /ha ra thig le tshul sbyar na/ /rab dgyes de ma thag tu 'gyur / /rab dgyes mchog tu brtag pa yis41/ /sa chen rnal 'byor 'gro 'gyur te/ /lha mo bzhi dang 'grogs pa yis she/ /sems can rnams kyi don kun byed / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad bde ba chen po la phyag bzhes nas gsol pa/ thal mo yang dag sbyar tsho byas te/ /phyag rgya de nyid nyid kyis shod/ /rdo rje mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bde ba'i bdag nyid mchod pa yishod/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri che dang / /ro zhudang reg pa yid 'ong ba'/ /thugs rje chen pos bsgrubs pa yis/ /dpa' bo chen po nyid kyis shod/ /de 83—971

nas bcom ldan bde byed che/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag po che/ /phyag rgya bcings pa 0)bde ba che/ /de nyid mchog ni bshad par mdzad/ /dang po chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ /gnyis pa dam tshig phyag rgya yin/ /gsum pa phyag rgya chen po ste/ /bzhi pa las kyi phyag rgyar bshad/ /de nas sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ /ji ltar 'gying ②bzhin bsgom (8)bya ba/ /sna tshogs ye shes rjes su dag /sna tshogs chen pos 'chad par mdzad/ /rtag pa'i sku ni ser po ste/ /mi bskyod rdo rje dkar po yin / /nam mkha'i snying po mthing ga ( riche/ /tshe dpag med pa pad+mo ⑤dmar/ /sna tshogs kha dog rgya che mchog /'od zer phreng ba rmad byung ba'iyi/ /gdon mi za ba rdo rje che/ /don chen byed pa bsam (7par bya/ /rang rang rigs kyi gnas nyid du/ /myur du nam mkha' (gyi'agro byed cing / /rigs kyi lha mo bzhi rnams kyis / /rol pa dang ni mchod par byed/ /sna tshogs sbyor ba bde che ba'i/ /lha mo bzhi dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sbyor bdag bsgom 6)byas na/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' mchog /rdo rje la sogs gdan zhugs 7par/ /rang gi 'khor lo mchog gis yinyabargyan/ /rang gi phyag rgyar gnas par bsam/ /pad+mo'i tsho gdan gyi tshul gyis ni/ /brtse dang ldan pa'i bsgom 1 byas te/ /snying po sbas don gar byas pas/ /sbas pa che la bde byed na/ /'gying ba'i bde bar ldan pa yi/ /rdo rje chen po de 'grub ste/ /sna tshogs dkyil 'khor rab nye bar0)/ /sna tshogs chen po 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bde ba chen po thams cad 'grub pa'i 7sbyor ba chen po'i bde ba zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya rab tu rgyas pe'o// //de nas phyag rgya bcing mibashad de/ /rtag la sogs pa'i de kho na/ /gang 843—972

wā /dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/71༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī māṃ rak+ta ya mā ri tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/gshin rje mthar byed dmar po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa bdag med pa'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /de la mgrin par dam 'khyud de/ /rang nyid sems can ched zhus pa/ /kye rdo rjer gsungs pa dang / /thar pa de bzhin sdom par yang / /'dus pa la sogs rgyud du yang / /slar yang ches mang du gsungs kyang / /sems can bsam pa yongs rdzogs byed/ /da ni bdag gis rab bshad bya/ /kha cig rgyal srid 'dod pa dang / /tshe ring nad med 'bras bu sbyin/ /zhi ba la sogs las rgyas pa/ /gang yang mngon par spyod pa dang / /dgra yi sde nyams byed pa dang / /skrod dang 'gugs dang gsod 83—1015

pa yang / /sna tshogs rgyud rnams su gsungs kyang / /sna tshogs rgyud du ma brjod pa'i / /'khrul 'khor 'jig rten gsum rnyed dka'/ /khyod la phan pa'i skyes kyi phyiral/ /bshad bya lha mo gus bcas nyon/ /'khrul 'khor gang gi mthu stobs kyis / /rtag tu rgyal srid thob pa dang / /ji srid nyi ma zla ba bzhin/ /gal te 'tsho bar 'dod pa dang / /khu ba rengs dang sde 'gugs dang / /mkha' spyod nyid dang mchog tu myur/ /deng 'dir ming gi spyod yul du/ /de yi sman ni bshad par bya/ /dang por byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis par snying rje de bzhin no/ /gsum par dga' ba bsgom par bya/ /bzhi par btang snyoms rnam bsgom bya/ /'jig rten chos rnams brgyad po ni/ /yongs btang stong par bsam par bya/ /slar yang stong nyid byang chub ste/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu / /bzhi par yi ge dgod pa'o/ /ra yig las byung nyi ma la/ /hūṃ byung sna tshogs rdo rje'o/ /de nyid kyis ni rdo rje yi/ /ra ba zhes dang de bzhin du/ /sa gzhi rdo rje 'ching ba'o/ /dang por stong par bsgom par bya/ /de nas yi ge e dmar po yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ dmar po'o/ /de'i steng du brlan dang bcas pa'i mgo bos brgyan pa'i dbyug pa'i dbus su rtsu yig dmar po'o/ /der yang nyi ma la hūm̐ yig go/ /de las nges par byung ba'i 'od zer rnams kyis nam mkha'i phyogs su dpa' bo'i gzugs de la 'jig rten gsum po thams cad bsdus nas slar yang de nyid du bcug ste/dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i gzugs su bdag nyid bsam par bya'o/ /sku mdog dmar po g.yon brkyang zhing rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal mche ba gtsigs pa / ljags 'dril ba 'jigs par byed pa/ klu brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/803—1016

dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ rked pa'i phyogs su stag gi pags pa 'dzag pas rnam par brgyan pa/ mi'u thung gsus pa 'phyang zhing 'jigs pa/spyan gsum pa shin tu 'jigs par byed pa dmar po 'bar ba'i rgyun mi zad pa 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'khrugs pa/ g.yon par sred med kyi bu la sogs pa'i khrag gis gang ba'i mi'i thod pa dang / g.yas par bdud bzhi rnam par 'joms par byed pa'i dbyug pa dkar po dang klu'i rgyan la sogs pas spras pa/rdo rje ro langs mas phrag par 'khyud pa/ 'dod chags chen po gcig tu nges par rgyas pa/ rje btsun gyi rang bzhin ji lta ba de bzhin du rje btsun ma yang ste mgo bo skam po'i rgyan gyis khyad par du byas pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dang bcas pa 'dzag pa'i mgo bo'i rgyan yang ste/ ska rags 'og pag sa kyang grol bar gyur pa'o/ /ma he dmar po la gnas pa'i g.yon brkyang gi zhabs kyis bzhugs pa'o / /phyi nas bcom ldan 'das las skyes pa'i rtse gsum pa'i dbyug pa dkar po'i dbus su slar yang sa bon kha dog dmar por bsam par bya'o/ /phyi nas bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo rje yang hūm̐ yig las skyes pa'o/ /slar yang bcom ldan 'das ma'i gsang ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa sbal mig 'gyus tsam dang bcas pa āḥyig gis rdzogs par mtshan pa'o/ /de'i rjes su gsang sngags rgyal ba'i bdag nyid can ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3rta/lte ba'i 'og tu brjod pa de 'dab ma brgyad pa kha dog dmar po'o/ /der yi ge hrīḥdamar po nges par son pa'o/ /spyi bor son pa'i re khā dkar po slar yang bsam par bya zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu la gzhug par bya'o/ /slar yang rdo rje'i lam der son par blo bzang pos bsam par bya'o/ /phan tshun gnyis gnyis 83—1017

snyoms par zhugs pas ro mnyam pa'i sa bon gyi gzugs can no/ /sa bon de lha mo bzhis rang bzhin las bslang ba ni/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi rnams na gnas pa'i lha mo thams cad yid gtsigs pas rang gi bdag po la blta zhing bslang ba'i ched du glu'i mchod pa byed par blta'o/ /thugs rje'i khro bo rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /sa gsum mtha' dag rmongs pa sol mdzod cig /rdo rje tsartsi kā yis so/ /jo bo bdud bzhi po ni las rgyal ba/ /sems ni g.yengs so rje btsun nyid bzhengs shig /phag mo yis so/ /'jig rten mgron gnyer stong nyid bzhugs sam ci/ /rje btsun 'jig rten bsod nams nyid kyis bzhengs/ /dbyangs can ma yis so/ /byang chub rang bzhin 'jig rten mgron gnyer nas/ /khyod nyid stong nyid sems shing ci la bzhugs/ /gi rī yis so/ /rab tu sad par byas nas slar yang de la rab tu bzhugs so/ /de nas der khu ba las byung ba'i bdag nyid lha'i bdag nyid can ma he dmar po la gnas pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa ban dhu ma'i me tog lta bu drag po zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis pa mche ba rnam par gtsigs pas mi bzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/sma ra dmar ser 'jigs par byed pa/ mi'u thung gsus pa 'phyang zhing 'jigs pa / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ ljags 'dril zhing khrag 'dzag pa/smin ma 'khyog cing drag tu bzhad pa/ mgo bos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po g.yas pa'i phyag gis 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas myos byed dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid dang mnyam pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i zhabs kyis gnas pa/ ma he'i rgyab nas gshin rje 'jigs shing bsdigs par mdzad pa/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa can/ klu brgyad kyis rnam par 843—1()18

brgyan pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba dbu la bcings pa/ mgo bo'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can gyi lha'o/ /rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa ni bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs dang kha dog 'dra ba la gri gug dang thod pa can phyag rgya lngas rnam par brgyan pa'i lus can mar brtson pa'i sems kyis bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas nga rgyal byas na bdag nyid grub par 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /de nas badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3rta gis gsang sngags bklag par bya'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das mas rjes su chags pa chen pos yan lag dang nying lag thams cad rnam par bltas nas pad+mar rdo rje gsor te gnyis ma'i stag lpags kyi na bza' 'phyar bar bsgom par bya'o/ /de la 'di dag rjes su chags par byed do zhes byas nas rdo rje pad+ma dag sems la byin nas hūṃ yig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rtse mor oṃ yig ser pos byin gyis brlabs pa rab tu bsgom par bya'o/ /āḥyig dmar pos pad+ma de'i ze'u 'bru la āḥyig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3nya zhes bklags nas/ rdo rje pad+ma mnyam par sbyor ba las bzhengs par bdag nyid bsgom par bya ste/ phyi rol gyi gnyis gnyis bzhin no/ /de nas 'pho ba'i gnas skabs na bdag nyid du bsgoms pa'i lha mo'i pad+ma'i khongs su dus mnyam par 'dzag pa'i khams gnyis 'dres par bsgom par bya'o/ /dkar po dang dmar po de dag yongs su gyur pas gti mug gshin rje'i gshed la sogs pa rnams bdag nyid ji lta ba bzhin du pad+ma'i dbus su bsams nas bcom ldan 'das ma las skye bar bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu de rnams mdun du bltas nas rang rang gi gnas su so sor gnas par bsam par bya'o/ /de nas shar gyi 83—1019

'dab ma'i nyi ma la gti mug gshin rje'i gshed tsartsi kā nag mos 'khyud pa'o/ /lho'i 'dab ma'i nyi ma la phra ma gshin rje'i gshed ser po phag mo ser mos 'khyud pa ste de yang phag pa'i gdong pa can no/ /nub kyi 'dab ma'i nyi ma la 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dbyangs can ma dkar mo dang sbyor ba'o/ /byang gi 'dab ma'i nyi ma la phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed sngo bsangs gi rī ma dang snyoms par 'jug pa'o/ /yang na thams cad kyang gshin rje'i gshed dmar po dang ske/ ro langs ma dang mtshungs par bsgom par bya'o/ /me ru mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam sbyar bas gang ba'o/ /bden bral du gser gyi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba'o / /de bzhin du rlung du byi ru'i bum pa sih+las gang ba'o/ /dbang ldan du dngul gyi bum pa ga pur gyis gang ba ji lta ba bzhin no/ /thod pa gang ba bltas nas nyi ma dang zla ba kun rdzogs pa dag la'o/ /'di nyid bde ba chen po dang zung du 'jug pa mchog las gzhan pa ma yin pa'o/ /de nas rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang / nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig las skyes pa de'i 'od zer rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la mchod pa kun gyis mchod nas/ dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥzhes pas bden par dgug pa dang / gzhug pa la sogs pa dang mchod par bya'o/ /sems can rnams thams cad bla ma'i man ngag ji lta ba las so zhes pas rnal 'byor gnyis so/ /des na phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs rnams blo dang ldan pas snga ma bzhin du bkug nas mchod cing dbang bskur ba la sogs pa rnams so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang spyan ma la sogs pa rnams kyis kun tu dga' ba'i thugs kyis sna tshogs par gyur pa'i glu la sogs pa dang gar gyis bdud rtsi lnga yis gang ba'i bum pa rnams kyis dbang 83—1020

bskur bzhin du/ dbang bskur rin chen chen po la/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /zhes gsung zhing bstod pas/ dkyil 'khor ba thams cad kyi dbu la khu ba steng du byung ba las/ rdo rje sems dpas rgyas btab par bsam mo/ /zhes pa yang dag par skyed pa'i cho ga'o/ /gti mug dang / phra ma dang /'dod chags dang / phrag dog rnams kyis/ gsol ba 'debs par byed pa ni/kye kye gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ /bla ma srin po'i gzugs rang bzhin/ /kho bos khyod mthong rnam par 'jigs/ /bla ma khro bo'i rang bzhin spongs/ /khyod kyis gar mdzad sa stengs dang / /sa bla dang ni sa 'og g.yo/ /chags pas brgyan pa'i khro bo yi/ /gar mdzad khyod ni ro langs lags/ /sku ni sbom thung dmar po ste/ /rnam pa sna tshogs sku sprul pa/ /rdo rje dbyangs can ma yis btud / /gar mdzad khyod ni bde ba che/ /hrīḥthiḥgasang sngags dag gis ni/ /khyod ni sa gsum 'khrul pa sel/ /rje btsun snying rje'i khro bo lags/ /gar mdzad khyod ni 'gro la gzigs/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā ba ād+ma ko3lha zhes so/ /de nas sngar bzhin du rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du oṃ yig yongs su gyur pa'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gsum gyi steng du āḥyig yongs su gyur pa las thod pa bsgom par bya'o zhes so/ /de'i dbus su bdud rtsi lnga dang / sgron ma lnga dang / zho dang / 'o ma dang /sha dang / nya la sogs pa dbyug pas dkrugs pas ro mnyam par byas la tshos nas rgya skyegs kyi khu ba lta bur blta'o/ /oṃ āḥ/ zhes pa 'dis bsil bar gyur par byas nas rtsu yig yongs su gyur pa'i lce sbu gu can bsams nas btung bar 83—1021

bya'ol/ /rang rang gi kha yis ni lha mo'i kha ru sbyin par bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis kyang bsams nas kun tu spyad par bya'o/ /de nas bdud rtsi myongs pas yang dag par dgos par gyur nas phyi nas gsang sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /snying gar gnas pa'i sa bon dang mtshan ma bstan par byas nas gsang sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas ji srid 'dod par bsams nas bzlas par bya'o/ /ldang bar 'dod na rang gi lus kyi 'od zer gyis sems can gyi don byas nas thams cad bdag la rab tu bcug ste yid kyis gshin rje'i gshed lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor dag gis ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor gyi gnas skabs ni bdag nyid kyi gzugs lta bu rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gshin rje'i gshed du nga rgyal byed par brjod par bya ste/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa gshin rje'i gshed kho na nga'o zhes so/ /rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /rnal 'byor bzhi dang ldan pa 'dis thun gnyis kyis sam/ thun bzhis kyang rung ste/ da ltar mngon par 'dod pa'i dus su rtag tu yongs su rdzogs pa'i bar ji srid du'o/ /de nas 'bum phrag gi mthar mtshan thog thag tu bzlas par bya ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas las thams cad pa'i thab kyi cho gas mar dang sbrang rtsi dang me tog dmar pos stong phrag bcur sbyin sreg bya ste/ re re zhing gsang sngags bklags nas so/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na man+t+ra sidhisme de tī ti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas las thams cad pa'i dngos grub kyi gsang sngags 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dmar po zhes pa'i lha la sogs pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //83—1022

'dir bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag rgya che'i//dngos grub ji ltar 'gyur ba dang / /rnam pa ci yis bsgrub bya ba/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das gsung gsol/ /kha yis kha la 'o byas nas/ /phan tshun dam po yis ni 'khyud/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i gzugs kyis ni/ /dga' ma bshad par bya yis nyon/ /gar byed pa'i rnam pa'i rnal 'byor bdag nyid kyi gzugs gang yin pa/ bcom ldan 'das mchog tu rnam par ma chad par 'bab pa ste/dper na chu klung gi rgyun rab tu 'bab pa bzhin no/ /'dir ji srid du bsgoms pa las skyo na sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs gal te myur du grub par 'gyur gyi gzhan du ma yin no/ /ji srid du/ 'di'i dngos grub kyang phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kho na de'o/ /'di rnams kyang rnal 'byor goms pa kho nas thams cad sgrub par byed kyi gzhan du ma yin no/ /skyes bu'i goms pa'i sbyor bas thar pa'i don dang 'dod pa'i don byung ba dang ma byung ba dang sngon du gnas pa rnams rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang sangs rgyas nyid kyi dngos grub kyang skye ba 'di nyid la 'gyur ro/ /las thams cad yongs su spangs nas der son pa'i yid du gyur nas/ ji srid rang nyid 'ongs nas smra bar byed de/kye kye sgrub pa po mchog ci yin pa de stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas mchod yon byin nas phyag byas te dngos grub blang bar byas pa de sbyin par byed do/ /oṃ hrīḥstuḥbi kṛ tā na na ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas rdo rje ro langs ma sgrub par 'dod na/ rdo rje ro langs ma'i gzugs brnyan bya ste/ ras sam 'bras bu la bya'o/ /rje btsun gyi kha dog dang dbyibs mdun du yang dag par bzhag nas/83—1023

ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas te/ de dag rang rang so so'i gzugs ma 'dres pas kun tu mthong ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /ji srid du 'ongs nas sgrub pa po la 'khyud de smras pa/ kye sgrub pa po khyed kyi bka' bsgo ba ci lags/sgrub pa pos mchod yon byin nas smra bar bya ste/ bdag gi chung mar 'gyur ba'o zhes pas chung mar 'gyur ro/ /de la longs spyad pas gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs su grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ de ṣa ra ti ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha nu da nu da tru ṭa tru ṭa hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ yang na oṃ badz+ra bet+ta li ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa yan lag bzang mo bag mar blangs pas sam yang dag par bzung nas/ bskyed de skal ldan mar byas te/ dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor ma sngags kyi sgom pa'i tshul gyis yang dag par mchod de/ lag pa g.yon pas 'khyud la rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs su bsams nas ji srid du 'bar bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas de la bzung nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs su grub par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra bet+ta li dz+wa la hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gti mug gshin rje'i gshed sgrub par 'dod na/gti mug gshin rje'i gshed kyi cha lugs su byas nas g.yas pa dang cig shos kyi rkang pa'i mthil gyis pad+ma mnan te/ ji srid du kye sgrub pa po zhes bos nas bka' bsgo ba ci lags zhes smra bar byed pa dang / ci bgyi bar 'gyur zhes smra ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas brtsams te 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid kyang ster ro/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de bzhin du phra ma gshin rje'i gshed dang / 'dod chags gshin rje'i gshed/ phrag dog gshin rje'i gshed sgrub par 'dod na de bzhin nyid du 'bras bu srub pa'i gsang sngags 83—1024

ni / oṃ mo hā ya mān+ta kṛta ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ pi shun ya mān+ta kṛta ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ rā ga ya mān+ta kṛta ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ smin+t+ra ya mān+ta kṛta ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gti mug dga' ma sgrub par 'dod na gti mug dga' ma lta bu'i sngar brjod pa'i lha mo'i gzugs ma he la zhon pa bdag nyid dang lhan cig pa byas nas sngar bzhin du mnan te/ ji srid du 'ongs nas ci bgyi bar 'gyur ro zhes smra ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas brtsams nas sgrub pa po mngon par 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du phra ma dga' ma dang / 'dod chags dga' ma dang / phrag dog dga' ma bsgrub par bya'o / /de nas sngags ni/ oṃ mo hā ra ti ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūm̐ dzaḥ i pi shu nā ra ti ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha ju dzaḥ i rā gā ra ti ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūm̐ dzaḥ i khrin+t+ra ra ti ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /yang na/ oṃ badz+ra tsartsi ke ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha hūṃ dzaḥ de bzhin du/ badz+ra wā rā tī/ badz+ra swa ra swa snyi/ badz+ra gau rī zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin sgrub par 'dod na/ de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi dngos grub sgrub pa'i 'du shes kyis gnod sbyin gyi gzugs brnyan byas te/de mnan te bsgrub par bya'o/ /bka' bsgo ba thams cad phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin mo dang / klu dang / klu mo dang / yi dgas dang / yi dgas mo dang / sha za dang / sha za mo dang / lha dang /lha mo dang / mi dang / mi mo yang ngo / /gzhan yang mngon du bsgrub par byas te / oṃ hrīḥjiḥbi kṛ tā na na che ge mo sā dha ya sā dha ya rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas rdo rje dbyug pa sgrub par 'dod na/ skar ma 83—1025

rgyal la rdo rje'i dbyug pa shing las byung ba sor mo sum cu pa'i dbyug pa byas nas/ba byung lngas byugs te/ tsan+dan dang / me tog gi phreng bas nye bar mdzes par byas pa'am/ yang na gang zhig rtse mo ral gri'i tshul gyis bzung nas ji srid du 'bar bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas dbyug pa 'dzin par 'gyur te/ gshin rje'i gshed dang mtshungs par pha rol gnon to/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na badz+ra daṇ+ḍa dzā la ya dzā la ya hūm̐ tsū phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o / /de nas thod pa sgrub par 'dod na bdud 'joms pa'i gzugs thod pa sor mo sum cu so gnyis pa byas nas sngar bzhin du lag pa g.yon par bzhag ste/lag pa g.yas pas bkab nas ji srid du 'bar bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o / /'bras bu ni de lta bu kho na'o/ /sngags la ni/ ka pā lam̐ dzā la ya zhes pa khyad par ro/ /de nas dbyug pa'i phyag rgya bsgrub par bya ste/ de'i tshe lag pa g.yas pa khu tshur byas nas sdigs mdzub brkyang bar bya'o/ /de'i phyag rgya bcings nas ji srid du 'bar bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas gshin rje'i gshed kyi gzugs kyi dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /sngags la ni/ daṇ+ḍa mu t+t+waṃ dzā la ya/ zhes pa khyad par ro/ /'di ni 'dod pa lnga po thams cad la nye bar longs spyod pa nyid kyis thams cad bsgrub par bya'o zhes te/ ji ltar rnyed pa'i dam tshig gi rdzas bsam pa rab tu rdzogs pa'i don du bza' bar bya zhing /btung bar bya'o/ /yang nas yang du gang ci'ang rung / /de kun gdon mi za bar yang / /bza' bya thams cad btung bar bya/ /phud kun gshin rje'i gshed la dbul/ /zhes pa dngos grub chen po sgrub pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o / / //83—1026

de nas dngos grub phran tshegs sgrub par 'dod na/ de la zhi ba can la sogs pa bsgrub par bya ste/ gro ga la yang lan brgya rtsa brgyad du bsngags pa'i 'o mas rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo so so tha dad pa mngon par bri bar bya'o/ /de'i shar sgo nas brtsams te/ g.yas skor gyis yi ge bcu gnyis bri bar bya'o/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ dbus su chu'i sa bon baṃ yig bri bar bya ste / ro yig gnyis kyi kha sbyar la bsgrub bya'i ming de'i dbus su bri bar bya'o/ /phyi rol tu yi gis bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas kha sbyor du byas nas skud pa dkar pos dkris nas myos byed kyis dkris te brgya rtsa brgyad du byin gyis brlabs la 'o mas gang ba'i bum pa bcug ste/ sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /ji ltar 'byor ba'i mchod pa byas nas/ oṃ trīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na ba de ba dat+ta su shārnyi ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa bya ste zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten pa rnams kyi sdig pa dang nad la sogs pa nye bar 'tshe ba la grong gi phyogs bcu rnams su/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na a mu ka grwa ma su sarbo pa dra wa shārnyi ku ru ku ru he he ba dzi groṇ+ḍi grohā phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa 'dis lan bdun du byin gyis brlabs nas cho gas gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /phyi rol la sogs par mdun du byas te 'o mas sbags pa'i sbyin sreg grong gi dbus ji srid par byas na nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas rgyas par bya bar 'dod na sngar bzhin du rdo rje gnyis mngon par bris te/ yi ge bcu gnyis po rnams kyi dbus su bh+rūṃ yig dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje bri bar bya'o/ /de'i dbus su bsgrub bya'i po ṣa ṭa gnyis kha sbyar ba bri bar bya'o/ /phyi rol tu gur gum gyis gru bzhi pa'i ri mo 83—1027

gsum gyis bskor bar bya'o/ /de skud pa ser pos dkris nas brgya rtsa brgyad du mngon par bsngags te/ mar dang sbrang rtsis gang ba'i bum par bcug nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas sngags bzlas par bya ste/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na bh+rūṃ po ṣaṭa lha sbyin gyi puṣ+ṭi ku ru po ṣaṭa hūm̐ rtsu phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /ji srid du nor 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur gyi bar du'o/ /sngags bzlas pa'i bar ma chad par zho'i zan gyis sbyin sreg bya'o / /de nas dbang du byed par 'dod na sngar bzhin du 'khor lo gnyis la sen rtsi'i khu bas yi ge bcu gnyis po rnams mngon par bris te/ dbus su hrīḥyig ku ru kusa'i sa bon no/ /dbus su hoḥyig gnyis kha sbyar ba kun tu bri'o/ /phyi rol tu gru gsum pa'i ri mos bskor bar bya'o/ /de nas srad bu dmar pos kun tu dkris nas brgya rtsa brgyad du byin gyis brlabs la mar dang sbrang rtsis gang ba'i kham phor la rgya skyegs kyi khu bas bris te bcug nas ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas sngags bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbi kṛ tā na na hrīḥhoḥ lha sbyin gyis lha byin la/ wa sha mā na ya hoḥrgyu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ji srid dbang du gyur gyi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /sngags bzlas pa'i mthar ni lan tshwa dang lhan cig pa'i me tog kha dog dmar po'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /de nas gong bu dgug par sems na dur khrod kyi sol ba dang sa'i gzugs brnyan gyi dbus su sngags dang de nyid kyi ming snying gar bcug ste/ rkang pa'i mthe bos mnan nas bzlas pa bya ste/'di kho na bsgrub bya'i gong bu zhes ji srid du gong bu khugs par gyur gyi bar du bzlas par bya'o/ /sngags la ni/ wa sha mā na ya'i gnas su ā nar+sha ya hūṃ zhes pa dang / hoḥyig gi gnas su dzaḥzhes pa ni khyad par ro/ /oṃ mame marmā a bi 8(3—1028

bhā te oṃ tsartsi ke ha ra ha ra puk+ki mā ra ya mā ra ya che ge mo'i ched du dzaḥ i gi dhī re tsartsi ke pad+ma tsū sho ṇi ta t+pā ye gi tī re che ge mo la dzaḥ/ shing gcig gam/dur khrod dam/ ri bo ru/ lhor mngon par phyogs pas gcer bur byung nas brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas 'grub par the tshom med do/ /bcom ldan 'das sngags kyi cho ga ji lta bu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa / dben par gcig pu can du gyur pas rje btsun gyi bris sku rab tu gsal ba dang phyogs bcur gnas pa'i bla ma dang / sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du byas nas mi'i rus pa bcad pas/ khrag chen po dang ske/ bya rog gi khrag gis sor mo bcu gnyis pa'i rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i rnam pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rlung gi sa bon no/ /de'i khongs su dgra'i ming rnam par bcad pa dang bcas pa kha sbyar la/ bya rog gi mgrin pa la bcings nas gal te ma bgrol ba de'i tshe tshar gcod do/ /de'i tshe tshar ma chod na de la sa bon bcu gnyis bri bar bya'o/ /phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūṃ na na tā kṛ bi thiḥtrīḥ.i/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa byas nas stobs po che yis bdug pa byin nas gal te rgyun la bskur bar bya'o/ /gal te ma yin na khwa ta'i gshog pa la lan bdun du bsngags te khyim gyi sgo ru ming nas smos na 'phral du skrod par byed de de tshar gcod do/ /de bzhin du rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su tsha ba gsum dang /dug dang / ske tshe dang / rus pa chen po dang / bud shing gis me'i sa bon gyi dbus su rnam par bcad pa dang bcas pa'i ya yig gnyis kha sbyar la ṭha yig gnyis kyis phyi rol nas bskor te me'i shing gi me la gdung bar bya'o/ /de'i skad cig la bu dang chung ma dang bcas pa dang / 'khor dang bcas pa 'chi bar 83—1029

'gyur ro/ /gal te ma yin na mi'i rus pa sor bzhi pa la lan bdun du mngon par bsngags par byas nas dgra'i sgor sba bar byas na/ /de yi rigs 'joms par byed do/ /de bzhin nyid du sa bon bcu gnyis yongs su gyur pas rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su tsan+dan la 'tsho ba'i shing ngam/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i 'khri shing gis chu'i sa bon gyi dbus su'o/ /de nyid gnyis kyis kha sbyar la ṭha yig gnyis kyis phyi rol du bskor bar bya'o/ /brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i 'o mas snga ma bzhin du me tog dmar po 'bum phrag gcig gis rgyal po 'chi bar byed cing de las gzhan du yang rgyal po bran gyi dngos por mi 'gro ba/ /de'i tshe bdag nyid mtshams med pa lnga byed par 'gyur te nges pa'o/ /yang na shing se phra li kā'am/ de dang 'dra ba'i me tog dmar po rnams kyis so/ /de bzhin nyid du sa bon bcu gnyis kyis yongs su gang ba'i kham phor du bzhag nas bzlas par bya'o/ /lha dang / lha ma yin dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / sprul gdug pa dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang /gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / gdul dka' ba'i mi dang / mi bdag rgyal po la sogs pa rnams 'bangs dang 'bangs mo'i dngos por 'gro bar byed do/ /gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud du thun mong gi zhi ba can la sogs pa'i cho ga'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas mnga' bdag dam 'khyud cing / /tshems kyis ma mchu btsir mdzad nas / /sems can don phyir phan pa'i dngos/ /bdag med ma yis zhus pa ni/ /bcom ldan ji ltar sems can rnams/ /ji ltar rgyal po rnams su 'gyur/ /83—1030

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ngo ma chogs pa'i phyir lha mo khyod la bshad par bya'o/ /a yig dang ba yig dag las kyang gzhan du me tog bzhi la ba ṭi ka byed du bcug la skar ma rgyal la sa gsum po bsgrub par bya'o/ /rgyal rigs kyi rigs kyi khyim lnga ru gsang sngags stong phrag bzlas par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor ma'i rdo rje nyi mas rang gi sngags kyis bsang gtor dang / rang gi gsang sngags sgrub pa ni sngon du khri bzlas pa'i sgrub pa las so/ /gser dang / dngul dang /byi ru dang / be+e ḍūr+ya dang / mā li ka la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig byas nas/de bzhin du bcu'i cha shas kyi sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rdo rje'i sa la 'bad pa las slar yang ske/ rta baṃ rtsa paṃ raṃ/ phyogs rnams su rnam par gzhag par bya'o/ /dbus su rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa gsang sngags la brtson pa mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor pas gang sngags kyi lha'i bdag nyid rnams la nyer spyod lnga'i mchod pa rnams kyis dang / phyogs bzhir rdo rje thod pa rnams su yang dag par gang ba'i gtor ma byas te phyi rol tu phyogs kyi gtor ma bcu byas nas de bzhin du mchod sbyin gyi shing las byung ba'i dbyug pa rnams kyis bgegs la phur bus 'debs shing 'gying ba dang bcas pas gsang sngags klog pa'am/ phyi rol du yang de nyid kyi ngos bzhi'i phyi rol du i yo gri shri'i/ /gtor ma sbyin pa sngon du 'gro bas dril bu dkrol te/ de bzhin du klog par byed pa'i klog pa po dang /sgrub pa po bzhi yis gar byed pa la brtson pa'o/ /sha bkag pa'i phyir bza' ba ma yin pa med do zhes sā lu la sogs pa lnga bza'o/ /bsod nams rnam pa bzhi zhes shes par bya ste/ /dbye ba ji lta ba shes par bya 'o/ /yongs su gang ba'i thod pa ru chang gi btung ba cung zad bya'o/ /thab tu yang blo dang ldan pas sbyin sreg 83—1031

bya'ol/ /ji ltar gsang sngags mnyam par gzhag pas dpa' bo'i dbang po nyid bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas sbyin sreg 'bum phrag gcig byas na gal te 'dod na thun mong du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob bo/ /'di nyid kyis nyis 'gyur gyis 'gyur ba 'dir the tshom med do/ /de nas lha mos gsol pa/ phra mo'i rgyal srid thob pa la dgra 'byung ste/ thabs ches mang po ci zhig gis lha'i dbang po yid kyi shing rta yang dag par gang bar 'gro ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gal te snying rje dang ldan pas sems can gyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ba dang / gal te dge 'dun mchod pa'i tshogs kyi bza' bar bya ba yang rjes su nyin rer byed pa dang / de'i don yang bya ste sems can mchod par byas par 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi bsam gtan la brtson pas dang por dbang bskur bar bya ste/ rang gi snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'i gsang ba'i sngags rab tu sbyin par bya'o/ /thun mtshams gsum du gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa byin nas ji lta ba bzhin du bya'o/ /bya ba'i rang bzhin des sems can mchod pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /bkad sa lnga byas te/ gsang bar byas nas rang gi mchod sbyin gyi mthar gtor ma dbul bar bya'o/ /sngags kyi bsam gtan la brtson pas slob dpon bzhi dang rnal 'byor ma mang po dang ldan pas legs par dbang bskur bar yang bya'o/ /rgyan lnga dang ni yang dag ldan/ /rtag tu myos byed mang po dang / /gri gug dang ni thod par ldan/ /kun tu stag lpags sham thabs dang / /sā li rnams kyis kha bkang nas/ /kha nas kha yi nang du sbyin / /sgrub po gcig ni rgyan kun brgyan/ /g.yon pas dril bu dkrol byed cing ske/ /g.yas nyid rdo rje gsor bar byed/ /khru lnga yi ni tshad kyis ni/ /bris 83—1032

sku lnga po bri bya ste/ gti mug phra ma 'dod chags dang / /phrag dog kha dog dbye bas bri/ /dkar po ser dmar sngo bsangs rnams/ /rang rang gzugs kyis bri bar bya/ /dbus su gshin rje'i gshed bri'o/ /sngags la mchog tu gzhol ba yis / /sbrang chen snag tsha byas nas ni/ /mchog gi rus pas bri bar bya/ /a yig dang ni ba yig dag /'bum phrag bzhi po yang dag rdzogs/ /thab khung gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ /sbyin sreg sngags la mchog gzhol bas/ /phyi rol tu ni slob dpon gzhan/ /bzhi po rnams kyis de bzhin du/ /thab tu 'khrul 'khor gsum yang bya/ /phyi nas sa bon bcu gnyis dang / /de bzhin 'khor lo bcu gnyis la/ drug /sngags kyi sa bon bri bar bya/ /gro ga sor bcu drug nyid la'ang / /ming med kyi ni khrag nyid la/ /sen rtsi yis ni bsres pas sam/ /yang na rgya skyegs khu bas so/ /ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ /ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ /ya da yo ni rā ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha ni rā ma ya/ /lha mo gsang sngags rnyed dka' 'di / /bdag gis ngo ma chogs pas bshad/ /'di yi sngags kyi mthu stobs kyis / /bdag gis sangs rgyas nyid sgrub ste/ /'jig rten gsum gyi dbang phyug 'gror / /gsang sngags brtson pas sbyar byas na/ /sde dang bcas pa bar snang la / /'gro 'gyur 'di ni the tshom med/ /gshin rje'i gshed dmar rnal 'byor pa / /kha cig rtag tu dam tshig brtson/ /rigs lnga'i bsnyen pa ldan pas kyang / /'bum du bzlas pas bri bar bya/ /shar du byas pa'i bkad sa ru/ /kham phor gnyis kyi dbus su mar dang sbrang rtsis yang dag par gang ba la bzhag nas zho'i zan dang / yungs kur dkar po dang / lan tshwa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /nub kyi 'dab ma la de dang mtshungs pa'i kham phor la/ me tog dmar po dang / sen 83—1033

rtsi dang / rgya skyegs kyi khu ba bsres pas sbyin sreg bya'o/ /byang phyogs kyi 'dab ma la sbrang chen gyis gang ba'i kham phor la yang dag par bzhag nas thab khung gru gsum du shing sin+d+ra ka shu dang / shing saṃ ko tsa mthe ka dang / dug dang / ske tshe rnams kyis sbyin sreg bya'o/ /dgu yi bdag nyid can 'bad pas/ /dang por dam tshig byas nas ni/ /rgyan lnga yis ni brgyan pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma yang de dang mtshungs/ /sna tshogs rin chen rang bzhin brgyan/ /rnga yab dkar pos brgyan pa yi/ /rdo rje dril bu'i lag dag gis/ /yang nas yang du gtor ma sbyin / /ji ltar 'os pa'i yon phul bya/ /gang gis mnyes par 'gyur ba yin/ /dbus su'ang de dang mtshungs par bya/ /mtha' ru bzhi 'gyur du bya'o/ /dge 'dun bza' ba yang bya'o/ /dman dang zhan la rjes brtse ba/ /so sor bdag ni dam tshig mchod/ /shes rab bcas shing yon dang bcas/ /rigs ni lnga po rnams kyi ni/ /bsgrubs pa'i bza' ba de dag gis/ /me la sbyin sreg bya ba ste/ /blo bzang 'bad pas bzhag mi bya/ /dbyug gur bab pas de sgo bzhir/ /rnga bo che yi sgra bya'o/ /gang dang gang du sgra thos pa'i/ /pha rol sde ni rab bros nas/ /rna ba rnams ni dgas par byed/ /mig gis mthong bar mi byed cing / /sde rnams dbang du byed pa dang / /mgo la zug rngur 'gyur ba dang / /skyid pa dag ni byed pa yin/ /yang na bya'i gshog pa la bcings nas gtong bar bya ste/gang dang gang du 'gro ba de dang de nyid du pha rol gyi sde rnams ni rang gi chung ma yang yongs su dor nas smyo bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid g.yul la mchog tu gzhol bar 'gyur ro/ /glang po che rnams dang / rta la sogs pa rnams ldog ste bdag nyid kyi sde yis 'gro bar byed do/ /gang gi tshe sde las brgal ba'i g.yul 83—1034

byas nas dum bu dum bur ltung bar byed do/ /pho nya gcig pus gnas pas ji lta ba bzhin du 'tsho ba tsam gyis 'tsho bar byed do/ /de'i thal bas pha rol gyi sde'i rgyal mtshan rlung gis kun tu bskor bas sgrib par byed do/ /glo bur du glang po che'i tshad kyi rdo ba 'beb par byed do/ /char chen po 'beb par 'gyur ro/ /klu'i tshul gyi sgrub pas sbyin sreg 'bum gyis 'dod pa rnyed do/ /shi ba'i pha rol tu yang dgra bo de rnams 'bangs su 'gyur ro/ /'dis ni sum 'gyur gyis sa dang 'jig rten gsum la dbang byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas shing se pā li kā'i 'bras bu 'bum phrag gcig gis de'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud du dngos grub phran tshegs kyi las rab 'byams kyi le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das mas gsol pa/ de nas bha ga la rtags yang dag par sbyor ba'i khu ba 'di nu ma rab tu 'phel bar bya ba la nad nyams pa las dang /yid bud med kyi dbang du gyur pa med pa las dang / de 'ching bar byed pa las kyang khu ba yis nu ma la bsrung ba dang bskyab pa'i sbyor ba bshad du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ khyod kyis nga la zhus pa legs so zhes gnang nas/ dang por phung po sbyang bya ste/ /phyis nas rab 'byams las brtsam bya/ /'bras bu gsum gyi phye ma gzung / /ya bak+ṣa ra pā lā sha /zos nas bu ram 'thungs pa las/ /srin dang 'khogs pa rab tu 'joms/ /til mar kai ta ku'i khu ba/ /hi la mo tse'i khu ba dang / /rgyam tsha 'thungs shing byugs pa des / /drag mo shig rnams 'joms par 'gyur/ /til mar kai ta ku'i khu ba/ /83—1035
